      <title>Hopper: Gestionnaire principal(e) du marketing de performance B2B// Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Canada Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7113/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Montréal - Remote
</p>

<p><strong>À propos du poste</strong><br><br>HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions) est la division B2B de Hopper et propulse des solutions d'IA pour le voyage auprès de grandes compagnies aériennes, d'hôtels et d'institutions financières partout dans le monde. L'équipe Marketing et Communications recherche un(e) gestionnaire principal(e) du marketing de performance B2B pour diriger la croissance marketing de ses activités B2B sur les canaux numériques. L'équipe est restreinte et expérimentée, les responsabilités sont vastes, et on s'attend à ce que la personne retenue assume à la fois la stratégie et l'exécution.</p><p><strong>À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien</strong></p><ul><li><p>Piloter la stratégie de marketing numérique B2B de HTS en établissant les priorités de canaux, les budgets et les objectifs liés au pipeline et aux revenus</p></li><li><p>Planifier, lancer et optimiser des campagnes payantes sur LinkedIn, Google Ads et d'autres canaux numériques, de la définition des audiences et de la création jusqu'à la production de rapports</p></li><li><p>Concevoir et mener de bout en bout des programmes de génération de leads, en collaboration avec les Ventes pour définir la qualité des leads et l'améliorer continuellement</p></li><li><p>Assumer la responsabilité de LinkedIn payant comme canal B2B central : gérer le contenu sponsorisé (Sponsored Content), les formulaires de génération de leads (Lead Gen Forms) et le ciblage d'audiences de type ABM pour rejoindre les décideurs de haut niveau des compagnies aériennes, des hôtels et des institutions financières, et tester continuellement les créatifs et les formats pour améliorer la qualité des leads</p></li><li><p>Concevoir du contenu pour les campagnes numériques, y compris du contenu pour les médias sociaux, des annonces de recherche et plus encore</p></li><li><p>Réaliser des tests A/B sur le contenu et les formats publicitaires afin d'optimiser la génération de leads et la conversion</p></li><li><p>Tester et déployer à grande échelle de nouveaux canaux et de nouvelles tactiques, et savoir quand abandonner ce qui ne fonctionne pas</p></li><li><p>Suivre, analyser et rendre compte de la performance, notamment le coût par lead, les taux de conversion et la contribution au pipeline, et transformer les données en recommandations claires pour l'équipe</p></li><li><p>Collaborer avec les équipes Produit, Ventes, Affaires juridiques et Communications afin d'assurer la cohérence des messages et l'alignement des campagnes sur les priorités de l'entreprise</p></li><li><p>Privilégier la qualité plutôt que la quantité en optimisant les campagnes pour les leads qualifiés par les Ventes (SQL) plutôt que pour le volume brut, et en travaillant avec les Ventes pour affiner continuellement le ciblage, les messages et les critères de leads afin que les efforts marketing se traduisent en véritable pipeline</p></li><li><p>Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Marketing et Communications tout en jouissant d'un haut degré d'autonomie</p></li><li><p>Rendre compte de la performance numérique à la haute direction en traduisant les indicateurs de canal, comme le coût par lead, les taux de conversion et la contribution au pipeline, en constats et recommandations clairs qui orientent les investissements et la stratégie marketing</p></li><li><p>Collaborer avec les Ventes, la direction et l'équipe Marketing et Communications pour établir la stratégie et le processus de suivi des leads marketing tout au long du pipeline de vente</p></li><li><p>Fournir des analyses complètes sur l'influence des campagnes marketing sur la progression du pipeline et sur les revenus</p></li><li><p>Possibilité de soutenir, au fil du temps, la croissance auprès des partenaires existants au moyen de campagnes d'expansion et de lancements de produits conjoints avec les équipes partenaires et les Communications</p></li></ul><p><strong>Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède</strong></p><ul><li><p>Plus de 5 ans d'expérience éprouvée dans la gestion de programmes de marketing numérique B2B, avec des exemples clairs de campagnes menées de leur conception jusqu'à l'obtention de leads acceptés et jugés qualifiés par les Ventes</p></li><li><p>Expertise concrète de LinkedIn Ads et de Google Ads, avec une excellente maîtrise du ciblage, des enchères, des tests de créatifs et de l'optimisation</p></li><li><p>Maîtrise de HubSpot, de Salesforce et de GA4, avec la capacité de gérer le flux de leads, l'attribution et la production de rapports de performance sur l'ensemble de l'entonnoir</p></li><li><p>Aisance à travailler aux deux niveaux : vous savez définir la stratégie et aussi concevoir, lancer, gérer, optimiser et mesurer vous-même les campagnes</p></li><li><p>Solides compétences analytiques et aisance avec les outils de reporting, les CRM et les plateformes d'automatisation du marketing</p></li><li><p>Esprit d'initiative, avec la capacité d'établir vos priorités, de gérer votre charge de travail et de livrer sans supervision étroite</p></li><li><p>Excellentes habiletés de communication écrite et orale, et capacité de collaborer entre les équipes et avec des parties prenantes de haut niveau</p></li><li><p>Une expérience dans les secteurs de la technologie, du voyage ou dans des environnements B2B constitue un atout important</p></li><li><p>Aisance au sein d'une équipe restreinte et expérimentée où les responsabilités sont vastes et où aucune tâche n'est trop petite</p></li></ul><p><strong>Avantages sociaux</strong></p><ul><li><p>Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d'un régime d'options avant l'entrée en bourse</p></li><li><p>Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective</p></li><li><p>Hopper offre une couverture d'assurance vie, invalidité de courte durée et de longue durée</p></li><li><p>Un compte de dépenses santé qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles</p></li><li><p>Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue</p></li><li><p>Tous les employés ont accès à un régime de REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt</p></li><li><p>N'hésitez pas à nous poser des questions sur notre congé parental très généreux</p></li><li><p>Vacances illimitées</p></li><li><p>Allocation de voyage Carrot Cash</p></li><li><p>Accès à un espace de coworking à la demande via FlexDesk et une allocation pour le télétravail</p></li><li><p>Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites fait partie du quotidien</p></li><li><p>Communication ouverte avec la direction et les dirigeants de l'entreprise</p></li><li><p>De petites équipes dynamiques ayant un impact considérable</p></li></ul><p><strong>À propos de Hopper</strong><br><br>Chez Hopper, nous bâtissons la plateforme technologique de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale, et nous le faisons en résolvant de vrais problèmes pour de vrais voyageurs, partout sur la planète. Nos plateformes de réservation grand public Hopper et notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), travaillent en synergie pour offrir aux voyageurs transparence, flexibilité et de véritables économies à chaque séjour. Pour y parvenir, nous combinons d'immenses volumes de données et l'intelligence artificielle à des produits fintech exclusifs. Nous ne sommes pas simplement un moteur de réservation de plus : nous offrons une façon fondamentalement meilleure de planifier et de vivre le voyage pour nos clients et nos partenaires. Nous sommes la preuve que ce qui est avantageux pour le client l'est tout autant pour l'entreprise.</p><p>Et notre croissance s'accélère! L’application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois, et 70 % de nos utilisateurs appartiennent à la génération Z et aux millénariaux — les voyageurs de demain. Aujourd'hui, notre plus grand levier consiste à propulser les solutions de fintech de voyage, de commerce et de fidélisation pour les plus grandes marques de l’industrie. Notre premier partenariat HTS avec Capital One a permis de lancer un portail de voyage dédié aux titulaires de cartes de cette grande marque financière. Depuis, nous nous sommes associés aux plus grands noms du voyage et du secteur bancaire, notamment Air Canada, Uber, la Banque Royale du Canada (RBC) et Nubank, en alimentant aussi bien une simple intégration fintech ciblée qu'un portail complet de fidélisation voyage clé en main.</p><p>Voilà notre trajectoire : nous avons fait nos débuts comme une petite application novatrice dans l'univers du voyage, et nous sommes désormais le moteur sous le capot qui propulse la technologie du voyage mondial.</p><p>Ce que cela représente concrètement :</p><ul><li><p>Des milliards de dollars en voyages et en solutions fintech transitent chaque année par Hopper et HTS</p></li><li><p>Nos produits fintech, dont l'annulation sans motif (Cancel for Any Reason) et l'assistance en cas de perturbation (Disruption Assistance for Any Reason), affichent des taux de satisfaction client exceptionnels grâce à des conditions limpides et des résolutions instantanées, sans poser de questions</p></li><li><p>Près de 30 % des clients de l'application ajoutent un produit fintech à leur réservation, et ces clients sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de réserver à nouveau avec nous</p></li><li><p>HTS génère désormais plus de 90 % des activités de l'entreprise, démontrant la rapidité avec laquelle notre volet B2B s'est développé à grande échelle</p></li><li><p>Grâce à HTS, n'importe quel fournisseur de voyages (transporteurs aériens, hôtels, banques, agences de voyages) peut intégrer les solutions fintech, commerciales et d'IA de Hopper directement dans ses propres canaux, qu'il s'agisse d'une intégration spécifique ou d'un portail de voyage complet de bout en bout</p></li></ul><p>Venez décoller avec nous!<br>------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p><p><strong>About the Role</strong><br><br>HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions) is Hopper’s B2B division, powering travel AI solutions across leading airlines, hotels and financial institutions globally. The Marketing &amp; Communications team is looking for a Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager to lead growth marketing for its B2B business across digital channels. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the expectation is that the candidate handles both strategy and execution.</p><p><strong>What would your day-to-day look like</strong></p><ul><li><p>Own the B2B digital marketing strategy for HTS, setting channel priorities, budgets, and targets tied to pipeline and revenue</p></li><li><p>Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Ads, and other digital channels, from audience and creative through to reporting</p></li><li><p>Build and run lead generation programs end to end, working with Sales to define lead quality and keep improving it</p></li><li><p>Own paid LinkedIn as a core B2B channel, running Sponsored Content, Lead Gen Forms, and ABM-style audience targeting to reach senior decision-makers at airlines, hotels, and financial institutions, and continuously testing creative and formats to improve lead quality</p></li><li><p>Develop content for digital campaigns, including social content, search ads, and more</p></li><li><p>A/B test content and ad formats to optimize for lead generation and conversion</p></li><li><p>Test and scale new channels and tactics, and know when to cut what isn’t working</p></li><li><p>Track, analyze, and report on performance, including cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution, and turn the data into clear recommendations for the team</p></li><li><p>Partner with Product, Sales, Legal, and Communications to keep messaging consistent and campaigns aligned with business priorities</p></li><li><p>Drive quality over quantity, optimizing campaigns for sales-qualified leads (SQLs) rather than raw lead volume, and working with Sales to continuously refine targeting, messaging, and lead criteria so that marketing effort translates into real pipeline</p></li><li><p>Work closely with the Marketing &amp; Communications team while operating with a high degree of independence</p></li><li><p>Report on digital performance to senior leadership, translating channel metrics like cost per lead, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution into clear insights and recommendations that inform marketing investment and strategy</p></li><li><p>Work with sales, leadership and marketing comms to create strategy and process for tracking marketing leads through the entire sales pipeline</p></li><li><p>Provide comprehensive insights on how marketing campaigns influenced pipeline progression and revenue</p></li><li><p>Potential to support growth within existing partners over time, through expansion campaigns and joint product launches with partner teams and Comms</p></li></ul><p><strong>An ideal candidate has</strong></p><ul><li><p>5+ years of proven experience running B2B digital marketing programs, with clear examples of taking a campaign from inception to leads that Sales accepted and considered qualified</p></li><li><p>Hands-on expertise in LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, with strong command of targeting, bidding, creative testing, and optimization</p></li><li><p>Proficiency in HubSpot, Salesforce, and GA4, with the ability to manage lead flow, attribution, and performance reporting across the full funnel</p></li><li><p>Comfort working at both levels: you can set the strategy and also build, launch, manage, optimize, and report on the campaigns yourself</p></li><li><p>Strong analytical skills and fluency in reporting tools, CRM, and marketing automation platforms</p></li><li><p>A self-starter mindset, with the ability to prioritize, manage your own workload, and deliver without close oversight</p></li><li><p>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across teams and with senior stakeholders</p></li><li><p>Experience in tech, travel, or B2B environments is a strong asset</p></li><li><p>Comfort in a lean, senior team where ownership is broad and no task is beneath you</p></li></ul><p><strong>Perks and benefits of working with us</strong></p><ul><li><p>Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages</p></li><li><p>Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan</p></li><li><p>Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage</p></li><li><p>HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses</p></li><li><p>All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere</p></li><li><p>All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay</p></li><li><p>Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!</p></li><li><p>Unlimited PTO</p></li><li><p>Carrot Cash travel stipend</p></li><li><p>Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend</p></li><li><p>Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business</p></li><li><p>Open communication with management and company leadership</p></li><li><p>Small, dynamic teams = massive impact</p></li></ul><p><strong>About Hopper</strong><br><br>At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same.</p><p>And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.</p><p>That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.</p><p>What that looks like in practice:</p><ul><li><p>Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year</p></li><li><p>Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked</p></li><li><p>Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again</p></li><li><p>HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled</p></li><li><p>Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal</p></li></ul><p>Come take off with us!<br><br>#LI-Remote</p><p><em>At Hopper, we use AI-assisted tools to help our team review applications more efficiently. These tools screen and prioritize applications against the qualifications and experience listed in this posting. They do not make decisions: every decision about your application is made by a member of the Hopper team. For details on how we process candidate data and your rights, see our Candidate Privacy Notice.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hopper-gestionnaire-principal-e-du-marketing-de-performance-b2b-senior-b2b-performance-marketing-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hopper-gestionnaire-principal-e-du-marketing-de-performance-b2b-senior-b2b-performance-marketing-manager</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> England
</p>

<h2><strong>About Docker</strong></h2><p>Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. <a href="https://www.docker.com/resources/containers-are-the-new-supply-chain-attack-vector-on-demand-webinar/?at_exp=DO112.B0">Docker Hardened Images</a> form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud <a href="https://www.docker.com/products/docker-sandboxes/?at_exp=DO112.B0">Docker Sandboxes</a> isolate where agents run, and <a href="https://www.docker.com/products/ai-governance/?at_exp=DO112.B0">Docker AI Governance</a> sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control. </p><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2><p>As a Renewals Manager at Docker, you will be responsible for driving the renewal process for our customers, ensuring that they continue to see the value in our products and services. You will work closely with our Account Executives and customers to identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, and to negotiate and close renewal contracts.</p><p></p><p>A successful Renewals Manager at Docker will be able to build strong relationships with customers and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They will have a deep understanding of our products and services, and be able to articulate the value that we provide to our customers. They will be proactive and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously, while also being able to identify and prioritize opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.</p><p></p><p><strong>Please note: </strong>French and English language fluency is a requirement for this role.</p><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2><ul><li><p>Manage the renewal process for a portfolio of customers end-to-end, ensuring timely and accurate renewals.</p></li><li><p>Build strong relationships with customers, and identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.</p></li><li><p>Negotiate and close renewal contracts on time, working closely with Account Executives or independently.</p></li><li><p>Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, articulating the value that we provide to our customers.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that customer needs are met and issues are resolved.</p></li><li><p>Identify and mitigate churn risk early by taking ownership over outreach, data review and other signals</p></li><li><p>Maintain accurate forecasts and Salesforce hygiene according to provide clear visibility into risk and outcomes</p></li></ul><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li><p>Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.</p></li><li><p>4+ years of experience in a sales or account management role preferably in a SaaS company, but not required.</p></li><li><p>Experience working with Mid Market and Enterprise level accounts</p></li><li><p>Strong communication and negotiation skills.</p></li><li><p>Ability to build strong relationships with customers.</p></li><li><p>Proactive and able to manage multiple accounts simultaneously.</p></li><li><p>Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools is a plus.</p></li><li><p>French and English language fluency</p></li></ul><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><p><strong>What to expect in the first 30 days</strong></p><ul><li><p>Onboarding and training on Docker's products and services.</p></li><li><p>Introduction to the Renewals team and cross-functional teams.</p></li><li><p>Review of current customer portfolio and renewal pipeline.</p></li></ul><p><strong>What to expect in the first 90 days</strong></p><ul><li><p>Management of a portfolio of customers and renewals.</p></li><li><p>Identification and pursuit of upselling and cross-selling opportunities.</p></li><li><p>Collaboration with cross-functional teams to resolve customer issues and meet customer needs.</p></li></ul><p><strong>What to expect in the first year</strong></p><ul><li><p>Continued management of a portfolio of customers and renewals, with a focus on driving customer satisfaction and revenue growth.</p></li><li><p>Identification and pursuit of strategic opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.</p></li><li><p>Active participation in cross-functional projects to improve the customer experience.</p><p></p></li></ul><p><strong>Visa sponsorship: </strong>Not available for this role.</p><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><div>&nbsp;</div><h2><strong>Compensation &amp; Equity</strong></h2><p>All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.</p><div>&nbsp;</div><p><strong>Europe:</strong> €85.4K – €122K OTE</p><p>______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>Posting Information</strong></h2><ul><li><p><strong>Open vacancy: </strong>This posting is for an existing open role.</p></li><li><p><strong>AI in hiring: </strong>Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.</p></li><li><p><strong>Interview recordings: </strong>Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.</p></li></ul><p>______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>Perks &amp; Benefits</strong></h2><ul><li><p><strong>Remote-first by design</strong> – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.</p></li><li><p><strong>Flexibility that fits your life</strong> – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.</p></li><li><p><strong>Time to recharge</strong> – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.</p></li><li><p><strong>Home office support</strong> – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.</p></li><li><p><strong>Technology stipend</strong> – Equivalent to <strong>US$100 net per month</strong> to help support your work.</p></li><li><p><strong>Learning &amp; development</strong> – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.</p></li><li><p><strong>Parental leave</strong> – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.</p></li><li><p><strong>Equity for all full-time employees</strong> – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.</p></li><li><p><strong>Comprehensive benefits</strong> – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.</p></li><li><p><strong>Docker swag</strong> – Because representing the whale never gets old.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><em>Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.</em></p><p></p><p>#LI-REMOTE</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada
</p>

<h2><strong>About Docker</strong></h2><p>Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. <a href="https://www.docker.com/resources/containers-are-the-new-supply-chain-attack-vector-on-demand-webinar/?at_exp=DO112.B0">Docker Hardened Images</a> form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud <a href="https://www.docker.com/products/docker-sandboxes/?at_exp=DO112.B0">Docker Sandboxes</a> isolate where agents run, and <a href="https://www.docker.com/products/ai-governance/?at_exp=DO112.B0">Docker AI Governance</a> sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control. </p><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2><p>The <strong>Director, Developer Success Engineering</strong> leads the technical half of Docker's Developer Success team: the senior engineers who build the demos, Labspaces, workshops, tech talks and technical content that show developers what Docker can do. This role gives that team a leader who can go deep on the technology, raise the bar on technical quality, and grow senior engineers in their careers. It owns three outcomes:</p><p></p><ol><li><p><strong>Own Docker's technical story for developers.</strong> Demos, Labspaces, reference applications and content that make AI Governance, Sandboxes, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience easy to understand and adopt.</p></li><li><p><strong>Turn technical content into adoption and revenue.</strong> Equip customer-facing teams, Captains and partners with enablement that lands and expands accounts, and measure its impact.</p></li><li><p><strong>Be the developer's voice inside Docker.</strong> Bring hands-on feedback from developers, Captains and customers back to Product and Engineering so it shapes what Docker builds.</p></li></ol><p></p><p>You will be part of the DevRel team's mission for Docker to become the destination where current and future developers improve their craft, get support and find their community home. You report to the VP of Developer Success (DevRel &amp; Docs) and lead a team of four staff and principal engineers. You work side by side with the Director, Developer Success Programmes, whose team runs the community, Captain, influencer and partner programmes your team's technical work powers.</p><p></p><p>You'll be successful if you are an engineer at heart who loves building and explaining technology, and who wants to multiply that impact through a team. The FY27 centre of gravity is product adoption and revenue enablement, not awareness metrics alone.</p><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2><p><strong>Own Docker's technical story for developers</strong></p><ul><li><p>Set the technical content strategy for Developer Success, aligned with Docker's product priorities: agentic development with Sandboxes, AI Governance, Docker Hardened Images and the core Docker experience.</p></li><li><p>Own the developer-facing product narrative for Captain briefings and launches, so the team delivers most briefings and demos itself rather than relying on ad hoc presenters.</p></li><li><p>Lead the Labspaces catalogue as Docker's reusable demo and learning format: every strategic demo, briefing, talk and workshop is packaged once and reused across Captains, revenue, partners, events and Docs.</p></li><li><p>Set technical quality standards for demos, code samples, reference apps and tutorials, including how they are tested, kept current with fast-moving products, and retired.</p></li><li><p>Partner with Docs on hands-on learning content on <a href="http://docs.docker.com">docs.docker.com</a>, including the Learn experience.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Turn technical content into adoption and revenue</strong></p><ul><li><p>Scale the technical enablement content for customer-facing teams: tech talks, Docker Days, SDLC demos and workshops, prioritised with Revenue leadership on a regular cadence.</p></li><li><p>Equip Solutions Engineers, Professional Services, Captains and partners to deliver Docker's story themselves, with kits that cut their demo preparation time.</p></li><li><p>Track the impact of technical enablement on product adoption, pipeline and expansion ARR, and report it alongside the programmes team.</p></li><li><p>Bring the team's technical depth to tier-1 events, partner work and the community programmes run by the Developer Success Programmes team.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Be the developer's voice inside Docker</strong></p><ul><li><p>Build structured feedback loops from developers, Captains and customers into Product and Engineering, including pre-launch reviews of new features.</p></li><li><p>Test new products early, report friction in the developer experience, and follow it through to fixes.</p></li><li><p>Represent Docker credibly in technical forums: conference talks, open source communities, technical blogs and developer communities.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Lead the team</strong></p><ul><li><p>Lead and grow a team of senior developer advocates and engineers: set clear goals, give technical and career coaching, and build growth paths for senior individual contributors.</p></li><li><p>Balance the team's capacity between strategic content, revenue enablement and inbound requests through a clear intake and prioritisation process.</p></li><li><p>Hire to fill capability gaps as Docker's product portfolio grows.</p></li></ul><h2>_______________________________________________________________________</h2><p></p><h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2><ul><li><p>A software engineering background, with deep hands-on knowledge of containers, Docker and modern developer workflows. You can build and debug a demo yourself.</p></li><li><p>Working knowledge of AI and agentic development (LLMs, agents, MCP) and of software supply chain security. Experience in either is a strong plus.</p></li><li><p>Experience leading a team of senior engineers, developer advocates or solutions engineers, and a track record of growing senior individual contributors.</p></li><li><p>A strong technical public presence: conference talks, workshops, technical writing or open source contributions.</p></li><li><p>Experience building technical enablement for sales, solutions or customer success teams, and tying it to adoption or revenue outcomes.</p></li><li><p>Ability to build trusted relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and to influence roadmaps with evidence from developers.</p></li><li><p>Analytical and data-driven in how you prioritise and measure technical content and programmes.</p></li><li><p>Able to coordinate across many teams and perform in a fast-moving environment; self-directed, self-driven and able to prioritise strongly.</p></li><li><p>Strong verbal and written English communication skills.</p></li></ul><h2>_______________________________________________________________________</h2><p></p><h2><strong>What to expect</strong></h2><p><strong>First 30 days</strong></p><ul><li><p>Get to know each team member, their technical focus areas, current work and career goals.</p></li><li><p>Get hands-on with Docker's products, especially Sandboxes, AI Governance and Docker Hardened Images, and run the team's top Labspaces and demos yourself.</p></li><li><p>Meet key stakeholders in Product, Engineering, Revenue, Professional Services, Docs and the Developer Success Programmes team, and learn what they need from technical Developer Success.</p></li><li><p>Live the Docker culture: humility, developer obsession, open collaboration and a bias for considered action.</p></li></ul><p><strong>First 90 days</strong></p><ul><li><p>Set the team's technical content and enablement roadmap for the next two quarters, tied to product priorities and launch cadence.</p></li><li><p>Put in place an intake and prioritisation process with Revenue and Product so the team's capacity goes to the highest-impact work.</p></li><li><p>Agree the measures that link the team's work to adoption and revenue, such as Labspace usage by account and ARR influenced by tech talks.</p></li><li><p>Become a trusted technical partner to Product, Engineering and marketing leadership.</p></li></ul><p><strong>First year</strong></p><ul><li><p>Deliver a consistent, current catalogue of demos, Labspaces and talks that tells Docker's story across AI, security and developer productivity.</p></li><li><p>Show a measurable link from technical enablement to product adoption and expansion revenue.</p></li><li><p>Establish a regular feedback channel from developers and Captains that visibly influences Docker's product roadmap.</p></li><li><p>Grow a team of senior engineers and advocates with clear career paths, recognised internally and externally for technical excellence.</p></li><li><p>Help Docker succeed in its vision to increase the time developers spend on innovation and decrease the time they spend on everything else.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Visa sponsorship: </strong>Not available for this role.</p><p>_______________________________________________________________________</p><div>&nbsp;</div><h2><strong>Compensation &amp; Equity</strong></h2><p>All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.</p><div>&nbsp;</div><p><strong>Canada: </strong>CA$303,450 - CA$433,500 base</p><p><strong>United States:</strong> $218,750 - $375,000 base</p><p><strong>Europe: </strong>€149,100 - €213,000 base</p><p>______________________________________________________________________</p><p></p><h2><strong>Posting Information</strong></h2><ul><li><p><strong>Open vacancy: </strong>This posting is for an existing open role.</p></li><li><p><strong>AI in hiring: </strong>Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.</p></li><li><p><strong>Interview recordings: </strong>Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations.       <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7109/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United Kingdom
</p>

<p>Coder is the leading platform for AI development infrastructure, and we’re growing fast in EMEA. We’re looking for a demand generation marketer to help us build predictable, repeatable pipeline growth in the region.</p><p>You’ll own day-to-day execution of the EMEA programs that create, capture, and convert demand, across media sponsorships, paid campaigns, vendor channels, and in-region nurture. This is a hands-on role for someone who can manage multiple programs independently, keep them running on a consistent cadence, and turn performance data into clear recommendations on what to scale.</p><p>You’ll work closely with our International Marketing Lead to execute our go-to-market strategy in the EMEA market, and partner with the global Demand Gen lead, Paid Media Manager, Integrated Marketing, ABM, and SDR team to ensure every program reaches the right audience and turns into meaningful business results.</p><p></p><p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p><ul><li><p>Run day-to-day execution of EMEA sponsorships, vendor programs, and paid campaigns against the regional plan.</p></li><li><p>Own vendor relationships and program logistics, including timelines, deliverables, budgets, launches, and follow-up.</p></li><li><p>Research and recommend new EMEA channels, sponsorships, vendors, and campaign opportunities to test.</p></li><li><p>Partner with the Paid Media Manager to launch and optimize EMEA paid campaigns, from awareness through conversion and retargeting.</p></li><li><p>Partner with marketing ops to execute lifecycle and always-on nurture programs that move EMEA leads from MQL to opportunity.</p></li><li><p>Support ABM programs for EMEA target accounts</p></li><li><p>Partner with the SDR team to build EMEA lead follow-up plays to improve conversion rates, and use their feedback to refine targeting and programs.</p></li><li><p>Track program performance against pipeline goals (MQLs, meetings, sourced and influenced pipeline, cost per opportunity) and recommend where to optimize, scale, or stop.</p></li><li><p>Document processes and learnings so successful programs become repeatable playbooks for the region.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p><ul><li><p>Based in the UK.</p></li><li><p>4+ years of hands-on experience in B2B demand generation, digital marketing, paid media, or a related field.</p></li><li><p>Experience marketing in EMEA markets such as the UK and Germany.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing media sponsorships, paid advertising programs, or vendor-led campaigns across multiple channels, with a track record of getting more value from sponsorship budgets.</p></li><li><p>The ability to independently own programs from planning through execution and reporting.</p></li><li><p>Strong project management skills across multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders, and clear communication when things shift.</p></li><li><p>Comfort working with data. You can pull reports from tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, or HockeyStack, assess performance, and turn the numbers into actionable recommendations.</p></li><li><p>Experience partnering with sales or SDR teams to turn marketing programs into meetings and pipeline.</p></li><li><p>Curiosity about using AI tools and workflows to speed up processes, analysis, and execution.</p><p></p></li></ul><p><strong>Bonus tacos if you have</strong></p><ul><li><p>Experience with ABM, programmatic advertising, or intent platforms such as 6Sense, LinkedIn, CommonRoom, Vector.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing programs and workflows in tools such as Asana.</p></li><li><p>Experience marketing to developers, platform engineers, or other technical buyers.</p></li><li><p>Experience in B2C marketing or industries outside traditional B2B demand gen. We value people who bring ideas from different playbooks.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2><strong>About Coder</strong></h2><p>Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at <a href="http://coder.com">coder.com</a>.</p><p></p><h2><strong>Interview process&nbsp;</strong></h2><p>We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow.  Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders. </p><p></p><h2><strong>AI use during the interview process</strong></h2><p>As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.  </p><p><strong>Not permitted</strong>: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.</p><p><strong>Permitted</strong>: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.</p><p></p><h2><strong>Our use of AI in hiring</strong></h2><p>We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:</p><ul><li><p><strong>Ashby</strong> and <strong>Brainerr</strong> help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.</p></li><li><p><strong>Granola</strong> takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.</p></li></ul><p>All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.</p><p>In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for <a href="https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf">Ashby</a>.</p><p>If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact <a href="mailto:careers@coder.com">careers@coder.com</a>.</p><div>&nbsp;</div><h2><strong>Coder is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></h2><p>We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
</p>

<p>How do you reach people who don't want to be marketed to? You lead with value. That's our approach with developers and the platform and security leaders who buy Coder: ads that speak to the problems they're actually solving, like where their AI agents run, who governs them, and how to keep code and data under their control.</p><p>Coder is defining the <a href="https://coder.com/ai-operating-layer">AI Operating Layer</a>, and paid media is one of the main ways we take that story to market. As our Paid Media Manager, you'll own the strategy and performance of our always-on programs across LinkedIn, Google Search, YouTube, and newer platforms like ChatGPT ads, aimed at our enterprise and target accounts. The goal is better, not just more: every dollar should reach the right people, tell the right story, and turn into pipeline.</p><p>You'll direct our paid media agency and give them the Coder context they can't get on their own (ICP, positioning, target accounts, business goals). You're just as comfortable in execution as in strategy. You can audit accounts, fix what's broken, or jump in to launch campaigns, and you know what good looks like down to the platform settings.</p><p>You'll report to our Demand Generation lead and work closely with product marketing, design, web, marketing ops, ABM, regional marketing, and GTM engineering.</p><p></p><p><strong>What you'll do here</strong></p><ul><li><p>Own the strategy and performance of our paid channels: LinkedIn (sponsored content, document ads, thought leader ads, video and CTV), Google Search, YouTube, and ChatGPT ads.</p></li><li><p>Lead our paid media agency day-to-day. Set priorities, review launches and ad copy, and hold the work to clear timelines and results.</p></li><li><p>Regularly audit our ad accounts, including campaign structure, settings, audiences, conversion tracking, and spend, and jump in hands-on to build, restructure, or fix campaigns when needed.</p></li><li><p>Own budget allocation, forecasting, and monthly pacing across channels and regions. Recommend where to scale, cut, or pause based on pipeline quality, not just clicks.</p></li><li><p>Run a structured test-and-learn agenda across audiences, keywords and match types, offers, creative, formats, and new channels. Define the hypothesis up front and document what we learn.</p></li><li><p>Build targeting around our ICP and target account lists, including retargeting, exclusion audiences, and intent signals.</p></li><li><p>Tailor programs for NAMER, EMEA, and APAC and for priority verticals like financial services, partnering with regional marketing on what each market needs.</p></li><li><p>Partner with PMM and design to keep ad copy and creative current with our positioning, and share back what's resonating. Work with web on landing pages and conversion paths.</p></li><li><p>Own paid reporting: monthly readouts that connect spend to pipeline and revenue, with a clear point of view on what we should do next.</p></li><li><p>Deliver paid air cover for launches and key moments like AWS re:Invent.</p><p></p></li></ul><p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p><ul><li><p>5–7 years of paid media or performance marketing experience, including owning multi-channel paid strategy and budgets.</p></li><li><p>Deep hands-on expertise in LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Google Ads (Search and YouTube). You can build, restructure, and audit campaigns yourself, not just review an agency's work.</p></li><li><p>Experience managing agencies or vendors. You hold partners accountable to results and are still someone they want to work with.</p></li><li><p>A track record of owning and scaling meaningful budgets across multiple channels, including pacing, forecasting, and reallocation.</p></li><li><p>Experience leading global paid programs and adjusting strategy to align with each region's priorities and performance.</p></li><li><p>Comfort working with data. You can connect ad platform data with attribution and CRM tools like HockeyStack, HubSpot, or Salesforce, and turn it into decisions.</p></li><li><p>A strong grasp of B2B targeting and measurement: ICP, account lists, segmentation, retargeting, exclusions, and conversion tracking.</p></li><li><p>Strong project management skills across multiple campaigns, deadlines, and stakeholders, and clear communication when things shift.</p></li><li><p>Curiosity about using AI tools and workflows to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.</p><p></p></li></ul><p><strong>Bonus tacos if you have</strong></p><ul><li><p>Experience marketing to developers, platform engineers, or other technical buyers.</p></li><li><p>Experience with ABM or intent tools such as Vector, 6sense, Common Room, or HockeyStack.</p></li><li><p>Experience with emerging or programmatic channels like ChatGPT ads, CTV, StackAdapt, or Reddit.</p></li><li><p>Paid experience from B2C or other industries. We value people who bring ideas from different playbooks.</p><p></p></li></ul><p><strong>Our tech stack</strong></p><p>You don't need to know every tool on day one. This role works across LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, HockeyStack, HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Asana, and AI tools like Claude.</p><p></p><h2><strong>About Coder</strong></h2><p>Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. Coder provides self-hosted, agent-ready workspaces that unify developer productivity and platform governance. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at <a href="http://coder.com">coder.com</a>.</p><p></p><h2><strong>Interview process&nbsp;</strong></h2><p>We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow.  Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders. </p><p></p><h2><strong>AI use during the interview process</strong></h2><p>As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.  </p><p><strong>Not permitted</strong>: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.</p><p><strong>Permitted</strong>: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.</p><p></p><h2><strong>Our use of AI in hiring</strong></h2><p>We use AI tools to help manage our recruitment process efficiently and fairly. Specifically:</p><ul><li><p><strong>Ashby</strong> and <strong>Brainerr</strong> help us review inbound applications by surfacing candidates who best match the role requirements we've defined. This tool does not make hiring decisions; it helps our team prioritize which applications to review first.</p></li><li><p><strong>Granola</strong> takes notes during our interview calls so our team can focus on the conversation with you.</p></li></ul><p>All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.</p><p>In accordance with New York City Local Law 144, an independent bias audit has been conducted on "Automated Employment Decision Tools"; results are available for <a href="https://www.ashbyhq.com/downloadables/ashby-bias-audit-08-2024.pdf">Ashby</a>.</p><p>If you're applying for a role at Coder and have questions about how we use AI in our process, or if you'd like to request information about the data we collect, please contact <a href="mailto:careers@coder.com">careers@coder.com</a>.</p><div>&nbsp;</div><h2><strong>Coder is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></h2><p>We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coder-technologies-inc-paid-media-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/coder-technologies-inc-paid-media-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Tilt: Head of Growth, Tilt Mexico</title>
      <region>North America Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Mexico
</p>

<h1>Join the Tilt team</h1><p>At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide<strong>, </strong>we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.</p><h1><strong>The Opportunity: Head of Growth, Tilt Mexico</strong></h1><p>Mexico was Tilt's first market outside the US. Since 2022, our mobile-first personal loan has helped over 1 million customers access short-term credit on transparent, affordable terms. We now offer a 3-month installment loan and are rolling out a credit card in beta. As Head of Growth, you'll own how Tilt Mexico finds, activates and keeps customers across all three products, with real budget accountability and the mandate to drive profitable growth.</p><p>Acquisition works today but is concentrated in a few paid channels. Lifecycle and cross-sell are early, and the brand is under-measured. This is a chance to build an AI-native growth function in one of Latin America's largest and fastest-moving consumer credit markets.</p><p>This is a remote role based in Mexico. Travel for company onsites is expected at least four times a year.</p><p></p><h2><strong>How you'll make an impact</strong></h2><ul><li><p><strong>Own the full growth funnel: </strong>Lead acquisition, activation, retention and cross-sell as one strategy, measured on profitable customers rather than installs or approvals. Paid acquisition stays the engine; you'll bring lifecycle and brand up to parity over time.</p></li><li><p><strong>Drive performance marketing sophistication: </strong>Allocate the acquisition budget across channels with rigour: proper attribution, event-based optimisation, and payback and CAC (customer acquisition cost) discipline tied to credit outcomes. Push beyond the current channel mix into new paid, partnership, referral and app store channels, backed by steady creative testing.</p></li><li><p><strong>Make growth and credit work together: </strong>Use the unit economics model with Credit and Data Science to decide which customers to acquire, at what cost and through which channels. Make sure growth targets account for approval rates and losses, not just volume.</p></li><li><p><strong>Build the brand and its measurement: </strong>Define how Tilt shows up in Mexico, in voice, visual identity and awareness strategy, and put in place the measurement it lacks today: brand tracking, organic search and app store visibility, and social listening.</p></li><li><p><strong>Grow customer value through lifecycle and cross-sell: </strong>Build triggered campaigns across push, SMS, WhatsApp, email and in-app that move customers from first loan to repeat loans, installment loans and the credit card. Partner with Product and Engineering to define what the lifecycle stack needs, and own the strategy that runs on it.</p></li><li><p><strong>Run a small, leveraged team: </strong>Lead a tight, high-output team that uses AI for creative production, budget allocation and analytics rather than defaulting to headcount growth. Share what works with the growth teams in our other markets: the US, Brazil, India and the Philippines.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2><strong>Why you're a great fit</strong></h2><ul><li><p>8+ years in growth or marketing, with hands-on performance marketing experience earlier in your career. You've personally run campaigns, not just overseen them.</p></li><li><p>You've had real budget accountability: your name on spend decisions, not just advisory input.</p></li><li><p>Consumer fintech or digital lending experience in Mexico or Latin America. You understand how acquisition cost, approval rates and credit losses shape what growth is worth.</p></li><li><p>Strong quantitative fluency. CAC, LTV (lifetime value), payback, attribution models and A/B test design (sample size, statistical significance) are second nature.</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with CRM and lifecycle tooling (Iterable or equivalent). You know what good looks like, even if you weren't the one building it.</p></li><li><p>You hold both halves of growth at once, analytical rigour and creative judgment, and you're honest about where your edge sits.</p></li><li><p>An AI-native mindset. You use agentic AI tools to raise your team's speed and quality, and you see AI as a force multiplier, not a threat to headcount.</p></li><li><p>Native or fluent Spanish and professional fluency in English.</p></li><li><p><strong>Bonus:</strong> Hands-on experience with AppsFlyer (or a comparable mobile attribution platform) for install and event measurement.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2><strong>Our Interview Process</strong></h2><ol><li><p><strong>Initial Recruiter Call: </strong>A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.</p></li><li><p><strong>Hiring Manager Interview: </strong>A deeper discussion about your experience.</p></li><li><p><strong>Skills Panel: </strong>Meet with Tilt team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach.</p></li><li><p><strong>Leadership Conversation: </strong>A final conversation with a leader to discuss how you'll contribute to Tilt's mission, and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way.</p></li></ol><p></p><p><strong>Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.</strong><br></p><p></p><h2><strong>What you'll get at Tilt</strong></h2><ul><li><p><strong>Virtual-first teamwork:</strong> The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.</p></li><li><p><strong>Competitive pay:</strong> We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.</p></li><li><p><strong>Complete support:</strong> Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.</p></li><li><p><strong>Visibility is yours</strong>: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.</p></li><li><p><strong>Paid global onsites</strong>: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)</p></li><li><p><strong>Impact is recognized</strong>: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.</p></li></ul><h2><strong>The Tilt Way</strong></h2><p>We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.</p><p></p><p><strong>You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.</strong></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tilt-head-of-growth-tilt-mexico">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tilt-head-of-growth-tilt-mexico</a></p>
</description>

<p>

<h2>About ElevenLabs</h2><p>ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.</p><p>We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.<br><br>We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:</p><ul><li><p>ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.</p></li><li><p>ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.</p></li><li><p>ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.</p></li></ul><p>Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders.       <title>GitLab: Commercial Account Executive - Australia</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇦🇺 Australia</country>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Australia
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2>
<p>This role can be based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll drive GitLab's growth by helping Commercialet organizations adopt, implement, and expand our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll also elevate your impact through team leadership and mentoring. You'll primarily focus on commercial accounts across the Queensland territory with opportunities in South Australia, guiding customers through their digital and DevSecOps journeys and driving pipeline generation that translates into measurable new ARR and long-term expansion. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab's field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle. You'll also mentor and coach fellow team members, sharing knowledge and learnings to elevate team performance. In your first year at this level, you'll deepen executive-level customer relationships, continue building a healthy book of business, and demonstrate consistent top-tier performance while supporting the growth of your peers.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own and grow a book of commercial accounts in your primary territory across Queensland, focusing on organizations that can benefit from GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform.</li>
<li>Drive the full sales cycle with commercial customers by generating and qualifying pipeline through outbound prospecting, then leading discovery, negotiation, and close to create new ARR.</li>
<li>Work with your key customers to drive adoption and consumption in new products.</li>
<li>Meet or exceed quota by building strong, long-term customer relationships and acting as the primary point of contact for all commercial opportunities in your territory.</li>
<li>Articulate the value of GitLab to commercial prospects and customers, clearly connecting our platform to their business outcomes, productivity goals, and security needs.</li>
<li>Manage your territory by documenting buying criteria and processes, defining next steps and owners, and keeping opportunity information accurate and up to date. Create clear quarterly forecasts against your plan through regular pipeline and deal reviews.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with partners, Sales Development, Customer Success, Renewals, and Solutions Architects to drive new business, ensure adoption, and support expansion while minimizing churn and contraction.</li>
<li>Represent GitLab in customer meetings and events by driving attendance and delivering compelling presentations, proposals, and reports that communicate value and outcomes. Contribute customer ideas to our public issue tracker and apply MEDPICC and Command of the Message on all opportunities.</li>
<li>Mentor and coach fellow Commercial Account Executives, sharing sales strategies, customer insights, and lessons learned to help elevate team performance and contribute to team goal achievement.</li>
<li>Regularly meet on-site with key customers to develop and strengthen executive-level relationships, ensuring GitLab is viewed as a strategic, long-term partner at the highest levels of the organization.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Ability to drive complex B2B software sales cycles and build trusted relationships with commercial and Commercialet customers, ideally in a Commercial Account Executive or similar role serving Commercialet customers.</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn and sell a complex SaaS or DevSecOps platform to commercial and Commercialet accounts, including identifying and breaking into new customers.</li>
<li>Excellence in operational rigor for deal management in Salesforce and Clari (or similar CRM and forecasting tools), with the ability to create reliable forecasts and manage your territory using both insight and data.</li>
<li>Skill in managing and closing larger, more complex deals in the Commercial segment using proven multi-threading, negotiation, and executive coverage strategies.</li>
<li>Self-starter who is a manager of one when it comes to territory account planning, quarterly and annual KPI execution, and driving new business acquisition and expansion through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach peers, share knowledge and learnings across the team, and take on additional team-level responsibilities that elevate team performance and collective goal achievement.</li>
<li>Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate value at all levels of the customer organization, lead clear and compelling customer conversations, and remain calm and solutions-focused under pressure.</li>
<li>Experience driving adoption and consumption with customers whilst leading your account team.</li>
<li>Outbounding: Not afraid to email, call, prospect into prospective accounts whilst building value narratives that land.</li>
<li>Adaptability, flexibility, creativity and a desire to build something new!</li>
</ul>
<p><br><br><strong>About the team</strong></p>
<p>The Commercial Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our Commercial customers. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, Sales Development, Customer Success, Renewals, and partner teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared territory planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on winning new customers, expanding existing accounts, and helping Commercial organizations get the most value from GitLab.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p>
