      <title>Twilio: Digital Sales Representative - Expansion</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p>
<p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p>
<p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative - Expansion.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About the job</strong></p>
<p>This position is needed to lead relationships within our Self Service customer base and Communications platform customers who consume our messaging, voice and email services. As our new Digital Sales Representative, you will be responsible for net new customer activations, transactional and solution selling, and closing deals within our Self Service account base.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you’ll:</p>
<ul>
<li>Manage and expand customer accounts within the Self Service segment.</li>
<li>Own a book of business with the goal of protecting revenue and driving upsell and cross-sells</li>
<li>Execute programmable sales plays to consistently deliver strong revenue, gross margin, and gross profit results.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Work cross-functionally with representatives from product, finance, support, and services teams to execute renewals and drive DBNE</li>
<li>Generate and maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce through proactive efforts and collaboration with your manager.</li>
<li>Execute automation strategies to serve a large quantity of customers while maintaining NPS and preventing churn&nbsp;</li>
<li>Work closely with marketing teams to align on messaging and campaigns.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p>
<p><strong>*Required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2 years closing experience or 1+ years closing experience at a SaaS or CPaas company, with a record of top performance</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships.</li>
<li>Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.</li>
<li>Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define processes and build programs.</li>
<li>Record of delivering revenue and gross profit results</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location</strong></p>
<p>This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, MD, NJ, NY, PA, WA, or Washington DC.</p>
<p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.</p>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p><em>*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.</em></p>
<p>The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:</p>
<ul>
<li>Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota, Illinois, Massachusetts or Vermont : $34.82/hour - $43.52/hour.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Based in Washington D.C., Maryland or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $36.87/hour- $46.08/hour.</li>
<li>Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $40.96/hour - $51.20/hour.</li>
<li>This role is eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.</li>
<li>This role is eligible to earn commissions.</li>
</ul>
<p>The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Applications for this role will be accepted on an ongoing basis.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p>
<p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p>
<p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a><br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p>
<p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-digital-sales-representative-expansion">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-digital-sales-representative-expansion</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Upstart: Principal Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States | Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Upstart</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.</p>
<p>As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.</p>
<p>We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.</p>
<p>If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.</p></div><p><strong>The Team:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Marketing Science sits within Upstart's Growth, Product, and Ops Analytics team and partners with growth marketing on every channel that brings borrowers to Upstart: direct mail, paid search and social, video, mobile, email, brand campaigns, and lending partnerships. Our job is to tell the business which of those dollars are working, and then help decide where the next one goes.</p>
<p>As our Marketing Measurement lead, you'll own how Upstart answers some key questions about its marketing spend. What did each channel actually cause? How should credit be shared across the touches a borrower saw before applying? Where should next quarter's budget go? The answers decide whether a dollar of spend buys a funded loan or takes credit for one that would have arrived anyway.</p>
<p>We're looking for a data scientist with deep experience in causal inference and marketing measurement to be the measurement partner for our marketing, finance, and product leaders, and the person they trust to say when the evidence is strong enough to move the budget.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Guide incrementality measurement across our marketing channels, working with the analysts who run tests in each channel on design and interpretation, so the team knows what each channel causes rather than what it gets credit for</li>
<li>Apply causal inference methods when a clean test isn't feasible, so budget decisions still rest on causal evidence</li>
<li>Build and maintain the attribution approach that splits credit across direct mail, digital, partnerships, and email, including channels where a borrower never clicks anything</li>
<li>Turn measurement results into spend allocation recommendations that marketing and finance use to plan budgets</li>
<li>Use marketing mix models alongside experiments and attribution, and work out which to trust when they disagree</li>
<li>Automate recurring measurement reporting, so your time goes to interpretation and recommendations</li>
<li>Mentor analysts across the team and review their measurement work</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Minimum Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in data science or a related quantitative role, much of it spent measuring marketing or growth spend</li>
<li>Hands-on experience designing and analyzing incrementality tests, and a solid grasp of causal inference beyond standard A/B testing</li>
<li>Working knowledge of marketing mix modeling and multi-touch attribution, including where each one breaks down</li>
<li>Strong Python and SQL skills</li>
<li>A track record of measurement work that changed how a marketing budget was spent</li>
<li>Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the judgment to push back when the evidence doesn't support the plan</li>
<li>Good judgment about when a result is solid enough to act on and when it needs another test</li>
<li>Ability to work independently, scope your own projects, and drive them end to end in ambiguous situations</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>An exceptional candidate will also have:</p>
<ul>
<li>A PhD or master's degree in statistics, economics, computer science, or another quantitative field</li>
<li>Familiarity with AI tools that speed up analysis and reporting</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Position location</strong> This role is available in the following locations: Remote</p>
<p><strong>Travel requirements</strong> As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.</p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></p>
<p><span>#LI-MidSenior</span></p>
<div></div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span>At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.&nbsp; The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</span></p>
<p><span>In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).</span></p></div><div class="title">United States | Remote -  Anticipated Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$195,300</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$270,400 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span>At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package.&nbsp; The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.</span></p>
<p><span>In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).</span></p></div><div class="title">Canada | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$182,800</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$230,000 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What you'll love</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly&nbsp;</li>
<li>Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)</li>
<li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)</li>
<li>Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada.</li>
<li>Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only)</li>
<li>Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security</li>
<li>Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements</li>
<li>Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country)</li>
<li>Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs</li>
<li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources</li>
<li>Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only)</li>

      <title>Cribl: Partner Solutions Engineer, Southern Europe</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - France
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p>
<p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p></div><p><span>Location: France</span></p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love This Role</strong></p>
<p>As the Partner Solutions Engineer, Southern Europe, you’ll be the technical face of Cribl for our strategic partners across Southern Europe, enabling partner presales and consultants to run high-quality discoveries, PoVs, and deployments themselves. You will also have the opportunity to own and run pre-sales engagements within the commercial territory.<br><br>You’ll own partner-facing enablement programs and ongoing technical communities. You’ll collaborate closely with Cribl sales, partner managers, and distributors to build repeatable patterns that our partners can take to market at scale.<br><br>You will help partners and customers understand the value of Cribl during the sales process, provide demonstrations and be the technical authority throughout the engagement to ensure the business benefits Cribl provides are understood.</p>
<p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Train and coach Partners value pillars, use cases and business cases</li>
<li>Provide architecture expertise</li>
<li>Drive adoption of Cribl University tracks, NFR environments and online resources</li>
<li>Drive deal confidence, velocity, and account activities by aligning Cribl and partner sales activities</li>
<li>Increase partner co-sell contribution</li>
<li>Monitor and maintain partner status and contribution</li>
<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><br>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience working with Channel Partners - experience of partner engagement, enablement and training.</li>
<li>3+yrs in Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or Consulting, working with cloud and SaaS based technology.</li>
<li>Experience with Logs, Metrics, IT Operations, and/or Security, ideally in observability, SIEM, or data platform contexts.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience designing and delivering technical enablement (trainings, bootcamps, workshops, or office hours) for partner or customer technical audiences.</li>
<li>Strong storytelling and presales skills—you can translate complex data architectures into simple, value-driven narratives and coach others to do the same.</li>
<li>Run high-impact discovery with technical and business stakeholders to understand current tooling, data flows, constraints, and success criteria.</li>
<li>Experience with proof-of-value or proof-of-concept projects, including defining success criteria, evaluation plans, and clear executive summaries.</li>
<li>Represent Cribl in the partner community via events, webinars, and user groups as needed.</li>
<li>Experience working with multiple operating systems (proficiency with Linux is desired).</li>
<li>Working knowledge of JavaScript and Regex, or similar scripting and data-manipulation skills.</li>
<li>Ability to travel up to 40% to customers, partners, and event locations as needed. Some international travel is also required.</li>
<li>Knowledge of MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or any solution selling methodology, advantageous.</li>
<li>Cloud Platform certifications advantageous.</li>
<li>Fluent French and English is required, both written and spoken.</li>
<li><strong>Bonus Points</strong><br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;-Italian, Spanish and Portuguese language proficiency is a plus</li>
<li>You are based in France</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-GV1<br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The salary for this role is dependent on country of employment and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.<br><br>In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.<br><br>In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl offers a benefits package that may include retirement/pension support, paid holidays and paid time off, remote office setup support, equity, and other wellness and support programs. Benefits vary by country in accordance with local requirements and market practice.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€97.400</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€122.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Bring Your Whole Self<br></strong><span><br></span><span>Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.</span></p>
<p><span>Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at </span><a href="https://cribl.io/about-us/"><span>cribl.io/about-us</span></a><span>.&nbsp;</span></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-partner-solutions-engineer-southern-europe">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-partner-solutions-engineer-southern-europe</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <state></state>

      <type>Full-Time</type>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, U.S.
</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at <a href="https://bitwarden.com/">bitwarden.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>As an outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Bitwarden, you will play a pivotal role as a Product Specialist, acting as the first point of contact for potential customers. Your responsibilities will include developing a deep understanding of our sales process, researching leads, initiating new relationships, and setting the stage for our sales team's success. You will engage primarily in outbound sales activities, showcasing our offerings compellingly through various channels.</p>
<p>This is an all-remote team ,and we’re looking for someone located in the U.S. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Generate sales leads by effectively prospecting and engaging potential Mid-Market and Enterprise clients through outbound outreach.</li>
<li>Manage and maintain an outbound sales pipeline, ensuring optimal lead and prospect qualification.</li>
<li>Identify and respond to potential client’s needs and suggest appropriate solutions.</li>
<li>Follow the sales playbook to guide sales leads through an Account Executive-led buying process.</li>
<li>Adhere to service-level agreements on lead outreach and follow-up intervals.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of outbound sales experience as a Sales Development Representative in the technology / SaaS space.</li>
<li>Experience using a CRM tool such as HubSpot, Outreach, or a similar engagement tool.</li>
<li>Experience using prospecting tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar, particularly in Enterprise B2B environments.</li>
<li>Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to quickly articulate technical information concisely.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Effective problem-solving abilities, coupled with strong time management and organizational skills.</li>
<li>Innovative thinker who thrives in a dynamic and evolving environment.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborative team player willing to share best practices and learn from others.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrates persistence, resilience, and a proactive approach to issue resolution.&nbsp;</li>
<li>A 4-year degree or equivalent is preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition Team</li>
<li>Interview with SDR Manager</li>
<li>SDR Skills Assessment</li>
<li>Interview with Head of Enablement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Interview with CSO</li>
<li>References</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Our user community loves us, and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.</li>
<li>Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open-source software.</li>
<li>We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.</li>
<li>Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join our #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-sales-development-representative">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-sales-development-representative</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Michigan; Remote, Ohio
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>THE ROLE</strong></h3>
<p>Join <strong>Everpure™</strong> to help architect the data center of the future Higher Education in the Midwest. In this role, you will lead the mission to modernize strategic, R1 university infrastructure through our radically simple data storage, management, and security innovations. You’ll serve as a strategic partner to the Higher Education community in the Midwest, navigating complex procurement landscapes and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver outcomes that directly impact community and educational services.</p>
<p><strong>Location: Michigan / Ohio</strong></p>
<h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own Territory Growth:</strong> Drive the end-to-end sales cycle within the SLED sector identifying and securing new logo opportunities while expanding existing accounts to meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.</li>
<li><strong>Evangelize Everpure™ Solutions:</strong> Position the <strong>Everpure™ Platform</strong> and our all-flash technology as the superior choice for public sector needs, translating complex technical benefits into clear, compelling value propositions for diverse stakeholders.</li>
<li><strong>Orchestrate Strategic Pursuits:</strong> Lead pursuit teams—including technical experts, product managers, and channel partners—to design and execute account plans that solve persistent customer challenges and ensure long-term success.</li>
<li><strong>Build Lasting Partnerships:</strong> Cultivate deep-rooted relationships from the data center to the boardroom, establishing Everpure™ as a trusted advisor and maintaining the highest customer satisfaction ratings in the industry.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>SLED Market Expertise:</strong> Proven success navigating the Higher Education procurement process, including deep experience with RFIs, RFPs, and contract negotiations, alongside an understanding of working with Federal system integrators.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Sales Mastery:</strong> A "Challenger Mindset" with the ability to use customer insights and a hunter's instinct to prospect new logos and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Influence:</strong> Exceptional communication skills with a track record of building internal and external partnerships, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li>
<li><strong>Outcome-Driven Track Record:</strong> Demonstrated ability to assess and manage a territory to achieve maximum revenue, leveraging CRM tools to track success and consistently delivering referenceable business results.</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em>Salary ranges are determined based on role, level and location. For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual base salary range is: </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$130,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$208,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p>
<p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p>
<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>
<p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p>
<p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.</p>
<p><strong>Join us and bring your best.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/everpure-account-executive-higher-education-mi-oh">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/everpure-account-executive-higher-education-mi-oh</a></p>

      <title>Glean: Enterprise Account Executive, Texas</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is seeking an experienced, consultative Enterprise Account Executive to lead new logo acquisition and expansion across Texas. You will own the full sales cycle—from pipeline generation through close—navigating complex, multi‑stakeholder deals with C‑level executives and driving a land‑and‑expand motion through effective multi‑threading. Partnering closely with Solutions Engineering, you’ll run compelling evaluations and POCs, quantify impact with clear ROI, and build business cases that accelerate adoption. This high‑impact, quota‑carrying role collaborates cross‑functionally, serves as the voice of the customer, and helps shape product direction while delivering sustained regional growth.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>Source and close net new logos within a given territory</span></li>
<li><span>Have the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions</span></li>
<li><span>Research and understand the business objectives of your customers and have the ability to perform a value drive sales cycle</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach</span></li>
<li><span>Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings</span></li>
<li><span>Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions</span></li>
<li><span>Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach</span></li>
<li><span>Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>6+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations</span></li>
<li><span>Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives</span></li>
<li><span>Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics</span></li>
<li><span>Experience selling technical SaaS and cloud based software solutions</span></li>
<li><span>Basic understanding of search infrastructure is a plus</span></li>
<li><span>You have previous experience working with multiple teammates including SEs, BDRs, PMs, Executives &amp; Engineers</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and using MEDDIC and Challenger (or similar) methodologies is a plus.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>Location:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote (based out of Texas)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>Compensation and Benefits:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>The on target earnings for this position is $280,000 - $315,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>As part of the Federal Account Executive team you will be responsible for the following in your territory: Intelligence Community&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Evangelize our radically simple, all-flash enterprise storage technology and data solutions, ensuring customers fully grasp Pure’s total value proposition</span></li>
<li><span>Build and invest in relationships with customers to establish Pure’s value, continually driving the highest customer satisfaction ratings in the industry</span></li>
<li><span>Lead pursuit teams and develop account plans to make sure all internal resources are engaged to execute and win new Pure Customers&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Drive and manage a healthy and robust pipeline of sales activity to assure quarterly and annual quotas are met or exceeded</span></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Demonstrated experience building and managing IC accounts in territory</span></li>
<li><span>Active TS/SCI clearance</span></li>
<li><span>Authenticity and a genuine desire to engage customers and understand their business challenges&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Thought leadership, creativity and a Challenger Mindset; the ability to apply your customer insights and expertise in technology solutions to position Pure’s portfolio to solve persistent problems</span></li>
<li><span>Avid hunter with proven prospecting skills, consistently opening doors to new customers and navigating seamlessly between the boardroom and the data center while passionately positioning the advantages of a Pure Storage solution</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent interpersonal skills including written and oral communication, able to build relationships easily and deepen them over time</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to assess, plan, and actively manage a territory to achieve maximum revenue and efficiency</span></li>
<li><span>Expertise leading a complex sales process with multiple stakeholders, while fostering teamwork and shared ownership internally and with Partners</span></li>
<li><span>Consistent track record of exceeding quota and driving reference-able business.</span></li>
<li><span>Passionate about post-sales customer success</span></li>
<li>7 + years of outside sales with a focus on new logo acquisition or business development; consistently delivering $5-$10M per year in revenues</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>&nbsp;</p>

<p><em>There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual base salary range is: </div><div class="pay-range"><span>$180,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$208,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>

<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p>

<p><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div>

      <title>Glean: Enterprise Account Executive, Southeast</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is seeking an Enterprise Account Executive for a high-impact sales role focused on driving new business and expanding relationships within large enterprise accounts. AEs at Glean are responsible for landing and managing multi-million dollar, often global, accounts by leveraging Glean’s differentiated AI technology and foundational knowledge graph to deliver tangible business outcomes for customers.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>Source and close net new logos within a given territory</span></li>
<li><span>Have the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions</span></li>
<li><span>Research and understand the business objectives of your customers and have the ability to perform a value drive sales cycle</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach</span></li>
<li><span>Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings</span></li>
<li><span>Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions</span></li>
<li><span>Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach</span></li>
<li><span>Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>6+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations</span></li>
<li><span>Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives</span></li>
<li><span>Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics</span></li>
<li><span>Experience selling technical SaaS and cloud based software solutions</span></li>
<li><span>Basic understanding of search infrastructure is a plus</span></li>
<li><span>You have previous experience working with multiple teammates including SEs, BDRs, PMs, Executives &amp; Engineers</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and using MEDDIC and Challenger (or similar) methodologies is a plus.</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>Location:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>This role is remote (must be based in territory, particularly in the FL or GA area)</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>Compensation and Benefits:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>The OTE range for this role is $280,000 - $310,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>AI-First Mindset at Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. <strong>As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. </strong>Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/privacy"><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></a>. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>.</span></div>
<div><span><br>By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the <a href="https://www.glean.com/arbitrationagreement"><strong>Applicant Arbitration Agreement</strong></a>, and I agree to the terms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-enterprise-account-executive-southeast">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/glean-enterprise-account-executive-southeast</a></p>

      <title>Mercury: Manager - Sales Development</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
</p>

<p>At Mercury, we’re building banking* for ambitious companies. More than 450,000 businesses use Mercury to manage their finances. In May 2026, we raised $200 million at a $5.2 billion valuation. By then, we’d reached $650 million in annualized revenue and had been profitable for four years.</p>
<p>Sales Development has helped Mercury reach startup founders from their earliest days. As we grow, we’re taking on a new challenge alongside that work. How we earn a conversation with a founder who just raised funding looks different from how we earn one with the owner of an established agency. We’re looking for a <strong>Manager, Sales Development</strong> who’s excited to help us figure that out and coach a team to do it well.</p>
<p>You’ll hire and develop SDRs, own your team’s pipeline goals, and partner with Account Executives to understand which conversations turn into customers and why. One week, you might coach a rep through a cold call that keeps stalling at the same objection. The next, you might take a message that’s opening doors for one SDR and test whether it works across an entire segment. As the team grows, the people you develop and the playbooks you build will shape how Mercury reaches its next customers.</p>
<p><em>*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</em></p>
<h3><strong>Here are some things you’ll do on the job:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lead &amp; Coach:</strong> Provide high-impact 1:1 coaching to a group of SDRs focused on driving pipeline generation in new verticals. Guide them through LinkedIn, email, and cold call strategies that drive high quality meetings for our AE teams.</li>
<li><strong>Pipeline Management:</strong> Oversee pipeline health and lead distribution across the team to ensure consistent, qualified opportunity generation.</li>
<li><strong>Messaging Ownership:</strong> Help build and refine outbound messaging that resonates with our ICP.</li>
<li><strong>Conversion Optimization:</strong> Identify patterns in high-performing outreach and scale winning tactics to drive better conversion rates across the team.</li>
<li><strong>Training &amp; Enablement:</strong> Build and lead training sessions on prospecting best practices, objection handling, and effective channel usage.</li>
<li><strong>Motivate &amp; Inspire:</strong> Be a source of energy and accountability. Create a culture of excellence and continuous improvement on your pod.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-functional Partnership:</strong> Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Strategy to align on ICPs, lead prioritization, and campaign execution.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You Should have:&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>2–3+ years of experience in a Sales Development role within a B2B SaaS environment, with at least 18+ months in a leadership role managing teams of 7+ sales reps – you’re comfortable with a high velocity sales motion and managing all aspects of several SDRs at once.</li>
<li>Proven track record of coaching SDRs 1:1 and leading training across cold calls, email, and LinkedIn outreach.</li>
<li>Experience managing a large pipeline across multiple reps, able to analyze metrics, prioritize high-value opportunities, and course-correct quickly.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of outbound sales strategies and how to drive consistent conversion from prospecting to qualified opportunity.</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, can articulate value propositions and give actionable feedback to SDRs.</li>
<li>A motivating presence: you uplift those around you, create accountability, and lead by example.</li>
<li>Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where experimentation and adaptability are key.</li>
<li>Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Salesloft, Apollo, Gong, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator plus awareness of new tools/ integrations/ AI use cases to improve SDR efficiency.</li>
<li>Having a curious mindset and the ability to quickly ramp up on a new vertical is essential.</li>
</ul>
<p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p>
<p>#LI-CJ1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p>
<p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p>
<p>Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following<strong>:</strong></p></div><div class="title">US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$137,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$171,500 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$123,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$154,400 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mercury-manager-sales-development">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mercury-manager-sales-development</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Tailscale: Demand Generation Coordinator</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (Canada)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.&nbsp;<em>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em>We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p>
<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span>About the Role</span></h3>
<p>The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.</p>
<p>You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<h4><span><strong>Creator Research &amp; Discovery</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.</li>
<li>Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.</li>
<li>Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Outreach &amp; Relationship Management</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.</li>
<li>Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.</li>
<li>Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Contracts &amp; Partnership Operations</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.</li>
<li>Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.</li>
<li>Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Briefs, Content Review &amp; Facilitation</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.</li>
<li>Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.</li>
<li>Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.</li>
<li>QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Performance &amp; Reporting</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.</li>
<li>Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li><span>Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>1-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, sponsorships, partner marketing, demand generation, or adjacent fields.</li>
<li>Hands-on technical experience, such as running a homelab, self-hosting services, or tinkering with networking, so you can follow technical content and spot inaccuracies.</li>
<li>Experience reaching out to and building relationships with external partners, creators, or vendors.</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write briefs that are clear, concise, and easy to act on.</li>
<li>Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-assurance mindset; you catch broken links, missing tracking, or off-brand messaging before anything ships.</li>
<li>Ability to manage several partnerships at once with high reliability and end-to-end ownership.</li>
<li>Comfortable collaborating across Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product to move multi-stakeholder projects forward.</li>
<li>Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up research and routine operational work.</li>
<li>Genuine curiosity about the people who create technical content and the communities that watch, read, and listen.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a developer-focused, infrastructure, security, or B2B SaaS company.</li>
<li>Active presence in technical communities such as r/homelab, r/selfhosted, Discord servers, or similar.</li>
<li>An existing network of technical creators or familiarity with the technical creator landscape.</li>
<li>Experience with influencer discovery tools or creator databases.</li>
<li>Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or Jira.</li>
<li>Familiarity with FTC disclosure guidelines and content usage rights.</li>
<li>Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support events and creator meetups.</li>
</ul>
<p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">CAN Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$101,840</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$123,280 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.&nbsp;<em>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em>We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p>
<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span>About the Role</span></h3>
<p>The Demand Generation team brings Tailscale to the people who need it, wherever they already spend their time. For many technical folks, that's a favorite YouTube channel, podcast, newsletter, or stream. As our Demand Gen Coordinator, you'll help us show up in those places in a way that feels genuine and earns trust.</p>
<p>You'll find creators and outlets who share our values, build real relationships with them, and guide partnerships from first hello to final deliverable. Along the way, you'll write briefs, review content, keep projects on track, and help us learn what actually works. This role is a great fit for someone early in their career who loves both technology and the people who make content about it, and who wants room to grow.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<h4><span><strong>Creator Research &amp; Discovery</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Research and identify creators across YouTube, podcasts, newsletters, streaming, and social media who cover self-hosting, networking, security, and developer tools.</li>
<li>Evaluate creators on audience fit, content quality, technical accuracy, values alignment, and brand safety.</li>
<li>Build and maintain a creator pipeline that tracks prospects, past partners, and performance history.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Outreach &amp; Relationship Management</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Own outreach to new creators and act as their day-to-day point of contact.</li>
<li>Maintain strong, long-term relationships across partnerships that often span one to two quarters with multiple deliverables.</li>
<li>Partner with your manager on proposals, negotiations, and budget by preparing recommendations on rates, deliverables, and timelines.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Contracts &amp; Partnership Operations</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Navigate internal processes for contracts, legal review, vendor setup, and payments in partnership with Legal and Finance.</li>
<li>Track deliverables, deadlines, payments, and usage rights across all active partnerships.</li>
<li>Keep internal stakeholders informed on partnership status, upcoming content, and blockers.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Briefs, Content Review &amp; Facilitation</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Write clear creative briefs that turn product launches, features, and key messages into guidance creators can run with.</li>
<li>Review content drafts for technical accuracy, messaging, brand guidelines, and disclosure requirements.</li>
<li>Facilitate feedback between creators and internal teams, including Product Marketing, Developer Relations, Engineering, and Legal, when needed.</li>
<li>QA tracking links, UTMs, and promo codes before content goes live.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Performance &amp; Reporting</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li>Track and report on partnership performance, including reach, engagement, signups, and pipeline influence.</li>
<li>Share learnings and recommend where to invest next based on what's working.</li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li><span>Work with Community Programs, Developer Relations, Social, and Lifecycle Marketing to amplify creator content and connect creators with launches, events, and campaigns.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>1-3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, sponsorships, partner marketing, demand generation, or adjacent fields.</li>
<li>Hands-on technical experience, such as running a homelab, self-hosting services, or tinkering with networking, so you can follow technical content and spot inaccuracies.</li>
<li>Experience reaching out to and building relationships with external partners, creators, or vendors.</li>
<li>Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write briefs that are clear, concise, and easy to act on.</li>
<li>Exceptional attention to detail and a quality-assurance mindset; you catch broken links, missing tracking, or off-brand messaging before anything ships.</li>
<li>Ability to manage several partnerships at once with high reliability and end-to-end ownership.</li>
<li>Comfortable collaborating across Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product to move multi-stakeholder projects forward.</li>
<li>Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up research and routine operational work.</li>
<li>Genuine curiosity about the people who create technical content and the communities that watch, read, and listen.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a developer-focused, infrastructure, security, or B2B SaaS company.</li>
<li>Active presence in technical communities such as r/homelab, r/selfhosted, Discord servers, or similar.</li>
<li>An existing network of technical creators or familiarity with the technical creator landscape.</li>
<li>Experience with influencer discovery tools or creator databases.</li>
<li>Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay, or Jira.</li>
<li>Familiarity with FTC disclosure guidelines and content usage rights.</li>
<li>Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support events and creator meetups.</li>
</ul>
