      <title>PagerDuty: Enterprise Account Executive - US Federal</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA - Washington DC-Baltimore Area)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>PagerDuty is seeking an Enterprise Federal Account Executive with experience selling SaaS products to Enterprise accounts. In this role, you will report to a Regional Sales Director. We are seeking a dynamic sales champion who not only embraces technology but also knows how to excel while doing it! We're on the lookout for someone with a consultative sales approach, a proven knack for driving sales growth, and the ability to captivate a tech-savvy audience.</p>
<p>As a customer-centric organization, PagerDuty places immense value on delivering exceptional sales experiences. Your mission will be to go above and beyond, ensuring our customers receive nothing short of the finest sales journey imaginable.&nbsp;This isn't just a job—it's an opportunity to showcase your sales prowess, leverage your tech-savviness, and inject your vibrant personality into every interaction. Join PagerDuty and be a part of a thrilling sales adventure where you'll thrive, have fun, and make a significant impact!</p>
<h3><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Possess a deep understanding of the problems and focus areas of your stakeholders and effectively communicating the technical wins and strategic business outcomes we can align to and drive with a PagerDuty partnership&nbsp;</li>
<li>Develops strategic plans that anticipate and address customer needs and preferences based on competitor knowledge and industry trends</li>
<li>Identifies long-term strategies to grow accounts by aligning with our customers Big Problems and objectives</li>
<li>Negotiate positive business outcomes with existing customers for PagerDuty</li>
<li>Managing and closing complex, multi-product sales cycles in the +$500 million in revenue space&nbsp;</li>
<li>Conducts consistent and effective conversations with senior-level executives (VP+) to garner interest and support for new initiatives</li>
<li>Strong presentation skills verbally and visually by customizing content and slides to an internal or external audience; Shares information with customers to build credibility, show integrity, and highlight the value of PagerDuty; and tailors presentations to suit the audience's level and interests.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Encourages positive conversations between existing customers and sales teams, leading to solutions aligned with the customer's strategic vision.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Planning - Mapping out your territory assignment, priority account targets and working with your greater support team to drive an effective territory strategy</li>
<li>Utilize historical data and market trends to provide accurate forecasts to management</li>
<li>Prospecting - leveraging our Marketing, Alliances, BDR programs to develop a point of view and approach to opening net new logo opportunities with a specific focus on Executive level alignment</li>
<li>Create effective strategies and qualify opportunities within accounts, including plans for winning business for PagerDuty&nbsp;</li>
<li>Documenting key qualification details, including use case, purchase timeframes, and next steps (MEDDICC &amp; COM Framework)</li>
<li>Proactively engages internal resources and partners at the right time and in the right manner in order to move the sales process forward throughout their accounts.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Basic Qualifications:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8-12 years field sales experience, preferably in software sales / SaaS sales</li>
<li>4-6 years of experience expanded into new areas of existing accounts&nbsp;</li>
<li>Enterprise Account Management experience with $500M+, Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies</li>
<li>Sold in a multi-product selling environment before</li>
<li>Travel expectations around 30%</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Effective time management, complex deal management, account planning, and analytical skills</li>
<li>Consistent track record of exceeding sales targets</li>
<li>Self-sufficient with the ability to work independently and collaboratively</li>
<li>Previous Sales Methodology training (e.g. MEDDIC, SPIN, Command of Message, Challenger Sales)</li>
</ul>
<p></p>
<p>The base salary range for this position is <span class="collapsed-field-text">$130,000.00 - $154,000.00</span>&nbsp;USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.</p>
<p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Hesitant to apply?</strong></p>
<p>We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobalerts">job alerts</a>!</p>
<p><strong>Where we work</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/locations">offices</a> in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we <strong>cannot</strong> employ candidates residing in:</p>
<p><strong>Location restrictions: </strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Australia:</strong> Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia<br><strong>Canada:</strong> Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon<br><strong>United States:</strong> Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming<br><em>Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.</em></p>
<p><strong>How we work</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/#values">Our values</a> guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.</p>
<p>People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer</strong></p>
<p>As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/global-benefits">benefits site</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Your package may include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefits package&nbsp;</li>
<li>Flexible work arrangements</li>
<li>Company equity*</li>
<li>ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*</li>
<li>Retirement or pension plan*</li>
<li>Generous paid vacation time</li>
<li>Paid holidays and sick leave</li>
<li>Dutonian Wellness Days &amp; HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO</li>
<li>Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*</li>
<li>Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year</li>
<li>Company-wide hack weeks</li>
<li>Mental wellness programs</li>
</ul>
<p>*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure</p>
<p><strong>About PagerDuty</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses</p>
<p>PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Go behind-the-scenes on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/home">careers site</a> and @pagerduty on Instagram.</p>
<p><strong>Additional Information</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's <a href="https://www.pagerduty.com/privacy-policy/">Privacy Policy</a>.</p>
<p>PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.</p>
<p>PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-enterprise-account-executive-us-federal">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-enterprise-account-executive-us-federal</a></p>

      <title>Rubrik Job Board: GSI Specialty Seller, Identity Resilience (Global)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="p-rich_text_section">
<div class="container">
<div class="markdown markdown-main-panel enable-luminous-fast-follows enable-updated-hr-color tutor-markdown-rendering"></div>
</div>
<p>This role will own the Identity Resilience go-to-market motion across Rubrik's strategic GSI and advisory partners in the Americas.&nbsp; You will turn GSI relationships into sourced pipeline, co-developed joint solutions, and closed revenue for identity protection and recovery across Active Directory ,Okta and Entra ID and make Rubrik part of each GSI's standard identity security, cyber recovery, and Zero Trust offerings.</p>
<span><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></span><br><br><span>Pipeline and Revenue</span>
<ul>
<li>Own a quarterly pipeline and bookings target for GSI-sourced and influenced Identity Resilience opportunities.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities in GSI installed bases: AD and Entra ID modernization, M&amp;A and divestiture identity work, ransomware recovery readiness, and cyber insurance and regulatory programs.</li>
<li>Drive deals from first conversation to close alongside Rubrik AEs, SEs, and Regional Directors, using partner-sourced expansion (PSX) and new-logo (PSNL) plays.</li>
<li>Attach Identity Resilience to Cloud Resilience and data protection deals to expand deal size and strategic relevance.</li>
<li>Run a disciplined cadence: weekly forecast, deal reviews, and clean Salesforce hygiene (account categorization, partner attribution, deal registration).</li>
</ul>
<span>GSI Engagement and Enablement</span>
<ul>
<li>Build relationships across GSI identity and security practice leaders, cyber recovery and incident response teams, managed security services, and sellers.</li>
<li>Create a joint account plan per priority GSI: target accounts, executive sponsors, solution focus, and quarterly milestones.</li>
<li>Train and certify GSI sellers, architects, and delivery teams on Rubrik's identity value proposition, competitive positioning, and services attach.</li>
<li>Lead recurring pipeline reviews, win/loss reviews, and joint account mapping sessions.</li>
</ul>
<span>Joint Solutions and Offerings</span>
<ul>
<li>Co-create packaged offerings that bundle Rubrik Identity Resilience with GSI identity assessment, recovery planning, managed detection and response, and incident response services.</li>
<li>Work with Product, Product Marketing, and GSI practices on repeatable assets: solution briefs, reference architectures, recovery runbooks, pricing guidance, and SOWs.</li>
<li>Align identity resilience with Rubrik's cyber recovery and Cloud Resilience motions, including clean-room and orchestrated recovery of AD ,Entra ID and Okta</li>
<li>Help GSIs build managed-service and recurring-revenue models around Rubrik.</li>
</ul>
<span>Ecosystem and Go-to-Market</span>
<ul>
<li>Coordinate with Rubrik's Microsoft, security, and identity ecosystem partners on co-sell and field engagement, including Azure Marketplace and MACC-eligible purchasing where applicable.</li>
<li>Stay current on identity attack techniques, AD and Entra ID architecture, and compliance drivers; position Rubrik against native Microsoft capabilities and specialist identity recovery vendors.</li>
<li>Partner with Marketing and Partner Programs on joint campaigns, workshops (e.g., ransomware tabletop exercises), and executive briefings; support customer meetings and RFP/RFI responses.</li>
<li>Publish win stories and references, and relay field and partner feedback to Product and Sales Leadership.</li>
</ul>
<span><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></span>
<ul>
<li>10+ years in enterprise software, cybersecurity, or identity and data protection sales, including 5+ years in a partner, alliance, or GSI-facing role.</li>
<li>Proven record of sourcing and closing six- and seven-figure deals through GSIs or large advisory partners.</li>
<li>Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID ,Okta and the identity threat landscape, including credential-based attacks and identity recovery after a breach.</li>
<li>Established relationships, or proven ability to build them, with major GSIs (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, HCLTech, Cognizant, Infosys, Wipro, Kyndryl, PwC).</li>
<li>Experience building joint offerings and enabling partner sellers and delivery teams.</li>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. <p>The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to lead a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an Account Executive in Higher Education, covering the Northwest, to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. <strong>&nbsp;</strong>Reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.</p>

<p>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</p>

<li>
<p>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</p>

<li>

<p><strong>About Welo Global</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over&nbsp;500,000&nbsp;linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo&nbsp;Global’s&nbsp;five&nbsp;brands—Welocalize&nbsp;(multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for&nbsp;law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology.&nbsp;<em><a href="https://www.weloglobal.com/">weloglobal.com</a>&nbsp;</em>&nbsp;</p>
<p>To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.</p>
<p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>Welo Global is partnering with a&nbsp;social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.</p>
<p>This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in <strong>Brazilian Portuguese</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<p>For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.</p>
<p><strong>Important:</strong> AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work.</p>
<p>We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting.</p>
<p><strong><span>Project details</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Language Pair</strong>: Brazilian Portuguese</li>
<li><strong>Task</strong>: AI data annotation</li>
<li><strong>Area of expertise (domain)</strong>: Fashion &amp; Style</li>
<li><strong>Tools</strong>: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration</li>
<li><strong>Estimated Volume</strong>: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule</li>
<li><strong>Location</strong>: Remote</li>
<li><strong>Engagement Type</strong>: Freelance / Independent Contractor</li>
</ul>
<div>
<p>If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application.</p>
<p>To proceed, please provide the following:</p>
<ul>
<li>Share an updated CV</li>
<li>A brief overview of your relevant experience, particularly in <strong>Fashion &amp; Style</strong> and how many years you have worked in the field</li>
<li>Your current&nbsp;<strong>availability</strong>&nbsp;and estimated&nbsp;<strong>monthly&nbsp;</strong>capacity</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Beware of recruitment scams.</strong> Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: <a title="https://welocalizetalent.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/17509955857431-Recognizing-Scams-and-Confirm…" href="https://welocalizetalent.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/17509955857431-Recognizing-Scams-and-Confirm%E2%80%A6">Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global</a></p>
<p><strong>Job Reference: #LI-JC1</strong></p>
</div>

<p>Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over&nbsp;500,000&nbsp;linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo&nbsp;Global’s&nbsp;five&nbsp;brands—Welocalize&nbsp;(multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for&nbsp;law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology.&nbsp;<em><a href="https://www.weloglobal.com/">weloglobal.com</a>&nbsp;</em>&nbsp;</p>
<p>To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.</p>
<p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>Welo Global is partnering with a&nbsp;social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.</p>
<p>This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in <strong>Brazilian Portuguese</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<p>For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.</p>
<p><strong>Important:</strong> AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work.</p>
<p>We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting.</p>
<p><strong><span>Project details</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Language Pair</strong>: Brazilian Portuguese</li>
<li><strong>Task</strong>: AI data annotation</li>
<li><strong>Area of expertise (domain)</strong>: TV &amp; Movies&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Tools</strong>: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration</li>
<li><strong>Estimated Volume</strong>: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule</li>
<li><strong>Location</strong>: Remote</li>
<li><strong>Engagement Type</strong>: Freelance / Independent Contractor</li>
</ul>
<div>
<p>If this opportunity aligns with your experience, we would be happy to receive your application.</p>
<p>To proceed, please provide the following:</p>
<ul>
<li>Share an updated CV</li>
<li>A brief overview of your relevant experience, particularly in <strong>TV &amp; Movies</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;and how many years you have worked in the field</li>
<li>Your current&nbsp;<strong>availability</strong>&nbsp;and estimated&nbsp;<strong>monthly&nbsp;</strong>capacity</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Beware of recruitment scams.</strong> Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: <a title="https://welocalizetalent.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/17509955857431-Recognizing-Scams-and-Confirm…" href="https://welocalizetalent.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/17509955857431-Recognizing-Scams-and-Confirm%E2%80%A6">Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global</a></p>
<p><strong>Job Reference: #LI-JC1</strong></p>
</div>

      <title>6sense: Head of Technology & Data Partnerships</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p>
<p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.&nbsp; We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p>
<p><strong>Our People:</strong></p>
<p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. &nbsp;Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.&nbsp; 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.&nbsp; We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.&nbsp;</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p>
<p class="p2">This is an enterprise-level leadership role responsible for defining and leading the company’s technology, data, and AI partnership strategy.</p>
<p class="p2">The role will serve as the executive owner of the broader technology and data partnership ecosystem.</p>
<p class="p2">This is not a traditional channel or alliances sales role. The focus is on partnerships that shape the product, strengthen the company’s data advantage, and extend the reach of the platform.</p>
<p class="p2">The leader will help determine where the company should build, buy, partner, or potentially acquire capabilities.</p>
<p class="p1"><strong>What the Leader Will Own</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li2">Set the company-wide strategy for technology, data, platform, integration, and AI partnerships.</li>
<li class="li2">Identify a focused portfolio of high-impact partnership opportunities that can improve product differentiation, innovation, distribution, and growth.</li>
<li class="li2">Build trusted C-suite relationships with priority technology platforms, data providers, cloud companies, and emerging AI ecosystems.</li>
<li class="li2">Originate and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements covering product scope, data rights, intellectual property, economics, investment, exclusivity, and governance.</li>
<li class="li2">Shape the external data strategy, including data coverage, quality, identity, signals, licensing, and differentiated data products.</li>
<li class="li2">Influence product and platform strategy by bringing an external ecosystem and market perspective into company investment decisions.</li>
<li class="li2">Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure strategic agreements translate into funded roadmaps, clear ownership, successful launches, and measurable customer adoption.</li>
<li class="li2">Establish portfolio governance, performance measures, and an operating model that allows the partnership capability to scale.</li>
<li class="li2">Build and develop a senior, globally effective organization over time.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><strong>Why the Role Matters</strong></p>
<p class="p2">The company’s advantage depends on connecting high-quality data, identity, and signals with the platforms, data environments, and AI ecosystems where customers already work.</p>
<p class="p2">These partnerships are viewed as a company-level lever for product innovation, differentiation, distribution, and growth, rather than simply a source of partner-sourced revenue.</p>
<p class="p2">The successful leader will have significant influence over product direction, ecosystem positioning, investment choices, and how the company creates long-term strategic advantage.</p>
<p class="p1"><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p>
<p class="p3"><strong>In the first 60 days</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li2">Assess the existing portfolio, market landscape, strategic gaps, team capabilities, active commitments, and role boundaries.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p3"><strong>By 90 days</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li2">Develop an executive-ready technology, data, and AI ecosystem strategy with a concentrated set of priority bets, investment choices, executive sponsors, and Product and R&amp;D commitments.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p3"><strong>Within six months</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li2">Demonstrate visible progress on consequential partnerships, including signed or late-stage agreements with funded productization paths and clear measures of impact.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p3"><strong>Within 12 months</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li2">Establish a focused portfolio producing measurable adoption, distribution, differentiation, and commercial impact, supported by trusted C-suite relationships and a scalable team and operating model.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><strong>The Profile That Will Be Successful</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li2">An executive who has built or materially scaled a technology, platform, product, or data partnership capability.</li>
<li class="li2">Someone who combines ecosystem strategy with enough technical fluency to engage credibly on architecture, APIs, data rights, identity, security, privacy, and AI.</li>
<li class="li2">A sophisticated negotiator who understands partnership structures, economics, data licensing, commercialization, and joint product delivery.</li>
<li class="li2">A strong cross-functional leader who can align senior Product, Engineering, commercial, legal, finance, and executive stakeholders around difficult investment and roadmap choices.</li>
<li class="li2">Someone with a practical understanding of how AI, agents, and MCP are changing enterprise software ecosystems.</li>
<li class="li2">A builder who can create the strategy, operating model, governance, metrics, and leadership team required for the capability to scale.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p2"><strong>Base Salary Range:</strong> $195,000.00 - $270,000.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO).</p>
<p class="p2"><strong>#LI-Remote</strong></p>
<p class="p2"><strong>Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents:</strong> California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><span>Our Benefits:</span></strong><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><strong><span>Equal Opportunity Employer:</span></strong><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to </span><span><a href="mailto:jobs@6sense.com">jobs@6sense.com</a><a href="mailto:jobs@6sense.com">.</a></span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><em><span><span class="TextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0" lang="EN-US"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">We are aware of recruiting impersonation&nbsp;</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">attempts</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0"> that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">A</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">ll email communications from </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">6sense</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0"> will originate from </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">the @6sense.com domain</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">We will </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">not initially contact you via text message and will </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">never request payments</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to </span></span><a class="Hyperlink SCXW160271132 BCX0" href="mailto:jobs@indeed.com"><span class="FieldRange SCXW160271132 BCX0"><span class="TextRun Underlined SCXW160271132 BCX0" lang="EN-US"><span class="NormalTextRun CommentStart SCXW160271132 BCX0">jobs@</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW160271132 BCX0">6sense.com</span></span></span></a><span class="EOP SCXW160271132 BCX0">&nbsp;</span></span></em></p></div>

      <title>Justworks: Senior Account Executive - In-Territory (SF/Bay Area, LA, Orange County, San Diego)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - U.S.A.
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h1><strong>Who We Are</strong></h1>
<p><span>At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.</span></p>
<p><span>We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.</span></p>
<p><span>We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.</span></p>
<p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#values"><span>Our Values</span></a></p>
<p><span>If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Who You Are</strong></h1>
<p>Are you a proven closer with a history of excelling in the PEO sales landscape? Do you thrive on a relentless pursuit of new business and come equipped with a network of relationships that can be leveraged immediately? Justworks is looking for a Senior Account Executive who isn't just looking for a job - they're looking to hit the ground running and make an immediate impact. This role is for a seasoned professional who understands the modern SaaS sales cycle and has a deep, innate knowledge of the PEO space, likely coming from a competitor. This isn't a ramp-up role; this is a "slide in and close" opportunity.</p>
<h1><strong>Your Mission</strong></h1>
<p>Your primary mission is to expand our user base and drive significant growth. You'll be the face of Justworks, building trust with business owners and evangelizing our product suite in the small business world. Your success is measured by your ability to manage your own book of business, build and manage a complete end-to-end sales pipeline, and consistently exceed your quotas.</p>
<h2><strong>What You Will Work On</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own the Pipeline: </strong>From prospecting to close, you'll manage all activities required to win.</li>
<li><strong>Hunt for New Business:</strong> Proactively prospect for new business through market research, sales tools, and cold outreach.</li>
<li><strong>Leverage Your Network:</strong> Build and nurture relationships with channel partners, especially brokers. We're looking for someone who can leverage a pre-existing rolodex of relationships to generate leads in addition to traditional cold methods.</li>
<li><strong>Be a PEO Expert: </strong>You will be an ambassador for Justworks and its solutions, gaining an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of our product suite to effectively communicate its value proposition to potential customers.</li>
<li><strong>Advocate for the Customer:</strong> Be the voice of our future customers, suggesting innovative ideas to improve the customer experience and advocating for product development internally.</li>
<li><strong>Expand Your Territory:</strong> Research and establish a dominant presence in your assigned territory, developing a strategic plan to connect with the entrepreneurial community.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How You Will Do Your Work</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Account Executive, how results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities, and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Good judgement </strong><span>- the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.</span></li>
<li><strong>Detail-oriented </strong><span>- exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.</span></li>
<li><strong>Foundational sales knowledge </strong><span>- the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a salesperson possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.</span></li>
<li><strong>Results-driven </strong><span>- consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.</span></li>
<li><strong>Clear communication </strong><span>- the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.</span></li>
</ul>
<p>In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Camaraderie</strong> - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.</li>
<li><strong>Openness</strong> - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.</li>
<li><strong>Grit </strong>- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.</li>
<li><strong>Integrity</strong> - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Simplicity</strong> - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>A minimum of 5 years experience in an Account Executive position managing a complete and consultative sales cycle and closing is required. </strong><strong>Experience in Lead generation for B2B in a high-velocity setting (i.e., SaaS, PEO, Fintech). Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn SalesNavigator, and/or ZoomInfo are required. Experience with Outreach.io and/or Hubspot, in addition to 6Sense and/or Hoovers/D&amp;B, is a plus.</strong></li>
<li>Cold-calling experience is required for this position.</li>
<li><strong>We are seeking candidates with a hunter mentality who are dedicated to grabbing new prospects, netting new logos, closing deals, and delivering immediate results.&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></li>
<li><strong>Have established ecosystem relationships with Broker &amp; Accountant Channel partners.</strong></li>
<li>Passionate about sales and relationship-focused customer engagements</li>
<li>Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrates the ability to listen to gather important information during a sales call and/or meeting</li>
<li>Ability to simplify complicated topics and explain them in terms people can easily understand</li>
<li>Able to apply creative solutions to a variety of issues in a fast-paced environment</li>
<li>You enjoy entrepreneurial environments and the opportunity to build something meaningful!</li>
<li>There is occasional travel in some territories (25% travel), which includes networking events, trade shows, and meeting potential clients in your area(s).</li>
</ul>
<p>This position is paid a base wage plus incentive compensation. The base wage range for this position is targeted at $105,000.00 - $105,000.00 in our California offices, and competitive On-Target Earnings, inclusive of incentive compensation, of *$255,000.00 - $255,000.00. Final offers may vary from those listed. *Incentive compensation is not guaranteed, and earning is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive compensation plan.</p>
<p><span>#LI-Hybrid #LI-AM2</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.&nbsp; </span><span>Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit </span><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#total-reward-philosophy">Total Rewards @ Justworks</a><span>.&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1><strong>Diversity At Justworks</strong></h1>
<p><span>Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.</span></p>
<p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at <a href="mailto:accommodations@justworks.com">accommodations@justworks.com</a>. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/press/company-news/justworks-impact-report-2024"><span>Our DEIB Report&nbsp;</span></a></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/justworks-senior-account-executive-in-territory-sf-bay-area-la-orange-county-san-diego">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/justworks-senior-account-executive-in-territory-sf-bay-area-la-orange-county-san-diego</a></p>

<h2 class="p1"><span class="s1">Role Description</span></h2>
<p><span class=" author-d-iz88z86z86za0dz67zz78zz78zz74zz68zjz80zz71z9iz90za3wz122zz77zjz88zx7z66zz78zz69zbz70znpvz79z6z87z9z90zxz81zz76zz68z9z72zz71zz70zi">Dropbox is hiring an Integrated Campaign Strategist to architect and orchestrate</span><span class=" author-d-1gg9uz65z1iz85zgdz68zmqkz84zo2qotvejqz71zz89zgz122zz76zp18az83zz72zz122zz122zm0kfukz81zz67zz84z5z87zz75zz79z8"> marketing</span><span class=" author-d-iz88z86z86za0dz67zz78zz78zz74zz68zjz80zz71z9iz90za3wz122zz77zjz88zx7z66zz78zz69zbz70znpvz79z6z87z9z90zxz81zz76zz68z9z72zz71zz70zi"> campaigns for priority product launches and evergreen marketing motions.       <title>Sumo Logic: Partner Marketing Program Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote USA
</p>

<p>Sumo Logic is seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-driven Partner Marketing Program Manager to support the growth and operational effectiveness of our global partner marketing organization.</p>
<p>This role will be responsible for managing the systems, processes, and governance that power our partner marketing programs, with a primary focus on our Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform, Market Development Funds (MDF), partner program operations, and performance reporting.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate brings experience in B2B technology channel marketing, understands the complexities of working with MSSPs, VARs, and distributors, and thrives on building scalable processes that improve efficiency, accountability, and business impact.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex programs, improving operational workflows, and enabling regional teams and partners to execute successfully.</p>
<h2>What Success Looks Like</h2>
<p>In this role, success means:</p>
<ul>
<li>Establishing a reliable, well-managed PRM platform that supports global partner marketing needs.</li>
<li>Improving partner and internal team adoption of Impartner.</li>
<li>Implementing consistent MDF governance, approval processes, and financial tracking.</li>
<li>Providing accurate, timely visibility into MDF spending, utilization, and program performance.</li>
<li>Reducing manual processes and administrative delays across partner marketing operations.</li>
<li>Improving partner accountability and reporting of marketing-generated opportunities and pipeline.</li>
<li>Enabling regional marketing teams to execute programs efficiently through standardized tools and processes.</li>
<li>Building scalable operational foundations that support Sumo Logic’s growing global partner ecosystem.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Required Qualifications</h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing, partner marketing, channel operations, or marketing program management.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience working with Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms, preferably Impartner.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience managing MDF programs, including funding requests, approvals, budget tracking, governance, and reporting.</li>
<li>Understanding of MSSP, VAR, and distributor (DISTI) partner ecosystems.</li>
<li>Experience managing program budgets, financial tracking, and reconciliation processes.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of channel marketing operations and partner program workflows.</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce and familiarity with marketing automation platforms.</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills and experience developing dashboards, reports, and performance metrics.</li>
<li>Excellent organizational, project management, and process improvement skills.</li>
<li>Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate stakeholders across global teams.</li>
<li>Strong attention to detail, financial accuracy, and operational accountability.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li>
<li>Ability to work independently and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Preferred Qualifications</h2>
<ul>
<li>Direct experience administering Impartner, including MDF workflows and partner portal management.</li>
<li>Experience developing or implementing MDF governance frameworks and standardized approval processes.</li>
<li>Experience supporting global partner marketing programs across North America, EMEA, and APJ.</li>
<li>Familiarity with two-tier distribution models and partner marketing programs involving MSPs, MSSPs, VARs, and distributors.</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce reporting, partner attribution, and pipeline tracking.</li>
<li>Experience supporting PRM integrations, workflow automation, and data quality initiatives.</li>
<li>Background in cybersecurity, SaaS, cloud, observability, or enterprise technology.</li>
<li>Experience developing partner enablement materials and training programs.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">About Us</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit</span><a class="XqQF9c" href="http://www.sumologic.com/"><span class="C9DxTc "> www.sumologic.com.</span></a></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><a class="XqQF9c" href="https://www.sumologic.com/privacy-statement/"><span class="C9DxTc aw5Odc ">Sumo Logic Privacy Policy</span></a><span class="C9DxTc ">. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">The expected annual base salary range for this position is $130,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application.</span><span class="C9DxTc ">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position.</span></p>

<p>Serve as the day-to-day business development lead for Rubrik's partnerships with LTIMindtree and HCLTech in the Americas.</p>
<p>Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline by connecting each GSI's account teams, practices, and delivery organizations with Rubrik's field and specialist teams.</p>
<p>Turn executive alignment into repeatable execution: joint account plans, active deals, enabled sellers, and published wins.</p>
<span><strong><span>Key Responsibilities</span>:</strong></span><br><br><em>Pipeline Generation and Deal Support</em>
<ul>
<li>Own pipeline targets for LTIMindtree and HCLTech, covering both partner-sourced expansion (PSX) and new-logo (PSNL) opportunities.</li>
<li>Co-develop target account lists with each GSI and Rubrik AEs and Regional Directors; prioritize by customer fit, partner presence, and deal potential.</li>
<li>Drive opportunities from first conversation to close: deal registration, partner engagement, executive sponsorship, and escalation of blockers.</li>
<li>Run weekly pipeline and deal reviews with each partner and maintain clean Salesforce data (partner attribution, account categorization, owners, deal stages).</li>
<li>Surface deal risks early, including stalled or early-stage deals and misaligned account ownership, and drive corrective action.</li>
</ul>
<em>Partner Relationship Management</em>
<ul>
<li>Build and maintain relationships with each GSI's alliance leads, sales leaders, practice heads, and delivery and managed services teams.</li>
<li>Maintain a joint business plan for each partner with goals, target accounts, executive sponsors, and quarterly milestones.</li>
<li>Lead regular business reviews, win/loss reviews, and joint account mapping sessions.</li>
<li>Act as the single point of coordination between the partner and Rubrik's AEs, SEs, CDMs, Regional Directors, and specialty sellers.</li>
</ul>
<em>Enablement and Joint Solutions</em>
<ul>
<li>Plan and run sales and technical enablement for LTIMindtree and HCLTech sellers, architects, and delivery teams on Rubrik's Cloud Resilience and Identity Resilience value.</li>
<li>Support joint offerings and managed services built around Rubrik, working with Product Marketing, Partner Programs, and the GSI practices.</li>
<li>Make sure partner teams have current collateral, pricing and packaging guidance, and access to the right Rubrik specialists.</li>
<li>Help partners shape services attach and SOW content so Rubrik is scoped into proposals early.</li>
</ul>
<em>Go-to-Market and Visibility</em>
<ul>
<li>Plan joint campaigns, workshops, executive briefings, and events with each partner, in coordination with Marketing.</li>
<li>Capture and publish win stories, references, and internal win announcements, with proper credit to partner and Rubrik contributors.</li>
<li>Prepare weekly and quarterly updates for GSI leadership covering partner highlights, risks, pipeline, and upcoming activities.</li>
<li>Relay field and partner feedback to Product, Sales Leadership, and Partner Programs, and align with global partner counterparts.</li>
</ul>
<span><strong><span>Required Qualifications</span>:</strong></span>
<ul>
<li>6+ years in enterprise software, cybersecurity, or data protection, including 3+ years in partner, alliance, or business development roles with GSIs or large services firms.</li>
<li>Track record of generating pipeline and supporting six- and seven-figure deals through partners.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of how GSIs operate: account teams, practices, delivery, and services-led deal structures.</li>
<li>Strong Salesforce discipline, forecasting, and pipeline management skills.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and relationship skills, with comfort engaging both senior partner executives and field teams.</li>
<li>Ability to work across time zones with partner teams in the US and India.</li>
<li>Travel of approximately 20-30%.</li>
</ul>
<em>Preferred Qualifications</em>
<ul>
<li>Existing relationships at LTIMindtree or HCLTech.</li>
<li>Background in data protection, cyber resilience, or cloud infrastructure.</li>
<li>Familiarity with MEDDPICC, partner deal registration, and co-sell motions with Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud.</li>
<li>Experience building joint solutions or managed service offerings with partners.</li>
</ul>
<strong><span>Success Metrics (First 12 Months)</span>:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Partner-sourced and influenced pipeline coverage against target and closed-won bookings through each partner.</li>
<li>Active joint business plan and named target account list for each partner.</li>
<li>Number of partner sellers and architects enabled, and joint offerings or reference wins published.</li>
<li>Pipeline accuracy and Salesforce data quality across partner-attributed deals.</li>
</ul>

      <title>Wrike: Senior Demand Generation Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Our vision:&nbsp; </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><h3><strong>About the Role:</strong></h3>
<p>You'll own your outcomes, from the strategies you run to the conversations that shape what we build next. We're looking for a results-oriented Demand Marketing Manager with proven B2B SaaS experience to lead one of Wrike's flagship global integrated campaigns. These campaigns bring together product, industry and buyer-journey strategy into a coordinated program that generates pipeline, accelerates deals and drives expansion across our customer base.</p>
<p>This is a hybrid role: part campaign leader, part hands-on practitioner. You'll own the campaign strategy, plan, budget and results. You'll also directly execute sponsored media and email/nurture programs. At the same time, you'll orchestrate the work of partner teams, including digital, ABM, field and events, and webinars, and make sure it all stays aligned with campaign goals and messaging.</p>
<p>You'll partner closely with product marketing, customer marketing, content, digital, field and regional marketing, ABM, sales development, and marketing operations. The ideal candidate has managed complex, multi-region campaigns, thrives in a metrics-driven environment, and uses Wrike to run their own work.</p>
<h3><strong>Your Impact:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Campaign Strategy &amp; Planning</li>
<li>Own the integrated campaign brief, strategy and roadmap, aligned to company priorities, product launches, target industries and personas, and buyer journeys.</li>
<li>Define the approach for both new-customer acquisition (Land) and existing-customer growth (Expand), including audiences, messaging and channel mix for each.</li>
<li>Translate positioning from product marketing into campaign themes and use-case-led messaging that resonates with enterprise buying committees.</li>
<li>Manage the campaign budget, allocating investment across channels and adjusting based on performance.</li>
<li>Execution (Hands-On)</li>
<li>Plan, launch and optimize sponsored media programs, including content syndication (including regional and local-language placements), sponsored webinars and virtual events, podcast sponsorships, and industry publication newsletter or dedicated email placements.</li>
<li>Select and manage third-party media and event vendors, negotiate placements within budget, and track delivery and results.</li>
<li>Build and manage email, nurture and lifecycle programs for prospects and existing customers, including customer newsletters and workflow- or role-based nurture streams.</li>
<li>Brief creative and content teams, and manage production and launch of the assets each tactic needs.</li>
<li>Monitor performance, run tests and optimize against targets for actions, MQLs, meetings and pipeline.</li>
<li>Program Oversight &amp; Cross-Functional Leadership</li>
<li>Oversee the programs run by partner teams, including paid digital (managed by the digital team), ABM (1:1 and 1:few), events (field, executive and customer events), and Wrike-hosted webinars and "deminars", and keep them aligned to campaign strategy, messaging, timelines and goals.</li>
<li>Integrate those programs with sponsored media and nurture into one coherent buyer journey, including follow-up and sales handoff.</li>
<li>Work with sales and sales development to ensure campaign assets, plays and follow-up cadences support target accounts and pipeline goals.</li>
<li>Balance global strategy with regional relevance, including localization, regional events and partner activity, across EMEA, the Americas and APJ.</li>
<li>Workflow &amp; Operations</li>
<li>Run campaign planning in Wrike, including briefs, templates, dependencies, workback schedules and creative requests, to keep a large cross-functional program visible and on track.</li>
<li>Work with marketing operations to build, QA and track programs across tools such as Marketo, Salesforce, 6sense and Tableau.</li>
<li>Identify risks, resolve conflicts and escalate when needed to keep the program on schedule.</li>
<li>Measurement &amp; Optimization</li>
<li>Define campaign KPIs across target-account coverage, engagement, intent, actions/MQLs, meetings, pipeline and revenue, including both sourced and influenced contribution.</li>
<li>Establish baselines and measure impact on target accounts, then use the data to recommend and drive optimizations.</li>
<li>Report regularly to senior leadership through dashboards, presentations and Wrike updates.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Your Qualifications:</h3>
<ul>
<li>5–7 years of experience in B2B SaaS demand generation or integrated campaign roles, including leading large, multi-channel or multi-region programs.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience executing sponsored media, content syndication and email/nurture programs.</li>
<li>Experience leading both acquisition and expansion campaigns, with exposure to ABM.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to align many workstreams and stakeholders across digital, events, webinars, ABM and sales outreach, including programs you don't directly own.</li>
<li>Experience owning or managing a program budget and working with third-party vendors.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with work management tools (preferably Wrike) for campaign planning and collaboration.</li>
<li>Familiarity with marketing automation, CRM and ABM tools such as Marketo, Salesforce, Tableau, 6sense or Sendoso.</li>
<li>Strong project management skills, attention to detail and a data-driven mindset.</li>
<li>Comfort working across time zones with global teams.</li>
<li>Preferred Qualifications</li>
<li>Experience marketing to complex enterprise or industry-specific buyers, such as manufacturing.</li>
<li>Ownership of campaign workstreams in Wrike, including templates, dependencies and reporting.</li>
<li>Experience coordinating localized campaigns, regional events and partner co-marketing.</li>
<li>Understanding of enterprise SaaS buyer journeys and content strategies that support multi-stakeholder decisions.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Our Work Style:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>A high-impact role on a high-performing demand generation team.</li>
<li>A collaborative team culture that values initiative and innovation.</li>
<li>Opportunity to make a direct contribution to revenue growth and brand visibility.</li>
<li>Competitive salary, full benefits, and flexible working environment.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Flexible Time Off (FTO)</li>
<li>Company 401(k) Match</li>
<li>Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity&nbsp;</li>
<li>2 Volunteer Days</li>
<li>Health Insurance (Employees + Dependents)</li>
<li>Disability (STD, LTD) &amp; Life Insurance Plans</li>
<li>Working from Home Allowance ($40 / Monthly)</li>
<li>$500 Working from Home home office set-up Stipend</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1">Your recruitment buddy will be&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/azizatalhi/"><span class="s1">Aziza Talhi</span></a>, Senior Recruiter.</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1">#LI-AT1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The range below reflects the total on-target earnings (including base salary and performance-based bonus potential) for this full-time position and applies to all U.S. locations, excluding benefits and other incentives. The final offer within this range will consider factors such as the role, seniority level, geographic location, and employment contract type. An individual’s work location, unique skills, experience, and relevant educational background will also influence the final offer. For tailored compensation details based on your preferred location, please discuss with your recruiter during the hiring process.</em></p></div><div class="title">Total compensation pay range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$101,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$130,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Who Is Wrike and Our Culture</strong></h3>
<div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div><strong>Hybrid work mode</strong></div>
<div><br>
<div>
<div>Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h4><strong>Our persona&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Smart:</strong> We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.</div>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Dedicated: </strong>We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!</div>
<div><strong>&nbsp; Approachable:</strong> We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.&nbsp;</div>
<h4><strong>Our culture and Values&nbsp;</strong></h4>
<p><strong> Customer-Focused</strong></p>
<p><strong>We care about our customers. </strong>We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.</p>
<p><strong> Collaborative</strong></p>
<p><strong>We work as one and win together, </strong>each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.</p>
<p><strong> Creative</strong></p>
<p><strong>We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. </strong>It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong> Committed</strong></p>
<p><strong>We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, </strong>by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>
<div>Check out our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/wrike/life/3fd588bf-73e8-47be-9b0a-1933d404ea88/">LinkedIn Life Page</a>, <a href="https://www.wrike.com/wrike-company-culture/">Company culture page</a>, <a href="https://www.instagram.com/wriketeam">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.wrike.com/wrike-engineering/">Wrike Engineering Team</a>,&nbsp;<a href="https://medium.com/wriketechclub">Medium</a>, <a href="https://www.meetup.com/WrikeTechClub/?_cookie-check=wtgfN9ARYGPSGd3e">Meetup.com</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/wriketechclub">Youtube</a> for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.&nbsp;</div>
</div>
