      <title>Reddit: Growth Manager (Contract)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United Kingdom
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div><p>Working as a Growth Manager supporting Reddit’s International Community team, you will develop and execute initiatives that strengthen Reddit’s user and community ecosystems in the US and across international markets.</p>
<p><strong>This position is open to candidates based in the UK or the US - East Coast.</strong></p>
<p>This is not a marketing role. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.</p>
<p>The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketing, and Community teams while maintaining the autonomy and entrepreneurial mindset required to scale successful initiatives to other markets.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>User &amp; Community Growth Strategies: </strong>Establish and execute comprehensive strategies to grow the user base and nurture communities.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Growth Experimentation:</strong> Design and execute growth experiments aimed at addressing gaps in content supply, community density, contribution, discovery, engagement, and user growth. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.</li>
<li><strong>Scaling and Repeatability:</strong> Translate successful experiments into repeatable playbooks, processes, and recommendations that can be applied across markets. Determine which elements can scale broadly, which require local adaptation, and what operational or product support is needed to unlock broader impact.</li>
<li><strong>Data &amp; Performance Analytics: </strong>Monitor key growth and ecosystem indicators, including DAU, contribution, content supply, community health, and retention. Analyze performance trends, identify risks and opportunities, and establish clear measurement frameworks for experiments and scaled programs.</li>
<li><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration: </strong>Partner with various internal teams to provide insights, shape priorities, and scale growth initiatives. Build compelling evidence through experimentation to influence cross-functional investment and product development.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li>
<li>5+ years of experience in user growth, product operations, or market expansion, with a demonstrated track record of executing growth initiatives at scale.</li>
<li>Strong entrepreneurial instincts, hands-on execution skills, and the ability to make progress independently in ambiguous or resource-constrained environments.</li>
<li>Data-driven and analytical mindset, with proficiency in Excel modeling, working knowledge of SQL, and experience creating scalable processes and automations.</li>
<li>Strong systems thinking, with the ability to distinguish between market-specific problems and growth opportunities that can be addressed through repeatable approaches.</li>
<li>Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and align cross-functional stakeholders across global teams.</li>
<li>Results-oriented mindset, strong attention to detail, and a bias toward execution.</li>
<li>Comfort balancing a portfolio of opportunities across the US and international markets and prioritizing based on potential impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p>
<p><span>During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.&nbsp; We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.&nbsp; We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.&nbsp; For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.&nbsp; Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-growth-manager-contract">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-growth-manager-contract</a></p>
</description>

      <title>LaunchDarkly: Strategic Account Executive - West</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US West
</p>

<h4><strong>About the Job:</strong></h4>
<p>As a Strategic Account Executive, you will own the relationship with the most strategic customers in your territory. You will play a significant role in the expansion of growth within these accounts. You should be business oriented, customer focused, and a self-starter who works well with little supervision.</p>
<h4>Responsibilities:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Ownership of Strategic Accounts: You will be the primary point of contact and relationship owner for several strategic accounts at LaunchDarkly (~8 total)</li>
<li>Territory and Account Planning: Develop comprehensive territory and account plans,&nbsp;<em>proactively drive</em> outbound pipeline generation independently, and collaborate effectively with Business Development Representatives.</li>
<li>Ensure Successful Adoption: Ensure the seamless adoption of LaunchDarkly within these large enterprises through robust account management. Coordinate closely with pre-and-post sales engineering, customer success, and support teams to guarantee client satisfaction.</li>
<li>Elevate LaunchDarkly's Visibility: Increase LaunchDarkly's visibility and communicate our value proposition effectively to Vice Presidents and C-Suite executives.</li>
<li>Collaboration with Solutions Engineers: Work closely with your solutions engineer counterpart to deliver both business and technical value to prospects and customers.</li>
<li>Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams, including product support, developer relations, marketing, and revenue operations, to align our offerings with customer business needs effectively.</li>
</ul>
<h4>About You:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities.</li>
<li>Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly.</li>
<li>Intellectual Curiosity and Ambition: You have a hunger for knowledge and strive for ambitious goals.</li>
<li>Excellent Communication: Your written and spoken communication skills are outstanding.</li>
<li>Highly Organized &amp; Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and thrive in an environment that encourages autonomy.</li>
<li>Adaptability: You excel in a fast-paced and dynamic organizational setting.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h4>Qualifications:</h4>
<ul>
<li>8-10+ years of Strategic Sales Experience (closing), preferably within the B2B technology sector.</li>
<li>Experience navigating complex deals over $1M.</li>
<li>You have a demonstrable track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota expectations of 1M+.</li>
<li>You possess the expertise to navigate consultative sales cycles with Executive-level stakeholders at Fortune 500 companies.</li>
<li>You have experience implementing and succeeding with a Land &amp; Expand SaaS Sales strategy, effectively expanding business within large accounts (1M ARR+).</li>
<li>Recent experience working for an emerging technology software company is a significant plus.</li>
<li>Familiarity with and experience using the MEDDPIC sales methodology is advantageous.</li>
<li>Travel: expected range of 25% to 50% as needed</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><strong>Pay:</strong></p>
<p class="p1"><em>Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:</em></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li1">Zone 1: <em>San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle</em> - $336,800 - $371,000**</li>
<li class="li1">Zone 2:<em> Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - </em>$303,100 - $334,000**</li>
<li class="li1">Zone 3: <em>All other US locations - </em>$286,300 - $315,000**</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><em>LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.</em></p>
<p class="p1"><em>*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.</em><br><em>**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.</em></p>
<h4><strong>About LaunchDarkly:</strong></h4>
<p>Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:</p>
<ul>
<li>Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages</li>
<li>Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts</li>
<li>Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize</li>
<li>Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types</li>
<li>Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability</li>
</ul>
<p>At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at <a class="notion-link-token notion-focusable-token notion-enable-hover" href="mailto:hr@launchdarkly.com"><span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id--893544457">hr@launchdarkly.com</span></a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Do you need a disability accommodation?</strong></span></p>
<p class="p1">Fill out this&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYb_7upYMtdRVXzvXGHGfQw0pU2FNma-6Rwp-I6NjKm7SYNw/viewform"><span class="s2">accommodations request form</span></a>&nbsp;and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1"><strong>Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from <a href="https://launchdarkly.slack.com/team/UKEE4GBS6">@LaunchDarkly</a>.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts.<strong> </strong>Be cautious of emails from other domains.&nbsp; Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit <a href="https://launchdarkly.com/careers/">Careers | LaunchDarkly</a>&nbsp; directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.<br><br>Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to <a href="mailto:careers@launchdarkly.com">careers@launchdarkly.com</a>.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/launchdarkly-strategic-account-executive-west">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/launchdarkly-strategic-account-executive-west</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Twilio: Digital Sales Representative - Activate</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p>
<p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p>
<p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative - Activate.</p>
<p><strong>About the job</strong></p>
<p>This position is needed to grow and retain high-value self-service accounts by engaging customers at the right moment, guiding product adoption, preventing churn, and helping customers reach scale across Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products. Twilio’s Self-Service Business serves more than 300,000 active customers and generates nearly $1B annually.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you’ll:</p>
<ul>
<li>Engage high-value self-service customers through programmatically assigned inbound and outbound leads.</li>
<li>Identify growth opportunities by assessing product usage signals, customer needs, and readiness to scale.</li>
<li>Guide customers through adoption of Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products to accelerate business outcomes.</li>
<li>Retain priority accounts by proactively addressing risks, removing blockers, and supporting continued product value.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Product teams to improve sales plays and customer engagement strategies.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p>
<p><strong>Required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least 1 year of sales development or business development experience at a technology company, or 2-3+ years of closing experience in another industry.</li>
<li>Ability to qualify inbound and outbound opportunities, uncover customer needs, and guide customers toward relevant solutions.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders.</li>
<li>Comfort using data, product usage signals, and sales plays to prioritize outreach and identify growth or retention opportunities.</li>
<li>Ability to manage a high-volume book of accounts, prioritize effectively, and follow through on customer commitments.</li>
<li>Curiosity about cloud communications, customer engagement, email, data, or SaaS products.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Desired:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience selling SaaS, cloud communications, email, customer data, or developer-focused products.</li>
<li>Familiarity with product-led growth, self-service customer motions, or usage-based sales models.</li>
<li>Ability to interpret customer usage trends and translate insights into relevant sales conversations.</li>
<li>Experience working with Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, or similar sales engagement and CRM tools.</li>
<li>Interest in helping customers adopt and scale solutions across Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location</strong></p>
<p>This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, MD, NJ, NY, PA, WA, or Washington DC.</p>
<p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.</p>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p><em>*</em><em>Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.</em></p>
<p>The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:</p>
<ul>
<li>Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota, Illinois, Massachusetts or Vermont : $29.42/hour - $36.78/hour.</li>
<li>Based in Washington D.C., Maryland or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $31.15/hour- $38.94/hour.</li>
<li>Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $34.62/hour - $43.27/hour.</li>
<li>This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.</li>
<li>This role is eligible to earn commissions.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Applications for this role will be accepted on an ongoing basis.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p>
<p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p>
<p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a><br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p>
<p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-digital-sales-representative-activate">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-digital-sales-representative-activate</a></p>
</description>

We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p>
<p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p>
<p>Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive, US ISV.</p>
<p><strong>About the job</strong></p>
<p>This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling, and closing new business opportunities across high-growth ISV, High Tech, and AI accounts.</p>
<p>At Twilio, our best sellers let curiosity lead and constantly ask “what if?” This position is needed to lead prospecting, solution selling, and closing new business opportunities across our ISV, High Tech, and AI Native verticals—wearing the customers' shoes to spot where CPaaS and Conversational AI unlock real ROI. You’ll lattice up from everyday builders to executive sponsors, build deep expertise in the CPaaS ecosystem and Twilio’s platform, and partner cross-functionally with product management, solutions engineering, finance, and carrier relations to own the outcome with transparency, high standards, and no shenanigans.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you’ll:</p>
<ul>
<li>Drive net-new customer acquisition and Annual Contract Value (ACV) for a specific set of ISV, High Tech, and AI Native accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with your SDR, sales, service, product and marketing teams to own, drive, and build intelligent outbound campaigns and outside sales meetings into new prospects as well as teams in Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Operations to design mutually beneficial contracts to address customer requirements, while balancing the needs of our business.</li>
<li>Source new leads, drive sustainable pipeline growth, and maintain accurate forecasting utilizing our CRM each quarter through daily prospecting activities supported by&nbsp; proactive account mapping, territory planning, and industry networking.</li>
<li>Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms, and managing the contract process from initial qualification through close.</li>
<li>Translate complex contractual, technical, and financial details into clear business value for C-level executives, founders&nbsp; and technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Act as the voice of the customer to Twilio’s product and carrier relations teams, demonstrating a strong understanding of the CPaaS industry, staying abreast of key industry initiatives and new AI capabilities on behalf of your customers and the wider Twilio go-to-market organization.</li>
<li>Balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects and deals at the same time.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Be passionate about what you do, think outside the box, and use world-class interpersonal and communication skills to present complex contractual, technical, and financial details to prospects in a way that builds confidence and comfort in the proposed solution.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p>
<p><strong>*Required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS closing experience with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding outbound sales quota and pipeline generation targets.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Familiarity working with sales qualification methodology, mutual action plans and consultative sales frameworks.</li>
<li>Strong experience identifying, mapping, and prospecting accounts across direct outside sales.</li>
<li>Experience leading consultative sales strategies for complex, data-heavy, or API-driven platform solutions (rather than out-of-the-box point tools), with the technical curiosity to master Twilio’s CPaaS and Conversational AI stack alongside Solutions Engineers.Proven track record of multi-threading and latticing up from day-to-day users to C-level decision-makers (e.g., CFO, CMO, CTO), delivering compelling executive presentations and ROI-driven business cases to win the deal.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models&nbsp;</li>
<li>Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define process and build programs&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience outbound prospecting into install base, greenfield prospecting into new accounts, and executing strong QBR strategy for territory penetrationProficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), sales engagement platforms (e.g., Gong, Outreach), and modern prospecting tools.</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English)</li>
<li>Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of experience<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Desired:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Deep familiarity with telecommunications industry dynamics, carrier ecosystems, and emerging Voice/GenAI market trends.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Software, SaaS, CPaas or PaaS selling experience</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, MD, NJ, NY, OR, PA, RI, VA, WA, or Washington DC.</p>
<p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p><em>*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.</em></p>
<p>The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:</p>
<ul>
<li>Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $110,500.00- 138,125.00.</li>
<li>Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $117.000.00- $146,250.00</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $130,000.00- $162,500.00</li>
<li>This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.</li>
<li>This role is eligible to earn commissions.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs)</strong></p>
<p>Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until December 15, 2026 but may change based on business needs.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p>
<p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p>
<p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a><br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p>
<p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-account-executive</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> APAC - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><em><strong>Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.</strong></em></p>
<p>Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: <strong>Open Money. </strong>This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.&nbsp; Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.</p></div><p><strong>The role</strong></p>
<p>MetaMask is launching a VIP programme. As the China Relationship Manager, you will own MetaMask's relationships with Mandarin speaking high value users across Trade and Money lanes.</p>
<p><strong>What you will own</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Recruiting, onboarding and retaining high value users across Mainland China/ Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Singapore.</li>
<li>Building relationships across Mandarin speaking traders and users, community networks, including industry networks, referrals, events and inbound interest.</li>
<li>Acting as each high value user's main point of contact, and bringing in relevant teams when needed.</li>
<li>Hosting and joining gatherings across Greater China and the wider region</li>
<li>Turning conversations with high value users into insight on trading behaviour, competitor offers, market shifts and product gaps</li>
<li>Adapting communications for a Chinese speaking audience, in line with Legal guidance.</li>
<li>Tracking and reporting on pipeline, revenues and retention.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What success looks like</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>A growing, active and engaged high value user community across Chinese-speaking user base.</li>
<li>Strong retention and a healthy flow of referrals.</li>
<li>High value user feedback that shapes what Product builds.</li>
<li>Relationships handled in full compliance with our policies.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in VIP account management or business development in crypto, exchanges, brokerages or fintech.</li>
<li>A credible network among high value Mandarin-speaking traders, holders, KOLs or trading communities, or a track record of building one.</li>
<li>Native Mandarin and strong professional English. Cantonese is a plus.</li>
<li>A good understanding of the regional market dynamics and how high value users compare offerings.</li>
<li>Comfort working towards volume, fee and deposit targets.</li>
<li>Solid knowledge of on-chain trading and DeFi.</li>
<li>Sound judgement on local regulation, and comfort working with Legal guidance.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience hosting private events or community gatherings in the region.</li>
<li>Japanese or Korean language skills.</li>
<li>A product mindset: you can turn feedback into clear requirements.</li>
</ul>
<p>Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="isSelectedEnd">In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.</p>
<p>It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.</p></div>

      <title>Bitwarden: Public Sector - Account Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, U.S.
</p>

<p>Bitwarden secures credentials and secrets for millions of users and tens of thousands of organizations worldwide. Our platform spans three products:&nbsp;<strong>Password Manager</strong>, <strong>Privileged Controls</strong>, and <strong>Secrets Manager</strong>. Open source, independently audited, and built for transparency, Bitwarden is trusted by security teams who need to verify what they deploy.</p>
<p>With FedRAMP authorization on the horizon and a growing installed base across federal agencies, states, counties, and municipalities, we are investing to make Public Sector a core growth engine for the business.</p>
<h2>The Role</h2>
<p>We are hiring a Public Sector Account Executive to win and grow Bitwarden's business across Federal, State, and Local government. You will own a blended territory, carry a quota, and run full-cycle sales — from first conversation with an agency CISO to a signed order through the right contract vehicle.</p>
<p>This is a ground-floor seat on a team being built now. You'll inherit real revenue, real agency logos, and a product roadmap purpose-built for government security requirements, and you'll help shape the playbook as our FedRAMP offering comes to market. You will report to the Vice President of Public Sector and work closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Partners, Marketing, Legal, and Compliance.</p>
<h2>What You'll Own</h2>
<p><strong>Quota and Pipeline</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Carry and exceed an annual quota across a blended Federal, State, and Local territory</li>
<li>Build territory and account plans that map agency missions, budget cycles, and security priorities to Bitwarden's products</li>
<li>Generate your own pipeline through agency outreach, events, and partner co-selling, in partnership with Sales Development</li>
<li>Maintain an accurate, disciplined forecast in the CRM and contribute to weekly forecast calls and deal reviews</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Full-Cycle Selling</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Run complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, technical evaluation with Solutions Engineering, pricing, procurement, and close</li>
<li>Sell to multiple stakeholders at once — CISOs, IT and security leaders, program offices, and contracting officers</li>
<li>Expand existing agency accounts across Password Manager, Privileged Controls, and Secrets Manager</li>
<li>Navigate fiscal-year timing, including end-of-year buying windows and appropriation rhythms</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Contract Vehicles and Partners</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Close business through Bitwarden's existing vehicles — including our NASPO ValuePoint agreement via Carahsoft — and the resellers and distributors that carry them</li>
<li>Guide customers to the right purchasing path, including GSA MAS, NASA SEWP, state term contracts, and cooperative purchasing agreements</li>
<li>Co-sell with value-added resellers, systems integrators, and prime contractors to reach agencies and programs</li>
<li>Flag vehicle gaps that block deals, and feed them into the team's contract vehicle strategy</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Compliance-Led Selling</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Position Bitwarden's FedRAMP authorization path, FIPS validation, and open source transparency as reasons to buy</li>
<li>Support agency ATO processes alongside Compliance and Solutions Engineering</li>
<li>Respond to RFIs, RFPs, and sources-sought notices with Legal, Compliance, and Proposal support</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Voice of the Customer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bring government requirements (StateRAMP, CJIS, agency-level controls) back to Product and Sales leadership</li>
<li>Partner with Marketing on public sector events, campaigns, and customer references</li>
<li>Represent Bitwarden professionally with agency leadership and procurement officials</li>
</ul>
<h2>What You'll Bring</h2>
<p><strong>Required</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of quota-carrying software sales into U.S. Public Sector, with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets</li>
<li>Experience selling into both Federal and State &amp; Local government — not exclusively one or the other</li>
<li>Working knowledge of government procurement: contract vehicles, GWACs, cooperative agreements, fiscal-year cycles, and the reseller/distributor channel</li>
<li>Experience selling cybersecurity, identity, or infrastructure software to security and IT buyers</li>
<li>Proven ability to self-source pipeline and run multi-stakeholder, multi-month sales cycles</li>
<li>Comfort in a high-growth environment where the playbook is still being written</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Strongly Preferred</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience selling a FedRAMP-authorized product, or supporting agencies through the ATO process</li>
<li>Existing relationships across federal civilian, DoD, and/or large state agencies</li>
<li>Familiarity with identity security, PAM, or secrets management</li>
<li>Experience co-selling with Carahsoft or other government distributors, resellers, and systems integrators</li>
<li>Experience at an open source or developer-adjacent company</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Why Bitwarden</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Mission.</strong> Our community loves us, and you'll bring better security to everyone from families to the world's largest organizations.</li>
<li><strong>Market.</strong> You'll become an expert in two growing markets: security and open-source software.</li>
<li><strong>Growth.</strong> You'll build channel, demand gen, and product-led growth experience in a fast-growing company.</li>
<li><strong>Team.</strong> Work remotely with motivated people around the world, with in-person meet ups.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>In the United States, the starting base compensation range for this role is $100,000k - $125,000k. Actual compensation may vary based on level, relevant experience, and skill set as assessed in the interview process, as well as market data by location. See our careers page for a list of benefits. Please note that compensation outside the U.S. will differ based on the market.</em></p>
<p><em>Bitwarden is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-public-sector-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-public-sector-account-executive</a></p>

      <region>Europe Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7073/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Sweden
</p>

<div><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h2><strong>THE ROLE</strong></h2>
<p>As a Global Account Manager (GAM) in EMEA Strategics, you will own two of the Nordics’ most important global accounts. You will act as the CEO of those accounts: setting a multi-year strategy, building trusted relationships at C-level, and orchestrating Everpure teams and partners across countries to create customer value and deliver growth.</p>
<p>One account has a young but fast-growing Everpure footprint; the other is a pure acquisition opportunity where we are starting from zero. This role therefore needs both sides of a great strategic seller: the vision to lead long-term, transformational conversations with executives, and the hunter’s drive to find, open and close deals in the near term.</p>
<p>Everpure is evolving into a data intelligence company, increasingly delivered as a service. You will help customers modernise their IT, build data platforms ready for AI and address priorities such as data sovereignty, connecting their business goals to Everpure’s data infrastructure and platform portfolio.</p>
<p>The role can be based in Sweden or Denmark, and we will consider candidates located elsewhere in the Nordics.</p>
<h2><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Build and execute three-year strategic account plans, mapping each customer’s business initiatives and challenges to stakeholders, opportunities, actions and measures of success.</li>
<li>Lead strategic, transformational conversations with C-level executives and senior IT, data, AI, security, infrastructure and business leaders.</li>
<li>Hunt for and close new business by winning new buying centres, countries, workloads and use cases, balancing larger strategic programmes with tactical deals that deliver revenue in the short to medium term.</li>
<li>Lead complex, multi-country sales campaigns and coordinate virtual pursuit teams across Everpure, customer and partner organisations.</li>
<li>Position Everpure’s data infrastructure and platform portfolio, including as-a-service offerings, through outcome-led value propositions, business cases, proposals and commercial plans.</li>
<li>Own revenue delivery, partner collaboration, pipeline, forecasting and opportunity hygiene from first engagement through close and post-sales success.</li>
<li>Travel regularly across the Nordics, EMEA and internationally, with office presence in line with Everpure’s policies.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Senior experience in enterprise or global account sales, strategic account management or business development within technology, data infrastructure, enterprise software or related services.</li>
<li>A track record of strategic account planning and executive engagement with large global enterprises. Experience with major Nordic-headquartered global accounts is a strong advantage.</li>
<li>Demonstrated success as a hunter: opening large, complex organisations and creating demand where you, or a comparable solution, had little or no footprint.</li>
<li>The ability to balance long-term strategic positioning with tactical deal execution, and a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales targets with strong pipeline and forecast discipline.</li>
<li>Understanding of the data infrastructure ecosystem. A storage background is welcome but not essential; experience in AI, data intelligence, data platforms, cloud or digital transformation is equally relevant.</li>
<li>Credibility with C-level and senior business and technology stakeholders, supported by strong value selling, negotiation and executive communication skills.</li>
<li>Experience influencing distributed teams across countries and working with GSIs, VARs, MSPs and other ecosystem partners.</li>
<li>Business-fluent English (a Nordic language is not required), resilience, and willingness to travel across EMEA and internationally.</li>
</ul>
<p>We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds. If you are a strong enterprise hunter who is ready to step up to C-level strategic engagement, we would still like to hear from you.</p>
<p>#LI-REMOTE</p><div><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p>
<p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p>
<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>
<p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p>
<p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.</p>
<p><strong>Join us and bring your best.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/everpure-global-account-manager-strategic-accounts-nordics">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/everpure-global-account-manager-strategic-accounts-nordics</a></p>
</description>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.</p>
<p><em>Learn more at </em><a href="https://www.veracode.com/"><em>www.veracode.com</em></a><em>, on the </em><a href="https://www.veracode.com/blog"><em>Veracode blog</em></a><em>, and on </em><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fveracode%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cjbelmonte%40Veracode.com%7C989fdcd544fe425a07b808dc69096df9%7C3b627b68f21c4ed79fe3698efdedbe21%7C0%7C0%7C638500736454429530%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=WIg8EmVTgkrfgliLodV3%2Fgl%2F1IdGyT05d7Y%2FEfXS070%3D&amp;reserved=0"><em>LinkedIn</em></a><em> and </em><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FVeracode%3Fref_src%3Dtwsrc%255Egoogle%257Ctwcamp%255Eserp%257Ctwgr%255Eauthor&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cjbelmonte%40Veracode.com%7C989fdcd544fe425a07b808dc69096df9%7C3b627b68f21c4ed79fe3698efdedbe21%7C0%7C0%7C638500736454434178%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=YUcOAPoWdcug7OmcC1N7CEoeEKUFDAaTvgE4r1rAAe0%3D&amp;reserved=0"><em>Twitter</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>Our Senior Account Executives are key individuals who prospect, maintain, and expand relationships with accounts in assigned territories. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle including outbound prospecting, building pipeline, and closing business. We are looking for self-starters with a hunter mentality, exhibiting a consultative selling approach with our customers and channel partners.</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Learn the product offerings to become a subject matter expert for key clients.</li>
<li>Develop account and territory sales plans and strategies for assigned customer base in DACH region to meet assigned sales quotas and goals.</li>
<li>Conduct outbound prospecting and maintain key relationships to educate current and potential clients on products and services.</li>
<li>Prepare and present sales proposals and quotations to clients.</li>
<li>Organize, track and maintain client account and contact information, as well as prospect updates in CRM database.</li>
<li>Review and negotiate complex agreements and be the primary contact for Veracode.</li>
<li>Own and resolve general sales inquiries pertaining to accounts and respond to RFPs.</li>
<li>Collaborate across the organization with business development, marketing, services, pre-sales engineering, renewals, development, and executive teams to ensure successful go to market strategies.</li>
<li>Attend and participate in trade shows and seminars as needed.</li>
<li>Participate in other tasks or projects as requested by supervisor/manager.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Minimum of 5 years of Sales experience selling SaaS in Cybersecurity industry</li>
<li><strong>Fluent in German required</strong></li>
<li>Proven track record of selling to technical audiences like Security, Dev/Ops and IT Operations, and C-Level suite</li>
<li>Strong business acumen and a proven history of quota over-achievement</li>
<li>Ability to adapt to a rapidly expanding and changing environment at a high growth company</li>
<li>Ability to work in both direct and channel selling environment</li>
<li>Clear understanding of procurement, negotiations and deal closing</li>
<li>Force Management experience desirable</li>
<li>SFDC or equivalent CRM experience</li>
<li>Travel required of up to 20%</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>What we offer you:</em></strong></p>
<ul>
<li><em>Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage to meet all your healthcare needs </em></li>
<li><em>Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow with us</em></li>
<li><em>An annual contribution of 6% towards your pension</em></li>
<li><em>Life assurance, personal accident, and long-term disability insurance </em></li>
<li><em>Enhance parental leave initiatives as well as other family friendly benefits </em></li>
<li><em>Annual fitness reimbursements and access to apps that support wellbeing </em></li>
<li><em>Summer and end of year social events to bring the team together and celebrate our success</em></li>
</ul>
<p><em>Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed</h3>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.</p>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Here’s our recruitment promise to you:</p>
<ul>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.</li>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.</li>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.</li>
</ul>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-5">If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@veracode.com">careers@veracode.com</a>&nbsp;before taking any further action.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

      <title>Cribl: GSI Partner Business Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United Kingdom
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p>
<p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p></div><div>
<div>
<p><strong>Why You’ll Love This Role</strong></p>
Cribl is on a mission to unlock the value of observability and security data, and our strategic alliance partners are an important part of how we scale.<br>We’re looking for an experienced GSI alliances leader to build and grow our go-to-market strategy across EMEA, with an initial focus on key partners such as Accenture and Deloitte.<br>This is a hands-on role combining strategy, relationship building and execution. You’ll work closely with Cribl sales teams and our GSI partners to create pipeline, support joint opportunities and build repeatable services and solutions around Cribl.</div>
<ul>
<li><strong>High Impact:</strong> Play a key role in growing Cribl’s GSI business across EMEA.</li>
<li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Take responsibility for developing the regional GSI strategy and turning it into measurable results.</li>
<li><strong>Great Team:</strong> Work alongside Cribl sales, technical, marketing and global alliance teams to build something that can scale.</li>
</ul>
<div><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build the GSI Strategy:</strong> Develop and execute the EMEA go-to-market plan for our priority GSI partners, aligned with Cribl’s global alliance strategy and regional sales priorities.</li>
<li><strong>Create Pipeline:</strong> Work with Cribl and GSI sales teams to identify accounts, develop opportunities and support joint customer pursuits.</li>
<li><strong>Build Strong Relationships:</strong> Develop relationships across our GSI partners, from senior leadership and practice leads through to sales and technical teams.</li>
<li><strong>Grow GSI Practices:</strong> Help partners build their Cribl capability through training, certifications, enablement and joint business planning.</li>
<li><strong>Develop Joint Solutions:</strong> Work with partners to create repeatable solutions and services around areas such as security, observability, cloud and data.</li>
<li><strong>Drive Field Engagement:</strong> Connect Cribl account teams with the right GSI teams and create a regular cadence around account mapping, opportunities and joint activity.</li>
<li><strong>Measure Success:</strong> Own the key partnership metrics, including pipeline, revenue, enablement and partner engagement, with regular business reviews.</li>
<li><strong>Work Across EMEA:</strong> This is a regional role, so some travel and occasional work across different EMEA time zones will be required.</li>
<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.</li>
</ul>
<div><strong><br>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Strong experience in alliances, strategic partnerships, channel or enterprise sales within SaaS or enterprise software.</li>
<li>Experience working with major GSIs, ideally including <strong>Accenture and/or Deloitte</strong>, and an understanding of how they operate and go to market.</li>
<li>A good understanding of areas such as cybersecurity, observability, data, SIEM/SOC, cloud or managed services.</li>
<li>A track record of building partner relationships that generate real pipeline and revenue.</li>
<li>Comfortable working independently, building new initiatives and taking them from strategy through to execution.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with everyone from technical teams through to senior executives.</li>
<li>Nice to Have
<ul>
<li>Experience building GSI-led managed services or MSSP propositions.</li>
<li>Experience working in a fast-growing technology company.</li>
<li>Existing relationships across EMEA GSI ecosystem.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div><strong>Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who can make Cribl relevant inside our strategic GSIs, get their teams selling and delivering around Cribl, and turn those relationships into meaningful customer opportunities and revenue across EMEA.</strong></div>
</div>
<p><br>#LI-GC1<br>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Bring Your Whole Self<br></strong><span><br></span><span>Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.</span></p>
<p><span>Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at </span><a href="https://cribl.io/about-us/"><span>cribl.io/about-us</span></a><span>.&nbsp;</span></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-gsi-partner-business-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-gsi-partner-business-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>GitLab: Business Development Representative, Australia</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇦🇺 Australia</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Australia
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>This position is 100% remote and will be based in Australia (Sydney/Melbourne).</p>
<h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2>
<p>GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative to join our growing Go To Market team. As a BDR at GitLab, you will lead the initial outreach to targeted Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts in Australia, working in conjunction with our Field and Digital Marketing teams. In this role you will leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's value proposition. You will be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p>
<p>Don't have extensive knowledge about GitLab yet? Don't worry. We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab, and we will provide you with the necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Manage inbound lead flow and execute outbound prospecting initiatives.</li>
<li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations in target accounts.</li>
<li>Meet or exceed BDR sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) volume targets.</li>
<li>Collaborate with and leverage teammates to develop targeted lists, call strategies, and messaging to drive opportunities.</li>
<li>Use business and industry knowledge to research accounts, identify key players, generate interest, identify compelling events, and develop accounts.</li>
<li>Execute a variety of touches (call, email, social, etc.) on all leads in your assigned territory using Outreach.io.</li>
<li>Manage, track, and report on all activities and results using Salesforce.</li>
<li>Participate in documenting all processes in the GitLab handbook and update as needed with your Sales Development Manager.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Field and Corporate Marketing to drive attendance at regional marketing events.</li>
<li>Attend field marketing events to engage with participants, identify opportunities, and schedule meetings.</li>
<li>Act as a mentor for new BDR hires in helping them navigate their key accounts.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Digital Marketing to develop targeted marketing tactics against your assigned target accounts.</li>
<li>Share innovative ideas and collaborate with the team to continuously refine BDR strategies and drive measurable results.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Professional proficiency in English. Proficiency in other Asian languages is a plus.</li>
<li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, and strong writing skills.</li>
<li>A self-starter with a track record of successful, credible achievements.</li>
<li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li>
<li>Experience in developing Enterprise and Mid-Market business in Australia&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated persistence in meeting or exceeding targets through consistent follow-up, effective objection handling, and continuous improvement.</li>
<li>Demonstrated interest in GitLab and the DevOps space, such as staying current on GitLab releases or industry trends.</li>
<li>Proficient in using Salesforce (incl. Salesforce reporting) and LinkedIn. Proficiency in other prospecting tools (Zoominfo, Cognism, Outreach, 6Sense, etc.) is a plus.</li>
<li>Previous tech industry experience; experience in sales development, marketing, and/or sales; and outbound prospecting experience.</li>
<li>Be based in Australia (Sydney or Melbourne) and have full working rights in Australia</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p>
<p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-business-development-representative-australia">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-business-development-representative-australia</a></p>
</description>
