      <title>Tebra: Senior Events Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Tebra only initiates contact with candidates via email from an official Tebra email address (@<a class="c-link" href="http://tebra.com/">tebra.com</a>, @<a class="c-link" href="http://patientpop.com/">patientpop.com</a>, or @<a class="c-link" href="http://kareo.com/">kareo.com</a>) or through our applicant tracking system, Greenhouse.&nbsp;We will only ask you to provide sensitive personal information through our official application portal — not via social media or text message. We do not conduct interviews via instant messaging.</p></div><h1>About the Role</h1>
<p>We’re looking to grow our events program into one of our most dependable sources of pipeline, and we’re looking for a Senior Events Marketing Manager to lead the way. You’ll own the full event lifecycle, from choosing the right conferences for our ideal customer to partnering with Sales so booth conversations become qualified opportunities. If you love pairing sharp analytics with hands-on execution and want to see your work show up in revenue, this is your seat.</p>
<h1>Your Area of Focus</h1>
<ul>
<li>Build a data-driven event strategy by evaluating conferences and events against our ideal customer profile, delivering a prioritized event calendar that puts our budget where our best-fit buyers gather.</li>
<li>Own the events budget and track cost against pipeline for every program, delivering regular ROI reporting that guides what we scale, renegotiate, or cut.</li>
<li>Manage vendor relationships for booths, signage, shipping, and event materials, negotiating to deliver a polished, professional presence at every event.</li>
<li>Run end-to-end event logistics, ensuring everything arrives, is set up, and runs smoothly on site.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales to select the right reps for each event, coordinate their travel details, and brief them before every show so they arrive prepared and confident.</li>
<li>Drive post-event follow-up by working with Sales to make sure every lead is routed, contacted, and worked, turning conversations into qualified pipeline.</li>
<li>Collaborate with our Growth Operations team to launch landing pages, email campaigns, and other promotions before and after each event.</li>
<li>Own pipeline targets for the events program, reporting on results and recommending changes that improve performance each quarter.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Your Professional Qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of B2B event or field marketing experience, including time in a senior or lead role.</li>
<li>Proven track record of driving qualified pipelines from events, and the ability to explain how you measured it.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience managing event budgets and negotiating with vendors.</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills, with comfort evaluating cost per lead, cost per opportunity, and pipeline influence.</li>
<li>Experience working with a CRM and marketing automation platform to track event leads and results (we currently use Salesforce and Marketo).</li>
<li>Demonstrated success partnering with Sales teams on event strategy and lead follow-up.</li>
<li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to give clear direction to internal teams and external vendors.</li>
<li>Highly detail-oriented, able to manage logistics for multiple events at once.</li>
<li>Collaborative by nature, with a sense of ownership for outcomes, not just execution.</li>
<li>Preferred: experience in healthcare or healthcare technology, or supporting events for SMB SaaS companies.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>#LI-AH1 #LI-Remote</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>In compliance with California's pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this position will be provided and may include an hourly rate, annual salary, or On-Target Earnings (OTE), depending on the nature of the role. The specific compensation structure and detailed range will be discussed with qualified candidates during the initial talent screen.</p></div><div class="title">Remote Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$124,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$142,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1>About Tebra</h1>
<p>Tebra is the only all-in-one EHR+ platform built exclusively for independent healthcare practices. Designed to replace the clunky, fragmented tools built for corporate systems, Tebra connects EHR software, billing, automation, telehealth solution, and marketing — so providers can spend less time on admin and more time with patients. More than 42,000 private practices trust Tebra to streamline operations, increase revenue, and reduce burnout — helping clinicians leave work on time and rediscover their purpose. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="http://www.tebra.com/">www.tebra.com</a>.</p>
<h1>Our Values</h1>
<h2>Start with the Customer&nbsp;</h2>
<p>We get to know our customers - and their patients - and look at the world through their lens.</p>
<h2>Keep It Simple</h2>
<p>Healthcare is too complex. We aim to simplify it for everyone.</p>
<h2>Stay Entrepreneurial&nbsp;</h2>
<p>We reject the status quo and solve problems with creativity, perseverance, and a bias to action.</p>
<h2>Better Together</h2>
<p>We are diverse, humble, and collaborative. We put the team first and win together.</p>
<h2>Celebrate Success</h2>
<p>Life is short and joy is underrated. We take time to have fun and celebrate success.</p>
<h1>Perks &amp; Benefits&nbsp;</h1>
<p>United States: In addition to our healthcare benefits, we also offer amazing perks! Need work from home basics? We offer a discount through Dell! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for a great workout, or TelusEmployee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.</p>
<p>Costa Rica: To assist with all of life’s needs, Tebra also offers a wellness and childcare subsidy and a University/Education discount! We also offer a number of resources to help you keep your mind and body healthy. Check out Gympass for access to health and fitness apps, or Telus Employee Assistance Program to find mental health resources, along with other resources for everyday occurrences.</p>
<h1>Compliance &amp; Privacy Disclosures</h1>
<p><em><span>NOTE: Tebra is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>California residents who apply or are recruited for a job with us: please carefully review our California-specific Privacy Notice under the California Consumer Protection Act here: <a href="https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/">https://www.tebra.com/privacy-policy/california-supplemental-notice/</a></span></em></p>
<p><em><span>If you would like to report a fraudulent Tebra job posting, please contact us at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="mailto:talentacquisition@tebra.com">talentacquisition@tebra.com</a>&nbsp;and consider reporting your experience to the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center or the Better Business Bureau to help keep others safe online, too.</span></em></p>
<p></p>
<p><em>As part of our commitment to a fair and efficient hiring process, Tebra utilizes Greenhouse Notetaker, Greenhouse's native interview intelligence tool, for our phone and video screenings. This technology records and transcribes interviews to help us ensure consistency, reduce bias, and make more informed hiring decisions. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your interview may be recorded.</em></p>
<p></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tebra-senior-events-marketing-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tebra-senior-events-marketing-manager</a></p>
</description>

<p>

</p>

<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Through the channel, a great product only wins when the partner knows how to sell it. At Abnormal, we want every partner ready to lead with the whole platform.</p>
<p>Abnormal is a channel-first company: nearly all of our transactions run through partners, which makes partner readiness a direct driver of revenue. As Channel Enablement Manager, you will own how our reseller, distributor, and referral partners learn to position, sell, and support the full Abnormal platform, and how our internal sellers work alongside them. We are expanding from email security into a multi-product behavioral platform spanning Identity, Insider Risk, and AI Security, so partners need to lead with the platform and grow every customer over time. You will be the person who makes that possible.</p>
<p>This is a high-visibility individual contributor role on the Sales Enablement team, working closely with Channel Leadership, Channel Account Managers (CAMs), and Channel SEs. You will build scalable, role-based partner enablement and certifications, deliver training people remember, and use data to prove that enabled partners generate more pipeline and win more deals. It is a role for someone who loves the craft of helping others succeed and wants to bring AI to the center of how enablement scales.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build the framework.</strong> Design, build, and deliver a role-based partner enablement framework (Partner Essentials, Partner Sales 101, Pre-Sales 101, and advanced modules) through the Partner Portal and live sessions.</li>
<li><strong>Get partners productive faster.</strong> Lead partner onboarding that takes new and focus partners from signed to productive, with clear readiness milestones and certification paths.</li>
<li><strong>Train with impact.</strong> Deliver engaging in-person and virtual training to partner sellers, SEs, and leaders on Abnormal's value proposition, SEG displacement, discovery, qualification, and competitive positioning.</li>
<li><strong>Teach partners to sell the platform.</strong> Enable partners to sell Abnormal as a platform, with clear land-and-expand plays, cross-sell motions, and readiness for every new product launch.</li>
<li><strong>Prepare our own teams to co-sell.</strong> Enable Abnormal AEs, SDRs, and SEs on how to work with partners, including rules of engagement, deal registration, channel discounts, and renewal incumbency.</li>
<li><strong>Create the assets partners use.</strong> Partner with CAMs, Channel SEs, Channel Ops, Channel Marketing, and Product Marketing to deliver partner-facing sales plays, use cases, win wires, campaigns-in-a-box, and competitive intelligence.</li>
<li><strong>Let the data steer.</strong> Use performance data (partner-sourced pipeline, deal reg conversion, certification completion, win rates) to find gaps, prioritize investments, and report measurable impact.</li>
<li><strong>Scale with AI.</strong> Use AI to scale enablement and reduce CAM 1:1 training time, through AI-assisted content, roleplays, and on-demand coaching, so CAMs can focus on pipeline generation and partner-sourced revenue.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>5 to 8+ years in channel sales, partner management, sales, or a sales-supporting role (for example, channel/partner enablement, CAM, channel SE, sales enablement), with a track record of individual success and/or developing others.</li>
<li>Direct experience working with or enabling channel partners (VARs, resellers, distributors, MSPs, or referral partners) in a B2B SaaS environment, a solid understanding of how partners make money and decide which vendors to champion, and the credibility to influence partner sellers and internal AEs on co-selling, deal registration, and channel conflict.</li>
<li>Experience designing and running scalable enablement: certifications, on-demand courses, LMS/partner portal content, and live training.</li>
<li>A genuine desire to help others succeed, with a sense of accomplishment tied to partner and field performance as much as your own.</li>
<li>A strong analytical mindset. You use data to diagnose performance and prioritize enablement, and can describe past examples of how data drove change.</li>
<li>Outstanding communication and facilitation skills, including front-of-room presentations, writing, and editing, with high attention to detail.</li>
<li>AI fluency. You use AI tools daily to build content, analyze data, and scale enablement, and you can clearly explain AI-native security concepts (behavioral AI, AI agents, AI governance) to partner sellers and their customers.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel approximately 20 to 30% for partner events, bootcamps at our Las Vegas training center, and offsites.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Nice to Have</h2>
<ul>
<li>Cybersecurity or IT security industry experience, or experience selling into security/IT buyer personas.</li>
<li>Experience enabling a multi-product or platform portfolio, including cross-sell, upsell, and new product launch readiness.</li>
<li>Experience with sales methodologies such as Force Management and MEDDIC, and translating them for partner audiences.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with partner portals/PRM and LMS platforms (e.g. Highspot, partner relationship management tools).</li>
<li>Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth (pre-IPO) environment, thriving in ambiguity and wearing multiple hats.</li>
</ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, California, United States, AMER
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><strong>About Us</strong></p>
<p>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.</p>
<p>Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.</p>
<p>Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.</p>
<p>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.</p>
<p>During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We’re looking for a Partner Sales Manager to drive North American sales execution with Snowflake and accelerate co-selling and go-to-market activities across our ecosystem.</p>
<p><span>This is a full-time remote position in the US.</span></p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build productive North American sales relationships with Snowflake</li>
<li>Drive sales enablement &amp; engagement with Snowflake &amp; our sellers to grow pipeline and exceed revenue and consumption goals</li>
<li>Drive joint sales &amp; marketing plays to generate pipeline and closed revenue for Fivetran &amp; dbt Labs</li>
<li>Collaborate internally at Fivetran and dbt Labs with product, sales, and marketing functions to accelerate revenue impact for Fivetran and dbt through Snowflake</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Skills We’re Looking For</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5–8 years of experience as a partner sales or partner development manager, with a proven ability to build mutual success with large data and AI platform partners</li>
<li>Experience partnering with &amp; navigating hyperscaler/platform partner sales and marketing organizations</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed pipeline/revenue quotas through partners</li>
<li>Well-developed commercial mindset with the ability to create partner-sourced pipeline</li>
<li>Excellent verbal, written, and in-person communication skills to interact with internal and external sales leadership as well as Account Executives</li>
<li>Ability to operate in a highly accountable, fast-paced work environment with integrity</li>
<li>Passion for being an inclusive, collaborative teammate focused on business outcomes</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus Skills​</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>An existing Snowflake network of sellers, solutions architects, and leaders</li>
<li>Track record of success in sales and alliances at technology companies; startup experience preferred, but not required</li>
<li>The ability to articulate a clear strategy for growing and supporting your partner</li>
<li>Ability to adapt quickly as product and platform partner strategies evolve</li>
<li>Demonstrated expertise in data analytics, ETL, BI, and/or open-source software</li>
</ul>
<p>This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.</p>
<p><span>#LI-REMOTE</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">OTE (On Target Earning)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$168,587</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$202,313 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Perks and Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>100% employer-paid medical insurance<strong>*</strong></li>
<li>Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.</li>
<li>RSU stock grants*</li>
<li>Professional development and training opportunities</li>
<li>Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities</li>
<li>Monthly cell phone stipend</li>
<li>Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.</li>
</ul>

<hr>
<p>We’re honored to be <a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/blog/hvr-acquisition-series-d">valued at over $5.6 billion</a>, but more importantly, we’re proud of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/culture">core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream</a>. Read about us in&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran-com.s3.amazonaws.com/news/forbes-aug-sept-2022-digital-reprint-10-21-22.pdf">Forbes</a>.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion &amp; belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.</p>
<p>To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xlhtp4dGh8o">click here</a> and enjoy our video.</p>
<p>To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can <a href="https://fivetran.com/candidate-privacy">read our statement here</a>.</p>

      <title>Justworks: Account Executive - In-Territory (Tampa, Miami, Orlando, Sarasota)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - U.S.A.
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h1><strong>Who We Are</strong></h1>
<p><span>At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.</span></p>
<p><span>We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.</span></p>
<p><span>We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.</span></p>
<p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#values"><span>Our Values</span></a></p>
<p><span>If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Who You Are</strong></h1>
<p><strong><span>The sales team at Justworks is ultimately in charge of expanding our customer base while driving revenue and growth. As an Account Executive in-territory in Miami, you will be responsible for the full sales cycle - building and managing a sales pipeline, market research, prospecting, fostering relationships and creating new ones, contract negotiation, and closing on your deals. Sales is challenging, especially at a start-up but it’s a fulfilling and rewarding experience as you become a trusted advisor to our customers.</span></strong></p>
<h1><strong>Your Success Profile</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>What You Will Work On</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><span>Manage own book of business, build and manage an end-to-end sales pipeline and all supporting activities; prospect to close; meet or exceed your quotas</span></li>
<li><span>Establish a presence in your territory; research the ins and outs of your<strong> </strong>territory, develop a marketing and networking plan for how you will reach entrepreneur community in your market, and build relationships with the small business community</span></li>
<li><span>Proactively prospect for new business by leveraging market research, sales tools, and cold prospecting</span></li>
<li><span>Gain a sound understanding of our value proposition and effectively communicate that to new potential customers</span></li>
<li><span>Be the voice of our future customers - suggest innovative ideas to generate sales, cultivate customer pipeline leads; improve overall customer experience  and advocate internally for product development</span></li>
<li><span>Be an ambassador of Justworks and its solutions; strive to gain an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of our suite of products</span></li>
<li><span>Travel in- territory in the Miami area</span></li>
<li><span>Perform other duties as needed based on department and/or organizational needs</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How You Will Do Your Work</strong></h2>
<p><span>As an Account Executive, </span><em><span>how</span></em><span> results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Good judgement </strong><span>- the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.</span></li>
<li><strong>Detail-oriented </strong><span>- exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.</span></li>
<li><strong>Foundational sales knowledge </strong><span>- the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a salesperson possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.</span></li>
<li><strong>Results-driven </strong><span>- consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.</span></li>
<li><strong>Clear communication </strong><span>- the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Camaraderie</strong><span> - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.</span></li>
<li><strong>Openness</strong><span> - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.</span></li>
<li><strong>Grit </strong><span>- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.</span></li>
<li><strong>Integrity</strong><span> - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><strong>Simplicity</strong><span> - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><span>A minimum of 2 years experience in an Account Executive position and 1-year experience managing a complete and consultative sales cycle and closing are required.</span></strong></li>
<li><strong><span>Experience in Lead generation for B2B in a high-velocity setting (i.e., SaaS, PEO, Fintech)Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn SalesNavigator, and/or ZoomInfo are required. Experience with Outreach.io and/or Hubspot, in addition to 6Sense and/or Hoovers/D&amp;B, is a plus.</span></strong></li>
<li><span>Cold-calling experience is required for this position. </span></li>
<li><strong><span>We are seeking candidates with a hunter mentality who are dedicated to grabbing new prospects, netting new logos, closing deals, and delivering immediate results.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></strong></li>
<li><span>Passionate about sales and relationship-focused customer engagements</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrates the ability to listen to gather important information during a sales call and/or meeting</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to simplify complicated topics and explain them in terms people can easily understand</span></li>
<li><span>Able to apply creative solutions to a variety of issues in a fast-paced environment</span></li>
<li><span>You enjoy entrepreneurial environments and the opportunity to build something meaningful!</span></li>
<li><span>There is travel within the territory (25% travel), which includes networking events, trade shows, and meeting potential clients</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>This position is paid a base wage plus incentive compensation. The base wage range for this position is targeted at $83,700.00 - $83,700.00 in our Florida offices, and competitive On-Target Earnings, inclusive of incentive compensation, of *$163,700.00 - $163,700.00. Final offers may vary from those listed. *Incentive compensation is not guaranteed, and earning is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive compensation plan.</span></p>
<p><span><span>#LI-Hybrid #LI-KH1</span></span></p>
<p><strong>Use of AI Tools.</strong> We may use artificial intelligence and other automated tools to process your personal information as part of the recruitment process. For example, we may use these tools to record, transcribe, and summarize interviews, to help organize and review applications, and to help us assess candidates by comparing their skills, experience, and qualifications against the criteria for open roles. These tools support, but do not replace, human review. We do not make hiring decisions based solely on automated processing, and all final hiring decisions are made by Justworks recruiters and hiring managers. Depending on where you reside, you may have rights regarding our use of automated tools. For more information, please contact us at privacy@justworks.com.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.&nbsp; </span><span>Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit </span><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#total-reward-philosophy">Total Rewards @ Justworks</a><span>.&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1><strong>Diversity At Justworks</strong></h1>
<p><span>Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.</span></p>
<p>We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or familial status, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. Justworks is fully dedicated to providing necessary support to candidates with disabilities who may require reasonable accommodations. We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If you're in need of a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at <a href="mailto:accommodations@justworks.com">accommodations@justworks.com</a>. Your comfort and success matter to us, and we're here to ensure an inclusive experience.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/press/company-news/justworks-impact-report-2024"><span>Our DEIB Report&nbsp;</span></a></p></div>

<li><span>Manage own book of business, build and manage an end-to-end sales pipeline and all supporting activities; prospect to close; meet or exceed your quotas</span></li>
<li><span>Establish a presence in your territory; research the ins and outs of your<strong> </strong>territory, develop a marketing and networking plan for how you will reach entrepreneur community in your market, and build relationships with the small business community</span></li>
<li><span>Proactively prospect for new business by leveraging market research, sales tools, and cold prospecting</span></li>
<li><span>Gain a sound understanding of our value proposition and effectively communicate that to new potential customers</span></li>
<li><span>Be the voice of our future customers - suggest innovative ideas to generate sales, cultivate customer pipeline leads; improve overall customer experience  and advocate internally for product development</span></li>
<li><span>Be an ambassador of Justworks and its solutions; strive to gain an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of our suite of products</span></li>
<li><span>Travel in- territory in the San Diego area</span></li>
<li><span>Perform other duties as needed based on department and/or organizational needs</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How You Will Do Your Work</strong></h2>
<p><span>As an Account Executive, </span><em><span>how</span></em><span> results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Good judgement </strong><span>- the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.</span></li>
<li><strong>Detail-oriented </strong><span>- exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.</span></li>
<li><strong>Foundational sales knowledge </strong><span>- the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a salesperson possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.</span></li>
<li><strong>Results-driven </strong><span>- consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.</span></li>
<li><strong>Clear communication </strong><span>- the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Camaraderie</strong><span> - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.</span></li>
<li><strong>Openness</strong><span> - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.</span></li>
<li><strong>Grit </strong><span>- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.</span></li>
<li><strong>Integrity</strong><span> - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><strong>Simplicity</strong><span> - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><span>A minimum of 2 years experience in an Account Executive position and 1-year experience managing a complete and consultative sales cycle and closing are required.</span></strong></li>
<li><strong><span>Experience in Lead generation for B2B in a high-velocity setting (i.e., SaaS, PEO, Fintech)Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn SalesNavigator, and/or ZoomInfo are required. Experience with Outreach.io and/or Hubspot, in addition to 6Sense and/or Hoovers/D&amp;B, is a plus.</span></strong></li>
<li><span>Cold-calling experience is required for this position. </span></li>
<li><strong><span>We are seeking candidates with a hunter mentality who are dedicated to grabbing new prospects, netting new logos, closing deals, and delivering immediate results.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></strong></li>
<li><span>Passionate about sales and relationship-focused customer engagements</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrates the ability to listen to gather important information during a sales call and/or meeting</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to simplify complicated topics and explain them in terms people can easily understand</span></li>
<li><span>Able to apply creative solutions to a variety of issues in a fast-paced environment</span></li>
<li><span>You enjoy entrepreneurial environments and the opportunity to build something meaningful!</span></li>
<li><span>There is travel within the territory (25% travel), which includes networking events, trade shows, and meeting potential clients</span></li>
</ul>
<p>This position is paid a base wage plus incentive compensation. The base wage range for this position is targeted at $91,000.00 - $110,000.00 in our San Diego office, and competitive On-Target Earnings, inclusive of incentive compensation, of *$182,000.00 - $220,000.00. <div class="content-intro"><p>ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>At ZoomInfo, we move fast, think boldly, and help you do the best work of your career. You'll work with teammates who care, take initiative and push each other to grow, and you'll have the tools and support to make an impact from day one.</p>
<h3>About the role</h3>
<p>Search is changing faster than at any point in the last 20 years. Buyers now find answers in Google and in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and AI Overviews, and we want ZoomInfo to always be the answer they get.<br><br></p>
<p>As Senior SEO &amp; AI Search Manager, you'll own projects across ZoomInfo's organic and AI search strategy, spanning all ZoomInfo domains, and the wider SEO and AI search roadmap. You'll write and ship content yourself, help manage our agency and vendor partners, and work closely with Sales, Product and Demand Generation. Success means connecting visibility to pipeline and revenue, not traffic alone. You'll report to the Director, Content Engineering.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own specific SEO and AI search projects end to end, each tied to a defined outcome such as visibility, AI mention share or pipeline</li>
<li>Write and own SEO and AI search content yourself, from research through to publishing</li>
<li>Deliver AI search projects that grow citation share, brand mentions and share of voice, and shape how AI answers describe ZoomInfo's key launches and capabilities</li>
<li>Set direction for an agent-ready site, optimized for AI agents and agentic workflows from content through to product, as part of our product-led growth push</li>
<li>Apply our Content Engineering frameworks and hold all search content to their quality standards</li>
<li>Help own day-to-day management of our SEO, link-building and AI-visibility partners</li>
<li>Own aspects of SEO and AI search measurement from visibility to revenue, and report it to marketing leadership</li>
<li>Support key projects such as product launches, aligning with Sales, Product and Demand Generation so search is in the plan from the start</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in SEO, with experience at a B2B SaaS company</li>
<li>You're an effective writer in your own right, with experience owning content end to end</li>
<li>A proven record of connecting organic and AI search visibility to pipeline and revenue</li>
<li>Practical experience with AI search and a point of view on where it is heading</li>
<li>Strong technical SEO literacy, including agentic crawlability: you can diagnose issues and write requirements engineers can act on</li>
<li>Familiarity with content engineering: structured content, programmatic pages, entity optimization and AI-assisted workflows</li>
<li>Fluency with Ahrefs or Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4, crawlers and AI-visibility tools</li>
<li>Experience working with agencies and influencing senior stakeholders</li>
<li>Curiosity about how AI can make search and content teams faster and smarter</li>
</ul>
<p><br>Bonus points: experience running programmatic SEO plays; a background in GTM, data or MarTech products.</p>
<p><br><strong>To apply: please include a link to your portfolio.</strong></p>

<p>The base salary range for this role in the UK is £80,000 – £90,000 . Actual pay depends on location, qualifications, skills and experience.       <title>Bitwarden: Mid-Market Sales Leader - EMEA</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇬🇧 United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, UK
</p>

<p>Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://bitwarden.com/">bitwarden.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are looking for a Leader to lead the EMEA small to medium and Mid market team and is based remotely in the UK.</p>
<h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3>
<p>This role leads the EMEA Small to medium and MidMarket business team and is accountable for new logo acquisition and expansion revenue across the region. The expectations are high: a team that generates its own pipeline across multiple countries, deals that are qualified with discipline, forecasts that hold, and Account Executives who improve every quarter.</p>
<p>This is not an oversight role. The leader in this seat works deals alongside their team, sets the standard for outbound execution in each market, and uses data to drive performance. It is a first-line leader role who has already delivered results in EMEA and wants to operate at the pace and scale of a fast-growing company.</p>
<h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<h4><strong>Deal leadership</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Engage directly in the team's most important opportunities: discovery, executive alignment, mutual close plans, commercial structure, procurement, legal, DPA, and security review.</li>
<li>Set the standard for value-based selling: quantifying the customer's business pain, building the business case, and tying Bitwarden to risk reduction and compliance outcomes that drive European buying decisions (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001).</li>
<li>Diagnose and unblock stalled deals, and use them to raise the skill level of the entire team. Coach disciplined excellence and field skills to find, transition and close deals efficiently.</li>
<li>Work tirelessly in the detail of each customer requirement, enabled by experience and strategic effort, placing Bitwarden in the best position possible to win deals and transfer this knowledge to the team.</li>
<li>Drive accountability through metrics, motivation, method and effective communication techniques. Be accountable, methodical, pragmatic and foster by example lead from the front.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Outbound pipeline generation</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Build and mature a repeatable cold outbound motion with AEs and partnered SDRs, localized by market: territory and account prioritization, ICP and persona targeting, multi-threaded sequencing, and messaging adapted for country and language.</li>
<li>Set activity and pipeline-generation standards, inspect them weekly, and hold every AE accountable for self-sourced pipeline.</li>
<li>Align and drive our message with Marketing, Sales Development, and Channel on programs, including partner-sourced plays, that produce qualified pipeline at a predictable rate.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>MEDDPICC and value-based execution</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Run MEDDPICC as the team's operating system across qualification, deal reviews, forecast calls, and win/loss analysis, with value-based selling defining how the team earns and proves each element.</li>
<li>Inspect every material opportunity for quantified Metrics, a validated Economic Buyer, a tested Champion, clear Decision Criteria and Process, a mapped Paper Process (including works council, procurement, and data-protection steps), and an honest read on Competition.</li>
<li>Deliver an accurate weekly forecast built on deal evidence and maintain CRM data the business can rely on.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Data-driven coaching</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Own the team's KPIs (pipeline generation, coverage, stage conversion, win rate, cycle length, average deal size, and activity-to-outcome ratios) by rep and by market, and act on what they show.</li>
<li>Identify where each AE is losing ground and build targeted coaching plans to close the gap.</li>
<li>Run a disciplined operating cadence across time zones: weekly 1:1s, pipeline and deal reviews, forecast calls, and call reviews.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Team building</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Recruit, hire, onboard, and ramp high-caliber Account Executives across EMEA markets, and develop them toward promotion.</li>
<li>Build a culture of accountability, competitiveness, and continuous improvement across countries and cultures.</li>
<li>Work across Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing, to deliver revenue as one team.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>3–5 years of first-line sales leadership in EMEA, ideally leading AEs selling security SaaS (identity, access, credential, endpoint, or adjacent categories).</li>
<li>A proven, documented track record of quota attainment as a leader, and as an individual contributor before that.</li>
<li>Deep working fluency in MEDDPICC and value-based selling, applied together to qualify, inspect, forecast, and coach.</li>
<li>A track record of building and maturing a cold outbound pipeline across more than one EMEA market, with the ability to explain exactly how it was done and what it produced.</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills, including fluency with Hubspot &amp; industry tooling for reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets, and a record of using KPIs to direct coaching and improve AE performance.</li>
<li>A hands-on approach to leadership, with direct, regular involvement in live deals.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Player-coach, building own pipeline coaching the team through example, including closing and processing, customer excellence.</li>

That's a legacy.</p><p>This is not a coast job. <br>Not a "circle back Tuesday" job. <br>Not a place where mediocrity gets another quarter to figure itself out.</p><p>If your pulse picked up while reading this, prove it.</p><p>Don't send us a resume that reads like a LinkedIn obituary. <br>Tell us what you've closed. <br>Tell us what you've built. <br>Tell us why you're the one.<br></p>What You’ll Do:<p>Phase 1 – Master the Machine</p><ul><li> Learn our scripts, CRM, and booking process </li><li> Sharpen your sales skills and start closing deals </li><li> Audit our current system and identify areas for improvement </li><li>Work with our existing team to increase their output<br></li></ul><p>Phase 2 – Scale the Team</p><ul><li> Continue to recruit insurance agents and closers for our coaching offer</li><li>Continue to recruit and add to your SDR Team</li><li> Lead 1:1 coaching, daily huddles, live sales reviews, and performance tracking </li><li> Build sales culture and help the team hit their stride fast </li><li> Work with leadership on onboarding, training systems, and KPIs </li></ul><p><br>Phase 3 – Own the Department</p><ul><li> Drive the department’s revenue, recruiting, and team performance </li><li> Collaborate with execs to scale campaigns and comp plans </li><li> Develop internal leaders and create strong bench strength under you </li></ul>
<p>You're the kind of person who doesn’t wait for direction — you take it and run.</p>You’ll crush this role if you:<ul><li>Have 3–5+ years in sales, including 1–2 years leading high-performing teams </li><li>Have managed a sales team of 20+ people</li><li>You are tech savvy</li><li>You understand and are proficient with pipeline management</li><li>Have built, hired, or scaled a sales team before </li><li>Are a strong closer with deep understanding of sales psychology </li><li>Know how to motivate, coach, and hold others accountable to results </li><li>Want ownership, not micromanagement </li><li>Have a track record of driving numbers into the green and scaling sales systems </li><li>Are obsessed with growth — both personally and professionally </li><li>Want to build something long-term with real legacy potential <br> </li></ul><p>KPI Ownership:</p><ul><li> 400+ Appointments Set / Month </li><li> 250+ Appointments Held / Month </li><li> 100+ Applications / Month </li><li> $1M+ in Funded Policies / Month </li><li> Reps onboarded and fully ramped within 30 days </li></ul>
<p>We believe in building something bigger than ourselves — and taking care of the people who help us do it.</p>What You’ll Get:<ul><li> Compensation: </li><ul><li>Compensation: Base of $5,000 - $10,000+ Per Month to Start Based on Experience, Past Results &amp;&nbsp;Tenure</li><li> Up to $12,000/month in bonus potential for Funded Policies </li><li> 3% revenue share on Lab division which is our coaching business<br> </li></ul><li> Leadership Opportunity: </li><ul><li> Real decision-making power — not just managing, but building </li><li> Direct collaboration with founders and execs </li><li> A voice in compensation, culture, and long-term strategy </li></ul></ul><p></p><ul><li> Team &amp; Culture: </li><ul><li> Join a mission-driven team that cares deeply about freedom </li><li> A high-performance culture built on accountability and growth </li><li> Systems and support to help you win </li></ul></ul><p></p><ul><li> Long-Term Potential: </li><ul><li> Opportunity to build your own division within the company </li><li> Create systems, culture, and success that outlast you </li><li> Mentorship from 7- and 8-figure business builders </li></ul></ul>

<p>Appointment Setter, Wealth Without Wall Street (Remote)</p><p>Read this first. It might save you an hour.</p><p>The base on this job is $2,000 a month. It's real, it's guaranteed, and it won't pay your bills by itself. We're not going to pretend it will.</p><p>If that made you close the tab, good. We just saved each other some time.</p><p>If it made you lean in, here's why the people who win this seat don't care about the base.</p><p>30,000 people are sitting in our database. Every one of them raised their hand to learn how to build passive income and become their own bank. Almost nobody is calling them.</p><p>That's your seat.</p><p>Who we are: Russ Morgan and Joey Muré have been teaching business owners how money actually works since 2015. They wrote the book on it, literally. And they don't just teach it. Every month they publish their own passive income in public. Most money teachers won't show you their numbers. Ours put theirs out every month.</p><p>What you'll actually do<br><br>You'll call warm leads. No bought lists and no cold calling.</p><ul><li>About 200 new leads come in every month from our webinars and referrals.</li><li>Behind them are 30,000 people who know our name and haven't heard from us in a while. Some raised a hand this morning and some a year ago.</li><li>You book qualified calls for our closers, and you follow up like it matters, because it does.<br></li></ul><p>Here's the catch. These are business owners, and plenty of them have read the book. Read a script at them and they'll eat you alive. You have to actually understand what you're talking about.</p><p>That's the part no other sales job will give you. While we pay you to make these calls, you learn the same system our clients pay to learn: how to stop handing your money to the banks and how to build income that keeps coming in. You'll use it on the phone, and then you'll use it in your own life.</p><p><br>The math (check it yourself)</p><ul><li>$2,000 monthly base</li><li>$50 to $100 for every appointment that shows</li><li>About $300 for every sale that closes from your bookings<br></li></ul><p>20 closes a month is $6,000 in commission. Add the $2,000 base and you're at $8,000 before appointment pay. That's what this seat is built to produce.</p><p>You won't get there in your first month. The early stretch is leaner while you learn the system and build your pipeline. Setters who win treat that stretch as an investment. Setters who wash out treat it as a paycheck.</p><p>Where this goes: We're filling closing seats too. They go to whoever earns them, and the fastest way to earn one is from this chair.</p>
<p>You'll fit if:</p><ul><li>You've spent 1 to 2 years on the phone somewhere real: solar, door to door, appointment setting, insurance, high-ticket, inside sales or home services</li><li>You can hold your ground with a business owner who pushes back, 50 times a day</li><li>You can make 150 dials without hunting for a shortcut</li><li>When you get coaching, tomorrow's call sounds different</li><li>You follow up without being reminded</li><li>You've worked in a CRM (HubSpot is a plus)</li><li>You have reliable internet and a quiet, professional home office</li></ul><p>Please don't apply if:</p><ul><li>You want the base to carry you and see commission as a bonus</li><li>You've hopped between 3 or more sales jobs in the last 2 years</li><li>You go quiet when a buyer who's read the book pushes back</li><li>You need someone watching you to stay on the phone at 4pm</li></ul><p>What winning looks like here: you hit your dials every day, call new leads fast, book qualified appointments, use coaching the same day you get it and own your number.</p>
Compensation<p>This is a performance-based opportunity that rewards consistency and execution.<br></p><ul><li>$2,000 monthly base, plus $50 to $100 per held appointment and about $300 per closed sale</li><li>Typical on-target earnings of $6,000 to $10,000 a month once you're ramped</li><li>Warm inbound leads, with zero cold lists</li><li>Fully remote</li><li>Real onboarding and ongoing coaching from experienced sales leaders</li><li>A clear path into closing and sales leadership</li><li>You learn the wealth system our clients pay to learn, on the clock</li><li>An established company that has been teaching this since 2015</li></ul><p>Actual earnings depend on individual performance and are not guaranteed.</p>

      <title>Appleseed: (Senior) Behavioral Researcher & Strategist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Wisconsin</state>
      <skills>Consumer Behavior, Market Research,  Client Relationship Management, and Storytelling</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7043/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://appleseedimpact.org/">https://appleseedimpact.org/</a>
</p>

<p>Are you a behavioral marketing or design researcher/strategist, ready to use your expertise to tackle some of the world’s toughest challenges? Join Appleseed and create lasting social and environmental impact in communities across the globe.</p>
<p> This is a remote position with travel required. You may be based anywhere.</p>
<h3>About the Role</h3>
<p>Appleseed is building a team of seasoned behavioral strategists who are also skilled researchers and client partners. This is not an academic or theoretical role: our consultants deliver B2B client services, leading field-driven research and crafting human-centered strategies that stick. We work only with nonprofits and funders fighting poverty and protecting the planet. This role requires behavioral insight, leadership &amp; storytelling ability, and a deep commitment to continuous learning.</p>
<p>We are seeking to fill both full-time core team and freelance project lead roles with significant ownership and influence in shaping Appleseed’s craft and culture. We are excited to meet exceptional candidates who prefer ongoing project-based work, as well as those who would rather join the core team full-time.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Freelance Project Fees:</strong> $20,000–$24,000 per project (travel covered separately)</li>
<li><strong>Core Team Salary Range:</strong> $95,000–$124,000 (growth potential to &gt;$160,000)</li>
<li><strong>Work Week:</strong> 4-day week; Thursdays off</li>
<li><strong>Benefits:</strong> Flexible work location and schedule, 178 annual workdays (vs. global average of 225–244), paid international travel, and stipends for workspace and professional development.</li>
</ul>
<p>Feel free to apply even if you are not immediately available — we will have ongoing project work, and strong candidates are kept on file and contacted when the right project comes up.</p>
<h3>Project Briefing</h3>
<p>All projects begin with part-time remote prep (onboarding, lit review, stakeholder interviews, research design), followed by 2–3 weeks of full-time in-country fieldwork, then part-time remote work for reporting and strategy. Each project has two consultants: a Lead and a Deputy. For this first engagement, you’d start as Deputy, partnering closely with a Core Team Lead who will manage the project.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Duration:</strong> 10–15 weeks total (4–6 weeks part-time remote → 2–3 weeks in-country → 4–6 weeks part-time remote)</li>
<li><strong>Time zones:</strong> Requires cross-time-zone collaboration with teams in Europe and Africa</li>
<li><strong>Issue areas:</strong> soil health, clean water, restoring eyesight, education, healthcare, early childhood development, and more.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Who We’re Looking For </h3>
<p>We want senior behavioral specialists who combine analytical sharpness, strong communication, and field fluency. Specifically, people who can:</p>
<ul>
<li>Apply behavioral frameworks to real-world problems in clear, actionable ways</li>
<li>Lead research in unpredictable, low-resource contexts with composure and agility</li>
<li>Diagnose root causes and craft strategic recommendations that land</li>
<li>Turn messy insights into crisp, persuasive narratives clients can rally around</li>
<li>Manage and build trust with clients as true partners</li>
<li>Work independently and collaboratively across time zones</li>
<li>Adapt quickly, lead calmly under stress, and foster team resilience</li>
<li>Give and receive feedback openly — we treat it as a gift, and so should you</li>
</ul>
<p>We especially want to hear from those who have played roles like:</p>
<ul>
<li>Communications strategist or insights lead in mission-driven organizations</li>
<li>Narrative strategist or messaging lead in social campaigns</li>
<li>Behavioral or UX researcher with in-field experience</li>
<li>Co-founder of a startup that achieved product-market fit</li>
</ul>
<p>We are especially eager to meet people with proven strength in field-based research, behavioral diagnosis and strategy, or storytelling — even if your title has never said “design.”</p>
<h3>The Role: What You’d Do</h3>
<p>On your first project with Appleseed, you are most likely to serve as a deputy supporting a project lead from Appleseed’s core team.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Field Research:</strong> Leading or supporting in-depth field research in low-resource settings using immersive qualitative methods: contextual interviews, observation, journey mapping, shadowing, and co-creation sessions.</li>
<li><strong>Synthesis:</strong> Synthesizing motivators and barriers into behavioral diagnoses using Appleseed’s methodology, similar to COM-B, EAST, CBSM, or Fogg.</li>
<li><strong>Deliverables &amp; Storytelling:</strong> Crafting clear, persuasive, narrative-driven strategy deliverables — frameworks, visuals, decision-making tools, and client playbooks — and telling stories that move clients to act.</li>
<li><strong>Intervention Design:</strong> Designing interventions ranging from messaging to organizational change, habit formation, environment design, and product and service design.</li>
<li><strong>Client Success:</strong> Guiding clients through insights, ambiguity, and hard choices as a genuine thought partner. Building long-term relationships based on trust and candor.</li>
<li><strong>Team &amp; Project Management:</strong> Upholding Appleseed’s values and ensuring clear, on-time, on-budget, and impactful delivery.</li>
<li><strong>Internal Leadership &amp; Learning:</strong> Contributing to Appleseed’s evolving craft, methods, and culture.</li>
</ul>
<h3>This Role Won’t Be a Fit If... </h3>
<ul>
<li>Your behavioral experience is mostly academic or theoretical, rather than practical</li>
<li>You’re looking for an entry-level or mid-level position</li>
<li>You cannot name several different teams you’d be happy for us to call and ask about how you’ve collaborated and added value</li>
<li>You’d be very uncomfortable in settings with limited infrastructure or resources during 2–3 research trips per year (e.g. spending a few nights in a village or urban setting without running water, electricity, or a toilet, while dealing with mosquitoes and the risk of stomach bugs)</li>
<li>You avoid feedback or find open, candid discussion uncomfortable</li>
<li>You prefer writing reports over shaping persuasive strategy and storytelling</li>
<li>You take significant pride in being a perfectionist or workaholic</li>
<li>This section rubs you the wrong way</li>
</ul>
<h3>Please DO Apply If… ✅</h3>
<ul>
<li>Practical behavior change (however you call it) is your craft, and it has been for many years, approaching or exceeding a decade or more. You enjoy and practice all aspects (research, strategy, design), and you always start with the audience</li>
<li>If you’ve worked as a consultant, you’ve built authentic and lasting relationships with your clients</li>
<li>You’d like to join a small remote team doing hard things, and to participate in its growth</li>
<li>You thrive in small tight-knit groups, and would help tighten the knitting</li>
<li>You’re a generalist, even if you’re very good at certain things</li>
<li>There is no work you consider beneath you</li>
<li>You’re always seeking wisdom</li>
<li>You consider feedback a gift, even when it is hard to give or receive</li>
<li>You enjoy working in the field, and as a leader you’re calm, grounded, and able to adapt when things go sideways</li>
<li>While you’re more of a leader than a follower, you’re certainly able to follow as well</li>
<li>You’re an avid reader and would be excited to join Appleseed’s Book Club</li>
</ul>
<h3>Our Process</h3>
<p>We run a transparent hiring process designed to ensure mutual fit and show you what it’s like to work with us. Feel free to suggest other steps — we’d also welcome your feedback on the candidate experience.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Application (1 hour)</strong> to help us understand a bit about you and your experience</li>
<li><strong>Simulations (2–4 hours):</strong> conducting, synthesizing, and reporting on an interview with a volunteer; and a live feedback session to see how we work together in real time</li>
<li><strong>Interview (45 min)</strong> to explore your behavior change expertise and mutual interest</li>
<li><strong>Reference checks &amp; conversations</strong> to answer questions, ensure a great fit, and come to terms</li>
</ol>
<p>Appleseed is building an inner circle of trusted collaborators — needed for challenging work with smart clients that impacts real lives. If successful, you may expect this one-time exploration of fit to translate into years of fruitful collaboration!</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/appleseed-senior-behavioral-researcher-strategist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/appleseed-senior-behavioral-researcher-strategist</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Brex: Field Marketing Coordinator, Upmarket</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why join us</strong></p>
<p>Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.</p>
<p>Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.</p></div><p><strong>Marketing at Brex</strong></p>
<p>Marketing tells the story of Brex to the world. From acquisition to activation, we translate product value into business results. Our team spans Revenue, Product, and Brand Marketing, and works closely with nearly every function at Brex. We move fast, experiment often, and think deeply about customer behavior. If you want your creativity to drive growth and shape perception, this is the place.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p>
<p>As a Field Marketing Coordinator, Upmarket, you'll play an important role in helping Brex scale regional marketing programs that drive pipeline generation, accelerate opportunities, and strengthen relationships with senior finance, accounting, and procurement leaders across Enterprise and Mid-Market organizations.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to the Field Marketing Lead, Upmarket, you'll support a diverse portfolio of revenue-driving initiatives, including executive experiences, regional events, account-based marketing (ABM), and digital campaigns.</p>
<p>You'll take ownership of day-to-day program execution and operational coordination, working closely with Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional partners to bring programs to life. Your work will help expand our regional presence, improve program efficiency, and ensure consistent Sales activation before, during, and after each program.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate is a proactive, highly organized marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment, builds strong relationships with Sales, and understands how thoughtful execution drives business growth. You’ll bring attention to detail, creative problem-solving skills, and the ability to balance multiple projects and competing priorities while delivering high-quality work.</p>
<p><strong>Where you'll work</strong></p>
<p>This role will be fully remote and based in the United States.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own day-to-day planning and execution for Upmarket field marketing programs, including executive experiences, regional dinners, sporting events, and digital activations.</li>
<li>Coordinate event logistics, including venue sourcing, vendor management, catering, gifting, shipping, registration, attendee communications, budgets, and onsite execution.</li>
<li>Develop and maintain event timelines, registration pages, attendee trackers, run-of-show documents, and internal event briefs.</li>
<li>Partner with AEs, SDRs, and Sales leadership to support account targeting, prospect outreach, attendee engagement, and pre- and post-event follow-up.</li>
<li>Execute smaller, repeatable regional programs and sales-led experiences that strengthen customer relationships, support multi-threading, and accelerate pipeline.</li>
<li>Support integrated digital marketing campaigns across email and paid media, coordinating audience lists, creative assets, landing pages, campaign launches, and performance tracking.</li>
<li>Coordinate ABM and direct-mail campaigns, including prospect targeting, vendor management, gifting, fulfillment, and delivery tracking.</li>
<li>Maintain the Field Marketing events calendar, campaign documentation, and performance reporting across Salesforce, registration platforms, and marketing automation tools, tracking meetings generated, qualified pipeline, and pipeline influence.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, demand generation, project management or a related role.</li>
<li>Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.</li>
<li>Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.</li>
<li>Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day execution with minimal supervision.</li>
<li>Ability to adapt to changing priorities, solve problems quickly, and maintain high-quality execution under tight deadlines.</li>
<li>Ability to travel up to 40% of the time to support regional events and onsite execution.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Seamless program execution:</strong> Deliver high-quality field events and integrated campaigns on time, within budget, and with minimal operational friction.</li>
<li><strong>Increased program capacity and efficiency:</strong> Expand the team's ability to execute more regional and digital programs through repeatable processes, automation, and streamlined workflows.</li>
<li><strong>Stronger Sales activation:</strong> Improve the consistency and timeliness of prospect outreach, attendee engagement, and post-event follow-up.</li>
<li><strong>Measurable business impact:</strong> Support programs that generate qualified pipeline, strengthen customer relationships, and accelerate revenue opportunities.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>The expected salary range for this role is $73,600 - $105,800.&nbsp; However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://brex.com/">brex.com</a>&nbsp;domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.</em></p></div>
