      <title>LaunchDarkly: Senior Product Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<h4><strong>About the Job:</strong></h4>
<p>Teams are putting AI agents into production everywhere, and almost no one owns controlling them once they’re there. Agents make decisions at runtime, change behavior with every model update, and touch systems that were never designed for them. The teams that figure out how to govern, observe, and control agents in production will set the pace for the AI era. That’s the category we’re building.</p>
<p>LaunchDarkly is hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the story and go-to-market for how teams govern, observe, and control AI agents in production, a new capability within the LaunchDarkly platform. You’ll set the strategy, build the story, and be judged on pipeline and revenue, not assets shipped. You’ll work with Product and Demand Gen on go-to-market strategy, with Sales on live deals, with RevOps on pricing and packaging, and with partners and analysts on defining the category. It’s early, it’s moving fast, and you’ll have real ownership.</p>
<p>This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who operates with minimal direction. You’ll thrive here if you’re data-oriented and a GTM operator at heart: curious about what’s happening in the market, quick to dig into the numbers, and able to identify and size new opportunities before anyone asks. You’d rather connect what product, sales, and marketing are each seeing into one strategic direction than optimize one part of the business, and you want to be measured on business outcomes, not deliverables.</p>
<h4>Responsibilities:</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own the go-to-market plan for agent management</strong> — know what’s happening in the business and the market, build and deliver the GTM plan against company goals, and align product, sales, and marketing leaders behind it. Bring GTM input and recommendations into quarterly and annual planning.</li>
<li><strong>Build the category narrative</strong> — define the audience, positioning, and differentiation for agent management with product and PMM leadership, grounded in customer and market research. Differentiate against observability, LLMOps, and agent-framework vendors, and adapt the narrative across web, content, and sales conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Lead go-to-market for launches</strong> — define the story, audience, and launch plan for releases, events, and customer stories, and work with cross-functional partners so each ships with a clear message and enabled field teams.</li>
<li><strong>Enable sales to win</strong> — work with sales leaders and reps to build what they need, from enablement and discovery guidance to outbound messaging and competitive positioning. Track win-rate impact, and support strategic deals where the narrative is decisive.</li>
<li><strong>Optimize the customer journey</strong> — partner with marketing, sales development, sales, and customer success to find where buyers stall from first touch to closed-won, and recommend and implement fixes that improve conversion, velocity, and deal quality.</li>
<li><strong>Experiment and adapt the GTM plan</strong> — build a clear view of how agent management is performing, monitor market and funnel data, run tests with marketing and sales across audiences, messaging, and channels, and use customer conversations and win/loss analysis to decide what to scale, change, or stop.</li>
<li><strong>Be the voice of the market</strong> — share customer, field, and data insights with product and marketing leadership to inform roadmap, pricing and packaging, and investment decisions. Brief analysts on agent management, and report on GTM progress and outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Qualifications:</h4>
<ul>
<li>8+ years in product marketing or a related GTM role at B2B software companies, including owning go-to-market for a segment or product tried to growth targets</li>
<li>A track record of impact you can quantify: pipeline you built, win rate you moved, or revenue that grew because of work you led</li>
<li>Fluency with technical buyers (developers, engineering leaders, AI teams) and the depth to hold your own with product managers and sales engineers</li>
<li>Comfort in the data: you can read a funnel, find where it breaks, and turn that into a decision</li>
<li>Strong writing and a high bar for quality, with examples that drove measurable business outcomes</li>
<li>A history of building trust fast with sales and product, and influencing leaders without owning their teams</li>
<li>Low ego and team-first: you care about the outcome more than the credit, and you step in where the team needs you</li>
<li><strong>Bonus:</strong>
<ul>
<li>Experience marketing AI infrastructure, LLMOps, or agent tooling, or deep familiarity with the observability and DevOps categories we compete with</li>
<li>Hands-on experience building AI-powered workflows</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><strong>Pay:</strong></p>
<p class="p1"><em>Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:</em></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li1">Zone 1: <em>San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle</em> - <em>$156,700<span class="collapsed-field-text"> - $215,490</span></em>**</li>
<li class="li1">Zone 2:<em> Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $141,000<span class="collapsed-field-text"> - $193,930</span></em>**</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><em>LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.</em></p>
<p class="p1"><em>*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.</em><br><em>**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.</em></p>
<h4><strong>About LaunchDarkly:</strong></h4>
<p>Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:</p>
<ul>
<li>Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages</li>
<li>Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts</li>
<li>Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize</li>
<li>Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types</li>
<li>Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability</li>
</ul>
<p>At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at <a class="notion-link-token notion-focusable-token notion-enable-hover" href="mailto:hr@launchdarkly.com"><span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id--893544457">hr@launchdarkly.com</span></a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1"><strong>Do you need a disability accommodation?</strong></span></p>
<p class="p1">Fill out this&nbsp;<a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdYb_7upYMtdRVXzvXGHGfQw0pU2FNma-6Rwp-I6NjKm7SYNw/viewform"><span class="s2">accommodations request form</span></a>&nbsp;and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p1"><strong>Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from <a href="https://launchdarkly.slack.com/team/UKEE4GBS6">@LaunchDarkly</a>.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts.<strong> </strong>Be cautious of emails from other domains.&nbsp; Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit <a href="https://launchdarkly.com/careers/">Careers | LaunchDarkly</a>&nbsp; directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.</p>
<p class="p1">Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@launchdarkly.com">careers@launchdarkly.com</a>.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/launchdarkly-senior-product-marketing-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/launchdarkly-senior-product-marketing-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>PagerDuty: Enterprise Account Executive (Denver)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>PagerDuty is seeking an Account Executive to join our high-performing, customer-focused team! As an Account Executive, you will drive growth and expansion within an established customer portfolio, combining strategic account management with consultative enterprise selling. You’ll partner with C-level executives and key stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes through Operations Cloud conversions and multi-product adoption. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the customer’s journey, close high-value deals, and accelerate PagerDuty’s growth in the enterprise market.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate is a relationship-driven sales professional who thrives in complex deal cycles, excels at executive engagement, and is passionate about delivering customer impact through innovative SaaS solutions.</p>
<h3><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own and grow a defined set of enterprise accounts by driving upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities.</li>
<li>Build and maintain trusted executive relationships through regular in-person engagement and consultative selling.</li>
<li>Develop and execute strategic account plans to identify growth areas, expansion pathways, and competitive positioning.</li>
<li>Drive adoption of PagerDuty’s Operations Cloud by articulating clear business value and ROI.</li>
<li>Execute complex, multi-product sales motions and partner with Solution Consultants for technical validation and proof-of-concept activities.</li>
<li>Maintain accurate forecasts and a disciplined pipeline in Salesforce using the MEDDICC framework.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Customer Success, Product Management, and Renewals teams to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term retention.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or expansion roles within SaaS or cloud software.</li>
<li>Proven success managing a quota in complex, long-cycle enterprise sales.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience selling to and influencing C-level executives.</li>
<li>Proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC) for pipeline management and forecasting.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Prior enterprise sales expertise leveraging MEDDPICC &amp; Value Selling</li>
<li>Experience managing high-value accounts&nbsp;</li>
<li>Track record of success with multi-product sales and solution-based selling models.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, Operations Cloud, or DevOps environments.</li>
<li>Strategic thinker with exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.</li>
</ul>
<p>The base salary range for this position is $130,000.00 - $154,000.00 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission (50/50 split), and/or benefits.</p>
<p>Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.</p>
<p>Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Hesitant to apply?</strong></p>
<p>We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobalerts">job alerts</a>!</p>
<p><strong>Where we work</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/locations">offices</a> in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we <strong>cannot</strong> employ candidates residing in:</p>

<p>People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer</strong></p>

<p><strong>About PagerDuty</strong></p>

      <title>Collibra: VP, Product Marketing & Executive Thought Leadership</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<h3><strong>Joining Collibra's Marketing Team</strong></h3>
<p>At Collibra, we believe the next decade of enterprise value will be decided by whether AI can be trusted to act. Agents are moving from demos to decisions, and the leaders deploying them need certainty at the speed of AI. It's why we built the Enterprise AI Control Plane, over eighteen years of ontology engineering, to govern context and ensure control across any data, any model, any agent. We are builders who come from a wide range of backgrounds to do what has never been done before.</p>
<h4>About this role</h4>
<p>We are looking for a VP, Product Marketing &amp; Executive Thought Leadership to own the narrative for Collibra's business, and to lead the team that takes it to market. This is a category-defining role at a defining moment: the vocabulary of AI context is being written right now, and we intend to author it.</p>
<p>You will make our CEO the recognized voice of the category, on every stage and in every byline that matters. You will build the joint story with the platforms the world runs AI on — Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, SAP. And you will grow and coach a team of product marketers into a multi-layer org that ships market-moving launches without you in the room. You manage managers: directors own the day-to-day launches; you own the bar, the narrative, and the few things that cannot be delegated. This is a 0→1 category role inside an 18-year-old company — you'll define how a new market is positioned, messaged, and brought to the world.</p>
<h4>About you</h4>
<p>You are a builder of leaders, not a soloist. You've run a PMM org through managers and you know the difference between setting a standard and taking back the pen — you coach the launch from spec-sheet to stake, and you let your directors own it. You move fluently between a whiteboard with engineers and a green room with a CEO, translating architecture into a story technical and business leaders both lean toward. You've moved a category before, ideally from the challenger's seat, not the incumbent's. You have a passion for proof — every number you ship traces to a source — and an unapologetic focus on customer truth over internal belief. You thrive where the assets are good but the narrative and the discipline are the gap, and you'd rather open a new frontier than chase a competitor into theirs.</p>
<h4>About Collibra</h4>
<p>Collibra is building the Enterprise AI Control Plane — the layer that governs context and ensures control so enterprises can deploy AI with certainty. Eighteen years of ontology and semantic engineering sit underneath it. We are at the center of the most important shift in enterprise software: the move from data governance to governing the context and agents that act on it. We are an entrepreneurial company with a founder who wants to be the author of this category, and a marketing team rebuilding around the AI growth motion to make that real.</p>
<h3><strong>VP, Product Marketing Managers at Collibra are responsible for</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead the team. Hire, develop, and coach director-level PMM leaders and their teams. Create an environment where strong people do their best work, raise the bar with every hire, and build a bench that ships launch-quality narrative without you in the room.</li>
<li>Set the launch standard, your team's own execution. Your team runs day-to-day launches. You own the bar: the narrative spine, the proof discipline, and the go/no-go on whether a story is ready for the CEO and the market. You coach the story from spec-sheet to stake; you don't write every one.</li>
<li>Own the category narrative. Enterprise AI Control Plane, “context and control,” and the Context Gravity thesis. This you hold yourself.</li>
<li>Drive sales success through storytelling. Own the ICP journey (Hero journey) that turns narrative into pipeline: the demos, content, and sales collateral that make reps and partner sellers win. Set the storytelling standard across the funnel, first-call decks, demo scripts, solution maps, campaign briefs, customer proof, playbooks, so the field carries a story buyers move on, not a feature list. Measured by what closes, not what ships.</li>
<li>Shape the CEO's narrative. Architect the keynote story arcs, anchor bylines, podcast and press narrative.</li>
<li>Own strategic partner marketing. Set the joint narrative and co-marketing strategy with Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, and SAP, and carry the executive partner relationships. Your team runs the joint launches, co-funded campaigns, and partner-event activations. Make Collibra the governance and context layer those platforms recommend by name.</li>
<li>Own analyst relations strategy. Run AR as a growth lever and hold the principal analyst relationships yourself. Enable Collibra to position strongly in Gartner and Forrester briefings and quadrants.</li>
<li>Own competitive read. Direct the day-to-day and longer-horizon competitive intelligence. Adjust the narrative to hold differentiation, without reacting into a challenger's frame.</li>
<li>Run the thought-leadership program. Design the executive roundtable and content series for CAIOs, CIOs, and AI leaders; your team builds and runs it. Grounded in customer truth, not a vendor pitch.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>15+ years in enterprise software, spanning product marketing, technology evangelism, and product management roles, ideally in databases, analytics, and AI.</li>
<li>Proven ability to market to both technical and business leaders, up to C-level (CAIO, CIO, CDO), translating architecture into narrative for engineers and into business stakes for executives.</li>
<li>6+ years leading teams, with direct experience managing managers (director-level reports); built and developed a multi-layer PMM organization.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ownership of a category narrative that moved a market, ideally from a challenger position, not the incumbent.</li>
<li>Track record architecting executive keynotes or bylines that landed on a major industry stage.</li>
<li>Strategic partner or alliance marketing experience across a hyperscaler / data-platform ecosystem (AWS, Google Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks, SAP, or equivalent).</li>
<li>Hands-on analyst relations with Gartner and/or Forrester, including Wave/MQ engagement.</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.</li>
<li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience is required.</li>
<li>This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You are</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experienced creating or shifting category vocabulary.</li>
<li>Someone who has built a PMM function or messaging architecture from an early or rebuilding state.</li>
<li>Able to operate without a large-company machine underneath you, scrappy, high-output, owns the outcome.</li>
<li>Comfortable building the executive's voice rather than performing your own, and comfortable coaching launches rather than running them.</li>
<li>Fluent with the agentic-AI buyer (CAIO / AI leader), not data alone.</li>
<li>Experienced running partner co-marketing at scale inside or alongside a hyperscaler.</li>
<li>Experienced with carrying a technology-evangelist or developer-facing platform mandate at scale.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compensation for this role</strong></h3>
<p>The standard base salary range for this position is $272,000 - $340,000 per year. This position is not eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits at Collibra</h3>
<p>Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about <a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits">Collibra’s benefits</a>.</p>
<p>We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei">diversity, equity, and inclusion</a> at Collibra.</p>
<p>At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.</p>
<p>With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations">Accommodations for Applicants form</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-vp-product-marketing-executive-thought-leadership">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-vp-product-marketing-executive-thought-leadership</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> USA - Remote - EAST
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Ping Identity:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.&nbsp;</p>
<p>While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pingidentity.com/en/company/championing-every-identity.html">We champion every identity.</a> One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>Position Summary</strong></h2>
<p>We are seeking a Enterprise Account Executive to join Ping’s sales organization. The Enterprise Account Executive is responsible for driving new business while expanding the right existing relationships, helping customers solve complex identity challenges tied to security, digital experience, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role works across technical and executive buying groups and partners closely with cross-functional teams to turn identity priorities into measurable business outcomes. This draft follows Ping’s internal job description guide and reflects internal role signals showing a strategic team structure, strong new-logo expectations, and solution positioning across workforce, customer, and embedded identity use cases.</p>
<h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own a strategic portfolio of enterprise accounts and build account plans that create, advance, and close high-value opportunities across enterprise, commercial, and technology organizations.</li>
<li>Generate pipeline through targeted prospecting, account prioritization, executive outreach, partner collaboration, and disciplined territory planning, with a strong emphasis on landing new logos.</li>
<li>Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close, aligning Ping’s solutions to customer priorities around risk reduction, cost reduction, and improved digital experiences.</li>
<li>Position Ping’s identity platform across workforce, customer, and embedded use cases, including opportunities where technology companies integrate identity into their own products and experiences.</li>
<li>Build trusted relationships with security, IT, digital, product, operations, and executive stakeholders to shape buying consensus and move opportunities forward.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Sales Engineering, leadership, customer-success teams, and channel partners to develop account strategy, validate solution fit, and deliver a strong customer experience.</li>
<li>Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and account hygiene while operating with strong inspection, prioritization, and execution discipline.</li>
<li>Represent Ping with credibility in the market by connecting industry challenges to clear business value and differentiated identity outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>4+ years of successful enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or identity sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota in complex sales environments.</li>
<li>Experience selling into enterprise accounts, including commercial enterprises, technology companies, or adjacent regulated industries.</li>
<li>A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline and win net-new business through strategic prospecting and account planning.</li>
<li>Success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that involve technical buyers, business leaders, and executive sponsors.</li>
<li>Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical capabilities into value tied to revenue, efficiency, risk reduction, or customer experience.</li>
<li>Excellent communication, discovery, negotiation, and forecasting skills.</li>
<li>A disciplined, self-directed working style with strong prioritization and follow-through.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Bonus Points If You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience selling identity, access management, CIAM, IGA, MFA, fraud, or verification solutions.</li>
<li>Familiarity with industry dynamics, including digital user or customer experiences, regulatory considerations, and security requirements.</li>
<li>Experience with platform, embedded, OEM, or ISV sales motions.</li>
<li>Experience working with strategic partners, GSIs, or channel ecosystems in enterprise accounts.</li>
<li>Knowledge of modern identity trends such as passwordless authentication, decentralized identity, or behavioral and risk-based security models.</li>
</ul>
<p>Base Hiring Range: $112,000-$140,000 + Commission</p>
<p>In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Life at Ping:</strong></p>
<p>We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.</li>
<li>Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.</li>
<li>Regular company and team bonding events.</li>
<li>Competitive benefits and perks.</li>
<li>Global volunteering and community initiatives</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Our Benefits:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Generous PTO &amp; Holiday Schedule&nbsp;</li>
<li>Parental Leave</li>
<li>Progressive Healthcare Options</li>
<li>Retirement Programs</li>
<li>Opportunity for Education Reimbursement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Commuter Offset (Specific locations)&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.</p>
<p><em>We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.&nbsp; All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-enterprise-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-enterprise-account-executive</a></p>

      <title>Glossier: Director, Product Marketing (Contractor)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA)
</p>

<h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2>
<p>Glossier is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Product Marketing leader to oversee product marketing across our portfolio during a maternity leave.</p>
<p>This person will play a critical role in bringing our product portfolio to life, leading go-to-market strategy for new launches, building enduring equity around our most iconic products, and translating product truths and consumer insights into compelling, culturally relevant storytelling that builds brand desire and drives commercial results.</p>
<p>Sitting at the intersection of Product Development, Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, and Commercial teams, this role will connect product innovation with consumer needs and business objectives—translating what makes our products special into clear positioning, impactful campaigns, and commercially successful launches.</p>
<p>We're looking for someone who can balance big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigate a fast-moving environment, and confidently drive projects and decisions forward.</p>
<h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Product Positioning &amp; Strategy</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own product marketing strategy across Glossier's portfolio, including new product launches, existing icons, and key commercial moments.</li>
<li>Develop compelling product positioning, consumer insights, key messaging, and points of differentiation that establish a clear role for each product within the Glossier portfolio and competitive landscape as needed.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to strengthen product equity, drive customer acquisition, and increase engagement and repurchase across existing products.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Product Development to understand product innovation, benefits, claims, and competitive differentiation, translating technical product information into meaningful consumer-facing storytelling.</li>
<li>Help shape future portfolio strategy by identifying market trends, consumer needs, competitive opportunities, and potential assortment gaps.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Go-to-Market Leadership</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead product marketing workstreams for upcoming launches, from early positioning and strategy through launch execution.</li>
<li>Develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies that establish target audiences, product positioning, key messaging, launch objectives, and commercial opportunities.</li>
<li>Lead cross-functional GTM kickoffs, ensuring teams are aligned on product strategy, consumer insights, launch priorities, and key deliverables.</li>
<li>Partner with Brand, Creative, Integrated Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, and Education to ensure product positioning is translated consistently and effectively across all consumer touchpoints.</li>
<li>Bring strong creative judgment and strategic guidance throughout the creative development process, ensuring campaigns build brand desire, communicate meaningful product differentiation, and deliver against commercial objectives.</li>
<li>Manage multiple launches and priorities simultaneously, keeping teams aligned and workstreams moving forward.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Portfolio &amp; Commercial Performance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Analyze sales performance, consumer feedback, and competitive trends to inform marketing strategies and future product decisions.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to reinvigorate existing products through new storytelling, strategic marketing moments, and customer acquisition initiatives.</li>
<li>Support portfolio planning, assortment decisions, and product lifecycle management, including product introductions, discontinuations, and reformulations.</li>
<li>Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product marketing strategies support brand and commercial objectives across DTC, Sephora, and retail channels.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Build effective partnerships with Product Development, Creative, Brand, Integrated Marketing, Education, Retail, Wholesale, and Commercial teams.</li>
<li>Represent the consumer perspective throughout the product development and launch process, advocating for clarity, relevance, and differentiation.</li>
<li>Ensure a seamless handoff of strategic decisions, deliverables, and ongoing workstreams throughout the coverage period.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Brand Marketing, or a related strategic marketing function, ideally within beauty, skincare, makeup, or consumer brands.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading product launches and developing go-to-market strategies from concept through execution.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of the beauty landscape, consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and emerging category trends.</li>
<li>Exceptional strategic thinking and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex product benefits into compelling, consumer-friendly messaging.</li>
<li>Strong commercial acumen and comfort using performance data, consumer insights, and market research to inform decisions.</li>
<li>Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive alignment without direct authority.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.</li>
<li>Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.</li>
<li>A genuine passion for beauty, product innovation, and the Glossier brand.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Key product launches remain on track, with clear positioning, strong cross-functional alignment, and compelling go-to-market strategies.</li>
<li>Product storytelling is consistent, differentiated, and grounded in both consumer insights and commercial objectives.</li>
<li>Existing hero products continue to receive strategic marketing support, with opportunities for growth proactively identified.</li>
<li>Cross-functional partners feel supported, informed, and empowered to execute against shared priorities.</li>
<li>A seamless transition of workstreams and strategic context is maintained throughout the maternity leave coverage period.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Employment Type:</strong> Temporary / Maternity Leave Coverage<br><strong>Duration:</strong> Approximately 4–5 months</p>

</description>

      <title>Abnormal: AI Security Sales Executive, TOLA</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
</p>

<p><em>*Ideal candidates will reside in the Dallas, Austin or Houston area.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><strong>ABOUT THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.</p>
<p>The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will work alongside the Account Executives who know our customers best: joining land motions, driving AI Security expansion across our 5,000+ customers, and running focused outbound to win net new logos in the largest enterprises. Early on, most of your focus will be expansion. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.</p>
<p>The timing matters. Abnormal is growing quickly, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up regularly in customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. You will have real say in how this category gets sold.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own AI Security in your region. Carry the AI Security quota and run the sales cycle from first conversation through close.</li>
<li>Drive expansion across our customer base. Lead upsell campaigns into customers who already trust Abnormal, and join land motions where AI Security belongs in the conversation.</li>
<li>Run focused pipeline generation. Build a targeted, strategic outbound motion to open net new logos in the largest enterprises, partnering with the core AE where a relationship exists. Quality over volume.</li>
<li>Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your region, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.</li>
<li>Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on AI governance, agent security, and cloud security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.</li>
<li>Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.</li>
<li>Shape the product and the playbook. Work directly with Product and R&amp;D leadership, including our co-founder and CTO, and feed what you hear in the field back in a fast loop as the suite matures from early availability to GA.</li>
<li>Build AI Security expertise across the sales team, in addition to closing.</li>
<li>Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL SELL</strong></p>
<p>Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:</p>
<ul>
<li>AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.</li>
<li>AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.</li>
<li>AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.</li>
<li>AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.</li>
<li>AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW</strong></p>
<p>Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.</p>
<p>For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.</p>
<p><strong>WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of personal quota attainment and winning new business.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience selling an AI product, with enough technical and product depth to run the sales cycle as the expert and give our product team credible feedback.</li>
<li>A record of selling in security or closely adjacent infrastructure.</li>
<li>Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.</li>
<li>A consultative, challenger style, paired with the hunter instincts to run strategic outbound into new logos.</li>
<li>Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.</li>
<li>Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>NICE TO HAVES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.</li>
<li>Experience as an early seller or builder of a new motion: a first sales hire, a founding seller, or a new product line launched inside a larger company.</li>
<li>Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.</li>
<li>Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.<br>In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.</p></div><div class="title">Base salary range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$157,250</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$185,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p>

      <title>Twilio: Digital Sales Representative</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United Kingdom
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p>
<p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p>
<p><span>Join the team as our next Digital Sales Representative&nbsp;</span></p>
<h1><span><strong>About the job</strong></span></h1>
<p><span>This position is needed to play a key role in further growing Twilio’s social impact organization. As our Digital Inside Sales Representative, you will be responsible for lead qualification, net new customer acquisition, solution selling, and closing deals within our nonprofit accounts, while upholding the Twilio Magic and driving forward with the ultimate goal to help our customers do good.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you’ll:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Manage and expand customer accounts within Twilio.org’s Self-Service and Named Account customers across community &amp; social services, public sector, healthcare, traditional NGO’s, Humanitarian aid, Credit Union and other miscellaneous non-profit customers.</span></li>
<li><span>Work with customers to understand their business and technical requirements. You will need to understand the capabilities of Twilio’s communications API platform so that, together, you can design a solution for their specific use case needs.</span></li>
<li><span>Manage entire sales cycles and own a book of business with the goal of closing new revenue, protecting revenue and driving upsell and cross-sells while managing your assigned account list and addressing issues that may arise&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Execute programmable sales plays to consistently deliver strong revenue, gross margin, and gross profit results.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Work diligently with cross-functional internal teams (Sales, Sales Development, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Support) to execute renewals, address customer requirements, advise on digital communication strategies, and help customers get started on the Twilio platform.</span></li>
<li><span>Generate and maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast utilizing our CRM, Salesforce through proactive efforts and collaboration with your manager.</span></li>
<li><span>Execute automation strategies to serve a large quantity of customers while maintaining NPS and preventing churn&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Be an owner to drive deals forward, knock down obstacles for our customers and internally, and find the best solution for each customer, and recommend process improvements to support the whole team.</span></li>
<li><span>Develop expertise in the social impact and nonprofit market to help prospective customers understand how others are leveraging Twilio’s platform to scale their reach and missions.</span></li>
<li><span>Have world-class interpersonal and communication skills to make complex technical and financial details sound simple.</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to balance competing priorities and manage multiple projects/deals at the same time.</span></li>
</ul>
<h1><span><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></span></h1>
<p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p>
<p><strong>Required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>At least 5+ years of sales, marketing, and/or operations experience in a technical SaaS/CPaaS space, with a record of top performance.</li>
<li>Technical solutions selling experience – including closing experience – and enjoys working with customers to solve their problems.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of managing business forecasts and financial models.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships.</li>
<li>Analytical account development strategy based on using data to find opportunities and prove value.</li>
<li>Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite to define processes and build programs.</li>
<li>Record of delivering revenue and gross profit results</li>
<li>Deep personal interest in the social impact market and dedicating your career to making a positive difference.</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effortlessly make complex technical and financial details sound simple.</li>
<li>High adaptability, with comfort trying new things and building within a rapid-paced environment, comfort with ambiguity and change.</li>
<li>Strong process-orientation, focus on amplifying improvements in your own work by improving systems and processes across the team.</li>
<li>World-class organization, prioritization, and documentation skills.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience with social impact and public sector entities is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location</strong></p>
<p>This role will be remote, and based in the UK.</p>
<p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.</p>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<p>There are many benefits to working at Twilio, including, in addition to competitive pay, things like generous time-off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p>
<p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p>
<p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a><br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p>
<p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. <h2><strong>Enterprise Expansion Account Executive</strong></h2>
<p>Sumo Logic addresses both security and observability use cases all while riding on a world class logging, SIEM, and security analytics cloud native platform. Combined with a newly installed executive sales and operations team, the time is now for overachievement and we’re looking for the next thinkers, doers and challengers to join us. This position calls for a seasoned, strategic Account Executive in our enterprise sales segment which is responsible for driving growth within a subset of some existing accounts and hunting for net new logo accounts. Once you land accounts you will focus on expansion. You are the tip of the spear, face of the company, owning the relationship and responsibility of our customers’ success.</p>
<h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Land and expand new logo accounts. Treat existing customer base like new logos to&nbsp;</li>
<li>drive incremental ARR growth within the account. Expand existing use cases and introduce new use cases to current buying centers.</li>
<li>Measure and quantify the business value of our existing use cases and evangelize aggressively to new buying centers within each customer.</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>Responsible for the full sales cycle of new, incremental and renewal business within the territory.</li>
<li>Exude operational efficiency and forecast accuracy to run a best-in-class business.</li>
<li>Up to 50% in-market travel to establish relationships. Be able to cultivate and grow relationships into referenceable champions.</li>
<li>Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions, particularly engineering, product management and marketing.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Required Qualifications and Skills</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Minimum 7+ years of total IT sales experience and 5+ years consistent quota over achievement selling software to enterprise-level customers.</li>
<li>Ideally, you will have sold an on-demand/SaaS Security or IT Infrastructure Management solution to a technical and business audience (IT Heads / DevOps / Security Operations, etc)</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills. We need storytellers and those that can simplify the complex for economic buyers and executives.</li>
<li>Good Sales DNA and methodology such as MEDDPICC is highly desired.</li>
<li>High activity with a fast motor to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, rapidly evolving technical environment.</li>
<li>Must be a team player and a life-long learner. You must be curious to know the ‘why’.</li>
</ul>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><strong><span class="C9DxTc ">About Us</span></strong></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit</span><a class="XqQF9c" href="http://www.sumologic.com/"><span class="C9DxTc "> www.sumologic.com.</span></a></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><a class="XqQF9c" href="https://www.sumologic.com/privacy-statement/"><span class="C9DxTc aw5Odc ">Sumo Logic Privacy Policy</span></a><span class="C9DxTc ">. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">The expected annual base salary range for this position is $141,000 - $150,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application.</span><span class="C9DxTc ">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position.</span></p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>

Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2>
<p>This position is 100% remote and open to candidates based in the United States who reside in the Pacific Time Zone (PST).</p>
<p>GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative - US State/Local &amp; EDU (SLED), to join our growing Business Development team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted US SLED working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams. In this role you will leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab’s value. You will be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p>
<p>Don’t have a ton of knowledge about GitLab yet? Don’t worry. We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you will be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Effectively conduct outbound prospecting initiatives in collaboration with SLED sales counterparts as well as managing inbound lead flow.</li>
<li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations in target accounts</li>
<li>Meet or exceed BDR-sourced First Order, Stage 1, and Stage 3 pipeline targets</li>
<li>Collaborate with and leverage teammates to develop targeted lists, call strategies, and messaging to drive opportunities</li>
<li>Utilize business and industry knowledge to research accounts, identify key players, generate interest, create/identify compelling events, and develop accounts</li>
<li>Work to have a variety of touches (call, email, social, etc.) on all prospects in your assigned territory</li>
<li>Manage, track, and report on all activities and results using Salesforce</li>
<li>Participate in documenting all processes in the GitLab handbook and update as needed with your Business Development Manager</li>
<li>Work in collaboration with Field and Corporate Marketing to drive attendance at regional marketing events</li>
<li>Attend field marketing events to engage with participants identify opportunities, and to schedule meetings</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience prospecting into State/Local Agencies, as well as the EDU sector</li>
<li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li>
<li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills</li>
<li>Meet or exceed daily, weekly and monthly KPIs</li>
<li>A self-starter with a track record of successful, credible achievements</li>
<li>You share our values, and work in accordance with those values</li>
<li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure</li>
<li>Determined personality with a desire to grow and win</li>
<li>Passionate about being a part of GitLab’s journey</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn new processes and tools that are critical to success as a BDR (Outreach, Zoominfo, Cognism, Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc)</li>
<li><span>The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li>
<li>Globally we require excellent written and spoken English which is our company language</li>
</ul>
<div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions">
<h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2>
<p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.</p>
</div>

<li>Experience developing Enterprise and Mid-Market business in Japan, with a strong understanding of Japanese business culture and consensus-driven buying processes.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated persistence in meeting or exceeding targets through consistent follow-up, effective objection handling, and continuous improvement.</li>
<li>Demonstrated interest in GitLab and the DevOps space, such as staying current on GitLab releases or industry trends.</li>
<li>Proficient in using Salesforce (incl. Salesforce reporting) and LinkedIn. Proficiency in other prospecting tools (Zoominfo, Cognism, Outreach, 6Sense, etc.) is a plus.</li>
<li>Previous tech industry experience; experience in sales development, marketing, and/or sales; and outbound prospecting experience.</li>
<li>Must be based in Japan, and have full working rights in Japan</li>
</ul><div><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>

<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li>

      <region>Asia Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>CRM, Data Analysis, HubSpot, SaaS, Excel, Conflict Resolution, Strategic Planning, and Portfolio Management</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/7024/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://getmagic.com">http://getmagic.com</a>
</p>

<h1>Account Manager, Retention &amp; Growth - Remote</h1><p><strong>Application Deadline: </strong> 5 December 2026</p><p><strong>Department: </strong>Talent Team</p><p><strong>Employment Type: </strong>Full Time</p><p><strong>Location: </strong>Philippines</p><p><strong>Reporting To: </strong>Andrew Valle</p><p><strong>Compensation: </strong>₱60,000 - ₱80,000 / month</p><br><br><h3>Description</h3><div>Backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, Magic has spent 10+ years connecting fast-growing businesses with top remote talent.<br><br>
</div><div>This is a full-time, in-house, permanent role with full benefits. You'll be a Magic employee owning client relationships on the company's behalf, not a VA placed with a client. Our clients are busy founders and executives who need remote workers to deliver real ROI, and they need a strategic partner to make that happen. You're not here to answer tickets. You're here to protect revenue, grow accounts, and turn happy clients into loud advocates. The pace is live and constant: client calls, escalations, and account health across a real portfolio, every single day, with no handoffs and no delays.<br><br>
</div><div>
<strong><br>Shift:</strong> US Eastern hours, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET, Monday to Friday (a 9-hour shift), with occasional early or late calls for West Coast clients or urgent situations. Fully remote, Philippines-based.</div><br><br><h3>Key Responsibilities</h3><ul>
<li>
<strong>Guard</strong> your book of business: own a portfolio of accounts sorted by size, health, and growth potential, and hold 90%+ gross revenue retention (GRR) and 110%+ net revenue retention (NRR). Those are the numbers you're graded on.</li>
<li>
<strong>Spot</strong> at-risk accounts before clients say a word. Start renewals 60–90 days out, and get save plans moving early.</li>
<li>
<strong>Launch</strong> every new client fast: kickoff call within 24–48 hours of signing, then Magic's 30-60-90 day onboarding framework, with a success plan tied to their business goals and an intro to their remote worker.</li>
<li>
<strong>Host</strong> quarterly business reviews (QBRs) clients actually look forward to: data-driven, strategic, action-oriented. Become the trusted advisor to founders and C-suite, and multi-thread across each client so one champion leaving doesn't sink the account.</li>
<li>
<strong>Hunt</strong> expansion opportunities and make the business case before anyone asks.</li>
<li>
<strong>Surface</strong> the story in the data: track churn risk and expansion signals, keep HubSpot clean, send a monthly portfolio health report (retention, NRR, CSAT, NPS, QBR completion), and own every escalation from intake to resolution.</li>
</ul><br><br><h3>Qualifications &amp; Technical Requirements</h3><ul>
<li>3+ years of B2B customer success or account management experience, juggling a portfolio of accounts at the same time</li>
<li>Direct ownership of revenue retention and expansion targets across the full customer lifecycle from onboarding to renewal</li>
<li>Background in SaaS/tech, outsourcing/staffing, professional services/BPO, or marketplace platforms</li>
<li>HubSpot experience used daily for pipeline and account health (intermediate-to-expert Salesforce or a similar CRM also works)</li>
<li>Intermediate-to-advanced Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX MATCH, dashboards, trend analysis</li>
<li>Real US market experience: you know US business culture, SMB challenges, and how executives like to communicate</li>
<li>Strong written and spoken English, good enough for daily conversations with US-based C-level and Director clients</li>
<li>A professional home office: high-speed internet (50+ Mbps), a headset, and a quiet space</li>
</ul><div><br></div><div>You treat customer success as a revenue function, not a help desk. You own the outcome, so you don't wait to be told an account is wobbling; you've already spotted it, and your save plan is moving. You're comfortable in a room with a founder or a C-suite exec, and you can plow through a messy escalation without losing the relationship. You read the data, find the story, and walk into every QBR with a point of view. You pitch expansion because the numbers back it up, not because a quota told you to. When something breaks, you adapt, get the right people in the room, and keep going.<br><br>
</div><div>Application + pre-qualifying questions → HR interview (45 min) → 24-hour reflection period → Panel Interview with Senior CSMs → interview with CS Director → Final Interview with the Head of Sales &amp; CS → Job Offer<br><br>
</div><br><br><h3>What's In It For You</h3><div>₱60,000–₱80,000 gross per month, permanent and full-time, fully remote (Philippines). HMO coverage after regularization, 12 vacation days and 10 sick days a year, 13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, and PAG-IBIG. We offer paid training and promote from within: top CSMs move into Senior CSM, Team Lead / CS Manager, and CS Director roles.<br><br>
</div><div>We're an ambitious, driven team that plows through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. There's no hierarchy and no politics: you can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything. We respect each other's time, and we actually like working together. Magic is backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with more than 10 years of connecting top remote talent with fast-growing businesses and 2,000+ remote workers worldwide.<br><br>
</div><div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/magic-inc-account-manager-retention-growth-remote">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/magic-inc-account-manager-retention-growth-remote</a></p>
