      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Seattle, Washington, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://jobs.workable.com/company/duc4nJ2nZdLeoU1s5RK1oU/jobs-at-gaggleamp-inc">https://jobs.workable.com/company/duc4nJ2nZdLeoU1s5RK1oU/jobs-at-gaggleamp-inc</a>.
</p>

<p>GaggleAMP is a profitable SaaS company that has led the employee-advocacy category for over a decade. We're hiring our second Account Executive: a full-cycle closer who builds their own pipeline, qualifies hard, sells on value and holds price.<br></p>The role<p>You'll be our second seller and the benchmark for the sales team that follows.</p><p>What you'll own</p><ul><li>A $1M new-ARR quota. At our deal sizes, that's roughly 2 to 4 new customers a month. Marketing sends some leads, but about half of your pipeline will come from your own prospecting.</li><li>Qualification. Confirm fit, find the person who controls the budget and build a value case before you invest your time. Walk away quickly when those aren't there.</li><li>Value-led discovery. Tie our impact to the buyer's own numbers, such as pipeline generated from social or paid spend we offset, before price comes up.</li><li>Price. We don't discount. You sell at list price and let poor-fit deals go.</li><li>An honest forecast. Deals move forward when the buyer does something real, and your CRM stays current.</li><li>Clean handoffs with Marketing, Implementation and Customer Success.</li></ul><p>Why join</p><ul><li>Real ownership of your pipeline, your qualification calls and your deal strategy.</li><li>A value story that wins and real pricing power, plus a sales framework you'll help shape.</li><li>A profitable company. No venture clock, no death-march growth targets, and a category we've led for over a decade.</li></ul>How you work<ul><li>You disqualify without drama. A clean no is a good outcome, and you can tell us about a recent deal you walked away from.</li><li>You build value cases in dollars from what the buyer tells you. When a buyer has no hard number, you can still put a dollar value on reach and traffic.</li><li>You tie price to value instead of defending it or offering a discount.</li><li>You advance deals on buyer commitment, not because a call went well or a demo got booked.</li><li>You understand the importance of getting to the decision maker to close deals.</li><li>You get leverage from your tools. You use AI tools (such as ChatGPT or Claude) and prospecting tools (such as Apollo) every week to sell smarter.</li></ul>Location<p>Fully remote within the United States.</p><p></p>
<p></p>Requirements<p></p><ul><li>You have carried and closed a new-business quota, running deals yourself from discovery to signature.</li><li>You are familiar with AI tools and use them in your selling every week.</li></ul><p>Nice to have</p><ul><li>You have sold SaaS or subscription software.</li><li>You have sold at a small or lean company and have sourced your own pipeline. Here, we target a 50/50 inbound/outbound split.</li></ul>
<p></p><p>Compensation</p><p>$160,000+ OTE with uncapped commission.</p><p>Benefits</p><ul><li>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision insurance (after 30 days).</li><li>Matching 401K (after 6 months).</li><li>Join an exciting and dynamic company with a strong leadership team and culture.</li><li>Grow professionally by gaining powerful experience managing relationships in the digital marketing space.</li><li>Have the opportunity to contribute and directly impact the growth and direction of the company you work for.</li></ul><p>GaggleAMP provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.</p>How to apply<p>Our process starts with a few written questions and a Culture Index survey, so every candidate is reviewed the same way. Specific answers help us review you fairly. Please be ready to share:</p><ul><li>Your average deal size (ACV), average sales cycle, and your quota and attainment in your last full year</li><li>How much of your pipeline you sourced yourself, and how you did it</li><li>The AI and prospecting tools you use every week</li><li>A short cover letter</li><li>The US city and state where you live</li></ul><p>We never ask about your current or past salary.</p><p></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gaggleamp-inc-b2b-mid-market-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gaggleamp-inc-b2b-mid-market-account-executive</a></p>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is seeking a Enterprise Account Executive to drive net-new logo acquisition and revenue growth within an assigned territory. This role requires strong experience selling complex, technical SaaS solutions to enterprise customers and the ability to navigate multi-stakeholder buying environments.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>You will:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>Source and close net new logos within a given territory</span></li>
<li><span>Navigate complex organizational structures and identify executive sponsors and champions</span></li>
<li><span>Research and understand customer business objectives and run a value-driven sales cycle</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success</span></li>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span><strong>About Glean:</strong></span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.</span></div></div><div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></div>

You’ll own the full sales cycle—from pipeline generation through close—navigating complex, multi-stakeholder deals with C-level executives, partnering closely with Sales Engineering, and building clear ROI and business cases that accelerate adoption of Glean’s Work AI platform.</span></div>

<li><span>Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>You will consistently deliver ARR revenue targets and drive success through a metric based approach</span></li>
<li><span>Develop and execute sales strategies and tactics to generate pipeline, drive sales opportunities and deliver repeatable and predictable bookings</span></li>
<li><span>Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions</span></li>
<li><span>Create ROI and business justification reports based off of a data driven approach</span></li>
<li><span>Run tight POCs based off of business success criteria</span></li>
</ul>
</div>
<div><span><strong>About you:</strong></span></div>
<div>
<ul>
<li><span>6+ years of closing experience in Sales with a track record of being a top performer</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to learn, pitch and demonstrate a highly technical product and have the ability to adapt in a fast growing and changing environment&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Have clear examples of closing complex deals and selling into complex organizations</span></li>
<li><span>Effectively use a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building out a new territory&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Previous experience building relationships and selling face to face to C level executives</span></li>
<li><span>Knowledge of best of breed softwares and a technical understanding of integrations, APIs, infrastructure management, security and analytics</span></li>
<li><span>Experience selling technical SaaS and cloud based software solutions</span></li>
<li><span>Basic understanding of search infrastructure is a plus</span></li>
<li><span>You have previous experience working with multiple teammates including SEs, BDRs, PMs, Executives &amp; Engineers</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and using MEDDIC and Challenger (or similar) methodologies is a plus.</span></li>

      <title>Upgrade: Vice President, Strategic Partnerships</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States (Remote)
</p>

<p><em>Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.</em></p>
<p><em>We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong></span></p>
<p><span><br>We are looking for a strategic, commercially driven leader to join Upgrade as our VP, Strategic Partnerships, playing a pivotal role in expanding our personal lending business through high-impact enterprise partnerships.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you will lead the development of strategic white-label partnerships with financial institutions, fintechs, and major consumer-facing brands, enabling them to offer personal loans under their own brand, powered by Upgrade's lending platform. </span><span>You will be responsible for identifying and engaging high-value partners, building relationships with senior decision-makers, and independently structuring and negotiating complex commercial agreements. With a strong understanding of partnership economics and P&amp;L impact, you'll evaluate opportunities that drive meaningful revenue growth and long-term profitability for Upgrade's personal lending business.</span></p>
<p><span>Working closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Risk, you'll help shape partnership strategies, navigate technical integrations, and bring new opportunities to market. </span><span>This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who thrives on building executive relationships, negotiating strategic deals, and turning commercial opportunities into scalable businesses. You'll have significant autonomy to shape a growing partnership channel, with opportunities to collaborate directly with senior leadership and contribute to emerging AI-driven products and initiatives.</span></p>
<h4><em><strong><br><br>This is a remote-flexible position for candidates based in San Francisco, New York, or Delaware, and requires occasional travel for partner meetings.</strong></em></h4>
<h4><span><strong><br><br>What you’ll do:<br></strong></span></h4>
<p><span><strong><br>Sourcing &amp; Pipeline<br></strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Build and manage a pipeline of prospective white-label partners.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Develop and prioritize a target list based on strategic fit, reach, and revenue potential.</span></li>
<li><span>Represent Upgrade at industry events and in outbound outreach to build a network of decision-makers at prospective partners.</span></li>
<li><span>Source potential partnerships to support Upgrade's emerging AI-driven product initiatives beyond personal loans</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong><br>Deal Structuring &amp; Negotiation<br></strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Lead commercial negotiations for partnership agreements, including economics, exclusivity, SLAs, and branding terms.</span></li>
<li><span>Partner with Legal, Finance, and Risk to structure deals that meet Upgrade's compliance and margin requirements.</span></li>
<li><span>Own the business case and internal approval process for each partnership, from term sheet through signed contract.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong><br>Onboarding &amp; Launch<br></strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Own the end-to-end onboarding of signed partners — project-managing integration, compliance review, branding/marketing/UX approvals, and go-live.</span></li>
<li><span>Serve as the primary point of contact for partners during implementation, coordinating Engineering, Product, Compliance, and Ops to hit launch dates.</span></li>
<li><span>Build repeatable onboarding playbooks and SLAs to shorten time-to-launch as the partner roster grows.</span></li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong><br>What We Look For:<br></strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li><span>10+ years in strategic partnerships, business development, or a related deal-making role, with a track record of sourcing and closing complex commercial agreements.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience in fintech, consumer lending, or financial services — comfortable with regulatory, compliance, and risk considerations&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated ability to manage a deal from first outreach through signed contract <em>and</em> through live launch.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong cross-functional leadership: proven ability to align Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering around a partner launch timeline.</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent negotiation and executive presence; comfortable representing Upgrade large enterprise partner leadership.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Nice to Have:<br></strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Direct experience structuring white-label or embedded finance partnerships (co-branded cards, private-label lending, BaaS-style programs).</span></li>
<li><span>An existing network of relationships at financial services companies or consumer-facing brands that could become Upgrade partners.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience at a high-growth fintech or consumer lending company.<br></span></li>
</ul>
<h4><span><strong>What We Offer You:</strong></span></h4>
<ul>
<li><span>Competitive salary &amp; stock option plan</span></li>
<li><span>Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance</span></li>
<li><span>Flexible PTO</span></li>
<li><span>Opportunities for professional growth and development</span></li>
<li><span>Paid parental leave</span></li>
<li><span>Health &amp; wellness initiatives<br><br><br></span><em><strong>The base salary range for this position is $250k-$275k annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual performance-based bonus as well as equity and other benefits as part of Upgrade’s total compensation package.</strong></em></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p><strong>Environmental &amp; Working Conditions</strong></p>
<p>Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.</p>
<p>Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.</p>
<p>The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.</p>
<p>Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.</p>
<p>Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.</p>
<p>Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.</p>
<p><em>Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.</em></p>
<p><em>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</em></p>
<p><em>Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-vice-president-strategic-partnerships">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-vice-president-strategic-partnerships</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Datadog: Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector, Federal & Defense</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> District of Columbia, USA, Remote
</p>

<p>Datadog is looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own marketing strategy and execution for our U.S. Federal and Defense business. In this role, you will build and run an integrated, multi-channel field marketing program across Federal Civilian agencies, Federal Systems Integrators, the Department of War (DoW/DoD), and the Defense Industrial Base.&nbsp;<br><br>This will span mission-focused events, executive briefings, account-based programs, and digital campaigns, in close partnership with Public Sector sales leadership. <br><br>The role is a full-funnel mandate with the latitude to prioritize the programs that move pipeline in a market where the buying cycle, the procurement path, and the compliance bar all look different from commercial tech.</p>
<p>Datadog for Government operates in a FedRAMP High-certified, AWS GovCloud (US) environment, with work underway toward DoD Impact Level 5. You will be the marketer who translates that platform and compliance story into mission language for program offices, CIOs, and the integrators who build for them.</p>
<p class="p1"><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Set the strategy for, and execute, the integrated Federal and Defense field marketing plan — aligned to Public Sector sales priorities, target agencies and programs, and pipeline goals. You will propose the pipeline target for this segment, not just deliver against one handed to you.</li>
<li>Build segment-specific program tracks for Federal Civilian, Federal Systems Integrator, DoW/DoD, and Defense Industrial Base audiences, recognizing that each buys on a different cycle and responds to different proof.</li>
<li>Own Datadog’s presence across the federal event calendar, from large-scale defense and civilian conferences to service association events, agency industry days, virtual events, and targeted executive gatherings.</li>
<li>Build the program formats that move federal buyers through the funnel — executive briefings, technical workshops, roundtables, and webinars — owning Federal and Defense field marketing budget, audience strategy, target account recruitment, and follow-through.</li>
<li>Work with Product Marketing to shape Federal-specific messaging and content: FedRAMP High, IL5 progress, data residency, U.S.-persons operations, continuous ATO, zero trust, and the compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, DISA STIGs) your audience is actually measured against.</li>
<li>Partner with Demand Generation on campaign strategy and execution. Adapt nurture tracks and email motions for a federal audience, manage lead flow and follow-up SLAs with sales, and tune programs based on funnel performance You bring the market context that makes a central campaign land with the audience, and you own stage-over-stage conversion for the segment.</li>
<li>Raise the bar for the wider field marketing team — mentor less experienced marketers, and bring federal market expertise back into how the broader org plans.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years marketing to the U.S. Federal government, with a demonstrated track record of driving pipeline for a public sector segment or business unit.</li>
<li>Direct experience with Defense buyers — DoW/DoD services and combatant commands, or the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base firms that serve them.</li>
<li>Fluent in the federal buying cycle: appropriations and fiscal-year dynamics, contract vehicles (GSA, SEWP, CIO-SP, GWACs), the role of resellers and integrators, and how an ATO actually gets granted.</li>
<li>Proven experience planning and executing large-scale federal events, executive forums, and sponsored trade shows.</li>
<li>Comfortable with the technical subject matter — observability, cloud, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity — and tune messaging that holds up with a technical federal audience.</li>
<li>Experience with account-based marketing against named agencies and programs.</li>
<li>Experience owning a program budget and reporting against a pipeline number you are accountable for.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication with strong executive presence, and a track record of influencing sales leadership and driving alignment across marketing functions.</li>
<li>A self-starter who makes confident decisions without a playbook in front of you, and who is comfortable being handed an ambiguous goal and coming back with the plan.</li>
<li>Hands-on with Salesforce, marketing automation, ABM platforms, and attribution tooling.</li>
<li>U.S. citizenship required.</li>
<li>Based in or willing to relocate to the Washington, D.C. metro area, with willingness to travel roughly 40% for events.</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.</em></p>
<p class="p1"><strong>Benefits &amp; Growth:</strong></p>
<ul class="ul1">
<li class="li1">Generous and competitive benefits package</li>
<li class="li1">New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan</li>
<li class="li1">Continuous career development and pathing opportunities</li>
<li class="li1">Employee-focused best in class onboarding</li>
<li class="li1">Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program</li>
<li class="li1">Friendly and inclusive workplace culture</li>
</ul>
<p class="p1"><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

      <title>Tailscale: Community Engagement and Advocacy Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (Canada)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.&nbsp;<em>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em>We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p>
<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span>About the Role</span></h3>
<p>The Community Programs team creates the spaces, programs, and opportunities that help our community thrive. We're looking for a Community Engagement and Advocacy Manager to help us strengthen relationships with the people who use, build with, and advocate for Tailscale.</p>
<p>In this role, you'll own and grow three important areas of our community: the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program, our digital communities, specifically Discord and Reddit, and our Community Projects program.</p>
<p>You'll focus on creating meaningful opportunities for community members to connect, contribute, share their expertise, and be recognized for the work they do. Whether that's helping an Insider find their next speaking opportunity, bringing Tailscale staff into conversations on Discord, or showcasing an exciting community-built project, you'll help turn community participation into lasting relationships and advocacy.</p>
<p>You'll work closely with teams across Tailscale, including Developer Relations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, to connect community members with the right people, resources, and opportunities.</p>
<p>We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people, understands what makes communities thrive, and can turn ideas into thoughtful, well-run programs. You don't need to be deeply technical, but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn from the people building with it.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<h3><strong>Insiders Advocacy Program</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the strategy, day-to-day operations, engagement, and ongoing growth of the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program.</li>
<li>Build and maintain meaningful relationships with Insiders, understanding their interests, expertise, motivations, and how they want to participate in the Tailscale community.</li>
<li>Develop recurring engagement opportunities that help Insiders connect with one another and with teams across Tailscale.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities for Insiders to contribute through speaking engagements, technical content, community events, product feedback, testing, and other initiatives.</li>
<li>Partner with internal teams to create clear pathways for Insiders to participate in company initiatives, ensuring opportunities are relevant and mutually beneficial.</li>
<li>Identify and nurture emerging advocates across the Tailscale community, creating pathways for deeper participation and potential involvement in the Insiders program.</li>
<li>Own the recruitment, onboarding, recognition, and ongoing engagement of Insiders, ensuring participants feel valued, supported, and connected.</li>
<li>Gather feedback from program members and continuously improve the Insider experience.</li>
<li>Track program participation, contributions, engagement, and outcomes to understand and communicate the impact of the program.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Digital Communities: Discord &amp; Reddit</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the strategy, day-to-day engagement, and overall community experience across Tailscale's Discord and Reddit communities, fostering welcoming, active, and inclusive spaces.</li>
<li>Develop and execute engagement initiatives, including community events, AMAs, discussions, and member spotlights that encourage participation and connection.</li>
<li>Partner with teams across Tailscale to bring staff into community conversations and create opportunities for meaningful engagement.</li>
<li>Partner with Product, Marketing, and Developer Relations to plan and lead Discord and Reddit engagement around product launches, announcements, and key company initiatives.</li>
<li>Own day-to-day community moderation, including enforcing guidelines, managing moderation tools and bots, coordinating volunteer moderators, and escalating sensitive issues to appropriate internal teams.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to improve community engagement, structures, and experiences based on member feedback and participation.</li>
<li>Recognize and celebrate active members and contributors, creating opportunities for deeper involvement and advocacy.</li>
<li>Monitor community conversations, feedback, and engagement metrics to identify emerging themes, share actionable insights with internal teams, and inform community strategy, product decisions, and program improvements.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Community Projects</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the strategy, operations, and continued growth of Tailscale's Community Projects program, recognizing and amplifying projects built by our community.</li>
<li>Develop and maintain a clear, repeatable process for discovering, submitting, reviewing, tracking, and showcasing community projects.</li>
<li>Build relationships with project creators, understanding what they've built, their motivations, and how Tailscale can support and recognize their work.</li>
<li>Partner with Developer Relations, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to identify opportunities to turn community projects into technical content, demos, documentation, social content, and community showcases.</li>
<li>Create opportunities for project creators to share their work through community events, presentations, blog posts, videos, and other channels.</li>
<li>Identify projects that demonstrate creative or emerging uses of Tailscale and help surface those examples to relevant internal teams.</li>
<li>Develop thoughtful ways to recognize and reward contributors, ensuring builders receive visibility and credit for their work.</li>
<li>Track program activity, project contributions, and outcomes to help demonstrate how community projects support advocacy, learning, and broader awareness of Tailscale as a platform.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>3–5+ years of experience in community management, advocacy, community programs, developer communities, or related roles.</li>
<li>Experience owning and growing community programs, including developing initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, and driving engagement.</li>
<li>Proven ability to build meaningful relationships with community members, advocates, contributors, and internal teams.</li>
<li>Experience managing and moderating online communities, including community guidelines, moderation tools, and maintaining healthy, inclusive environments.</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage authentically and collaborate across teams.</li>
<li>Excellent organizational and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and navigate ambiguity.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of community engagement and advocacy, with the ability to identify opportunities, recognize contributors, and turn feedback into meaningful improvements.</li>
<li>Genuine curiosity about technology and an eagerness to learn about Tailscale's products and community.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience managing advocacy, ambassador, champion, or contributor recognition programs.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience managing Discord, Reddit, or similar community platforms, including moderation bots and automation tools.</li>
<li>Experience working with developers, open source, infrastructure, networking, security, or other technology-focused communities.</li>
<li>Familiarity with community engagement and intelligence tools such as Common Room.</li>
<li>Experience developing community programming such as AMAs, virtual events, member spotlights, and recurring engagement initiatives.</li>
<li>Experience identifying and amplifying community stories, projects, or contributor achievements.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with Product, Developer Relations, Engineering, Marketing, or Support teams.</li>
<li>Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support community events, meetups, and other initiatives.</li>
</ul>
<p>As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">CAN Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$192,960</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$237,180 CAD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self.</strong> We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.</li>
<li><strong>A competitive total compensation package.</strong> This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).</li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. </strong>Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!</li>
<li><strong>Remote first company</strong>—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.</li>
<li><strong>Employer-funded retirement contributions. </strong>Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.</li>
<li><strong>Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. </strong>Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.<strong><br></strong></li>
<li><strong>Support for your personal and professional development.</strong> Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration.&nbsp;</strong>Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>A build-your-own home office setup. </strong>You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Paid parental leave program</strong>. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.</em></p>
<p><em>Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.</em></p>
<p><em>Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit <a href="https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness">https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness</a>.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tailscale-community-engagement-and-advocacy-manager-1">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tailscale-community-engagement-and-advocacy-manager-1</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Ontario, Canada
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p>
<p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><strong>The Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an Account Executive - Majors to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. This role is based in Toronto, reporting to the Regional Director. You will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving</li>
<li>
<p>10+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Residency in or willingness to commute within the Toronto area&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships</p>
</li>
<li>Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management.</li>
</ul>

      <title>MetaMask: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> UNITED STATES - Remote, LATAM - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><em><strong>Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.</strong></em></p>
<p>Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: <strong>Open Money. </strong>This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.&nbsp; Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Growth Marketing team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for setting the strategy and executing on lifecycle campaigns across all Consensys products. You’ll look for opportunities to ensure we are bringing a level of personalization in our communication to our users such that every touch point is driving value for our customers and the business.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The ideal candidate has a proven track record of taking projects from start to finish with deep experience leveraging customer data to inform their strategy. You’ve developed multiple lifecycle programs at scale, have conducted hundreds of A/B tests, and have even launched new lifecycle channels from the ground up.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Oversee the lifecycle strategy across Consensys’ product offering (e.g. in-app notifications, in-app banners, push notifications, full screen modals,, etc)</li>
<li>Determine the channel and messaging throughout a user’s lifecycle (new user education, activation, engagement, retention)</li>
<li>Comfortable working end-to-end on a lifecycle campaign (through setting the strategy, briefing the creative team, building the targeting, QAing the campaign, and measuring results)</li>
<li>Develop an experimentation roadmap across lifecycle channels. Continuously test and learn, identifying the most effective content and messages for different audiences.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About You</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4-8 years of experience in lifecycle marketing</li>
<li>Have built lifecycle user journeys from the ground up with little to no oversight on large userbases</li>
<li>Excellent project management skills to manage multiple experiments at different points in their development&nbsp;</li>
<li>Practical experience executing in CEP systems such as Braze</li>
<li>Familiar with marketing and analytical tools like Segment, Mixpanel, and Preset</li>
<li>Self starter who is data-driven, results-oriented and customer-obsessed</li>

While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role</span><span>.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. <p>It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.</p></div>

      <title>Collibra: Senior Enterprise AI Account Executive — Deasy Labs</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>

      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<h3><strong>Joining Collibra's AI Sales team</strong></h3>
<p>Collibra's AI Sales team is at the forefront of how enterprises adopt and scale AI, selling a suite of AI products including AI Command Center, Collibra Units, and Deasy Labs, Collibra's unstructured data platform for AI, directly to the builders and technical leaders driving production AI systems. This role exists because the market is moving fast and we need elite hunters who can open doors, build trust with technical buyers and close net-new logos in a category that's still being defined. Your work will directly shape how Deasy Labs grows and how Collibra establishes itself as the leader in enterprise AI.</p>
<h3><strong>About Deasy Labs</strong></h3>
<p>Deasy Labs, part of Collibra, develops technology that automatically discovers, enriches, and maintains the semantic context inside unstructured data. Enterprise knowledge often lives in documents, PDFs, reports, and transcripts that traditional data systems cannot easily organize or govern. The Deasy platform analyzes that content and generates structured metadata, taxonomies, and relationships that allow AI systems to retrieve the right information with accuracy and control.</p>
<h3><strong>Senior Enterprise AI Account Executives at Collibra are responsible for</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Owning net-new logo acquisition</strong> with AI/ML teams and Chief AI Officers across your territory, running the full sales cycle from prospecting through close</li>
<li><strong>Building a structured, self-sourced prospecting motion</strong> including agent-based prospecting layered on top of SDR-assisted pipeline to ensure consistent pipeline coverage</li>
<li><strong>Multi-threading across AI engineering, AI ops, data platform, and executive sponsors</strong> simultaneously to build consensus and accelerate deal velocity</li>
<li><strong>Connecting AI products to Collibra's core governance story</strong> in accounts where AI governance is a natural expansion conversation</li>
<li><strong>Delivering accurate, reliable forecasting</strong> with real-time Salesforce updates so the business can plan with confidence</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience selling to technical buyers including AI/ML, data engineering, platform engineering, or software engineering teams</li>
<li>A track record of closing $200K+ ACV deals with AI/ML teams as the primary economic buyer</li>
<li>Demonstrated quota attainment of at least 100% across two or more employers</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows</li>
<li>A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience is required</li>
<li>This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You are</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Able to earn credibility with AI engineers quickly you're a peer, not a pitch</li>
<li>Skilled at multi-threading across a buying committee by instinct, not by process checklist</li>
<li>Comfortable creating real urgency in a market where buyer timelines shift constantly, without manufacturing false pressure</li>
<li>Familiar with unstructured data concepts and able to translate them into business value for stakeholders who don't live in the stack</li>
<li>Able to hold your own on AI governance topics including bias, auditability, and model risk without a subject matter expert in the room</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Measures of success</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Within your first month, you will complete onboarding, build your territory account plan, and identify your top priority target accounts</li>
<li>Within your third month, you will have active qualified pipeline with AI team buyers and at least two deals past the discovery stage</li>
<li>Within your sixth month, you will have closed your first net-new logos and be forecasting your annual number with confidence</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compensation for this role</strong></h3>
<p>The standard base salary range for this position is $120,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits at Collibra</h3>
<p>Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about <a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits">Collibra’s benefits</a>.</p>
<p>We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei">diversity, equity, and inclusion</a> at Collibra.</p>
<p>At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.</p>
<p>With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations">Accommodations for Applicants form</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-senior-enterprise-ai-account-executive-deasy-labs">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-senior-enterprise-ai-account-executive-deasy-labs</a></p>

      <title>PagerDuty: Territory Executive (US)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>PagerDuty is seeking a Territory Executive (TE) to join our dynamic, customer-focused team! As a Territory Executive, you will own a defined territory of mid-sized customer accounts with significant expansion potential. You will combine strategic account management with consultative selling to drive growth, deepen executive relationships, and expand adoption of PagerDuty’s Operations Cloud. This is an exciting opportunity to accelerate PagerDuty’s footprint in high-growth accounts by engaging directly with C-level stakeholders and delivering measurable business outcomes.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate is a strategic seller who thrives in fast-paced environments, excels at executive engagement, and has a proven track record of driving multi-product growth within existing customer portfolios.</p>
<h3><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Drive growth within a defined territory by expanding revenue in existing mid-sized accounts through upsell and cross-sell motions.</li>
<li>Build and sustain relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers through consultative, in-person engagement.</li>
<li>Develop and execute territory and account plans that identify expansion opportunities, competitive risks, and customer priorities.</li>
<li>Champion the adoption of PagerDuty’s Operations Cloud to deliver tangible value and expand platform usage.</li>
<li>Accurately forecast and manage your sales pipeline using Salesforce and the MEDDICC qualification framework.</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Solution Consultants, Customer Success Managers, Renewal Managers, and Product teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or expansion-selling roles within SaaS or enterprise software.</li>
<li>Proven success in meeting or exceeding quota within a defined territory.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to sell to and influence C-level executives and technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Proficiency using Salesforce (SFDC) for pipeline management and forecasting.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Prior enterprise sales expertise leveraging MEDDPICC &amp; Value Selling.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of multi-product SaaS sales motions and consultative selling at the enterprise level.</li>
<li>Experience selling into high-growth or high-potential accounts across AMER, EMEA, APAC, or Public Sector verticals.</li>
<li>Familiarity with Operations Cloud or DevOps environments.</li>
<li>Results-oriented mindset with exceptional collaboration, negotiation, and presentation skills.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Hesitant to apply?</strong></p>
<p>We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobalerts">job alerts</a>!</p>
<p><strong>Where we work</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/locations">offices</a> in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we <strong>cannot</strong> employ candidates residing in:</p>
<p><strong>Location restrictions: </strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Australia:</strong> Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia<br><strong>Canada:</strong> Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon<br><strong>United States:</strong> Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming<br><em>Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.</em></p>
<p><strong>How we work</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/#values">Our values</a> guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.</p>
<p>People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer</strong></p>
<p>As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/global-benefits">benefits site</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Your package may include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefits package&nbsp;</li>
<li>Flexible work arrangements</li>
<li>Company equity*</li>
<li>ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*</li>
<li>Retirement or pension plan*</li>
<li>Generous paid vacation time</li>
<li>Paid holidays and sick leave</li>
<li>Dutonian Wellness Days &amp; HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO</li>
<li>Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*</li>
<li>Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year</li>
<li>Company-wide hack weeks</li>
<li>Mental wellness programs</li>
</ul>
<p>*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure</p>
<p><strong>About PagerDuty</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses</p>
<p>PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Go behind-the-scenes on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/home">careers site</a> and @pagerduty on Instagram.</p>
<p><strong>Additional Information</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's <a href="https://www.pagerduty.com/privacy-policy/">Privacy Policy</a>.</p>
<p>PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.</p>
<p>PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-territory-executive-us">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-territory-executive-us</a></p>
</description>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - U.S.A.
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h1><strong>Who We Are</strong></h1>
<p><span>At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.</span></p>
<p><span>We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you.</span></p>
<p><span>We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team.</span></p>
<p><a href="https://www.justworks.com/careers#values"><span>Our Values</span></a></p>
<p><span>If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.</span></p></div><h1><strong>Who You Are</strong></h1>
<p><strong><span>The sales team at Justworks is ultimately in charge of expanding our customer base while driving revenue and growth. As an Account Executive in-territory in Chicago, you will be responsible for the full sales cycle - building and managing a sales pipeline, market research, prospecting, fostering relationships and creating new ones, contract negotiation, and closing on your deals. Sales is challenging, especially at a start-up but it’s a fulfilling and rewarding experience as you become a trusted advisor to our customers.</span></strong></p>
<h1><strong>Your Success Profile</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>What You Will Work On</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><span>Manage own book of business, build and manage an end-to-end sales pipeline and all supporting activities; prospect to close; meet or exceed your quotas</span></li>
<li><span>Establish a presence in the Chicago territory; research the ins and outs of your<strong> </strong>territory, develop a marketing and networking plan for how you will reach entrepreneur community in your market , and build relationships with the small business community</span></li>
<li><span>Proactively prospect for new business by leveraging market research, sales tools, and cold prospecting</span></li>
<li><span>Gain a sound understanding of our value proposition and effectively communicate that to new potential customers</span></li>
<li><span>Be the voice of our future customers - suggest innovative ideas to generate sales, cultivate customer pipeline leads; improve overall customer experience  and advocate internally for product development</span></li>
<li><span>Be an ambassador of Justworks and its solutions; strive to gain an intimate and comprehensive knowledge of our suite of products</span></li>
<li><span>Travel in- territory in the Chicago and Greater Chicago area</span></li>
<li><span>Perform other duties as needed based on department and/or organizational needs</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>How You Will Do Your Work</strong></h2>
<p><span>As an Account Executive, </span><em><span>how</span></em><span> results are achieved is paramount for your success and ultimately result in our success as an organization. In this role, your foundational knowledge, skills, abilities and personal attributes are anchored in the following competencies:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Good judgement </strong><span>- the exercise of critical thinking, analyzing and assessing problems and implications, identifying patterns, making connections of underlying issues, understanding risks and developing mitigation strategies, and taking ownership of the outcome.</span></li>
<li><strong>Detail-oriented </strong><span>- exercises extreme attention to detail; is thorough, accurate, organized, and productive and seeks to understand both the cause and effect of a situation.</span></li>
<li><strong>Foundational sales knowledge </strong><span>- the specific set of sales skills (prospecting, cold calling, nurturing, engaging, presenting, negotiating, closing etc) and knowledge (product, markets, trends, business etc) a salesperson possesses to enact the exchange of value between a buyer and the vendor.</span></li>
<li><strong>Results-driven </strong><span>- consistently achieves results, even under difficult circumstances.</span></li>
<li><strong>Clear communication </strong><span>- the ability to articulate thoughts and express ideas effectively using oral, written, visual and non-verbal communication skills, as well as listening skills to gain understanding.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>In addition, all Justworkers focus on aligning their behaviors to our core values known as COGIS. It stands for:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Camaraderie</strong><span> - Day to day you can be seen working together toward a higher purpose. You like to have fun. You’re an active listener, treat people respectfully, and have a strong desire to know and help others.</span></li>
<li><strong>Openness</strong><span> - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.</span></li>
<li><strong>Grit </strong><span>- You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.</span></li>
<li><strong>Integrity</strong><span> - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><strong>Simplicity</strong><span> - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><span>A minimum of 2 years experience in an Account Executive position and 1-year experience managing a complete and consultative sales cycle and closing are required.</span></strong></li>
<li><strong><span>Experience in Lead generation for B2B in a high-velocity setting (i.e., SaaS, PEO, Fintech)Salesforce, SalesLoft, LinkedIn SalesNavigator, and/or ZoomInfo are required. Experience with Outreach.io and/or Hubspot, in addition to 6Sense and/or Hoovers/D&amp;B, is a plus.</span></strong></li>
<li><span>Cold-calling experience is required for this position. </span></li>
<li><strong><span>We are seeking candidates with a hunter mentality who are dedicated to grabbing new prospects, netting new logos, closing deals, and delivering immediate results.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></strong></li>
<li><span>Passionate about sales and relationship-focused customer engagements</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrates the ability to listen to gather important information during a sales call and/or meeting</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to simplify complicated topics and explain them in terms people can easily understand</span></li>
<li><span>Able to apply creative solutions to a variety of issues in a fast-paced environment</span></li>
<li><span>You enjoy entrepreneurial environments and the opportunity to build something meaningful!</span></li>
<li><span>There is travel within the territory (25% travel), which includes networking events, trade shows, and meeting potential clients in the Chicago and Greater Chicago area.&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p>This position is paid a base wage plus incentive compensation. The base wage range for this position is targeted at $91,000.00-$110,000.00 in the Chicago area, and competitive On-Target Earnings, inclusive of incentive compensation, of *$182,000.00-$220,000.00. Final offers may vary from those listed. *Incentive compensation is not guaranteed, and earning is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive compensation plan.</p>

These tools support, but do not replace, human review. We do not make hiring decisions based solely on automated processing, and all final hiring decisions are made by Justworks recruiters and hiring managers. Depending on where you reside, you may have rights regarding our use of automated tools. For more information, please contact us at privacy@justworks.com.</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location.&nbsp; </span><span>Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location.&nbsp;</span></p>
