      <title>Pinterest: Designer, PPM</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>As a Designer within Pinterest’s Paid Performance Marketing team, you’ll play an integral role in shaping how Pinterest shows up across the social and digital advertising landscape. You’ll concept, collaborate, and execute on a broad range of creative briefs from our world class Marketing team. The role requires passion for developing exceptional creative solutions and scalable design thinking.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Evolve and elevate Pinterest’s performance creative across social and digital touchpoints</li>
<li>Create high-impact, globally recognized creative solutions that drive the business forward. Deliver work that demonstrates excellence both for the Pinterest brand and the industry at large.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Iterate quickly and communicate ideas across various levels of fidelity, with the ability to receive feedback constructively as well as provide feedback to others.</li>
<li>Single-handedly develop pixel-perfect graphic assets.</li>
<li>Be a source of inspiration for the House of Creative more broadly. You will collaborate with copywriters, motion designers, producers, and marketers to shepherd the brand forward.</li>
<li>Present and articulate the thinking behind your work to key stakeholders, creative directors and team members.</li>
<li>Craft compelling visual stories, using key insights to “sell” in visual concepts and make our message as powerful and influential as possible.</li>
<li>Leverage all available AI tools to assist and optimize your existing workflow—from prompt engineering for static and motion assets to generating AI VO and AI music.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>

<h1><strong>Senior Solutions Consultant</strong></h1>
<h2><strong>Remote - US</strong></h2>
<p><strong>ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITY</strong></p>
<p>The mission of the Senior Solutions Consultant is to configure and demonstrate the value of Legion’s next-generation workforce management technology to prospective customers.&nbsp; The Solutions Consultant will pair their functional expertise, presentation skills, and keen interest in diagnosing an organization's labor management challenges to showcase Legion’s cutting-edge products in a tailored manner.&nbsp; We seek a Senior Solutions Consultant with expertise in pre-sales discovery meetings, demo environment setup and maintenance, and superior presentation skills to partner with our Enterprise Sales team to demonstrate the business value of Legion’s workforce management platform.</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Become an expert for all Legion products</li>
<li>Support the Enterprise Sales team with opportunities across discovery, demonstrations, Proof of Concept engagements, RFP responses, and business justification in a presales capacity</li>
<li>Define and present how Legion’s platform addresses the critical business and operational issues that a prospect faces; form a deep understanding of a prospect’s business as well as their technical environment</li>
<li>Identify potential risks/gaps and eliminate obstacles through creative and adaptive approaches</li>
<li>As needed, travel to various field events such as meetings, conferences, etc.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Participation in competitive landscape and differentiation discussions&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp;5+ years of Workforce Management WFM software pre-sales experience</li>
<li>Experience presenting and demonstrating software to large (10,000+ employee) global organizations</li>
<li>Excellent communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills. Ability to communicate at all levels in the customer organization.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Superior organizational, project management, and multitasking skills</li>
<li>A desire to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment</li>
<li>Experience in labor operations and/or Retail, Food &amp; Beverage, or Hospitality industries a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES</strong></p>

<li>Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence&nbsp;</li>
<li>Personal passion and fervor for industry-leading next generation technology&nbsp;</li>
<li>Ability to operate in an environment with limited resources&nbsp;</li>
<li>A great communicator who can distill powerful messages which resonate with customers&nbsp;</li>
<li>Track record of building positive relationships with peers&nbsp;</li>
<li>Continuous and thoughtful listener, able to learn from others and leverage input</li>

<h3><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></h3>
<p>Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.Our award-winning AI-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric and has proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.</p>
<p>If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.</p>
<h3><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp; Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.</p>

<li>Data-driven problem solver with strong judgment and business acumen.</li>
<li>Collaborative leader who builds trust across Marketing, Sales, Operations, and Enablement.</li>
<li>Committed to continuous learning and improvement.</li>

      <title>Fivetran : Business Development Rep, Enterprise, DACH</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇩🇪 Germany</country>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Germany, EMEA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.</p></div><p><strong>About Us</strong></p>
<p><br>Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.<br><br>Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.<br><br>Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.<br><br>As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.<br><br>During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We’re looking for an Enterprise Business Development Representative to join our team! In this role you will work closely with your Account Executives, Marketing and Partner teams to ensure EMEA builds strong opportunities in key target accounts. Your responsibilities will include outbound calling, video prospecting, crafting compelling messaging as well as qualifying leads to start high quality conversations for your AEs.<br>This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany.</p>
<p><br><strong>Ideally, you'll have experience using:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Salesforce</li>
<li>Outreach/Salesloft/Amplemarket</li>
<li>Gong</li>
<li>Demandbase</li>
<li>LinkedIn Sales Navigator</li>
<li>ZoomInfo or similar.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do<br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Outbound into Enterprise Accounts.</li>
<li>Qualify inbound leads to generate quality meetings with all levels of employees.</li>
<li>Build account plans with your Account Executive.</li>
<li>Organize, log activity, and categorize sales lead information into our CRM, as well as utilize other prospecting tools.</li>
<li>Be able to articulate and sell Fivetran’s value to prospects and how we can support their business goals.</li>
<li>Adhere to your inbound and outbound KPIs as well as being comfortable balancing your time &amp; competing priorities.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Skills We’re Looking For<br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience outbounding into large enterprise businesses, with a track record of high performance.</li>
<li>Confident qualifying inbound/outbound leads.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li>
<li>Highly curious and interested in solving our customer's problems.</li>
<li>Able to convey technical principles in a way that is easy to understand.</li>
<li>Comfortable with daily, weekly and monthly calls, email and meeting targets.</li>
<li>Intrinsically motivated person with a 'get stuck in' attitude.</li>
<li>Fluency in German.</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.</p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€51.999</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€62.401,50 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Perks and Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>100% employer-paid medical insurance<strong>*</strong></li>
<li>Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.</li>
<li>RSU stock grants*</li>
<li>Professional development and training opportunities</li>
<li>Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities</li>
<li>Monthly cell phone stipend</li>
<li>Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.</li>
</ul>
<p><em><strong>*</strong>May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information</em></p>
<p><em>Click <a href="https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CdawUwjo1Q1B7ghZJ_owdmmHB8VtqhBu?usp=sharing">here</a> to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.</em></p>
<hr>
<p>We’re honored to be <a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/blog/hvr-acquisition-series-d">valued at over $5.6 billion</a>, but more importantly, we’re proud of our&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran.com/culture">core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream</a>. Read about us in&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://fivetran-com.s3.amazonaws.com/news/forbes-aug-sept-2022-digital-reprint-10-21-22.pdf">Forbes</a>.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion &amp; belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.</p>
<p>To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xlhtp4dGh8o">click here</a> and enjoy our video.</p>
<p>To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can <a href="https://fivetran.com/candidate-privacy">read our statement here</a>.</p>
<hr>
<p><em>We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this <a href="https://forms.gle/V7k3t4u9j523XkEt6">form</a>. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.</em></p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human<br><br></strong>Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.<br><br>This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.</p></div><p><strong>The SMB New Business Account Executive Opportunity</strong></p>
<p>As a New Business Account Executive focused on new customer acquisition (under 300 employees), you will play a crucial role in expanding Okta’s market presence and driving growth. You will be responsible for identifying and engaging potential clients, effectively communicating the value of our identity and access management software solutions, and closing new business deals</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p>

<li>Generate self-sourced opportunities as well as partnering with Marketing,SDRs and Partners to win new logos.&nbsp;</li>

<li>Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to potential customers</li>

<p>&nbsp;</p>

<li>An understanding of selling in partnership with the channel ecosystem.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience in collaborating effectively within the GTM ecosystem, including but not limited to:&nbsp; AEs, xDRs, SEs, RMs, CSMs, Partners</li>
<li>Prior experience managing a territory based quota</li>
<li>Confident presentation skills with the ability to run demos to C-level executives (decision makers)</li>
<li>Strong verbal and written communications skills</li>
<li>Travel to customer sites at least once per month</li>
<li>Other travel as needed for company events and team offsites</li>
</ul>
<p><br><br></p>
<p><strong>Preferred experience in any of the following:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>IT/Security sales experience</li>
<li>Located near an Okta office hub or in region</li>
<li>BS/BA degree</li>
</ul>

<p>P24001</p>

<p>

</p>

<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>As a Channel Development Manager (CDM) you will build &amp; manage relationships between Rubrik and key regional and national channel partners across the <strong>Ohio Valley Region (MI, OH and KY)</strong>. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams from Rubrik’s Field Sales, Systems Engineering, Channel Marketing, Field Marketing, Alliances and Sales Operations functions, as they will be key resources for you to leverage to attain and exceed sales performance goals.<strong> </strong><br><br><strong>Day-to-Day</strong><br>CDM’s will grow the channel business in their regions through strategic partner planning, enablement, and driving sales acceleration and pipeline generation activities.<br><br><strong>Where you can make an impact:</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Driving Rubrik focus around technologies/products and increases revenues and number of Partner Initiated Deals.</li>
<li>Managing existing and the growth of Distribution and regional Channel partners that will allow better market and vertical sales/support coverage.</li>
<li>Arrange account mappings and meetings with other Rubrik staff with partners to qualify target accounts and opportunities that will lead to Partner Initiated Deals and POCs.</li>
<li>Doing Enablement sessions to train our partners field sales/SE staff to ensure we have self-sufficient partners</li>
<li>Build up strong relationships with relevant decision makers and key persons within those partners to get the right and needed attention to be set as strategic partner with them.</li>
</ul>
<div><strong>Who you are:</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Hard working, self-driven and highly motivated individual with great team spirit</li>
<li>Strong knowledge about the Data Management / Data Protection / Storage market</li>
<li>Great relation and reputation with key partners in assigned region</li>
<li>Able to present in front of bigger audience and hosting events with and for partners and end-customers</li>
<li>Able to identify and initiate deals with partners, work on deals and close them with a partner in close sync with Rubrik Account Teams</li>
</ul>
<div><strong>Ideal background:</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Experience working with local regional channel partners or distributors</li>
<li>Effective at quarterly and yearly planning of sales activities</li>
<li>Ability to implement marketing plans and coordination of marketing activities</li>
<li>Able to identify, develop and acquire new partners</li>
<li>Display repeated success in encouraging existing partners in their sales activities</li>
<li>Strong ability to execute channel programs</li>
<li>Led sales and product trainings</li>
<li>Strong presenter on reseller and end-customer events</li>
<li>Successfully run sales activities with partners</li>
<li>Worked supporting partners in identifying opportunities and closing projects</li>
<li>Worked in teams and is used to work as a team player</li>
<li>Knows how to report numbers and activities, and do forecasting</li>
<li>Sold competitive solutions and has an extensive experience in Backup and Recovery</li>
<li>Worked with vendors like Crowdstrike, Zscaler, Pure Storage, NUTANIX and others together and understands their value proposition and how to build up a joint solution with Rubrik</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-MR2</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2>
<p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/">Instagram</a> |&nbsp;<a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p>

<p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p>
<p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p>

<li>
<p>Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p>
</li>
</ul>

Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.</p>
<p>Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact&nbsp;<a href="mailto:hr@rubrik.com">hr@rubrik.com</a>. <p><strong>The Senior SMB Customer Account Executive Opportunity</strong></p>
<p>As a Customer Account Executive focused on growing Okta’s current customer base, you will be responsible for nurturing and expanding relationships with our existing customers (&lt;300 employees). Your goal is to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, manage account health, and understand your customer’s evolving needs, ensuring our clients receive maximum value from our identity and access management solutions, and that Okta can grow and retain its customer base.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to understand their evolving needs and business challenges</li>
<li>Develop and execute against an assigned quota and territory plan for current customer base by closing upsell, cross-sell, and connected renewal opportunities</li>
<li>Collaborate with product and technical teams to customize solutions that meet customer requirements</li>
<li>Demonstrate the value of additional software features or services to customers through presentations</li>
<li>Facilitate customer onboarding to new products sold and process sales orders</li>
<li>Monitor customer satisfaction and address any concerns or issues promptly&nbsp;</li>
<li>Reporting on sales achievement and forecasts</li>
<li>Collaborate with New business team to ensure success of customers</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll bring to the role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>1+ years experience B2B closing sales experience OR 18+ months experience in a Sales Development role, prospecting and qualifying new leads</li>
<li>A proven track record of success selling to small to medium-sized businesses</li>
<li>Strong verbal and written communications skills</li>
<li>Building relationships with existing customers to push for add-on or incremental business</li>
<li>Developing account strategies with existing customers</li>
<li>Experience using a sales framework such as MEDDICC, Challenger or Sandler (we use MEDDPICC)</li>
<li>An understanding of selling in partnership with the channel ecosystem.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience in collaborating effectively within the GTM ecosystem, including but not limited to:&nbsp; AEs, xDRs, SEs, RMs, CSMs, Partners</li>
<li>Located near an Okta office hub or in region</li>
<li>Travel to customers, events, and team offsites</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Preferred experience in any of the following:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Prior experience managing a territory based quota</li>
<li>Demonstrated sales experience with SaaS/Cloud products/services</li>
<li>Involvement with IT/Security sales</li>
<li>Confident presentation skills with the ability to run demos to C-level executives (decision makers)</li>
<li>BS/BA degree</li>
</ul>

      <title>GitLab: Strategic Account Executive - Singapore</title>
      <region>Asia Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Singapore
</p>

<div><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Strategic Account Executive for Singapore, you will own and grow GitLab’s enterprise relationships in the Singapore market. You’ll help large organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform by leading the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through rollout and long-term adoption. Reporting to an Area Sales Manager or Regional Director, you’ll use a consultative approach to understand complex customer needs, guide them through evaluation, and coordinate pre- and post-sales resources to ensure successful deployments and visible business outcomes.</p>
<p>You’ll work under minimal supervision on complex deals, act as the voice of the customer into GitLab, and partner closely with our strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities and develop new customers. In your first year, you’ll be expected to establish and execute clear account plans for enterprise prospects and customers in the Singapore market, build strong internal and external stakeholder relationships, and consistently manage your forecast and pipeline with transparency and discipline.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in the Singapore Market, owning the full sales cycle for large and enterprise accounts&nbsp;</li>
<li>Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals</li>
<li>Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers</li>
<li>Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products</li>
<li>Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management</li>
<li>Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes</li>
<li>Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels</li>
<li>Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers.</li>
<li>Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management</li>
<li>Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion</li>
<li>Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes</li>
<li>Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis</li>
<li>Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams</li>
<li>Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management</li>
<li>Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2>
<p>The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the Singapore market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p>
<p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-strategic-account-executive-singapore">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-strategic-account-executive-singapore</a></p>

      <title>Virtual Peace of Mind: Marketing and Communications Specialist</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Copywriting, CRM, Graphic Design, Marketing, Marketing Automation, Project Management, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Lead Generation</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Virginia, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://virtualpeace.bamboohr.com/careers">https://virtualpeace.bamboohr.com/careers</a>
</p>

<p><span><span>Marketing and Communications Specialist</span></span></p>
<p><span>Job Title:</span><span> Marketing and Communications Specialist</span></p>
<p><span>Employment Type:</span><span> W-2 Part-Time</span></p>
<p><span>Reports to:</span><span> Chief Executive Officer</span></p>
<p><span>Location:</span><span> Remote, Virginia-based, with occasional travel to Hampton Roads and partner districts for community events</span></p>
<p><span>Schedule:</span><span> Approximately 20 hours per week during business hours, Monday–Friday. The selected candidate will establish a consistent weekly schedule in coordination with their supervisor and must be available for required meetings and collaborative activities.</span></p>
<p><span>Applicant Note:</span><span> Please do not apply for this position if you are unavailable to attend onboarding on your date of hire. Onboarding is required on day one — four hours starting at 9:00 AM (2 hours organizational onboarding + 2 hours systems and tools onboarding) — and will most likely fall during your full-time job's business hours. Onboarding hours are paid. If you are unable to take off during business hours, this is not the job for you.</span></p>
<p><span>Compensation:</span><span> $32/hr</span></p>
<p><span><span>About Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM)</span></span></p>
<p><span>Virtual Peace of Mind (VPM) is a fast-growing, fully remote mental health practice dedicated to providing evidence-based mental health services to children, adults, and families across multiple states. Our mission is to expand equitable access to mental health services through high-quality virtual care — and to support the clinicians and professionals who make that care possible.</span></p>
<p><span>We're building a culture that is mission-driven, accountable, supportive, and built for sustainable remote work.</span></p>
<p><span><span>Why Join VPM</span></span></p>
<p><span>At VPM, you'll be part of a team transforming access to mental health care through virtual care — with a remote model designed to support excellent work and real life.</span></p>
<p><span>What you can expect:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Mission-Driven Impact:</span><span> Contribute to meaningful work improving access and outcomes for youth and families.</span></li>
<li><span>Remote by Design:</span><span> Fully remote environment with clear expectations and supportive infrastructure.</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborative Culture:</span><span> Work with a multidisciplinary team that values integrity, empathy, and shared learning.</span></li>
<li><span>Growth &amp; Leadership Pathways:</span><span> Opportunities to expand scope and take on leadership or consulting responsibilities as we scale.</span></li>
<li><span>Professional Development:</span><span> Access to training, resources, and continued learning opportunities aligned to role scope.</span></li>
<li><span>State &amp; School-Based Partnerships:</span><span> Join initiatives that strengthen school-based mental health delivery and expand access across communities.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Role Overview</span></span></p>
<p><span>VPM is seeking a Marketing and Communications Specialist to tell VPM's story and keep our message consistent everywhere families, schools, and partners see us. This role owns our social media presence, creates and updates marketing materials, supports community outreach events, keeps our website and communications current, and builds the marketing funnels and automated follow-ups that turn interest from families and schools into next steps.</span></p>
<p><span>This is a part-time, remote role based in Virginia, with occasional travel to community events. The Marketing and Communications Specialist works closely with the CEO and the Director of Community Engagement and Partnership to make sure everything VPM puts out — from a flyer at a school event to a post on social media — reflects who we are and the care we provide. This is an organization-wide role supporting VPM's private practice, school-based programs, and other approved initiatives.</span></p>
<p><span><span>Ideal Candidate Profile</span></span></p>
<p><span>We are seeking someone who:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Writes clearly and well — they can turn an idea into a post, a flyer, or an email without a lot of back-and-forth.</span></li>
<li><span>Is organized and can manage multiple projects and deadlines at once.</span></li>
<li><span>Is self-directed — they see what needs doing and do it, without waiting to be told.</span></li>
<li><span>Values consistency — they care that the logo, the colors, and the message look right every time.</span></li>
<li><span>Understands the mission — they care about access to mental health care and want their work to mean something.</span></li>
<li><span>Is comfortable with feedback and revisions — they don't take edits personally.</span></li>
<li><span>Comfortable with technology and marketing automation — they like building systems that follow up while they focus on the creative work.</span></li>
<li><span>Is looking for a home, not another stop — they want to settle in and grow with the practice.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Who This Role Is </span><em>Not</em><span> For</span></span></p>
<p><span>This role may not be the right fit for someone who:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Needs constant direction to get started on a task.</span></li>
<li><span>Struggles to meet deadlines or juggle more than one project at a time.</span></li>
<li><span>Is uncomfortable writing — most of this role is words.</span></li>
<li><span>Wants a purely creative role with no coordination, admin, or follow-through.</span></li>
<li><span>Is looking for a full-time position.</span></li>
<li><span>Uncomfortable with technology or learning new platforms.</span></li>
<li><span>Is not comfortable working independently in a remote setting.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Key Responsibilities</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Content &amp; Social Media</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Manage VPM's social media accounts, including creating and scheduling content</span></li>
<li><span>Write posts, captions, newsletters, and email updates that reflect VPM's voice and mission</span></li>
<li><span>Monitor engagement and adjust content based on what resonates with our audiences</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Marketing Materials</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Design and update flyers, brochures, and program awareness materials for schools and community events</span></li>
<li><span>Maintain brand consistency across all materials — logo, colors, and messaging</span></li>
<li><span>Keep a current library of marketing materials organized and accessible</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Website</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Update and maintain content on the VPM website (vpmforschools.org)</span></li>
<li><span>Ensure program information, contact details, and resources stay current</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Outreach &amp; Events</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Prepare marketing materials for community outreach events</span></li>
<li><span>Coordinate with the outreach team on event promotion and materials</span></li>
<li><span>Support promotion of VPM programs to schools, families, and community partners</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Communications</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Draft internal and external communications as needed</span></li>
<li><span>Support district-facing materials in coordination with the Director of Community Engagement and Partnership</span></li>
<li><span>Check VPM email daily for changes, updates, or requests from the team, and respond promptly</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Marketing Automation, Funnels &amp; Lead Generation</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Design, build, launch, and maintain marketing funnels and landing pages using GoHighLevel</span></li>
<li><span>Develop automated email and SMS campaigns to support lead generation, program awareness, community engagement, and approved follow-up communications</span></li>
<li><span>Create and manage lead capture forms, marketing pipelines, campaign workflows, and audience segmentation</span></li>
<li><span>Build QR-code campaigns connecting outreach events, printed materials, and digital marketing initiatives</span></li>
<li><span>Monitor funnel performance, conversion rates, campaign engagement, and lead-generation results</span></li>
<li><span>Identify opportunities to improve marketing automation, audience engagement, and conversion performance</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with the IT Developer on advanced integrations, technical issues, and platform configurations requiring specialized support</span></li>
<li><span>Ensure funnels and automated communications comply with VPM's privacy policies and consent requirements — family and student information is collected only through VPM's approved secure intake system</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Performance &amp; Accountability</span></span></p>
<p><span>The Marketing and Communications Specialist is responsible for independently executing assigned marketing initiatives, maintaining consistent organizational messaging, and supporting measurable growth in program awareness and engagement.</span></p>
<p><span>Performance will be evaluated through timely campaign execution, completion of approved marketing materials, effective management of GoHighLevel funnels and automated workflows, website accuracy, communication responsiveness, and monthly reporting of marketing activities and campaign results.</span></p>
<p><span><span>Qualifications &amp; Preferred Experience</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>Education</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related field, or equivalent experience</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Experience</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Minimum of 2 years of experience in marketing, communications, or a related role</span></li>
<li><span>Experience managing social media accounts for an organization</span></li>
<li><span>Experience creating marketing materials (flyers, brochures, digital content)</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated experience building marketing funnels, landing pages, lead capture forms, and automated email/SMS campaigns using GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM platform. Candidates must be able to independently manage routine marketing automation after orientation to VPM's systems — training on GoHighLevel specifics is available for candidates with comparable platform experience.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience in healthcare, mental health, education, or nonprofit settings a plus</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Skills &amp; Competencies</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Strong writing and editing skills</span></li>
<li><span>Basic graphic design skills (Canva or similar tools)</span></li>
<li><span>Ability to track campaign performance and use data to improve results</span></li>
<li><span>Strong time management, organization, and attention to detail</span></li>
<li><span>Comfort working independently while staying connected through remote collaboration</span></li>
<li><span>Self-directed with strong virtual presence and professionalism in remote settings</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Professional Communication &amp; Attendance (Essential Function)</span></span></p>
<p><span>Reliable communication and attendance are essential job responsibilities. Team members must:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Attend required onboarding, meetings, and trainings (as applicable)</span></li>
<li><span>Notify the team as soon as possible regarding delays, absences, or scheduling conflicts</span></li>
<li><span>Maintain timely, professional communication during scheduled work hours</span></li>
<li><span>Uphold remote-work standards, including a private workspace and reliable internet connection</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Remote Work Requirements</span></span></p>
<p><span>To support client confidentiality and team effectiveness, this role requires:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>A private, quiet workspace suitable for professional work</span></li>
<li><span>Reliable high-speed internet and ability to use required systems/tools</span></li>
<li><span>Comfort working independently while staying connected through remote collaboration</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>Tools &amp; Systems</span></span></p>
<p><span>This role uses the following tools as part of day-to-day work:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>BambooHR (HRIS + onboarding)</span></li>
<li><span>EnGuard (secure email)</span></li>
<li><span>Google Drive (shared files + documents)</span></li>
<li><span>GoHighLevel (marketing automation and CRM)</span></li>
<li><span>Social media platforms</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><span>What the Employment Process Looks Like</span></span></p>
<ol>
<li><span>Submit an application.</span></li>
<li><span>If there is interest, get a response from VPM for an initial interview.</span></li>

World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h4>The Team:</h4>
<p>Celonis grew up with the private sector: Deutsche Telekom, Mercedes-Benz, Uniper and three quarters of the DAX companies rely on Celonis Process Intelligence. Now we are taking the next big step in Germany: scaling our business with the public sector. To make this happen, Celonis is investing heavily through 2029 in its German public sector business.</p>
<p>Over the past year, we have built our Public Sector team from the ground up. Today, a strong go-to-market core team of Account Executives and Value Engineers is in place, working with federal and state-level institutions.</p>
<p>The police are one of our primary target organizations in the public sector. Police officers spend a <strong>large proportion of their time on data work</strong> and <strong>comparatively little on the actual investigation. We want to turn that around. </strong>With our new police solution, Metropolis, we help police authorities connect and make sense of their data, so that officers can focus on what matters most: <strong>solving cases and keeping people safe</strong>.</p>
<p>To address this, we are now complementing our existing Public Sector team with a highly specialized Account Executive who brings first-hand experience from inside the organization we serve: the <strong>Police</strong>.</p>
<h4>The Role:</h4>
<p>This is not a typical Account Executive role. You bring the perspective of someone who knows police work from the inside: how investigations really run, where time is lost in data work, and how decisions are made and budgets are approved. You will use this credibility to build trusted relationships with police authorities at federal and state level and position Celonis as a long-term partner for their digital transformation.</p>
<p>Working closely with our Public Sector AEs, Value Engineers and product experts, you will translate the operational reality of police work into compelling use cases, contribute to the creation of solution blueprints, drive opportunities from first conversation to signed contract, and help shape how Celonis enters and grows in this market.</p>
<h4>The Work you'll do:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Build and own relationships with police authorities at federal and state level, e.g. <strong>Bundespolizei, Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), Landeskriminalämter (LKA), Landespolizeien</strong> and the responsible <strong>Interior Ministries</strong>.</li>
<li>Engage with decision-makers from police leadership, investigation units, IT and digitalization departments, and procurement</li>
<li>Translate investigators' daily challenges into concrete, AI-enabled use cases for Celonis and Metropolis, with measurable impact (e.g. time saved per case, faster case processing).</li>
<li>Bring the voice of the police into Celonis: share insights with our product, marketing and value engineering teams to sharpen our offering.</li>
<li>Own an individual revenue target and drive complex, long sales cycles to a successful close.</li>
<li>Navigate public procurement and tender processes (e.g. VgV, VSVgV, UVgO, framework agreements) together with our partners and internal experts.</li>
<li>Work closely with partners such as consulting firms, system integrators and public IT service providers.</li>
<li>Represent Celonis at public sector events, conferences and police-specific forums.</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Several years of professional experience <strong>within the German police</strong> (federal or state level), ideally in a leadership role and/or in an area close to investigations, criminal analysis, IT, digitalization or organizational development.</li>
<li>A solid network within the police landscape and a deep understanding of how police authorities and Interior Ministries are organized, how decisions are made and how budgets are planned.</li>
<li>First-hand understanding of the data challenges in police work, e.g. case management, evidence and data analysis, and cross-agency information sharing.</li>
<li>A strong interest in moving into a commercial, customer-facing role. Prior experience in sales, business development or consulting is a plus, but not a must. We will support your onboarding into the sales role.</li>
<li>Strong affinity for technology, data and AI, and the ability to explain complex topics in a simple and convincing way.</li>
<li>Degree in Technology &amp; Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program</li>
<li>Grit, a hands-on mindset, and the drive to build something new.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (native or fluent) and very good English.</li>
<li>Familiarity with public procurement processes is a strong plus.</li>
<li>Willingness and eligibility to undergo a security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) if required by our customers.</li>
<li>Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset.</li>
<li>Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter</li>
<li>Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-SS6</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About Us:</strong></p>
<p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p>
<p>Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _2rkolb4i _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YR5oRJGhJYg&amp;list=PLuVor-ZUD4pnM6G33C5D0tjXUvlTPYBRe">video</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Celonis Inclusion Statement:</strong></p>
<p>At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.<strong><br></strong></p>
<p><strong>Your Privacy:</strong></p>
<p>Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/candidate-notices">Accessibility and Candidate Notices</a></p>
<p>By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/privacy-notice/">Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools</strong><br><br>We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.<br><br>The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.</p>
<p>Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/fraud-alert/">here</a>.</p></div>

      <title>Legion: Sales Development Representative</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<p><strong>JOB OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>As a Sales Development Representative at Legion, your mission is to expand our business by actively prospecting into accounts and showcasing the exceptional value our platform offers. We are seeking a driven individual with a passion for sales and strong business acumen to contribute to our growing Sales team. This role provides an opportunity to develop your sales skills and accelerate the growth of an exciting company that is revolutionizing the future of work for the 2.7 billion-person strong deskless workforce.</p>
<p><strong>ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITY</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Achieve monthly and quarterly quotas for leads sourced, meetings scheduled, and opportunities generated.</li>
<li>Qualify and schedule meetings for the sales team from marketing and partner-generated leads.</li>
<li>Collaborate with the Marketing team to drive attendance to virtual and in-person events.</li>
<li>Effectively communicate Legion’s unique value proposition to prospects and maintain strong product knowledge.</li>
<li>Research and identify key contacts, actively contacting prospects via phone and email.</li>
<li>Maintain accurate lead and activity history in Salesforce CRM.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PROFESSIONAL BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Minimum of 1 year of sales development prospecting experience for a SaaS company.</li>
<li>Comfortable with prospecting, cold calling, and overcoming objections.</li>
<li>Superior verbal and written communication skills.</li>
<li>Experience working with larger organizations with over 5,000 employees.</li>
<li>Familiarity with modern sales tech stack including Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, Zoom, Vidyard, and Sendoso.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES AND VALUES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Highly motivated self-starter with a hunter mentality and growth mindset</li>
<li>Great collaborator with team mentality</li>
<li>Desire to continue to learn and improve in role</li>
<li>Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence</li>
<li>Exceptional time management and organizational skills</li>
<li>Continuous and thoughtful listener, ability to learn from prospects and leverage input</li>
<li>Unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character; demonstrated high moral and ethical behavior</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>COMPENSATION &amp; BENEFITS</strong></p>
<p><em>Salary Range: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 + Bonus + </em><em>Stock Equity</em></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:</p>
<ul>
<li>$0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment</li>
<li>401k plan</li>
<li>Unlimited Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Equity&nbsp;</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></h2>
<p>Legion is on a mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, and we’re looking for best-in-class talent to drive this mission.Legion is a fully remote, mission-driven company focused on turning hourly jobs into good jobs. It’s a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture. You’ll have the opportunity to learn, interact directly with seasoned product executives, grow your skills, and enhance your career while helping solve important problems and achieve Legion’s mission.&nbsp;Our industry-leading, intelligent automation is powered by Legion’s Workforce Management (WFM) platform, which maximizes labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously . In a recent Forrester Total Economic&nbsp;Impact study, Legion WFM was proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion has been recognized for its innovative, modern approach to transforming workforce management – Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, JMP Securities’ Hot 100 List of the Best Privately Held Software Companies, recognized for its industry leading AI technology by with back to back AI Breakthrough and Artificial Intellegence awards, and named a Gartner Cool Vendor. Legion is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures.</p>
<h3><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig-economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees.The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options.Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.&nbsp;Legion WFM was built for the cloud, designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses, and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp;Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.For more information, visit&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co">https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></h3>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<h3><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></h3>
<p>For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email <a href="mailto:recruiting@legion.co">recruiting@legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>
<h1>Job Applicant Privacy Policy</h1>
<p>This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“<strong>Policy</strong>”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>
<div class="section-anchor position-relative"></div>
<ol class="ol-bold">
<li>
<p><strong>Types of Personal Information We Handle</strong></p>
<p>We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Identification and contact information, and related identifiers</strong>&nbsp;such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.</li>
<li><strong>Professional or employment-related information,</strong>&nbsp;including:
<ul>
<li><strong>Recruitment, employment, or engagement information</strong>&nbsp;such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.</li>
<li><strong>Career information</strong>&nbsp;such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Education Information</strong>&nbsp;such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.</li>
<li><strong>Legally protected classification information</strong>&nbsp;such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.</li>
<li><strong>Other information</strong>&nbsp;such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="mt-3">
<p><strong>How We Use Personal Information</strong></p>
<p>We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.</p>
</li>
<li class="mt-3">
<p><strong>With Whom We Share Personal Information</strong></p>
<p>We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Internally</strong>: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process.</li>
<li><strong>Vendors</strong>: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable.</li>
<li><strong>Legal Compliance</strong>: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency.</li>
<li>L<strong>itigation Purposes</strong>: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party.</li>
<li><strong>Business Transaction Purposes</strong>: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="mt-3"><strong>How to Contact Us About this Policy</strong>&nbsp;– If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact <a href="mailto:privacy@legion.co">privacy@legion.co</a>.</li>
</ol></div>

<p>

</p>

<h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3>
<p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<p>As an Enterprise Account Executive covering strategic accounts, you’ll manage existing relationships and identify new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.</p>
<h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Work strategic Stripe customers to develop and execute long-term sales strategies to expand Stripe’s revenue</li>
<li>Expand business with high growth technology companies</li>
<li>Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities</li>
<li>Drive deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex renewals</li>
<li>Develop relationships with executive stakeholders within your book of business</li>
<li>Be responsible for account mapping and coordinating effective meetings with the appropriate external stakeholders expanding the customer relationship</li>
<li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p>
<h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>15+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a highly technical product to strategic customers, with a track record of top performance</li>
<li>Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products</li>
<li>Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations</li>
<li>A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally</li>
<li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders</li>
<li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreement</li>
<li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li>
<li>Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-account-executive-strategics">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-account-executive-strategics</a></p>
