      <title>Stripe: Account Executive, Product Sales (Terminal), Enterprise Retail</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US-SF, US-NY, US-Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Who we are</strong></p>
<p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p>
<p><strong>About the team</strong></p>
<p>Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio.&nbsp; The Terminal Product Sales is tasked with attacking a $15T market opportunity for unified online and offline commerce. The team is lean, high visibility and highly cross-functional!</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p>
<p>As an Account Executive, Product (Terminal) focused on Enterprise Retail, you will use your sales and product expertise to drive growth of Stripe's Unified Commerce suite of hardware, software and payments solutions among North America's largest retailers. You will partner with product, engineering and marketing teams to build deep product and industry knowledge, and you will lead strategic, multi-stakeholder deals with Fortune 100-500 retail brands. You will lead in-depth product discussions with existing and prospective customers and help build and execute our go-to-market strategy for the retail vertical.</p>
<p>You are an adept salesperson, able to hold business-level and technical conversations at every level of a large organization, up to the C-suite (CEO, CFO, CIO and CTO). You are used to building value in competitive, long-cycle enterprise situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding combined with technical knowledge. You are as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders, including executives. You are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You are an organized self-starter and an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record of improving the processes and organizations around you.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive new business growth by identifying, prospecting and closing Stripe Terminal opportunities with Fortune 100-500 retailers in North America.</li>
<li>Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from lead generation through close, with a strong focus on expanding Stripe Terminal's footprint across large retail estates (stores, regions and banners).</li>
<li>Lead strategic sales conversations with retail executives and buying committees (e.g., Payments, IT, Store Operations, Digital/Ecommerce, Finance and Procurement), positioning Stripe Terminal's hardware, software and payments as the best unified commerce solution.</li>
<li>Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including RFPs, security and compliance reviews, pilots and phased multi-store rollouts.</li>
<li>Develop and execute account strategies and go-to-market plans to displace incumbent POS and payments providers and accelerate adoption.</li>
<li>Manage and expand relationships with existing enterprise customers, driving upsells and incremental revenue growth.</li>
<li>Act as a trusted advisor and Terminal expert, both internally and externally, to drive customer success and influence product direction.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Product, Marketing and User Operations teams to refine our approach and fuel Terminal's growth in retail.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who you are</strong></p>
<p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p>
<p><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of sales or prospecting experience at a technology company, with a track record of top performance.</li>
<li>Experience selling hardware and/or software solutions into large enterprise accounts.</li>
<li>A proven ability to build strong, collaborative working relationships with business partners and multiple stakeholders.</li>
<li>The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.</li>
<li>A proven ability to be a self-starter who drives business results without significant supervision.</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li>
<li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.</li>
<li>A proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.</li>
<li>The ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience selling online and offline payments or commerce solutions directly to large enterprise merchants.</li>
<li>Experience selling to or working for large POS or commerce technology businesses.</li>
<li>Experience selling into large, strategic clients in retail, hospitality, travel or banking.</li>
<li>Proven ability to sell complex solutions that combine hardware and software.</li>
<li>Familiarity with the North American enterprise retail landscape, including omnichannel and unified commerce trends, in-store payments, and the POS and payments competitive environment.</li>
</ul>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3>&nbsp;</h3>
<h3>THE ROLE</h3>
<p>Portworx by Everpure is the leading global solution for unlocking the potential of Kubernetes by unlocking the power of data at enterprise scale.&nbsp; Portworx is a cloud native platform that enterprises depend on to reduce the cost and complexity of rapidly deploying containerized applications across multiple clouds and on-prem environments.&nbsp; By providing a single standard that works across the environment, we reduce the operating cost of kubernetes, unlock more use cases, respond and pivot to changes due to economic, regulatory and/or business impacts and make it easier to modernize applications, delight developers, and deliver innovation.</p>
<p>Via Portworx, you can manage any database or stateful service on any infrastructure using any container scheduler. You get a single data management layer for all of your stateful services, no matter where they run. And we thrive in multi-cloud environments.</p>
<p><strong>SHOULD YOU ACCEPT THIS CHALLENGE…</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a highly motivated, persistent, polished and entrepreneurial Account Executive selling into federal accounts finding/nurturing/closing deals related to Portworx and our Everpure Cloud offerings.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Grow a territory and manage deals from land to expand, doing account planning/selling across our Enterprise, Commercial, Corporate and US SLED segments</li>
<li>Work through partners and with co-sellers in order to drive new business opportunities&nbsp;</li>
<li>Understand prospect and customer use-cases in order to drive new business&nbsp;</li>
<li>Plan and manage the relationships at both the strategic and operational level</li>
<li>Evaluate new opportunities and present recommendations to the management team</li>
<li>Conduct competitive and market intelligence sessions for customers</li>
<li>Work closely with the rest of the Portworx and Everpure Cloud sales/pre-sales/SDR and engineering teams&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li>Give enablement sessions both 1:1 and 1:many in order to spread the word on Portworx and Everpure Cloud</li>
<li>Leverage all available documentation, best practices, knowledge-base articles and other vehicles to assist customers</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years experience in selling enterprise software and subscription software, building 3-4x pipeline and exceeding annual quota.</li>
<li>A basic technical understanding of the enterprise software, container, cloud native, and storage domains</li>
<li>Ability to present Portworx and Everpure Cloud’s unique value propositions, products, vision, strategy, and road map</li>
<li>Excellent interpersonal skills including written and oral communication, able to build relationships easily and deepen them over time</li>
<li>Avid hunter with proven prospecting skills, consistently opening doors to new customers and navigating seamlessly between the boardroom and the data center while passionately positioning the advantages of a Portworx and/or Everpure Cloud solutions</li>
<li>Authenticity and a genuine desire to engage customers and understand their business challenges</li>
<li>Thought leadership, creativity and a challenger mindset; the ability to apply your customer insights and expertise in technology solutions to position Everpure’s portfolio to solve persistent problems</li>
<li>Ability to assess, plan, and actively manage a territory to achieve maximum revenue and efficiency</li>
<li>Expertise leading a complex sales process with multiple stakeholders, while fostering teamwork and shared ownership internally with Everpure co-sellers and with Partners</li>
<li>Consistent track record of exceeding quota and driving referenceable business</li>
<li>Passionate about post-sales customer success</li>
<li>TS/SCI Required</li>
<li>Previous Experience selling into federal accounts&nbsp;</li>
</ul>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>We're transforming the grocery industry</strong></p>
<p><span class="im">At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.</span></p>
<p>Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.</p>
<p><strong>Instacart is a Flex First team </strong></p>
<p>There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. <a href="https://www.instacart.careers/flex-first">Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.</a></p></div><h2>Why this role is on the menu</h2>
<p>Instacart is solving incredibly hard problems and growing, and that growth runs on commercial arrangements with partners, including retailer, partnerships, and vendor agreements. This role exists to work closely with business development, partnerships, product, and operations to solve thorny legal problems and enable the business to scale and grow. Without it, commercial terms and business strategy lack sound legal advice and creative solutions to tough legal problems. A year from now, partner agreements are drafted, negotiated, and implemented across the business, and internal teams have a proactive legal partner who works well cross-functionally.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What you'll cook up in your first year</h2>
<ul>
<li>Draft, negotiate, and implement major enterprise and partner agreements across all areas of the business</li>
<li>Lead negotiations with retailers and other strategic partners, aligning internal stakeholders and driving deals to close</li>
<li>Provide strategic legal advice to internal business clients, including whether to approve, approve with conditions, decline, or escalate</li>
<li>Lead special legal and cross-functional projects from start to finish</li>
<li>Implement best practices for integrating AI into your work</li>
<li>Stay current on advertising, competition, IP, consumer protection, gig economy, international, and privacy laws and regulations, and translate them into practical compliance advice</li>
<li>Draft terms, policies, and disclosures, and build the processes that support them</li>
<li>Advise internal clients on the application of executed agreements</li>
<li>Create and update our form legal agreements and playbooks</li>
<li>Train clients and colleagues on legal issues</li>
<li>Think ahead, see around corners, and help the business prepare for future legal issues</li>
</ul>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>The secret ingredients we're looking for</h2>
<p><strong>Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><em>A J.D. from a top-tier law school and membership with at least one state bar (preferably California)</em></li>
<li><em>A minimum of 6 years of related experience working at a leading law firm or in-house legal department</em></li>
<li><em>Strong experience with legal issues affecting the Internet and e-commerce spaces, particularly privacy, SaaS, and payments</em></li>
<li><em>A strong history of managing strategic partner negotiations and contract drafting from start to finish</em></li>
<li><em>Strong negotiation presence and the ability to lead teams working towards a goal</em></li>
<li><em>Sound and practical business judgment and ability to manage multiple, high priority, competing priorities</em></li>
<li><em>The ability to provide clear, concise legal advice, work effectively cross-functionally to drive to results</em></li>
<li><em>A team player</em></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><em>In-house experience, especially at a tech company or retailer</em></li>
<li><em>Experience in alcohol law, international law, and/or privacy and data security laws (including GDPR and CCPA/CPRA)</em></li>
<li><em>Experience with AI governance and privacy-by-design in ML/AI product development</em></li>
<li><em>Experience in AdTech</em></li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Your Recipe for Impact</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><em>Initiative. You take ownership, spot issues before they become problems, and move work forward without waiting to be asked.</em></li>
<li><em>Sound judgment. You know when to approve, approve with conditions, decline, or escalate, and you can explain your reasoning to both lawyers and business stakeholders.</em></li>
<li><em>Cross-functional partnership. You build trusted relationships with business development, partnerships, product, and operations, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment.</em></li>
<li><em>Clear, articulate communication. You make complex legal concepts accessible to non-legal audiences, including senior leadership.</em></li>
<li><em>Fast learning and range. You pick up new products, industries, and legal areas quickly and enjoy a varied docket.</em></li>
<li><em>Creative problem-solving. You think outside the box, are comfortable in ambiguous, novel territory, and find workable solutions beyond the standard playbook.</em></li>
</ul>
<p><em>#LI-Remote</em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span>Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy </span><a href="https://instacart.careers/flex-first/">here</a>.</p>
<p><span>Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. </span><span>Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please rea</span><span>d more about our benefits offerings </span><a href="https://instacart.careers/taste-of-instacart/"><span>here</span></a><span>. <br><br></span><span>For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.</span></p></div><div class="title">CA, NY, CT, NJ</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$231,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$244,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">WA</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$221,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$233,500 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$212,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$224,000 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">All other states</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$193,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$203,500 USD</span></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/instacart-commercial-counsel">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/instacart-commercial-counsel</a></p>
</description>

<p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p>
<p><span>Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers.       <title>Grafana Labs: Commercial Account Executive, Growth | Remote | Germany</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Germany (Remote)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <span><a href="http://grafana.com">grafana.com</a></span> and follow us on <span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/">LinkedIn</a></span> and <span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana">X</a></span>.</p>
<p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p>
<p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><div class="section page-centered">
<div class="section page-centered">
<div class="job__description body">
<div class="section page-centered">
<div class="section page-centered">
<div class="section page-centered">
<div class="section page-centered">
<h3 class="section page-centered">The Opportunity&nbsp;</h3>
<div class="section page-centered">Grafana Labs is looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Commercial Account Executive, Growth</strong> based in Germany who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across DACH. You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before.</div>
<div class="section page-centered">
<h3><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals</li>
<li>Outbound prospecting into net-new customers</li>
<li>Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations)</li>
<li>Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads</li>
<li>Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise</li>
<li>Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce</li>
<li>Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="section page-centered">
<h3>What Makes You a Great Fit:</h3>
<ul>
<li>2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales</li>
<li>Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer)</li>
<li>Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player</li>
<li>Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies</li>
<li>You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually</li>
<li>Fluent in English &amp; German&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h3>&nbsp;Bonus Points For:&nbsp;</h3>
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage</li>
<li>Experience using Salesforce</li>
<li>Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="section page-centered">
<h3>Compensation &amp; Rewards<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></h3>
<p>In Germany, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 175,000 - EUR 185,000<span>.</span> Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div><div class="content-conclusion"><div>
<p><em>*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p>
<p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li>
<li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li>
<li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li>
<li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li>
<li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li>
<li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li>
<li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li>
<li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li>
<li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li>
<li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p>
<p><em>Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>
</div>
<div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</em></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-commercial-account-executive-growth-remote-germany">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/grafana-labs-commercial-account-executive-growth-remote-germany</a></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇬🇧 United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland</country>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United Kingdom, Remote
</p>

<p>The Datadog Major Accounts Team is focused on driving new business and expanding the current Datadog footprint with our largest and most strategic clients. The success of the Major Accounts Team directly impacts the success of Datadog and is a highly visible position with bold revenue targets. We are searching for seasoned and successful Account Executives that have a passion for technology and a fast-paced sales environment. The Major Accounts Team has experienced unprecedented success since its inception in 2021 and we are continuing to expand the team. This is a lucrative opportunity for any driven and competitive salesperson.</p>
<p>&nbsp;<em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Prospect into a targeted set of accounts while running an efficient sales process</li>
<li>Nurture existing client relationships and grow the Datadog footprint</li>
<li>Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory including existing relationships and aspirational contacts</li>
<li>Develop a deep comprehension of the customer's business</li>
<li>Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms by selling value and ROI</li>
<li>Demonstrate resourcefulness when faced with challenges</li>
<li>Determine necessary steps to close business and gain customer validation</li>
<li>Identify a robust set of business drivers behind all opportunities</li>
<li>Ensure high forecasting accuracy and consistency</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Someone with 7+ years Enterprise software sales experience</li>
<li>Experienced in selling Fortune 100 companies with the ability to win new business</li>
<li>Experience managing a complex account team from multiple GTM Ecosystem partner functions to support Sales cycle</li>
<li>Experience/success selling new solutions into accounts already leveraging core technical products</li>
<li>Combination of leveraging existing customer contacts and net new PG to break into new BUs and sell net new products</li>
<li>Have consistently met/exceeded direct sales goals</li>
<li>Able to demonstrate methodology to prospect and build pipeline on your own</li>
<li>Experienced in working for an innovative tech company</li>
<li>Willingness to travel over 50% of the time</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.</em></p>
<p><strong>Benefits and Growth:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>High income earning opportunities based on individual performance</li>
<li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li>
<li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li>
<li>Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message</li>
<li>Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li>
<li>An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)</li>
<li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions</li>
<li>Free, global Spring Health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li>
<li>Competitive global benefits</li>
<li>Giving programs</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr>
<p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on <a href="https://www.instagram.com/datadoghq/?hl=en">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/datadog">LinkedIn,</a> and <a href="https://learn.datadoghq.com/">Datadog Learning Center. </a></p>

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>

      <title>MetaMask: Product Marketing Lead - Trade</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> UNITED STATES - Remote, EMEA - Remote, LATAM - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><em><strong>Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.</strong></em></p>
<p>Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: <strong>Open Money. </strong>This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own.&nbsp; Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.</p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>MetaMask is the world's leading self-custodial wallet — and the primary gateway for hundreds of millions of people into the onchain economy. Our Trading features sit at the heart of that experience: enabling users to place a swap, a perp trade, a prediction market trade, or an investment in Real-World-Assets (RWA) with confidence.</p>
<p>We're looking for a strategic, data-informed, and user-obsessed <strong><em>Senior Product Marketing Manager</em></strong> to own the positioning and growth of these features. This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the MetaMask marketing organisation — sitting at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and long-term brand trust.</p>
<p>You'll report to our Product Marketing Director and work across Product, Growth, Brand, Business Development, and Partner Marketing to ensure every launch and lifecycle initiative is anchored in insight, competitive differentiation, and measurable impact.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>What you'll do</strong></p>
<p><em>Strategy</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Define and execute end-to-end GTM strategy for features within Trading across global markets — from opportunity sizing and positioning through to launch and lifecycle optimisation</li>
<li>Partner with Product leads to shape roadmap priorities based on market insight, user behaviour, and growth potential</li>
<li>Act as a strategic thought partner to Product and Growth, representing user needs and market realities in decision-making</li>
<li>Influence long-term product strategy and monetisation through competitive analysis, segmentation, and market research</li>
</ul>
<p><em>GTM and product growth</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead product and feature launches, crafting narratives that resonate with crypto traders and holders,</li>
<li>Drive lifecycle marketing initiatives that increase awareness, activation, and retention across Trading funnels</li>
<li>Partner with Growth and Analytics to identify friction points and opportunities within user journeys, translating insights into programmes that move key metrics — conversion, volume, retention</li>
<li>Ensure strong measurement and continuous iteration — every campaign should have clear success metrics and documented learnings</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Cross-functional collaboration</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborate with Product, Brand, Growth, Communications, Business Development, and Customer Support to deliver integrated campaigns that connect product value to cultural relevance</li>
<li>Align cross-functional stakeholders and manage timelines, priorities, and expectations to ensure seamless execution</li>
<li>Partner with Data and Product to monitor performance, share learnings, and continually refine GTM approaches</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Brand and community</em></p>
<ul>
<li>Strengthen MetaMask's reputation as a trusted, user-first brand in the Trading community</li>
<li>Support education, community, and influencer programmes that drive awareness and confidence — particularly among emerging market segments</li>
<li>Ensure consistency in storytelling across all surfaces, from lifecycle emails to content and brand campaigns</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6 to 8+ years in product marketing, ideally within fintech, crypto, or a high-growth consumer tech environment</li>
<li>Demonstrated success leading complex product launches and lifecycle growth initiatives with measurable outcomes</li>
<li>Strong strategic thinking and storytelling ability — able to turn complex product concepts into clear, compelling narratives</li>
<li>Analytical and outcome-driven; comfortable interpreting data and using insight to inform both marketing and product strategy</li>
<li>Exceptional cross-functional communication, influence, and project leadership skills</li>
<li>Deep curiosity about web3, DeFi, and onchain user behaviour — or direct experience in the crypto ecosystem</li>
<li><em>Nice to have: </em>experience in leading GTM for perps trading and prediction markets products and leading GTM to Asia audience.</li>
</ul>
<p><span>Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role</span><span>.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.</em></p></div><div class="title">US pay range (not including bonus, equity or other benefits)</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$146,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$220,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="isSelectedEnd">In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices and we encourage all applicants to review our best practices to protect yourself, which can be found on our page.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">MetaMask may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, or conducting initial candidate assessments. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and improve efficiency — they do not replace human judgment. A human recruiter or hiring manager reviews every candidate, and all final hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.</p>
<p>It is a requirement of employment in this position that applicants may be required to submit to background and identity verification checks, including but not limited to employment, education, criminal record checks, and other such checks as determined necessary by the company.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metamask-product-marketing-lead-trade">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/metamask-product-marketing-lead-trade</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Bitwarden: Channel Account Executive - LATAM</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US
</p>

<p></p>
<p>Bitwarden helps enterprises, developers, and individuals securely store and share sensitive data. We're open source, and our products cover password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovation. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Santa Barbara, California, we're backed by a global community of security experts and enthusiasts.</p>
<p>LATAM is a channel-first region for us. As channel manager, you'll build the partner ecosystem across Latin America, own a quota, and get resellers and MSPs selling Bitwarden on their own.</p>
<h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own a regional go-to-market plan for LATAM, with priority markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and Argentina</li>
<li>Recruit and onboard regional resellers, MSPs, and local and boutique VARs, plus distributors where they're the right route to market</li>
<li>Build and maintain a partner plan that maps each partner's strengths (customer relationships, vertical focus, technical specialty) to target accounts</li>
<li>Manage lead flow both ways between partners and Bitwarden Sales, run deal registration, and keep sales leaders current on channel pipeline and forecast</li>
<li>Set financial goals with focus partners and drive them to hit those goals</li>
<li>Train partners in Spanish and Portuguese on Bitwarden products, positioning, and competitive displacement</li>
<li>Run joint marketing with partners and our marketing team: local events, campaigns, and co-selling motions</li>
<li>Join partner sales calls to provide product expertise and help close deals</li>
<li>Work through LATAM-specific deal mechanics with Finance and Legal, including local-currency pricing, invoicing and tax requirements, payment terms, and data residency questions (LGPD in Brazil, for example)</li>
<li>Run several channel initiatives at once across technical, professional services, and sales</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5-10 years in partner development, channel management, or sales, with a record of hitting quota</li>
<li>Existing relationships with LATAM resellers, MSPs, or distributors in security or IT</li>
<li>Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese and English.Experience with both global and boutique VARs, and with how channel works in the region: tiered distribution, local entities, and longer public-sector cycles</li>
<li>Comfort working remotely with minimal supervision across time zones, with regular travel in-region for partner meetings and events</li>
<li>A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field</li>
<li>A self-starter mindset and a bias toward solving problems yourself</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2>
<ol>
<li>Screening call with our recruiting manager</li>
<li>Hiring manager interview (head of channel sales)</li>
<li>Interview with our CSO</li>
<li>Interview with our head of sales enablement</li>
<li>Final interview with our CEO</li>
<li>Reference checks</li>
</ol>
<h2><strong>Why Bitwarden</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Mission.</strong> Our community loves us, and you'll bring better security to everyone from families to the world's largest organizations.</li>
<li><strong>Market.</strong> You'll become an expert in two growing markets: security and open-source software.</li>
<li><strong>Growth.</strong> You'll build channel, demand gen, and product-led growth experience in a fast-growing company.</li>
<li><strong>Team.</strong> Work remotely with motivated people around the world, with in-person meetups.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-channel-account-executive-latam">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bitwarden-channel-account-executive-latam</a></p>
</description>

      <title>GitLab: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Sydney or Melbourne)</title>
      <region>Oceania Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Australia
</p>

<div><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>Role overview</strong><br><br>As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive for ANZ, you will own and grow GitLab’s enterprise relationships across Australia. You’ll help large organizations realize the full value of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform through strategic, consultative SaaS sales. You’ll engage customers on how Agentic AI, AI orchestration, and integrated security can support secure software development and business outcomes. You’ll lead the end-to-end sales cycle—from territory and account planning, prospecting, and qualification through complex deal execution, deployment, adoption, and long-term expansion.</p>
<p>Reporting to our Regional Sales Director, you’ll take a customer-centric approach to understanding complex business and technical needs, guiding customers through evaluation, and coordinating pre- and post-sales resources to achieve successful deployments and measurable business outcomes.</p>
<p>You’ll operate with minimal supervision on complex enterprise opportunities, act as the voice of the customer within GitLab, and partner closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified pipeline and win new customers. In your first year, you’ll establish and execute account plans for enterprise prospects and customers across ANZ, build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and manage your pipeline and forecast with transparency and discipline.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Support GitLab’s strategic prospects and customers in the ANZ Market, owning the full sales cycle for large and enterprise accounts&nbsp;</li>
<li>Lead account strategy by developing and executing account plans aligned to each customer’s business needs and long-term goals</li>
<li>Conduct prospecting and opportunity development activities in named large and strategic accounts, including working closely with strategic channel partners to generate qualified leads and new customers</li>
<li>Coordinate pre- and post-sales engagement with solutions architects, customer success, and support teams to ensure successful rollout, adoption, and expansion of GitLab products</li>
<li>Provide clear account leadership, including regular activity, pipeline, and forecast reporting to sales management</li>
<li>Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes</li>
<li>Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas through GitLab’s public issue tracker and internal channels</li>
<li>Use a consultative sales approach to uncover business issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience managing complex sales cycles with ANZ large, strategic enterprise customers.</li>
<li>Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management.</li>
<li>Familiarity with software development concepts and tools; exposure to Git, software development tools, DevSecOps, application lifecycle management, Agentic AI, AI orchestration, or software and application security is preferred.</li>
<li>Proficiency in consultative, solution, value-based, and consumption-based selling—including discovery, uncovering business needs, aligning solutions to customer outcomes, driving product adoption and expansion, and delivering persuasive proposals and presentations.</li>
<li>Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion</li>
<li>Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes</li>
<li>Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis</li>
<li>Effective communication and collaboration skills to share customer feedback and lessons learned with sales management, product, marketing, and technical teams</li>
<li>Familiarity with software development concepts and tools, with preferred exposure to Git, software development tools, or application lifecycle management</li>
<li>Alignment with GitLab’s values, openness to learning, and interest in applying transferable skills even if your background does not match every requirement exactly</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2>
<p>The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the ANZ market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.</p>
<p><br><br></p><div><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>

<p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. <div><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2>
<p>As a Senior Recruiter, Public Sector GTM, you'll build the go-to-market (GTM) teams that drive GitLab's growth across U.S. federal, state, local, and education customers. In this senior individual contributor role, you'll partner with Public Sector leaders across Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Professional Services, Field Operations, and Enablement, owning searches from intake through close. You'll build inclusive pipelines, use data and market insight to guide hiring decisions, and act as a trusted talent advisor to Public Sector leadership.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Manage full-cycle searches for Public Sector Account Executives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Sales Operations roles. Deliver against agreed recruiting goals and key metrics, with accurate, timely documentation in Greenhouse.</li>
<li>Lead intake conversations to align hiring teams on role scope, segment, territory, quota and ramp expectations, citizenship and clearance requirements, interview plans, and timelines. Support Federal Civilian, Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, and State, Local, and Education searches.</li>
<li>Build research-based, diversity-focused sourcing strategies for a constrained talent market. Balance applicants, passive talent, referrals, internal talent, veteran and military-transition talent, and targeted outreach, including candidates with active or previously held security clearances and experience with government agencies, systems integrators, and contract vehicles.</li>
<li>Partner with Public Sector leaders on structured, equitable interviews with clear competencies and actionable feedback. Challenge assumptions and escalate risks or blockers early.</li>
<li>Use talent-market research, compensation and on-target earnings (OTE) benchmarks, funnel metrics, and candidate feedback to shape search strategy. Plan hiring around public sector buying cycles, including the federal fiscal year-end.</li>
<li>Assess sales candidates on track record, quota attainment, deal complexity, and experience with long, procurement-driven sales cycles relevant to GitLab's Public Sector segments and approach.</li>
<li>Deliver a thoughtful candidate experience through disciplined pipeline management, proactive communication, timely feedback, and offer negotiations that clearly explain compensation and OTE.</li>
<li>Coach less experienced recruiters and improve recruiting practices by sharing reusable resources, using artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly, and representing GitLab's mission, values, and culture.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you’ll bring</h2>
<ul>
<li>Senior-level recruiting experience, with a track record of independently owning full-cycle searches and handling complex, hard-to-fill roles.</li>
<li>Public Sector, federal, or government-focused sales recruiting experience, or deep familiarity with government sales segments, quotas, OTE, ramp time, territory design, and procurement-driven sales cycles.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of how citizenship, clearance, and background investigation requirements affect sourcing, interview timing, and offer-to-start timelines.</li>
<li>Experience building stakeholder trust, influencing without authority, and managing hiring team expectations at the manager level and above.</li>
<li>Experience building proactive, diversity-focused sourcing strategies and balanced pipelines in niche or credential-restricted talent markets, using funnel insights to guide practical actions.</li>
<li>Strong organization across multiple requisitions and clear written and verbal communication across time zones, with attention to detail and candidate care.</li>
<li>Experience with an applicant tracking system and recruiting tools such as Greenhouse, Metaview, LinkedIn Recruiter, LinkedIn Insights, SeekOut, ClearanceJobs, or comparable platforms. Ability to evaluate AI-generated work, protect confidential information, and share responsible workflows with team members.</li>
<li>Technology or business-to-business (B2B) software recruiting experience is helpful, not required.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About the team</h2>
<p>You'll join a globally distributed, remote-first Talent Acquisition team where clear communication and reliable follow-through matter. Guided by GitLab's operating principles, including Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset, and Customer Outcomes, we take ownership, move with urgency and rigor, and focus on hiring outcomes that matter to our internal customers. We share learnings and create reusable resources to continually improve the quality and consistency of hiring across GTM teams.</p><div><div><div><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">benefits</a><span> and </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div>United States Salary Range</div><div><span>$104,800</span><span>—</span><span>$176,400 USD</span></div></div></div><div><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6923/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States

</p>

<h2>About the Organization</h2>
<p>Millions of Americans feel politically homeless and left out of the two-party structure. Too many electoral choices are settled before most voters have a meaningful say, and our political system consistently fails to address the nation's biggest challenges. We are a stealth team building an ambitious cross-partisan political venture to make American democracy more open, competitive, and responsive. We will build the infrastructure to effectively challenge the two-party political establishment, and create fundamentally new pathways to elected office and engaged citizen participation.</p>
<p>Our first major initiative will launch publicly in spring 2027 with the objective of materially influencing the 2028 national election cycle. This project will combine the scale of a mainstream consumer technology product, the reach of a modern media operation, and the ground game of a national political campaign - complete with digital and IRL field organizing across dozens of states - to engage tens of millions of Americans and build a constituency that outlasts this election cycle.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our leadership team has raised and deployed over $100M toward democracy reform, winning dozens of state and local reform campaigns. Backed by seed funding from prominent investors and a cross-partisan board of civic leaders and company-builders, we are now assembling a multidisciplinary operating team of technologists, storytellers, politicos, and operators to build it from the ground up.<br></p>
<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>You are a rare growth leader who understands brand, narrative, and how the modern attention economy works - and you believe deeply in the American political experiment, with conviction that more political competition is needed for a more productive, representative government. As our <em>Chief Growth Officer</em>, you will champion and grow a new civic platform that millions of Americans will join to inform themselves, deliberate together, and make their voices heard in the 2028 election cycle. You will own the full stack of brand, narrative &amp; communications, and growth marketing to grow user adoption and engagement, and you'll do it while political adversaries work to turn our mission into a punching bag. In short, you will tell the story of the most ambitious experiment in American self-government in a generation, and make it feel inevitable to the public.</p>
<p>You'll start in January 2027 with a name, a mission, a launch date that spring, and no audience. You'll lead the development of the brand and the story, and assemble and manage the team (FTEs, contractors, firms, creators) that makes this organization a household name across the country. You'll lead the team toward three core objectives:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<strong>Sign up millions of Americans for a civic cause and platform that has never existed, and count them the hard way:</strong> a verified identity and one real action beyond sign-up. The target is at least 10 million members by the end of 2028.</li>
<li>
<strong>Reach the politically homeless.</strong> Our success runs through activating Americans who have grown disillusioned with the two-party system and tuned politics out. You'll find the stories, formats, and messengers that break through to them.</li>
<li>
<strong>Build momentum on an unforgiving fixed calendar: </strong>a steady drumbeat of milestones, launches, and moments, each bigger than the last, that people choose to watch, share, and debate over dinner, so it feels like a cultural event instead of a civics assignment.<br>
</li>
</ol>
<h2>What you'll own</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<strong>The dual engines of Communications &amp; Growth</strong>. You will lead both, and can hire a deputy for whichever is less your strength. For each piece, you select and brief the right person or firm, building an ensemble that is more than the sum of its parts:</li>
<ul>
<li>Qualitative excellence in Communications: brand creation and stewardship, a new-media content studio, press and earned media, a creator program, and other tactics as needed.</li>
<li>Quantitative excellence in Growth: designing acquisition funnels for platform participants and small-dollar supporters, paid and organic channels, email and SMS, lifecycle, data, and reporting on all of the above.</li>
</ul>
<li>
<strong>Brand development.</strong> The organization's name (mostly), mission, and values (definitely) already exist. You will lead a fast, rigorous brand strategy process that defines the look, the voice and tone, the role we play in people's lives, and the starting key messages and storylines for launching something Americans haven't seen before. Positive, optimistic, and funny where it counts. Progressive, conservative, moderate, and checked-out should all be able to see something of themselves in this brand.</li>
<li>
<strong>A modern media operation people watch by choice</strong>. You set the formats, pick the talent, and build the team that produces them. Think new media, not just press releases: series, conversations, and potentially a daily stream that makes sense of the political news through our worldview, takes calls, breaks our announcements, and gets clipped across every channel. If it plays like C-SPAN, we've lost; we're aiming for the clip people send to their group chat.&nbsp;</li>
<li>
<strong>Growth, end to end, including its economics</strong>. You run the public launch against an ambitious sign-up goal, owning paid and organic acquisition, the creator network, the topic mix, and message testing on every channel. You own the budget and will take pride in driving our blended CAC down every month, toward zero as our messengers, creators, and members spread the message. When the data calls for a course correction, you flag it and bring leadership a clear recommendation.</li>
<li>
<strong>Engagement from sign-up through 2028</strong>. You own the goals for onboarding, activation, and re-engagement. You coordinate with the organizing team, which turns engagement into action and volunteers, and with product and engineering, which build the tools you deploy.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<h2>Who we're looking for...</h2>
<ul>
<li>You believe in a healthy, competitive democracy and you're willing to work hard on a tour of duty - January 2027 through the 2028 general election, at least - to serve the country.&nbsp;</li>
<li>You've grown an audience or user base from zero to large for a product, a campaign, or a cause, and you're as comfortable designing content people share as analyzing and presenting cost-per-acquisition tables and retention curves.&nbsp;</li>
<li>You've managed user engagement at scale but still carry the startup gene: you're happy starting lean and building at high velocity.&nbsp;</li>
<li>You can write messages that land with people across demographics and ideologies, including people who have grown skeptical and cynical, and you're comfortable in a genuinely cross-partisan environment.&nbsp;</li>
<li>You know how to use modern AI tools effectively, because you will need them to keep all of these plates spinning.&nbsp;</li>
<li>You've worked on high-stakes projects under an unforgiving news cycle, where a bad story could break at 6am and need an answer by 7am.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<ul><li>
<strong>You are battle-ready.</strong> Political media and party operatives will come at us, early and often. You bring the political astuteness to know what we should never say, build a press and rapid-response operation that understands politics, and turn the inevitable attacks into attention. Public criticism of you personally will not rattle you.</li></ul>
<p></p>
<h3>Other details:</h3>
<ul>
<li>This role reports to the Chief Executive Officer.</li>
<li>Location is flexible (headquarters not yet determined); regular travel required.</li>
<li>This role will begin as contract-to-hire while the organization completes its legal formation. Exact timeline to be shared with qualified candidates.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p>Compensation will be commensurate with experience - starting at $250K - and include standard benefits (health insurance, etc).</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/formidable-chief-growth-officer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/formidable-chief-growth-officer</a></p>

      <title>Sweat Pants Agency: PPC Marketing Specialist (Remote)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6921/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Montreal, Quebec, Canada
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.sweatpantsagency.com/">https://www.sweatpantsagency.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.</strong></p>
<p>That is the whole job.</p>
<p>Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.</p>
<p>So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.</p>
<p>At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.</p>
<p>You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.</p>
<p>Here is what "end to end" actually means.</p>
<p><strong>You are the account manager. We do not have any.</strong> You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.</p>
<p><strong>You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.</strong> Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.</p>
<p><strong>You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.</strong> We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.</p>
<p><strong>You can live anywhere.</strong> We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.</p>
<p>If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.</p>
<p>If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.</p>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<p><strong>What the job looks like</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<strong>Own a set of DTC accounts</strong>&nbsp;as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.</li>
<li>
<strong>Own the client relationship.</strong>&nbsp;There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.</li>
<li>
<strong>Audit before you touch anything.</strong>&nbsp;Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.</li>
<li>
<strong>Run brand and non brand as different businesses.</strong>&nbsp;Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.</li>
<li>
<strong>Know what PMax is actually doing.</strong>&nbsp;The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.</li>
<li>
<strong>Keep Google's automation on a leash.</strong>&nbsp;Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.</li>
<li>
<strong>Own the feed.</strong>&nbsp;Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.</li>
<li>
<strong>Own the tracking.</strong>&nbsp;GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.</li>
<li>
<strong>Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.</strong>&nbsp;Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.</li>
<li>
<strong>Build the things the account needs.</strong>&nbsp;Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You are a fit if</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<strong>You have done this with real money.</strong>&nbsp;Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.</li>
<li>
<strong>You are fluent in the whole stack</strong>, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.</li>
<li>
<strong>You are AI native, and you build.</strong>&nbsp;This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.</li>
<li>
<strong>You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.</strong>&nbsp;You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.</li>
<li>
<strong>You are skeptical of your own numbers.</strong>&nbsp;You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.</li>
<li>
<strong>You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.</strong>&nbsp;Where you live is up to you.</li>
<li>Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You are not a fit if</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.</li>
<li>You want to be told what to do this week.</li>
<li>You need a ticketing system to know what matters.</li>
<li>You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<p><strong>Why this role is exciting</strong></p>
<p>This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.</p>
<p>You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.</p>
<p>You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.</p>
<p>You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.</p>

</description>
