      <title>Celonis: Account Executive - Cross Industries</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇨🇭 Switzerland</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Switzerland
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h4><strong>The Team:</strong></h4>
<p>You will join our high-performing Swiss sales team. We help leading enterprise organizations in Switzerland optimize their end-to-end processes, increase operational efficiency through our Process Intelligence platform, and provide the contextual layer to industrialize Enterprise AI.<br><br></p>
<h4><strong>The Role:</strong></h4>
<p>Applying a value-driven consultative sales approach, you will build and grow relationships to drive sales cycles from discovery to value realization. You will be responsible for a portfolio of enterprise accounts headquartered in Switzerland, combining existing customers, where you will expand our footprint, with new / greenfield accounts, where you will win new logos for Celonis. Navigating complex organizations from operational leaders up to the C-suite, you will collaborate cross-functionally to understand your accounts' needs and drive the end-to-end sales cycle to a successful close.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>The work you'll do:</strong></p>
<p>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Manage a balanced portfolio of existing customers (land-and-expand) and new / greenfield accounts (new logo acquisition)<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Build pipeline in greenfield accounts through targeted prospecting and account planning<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Engage stakeholders across lines of business, from operational leaders up to C-level<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Drive Celonis Process Intelligence sales motions across the core enterprise value chain, translating business challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases that deliver measurable execution capacity<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Hold an individual revenue target for closing six-figure+ deals within your accounts<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Engage closely with partners e.g., consulting firms and SaaS vendors<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Drive sales cycles through orchestrating virtual teams including business development representatives, marketing managers, partner managers, sales engineers / pre-sales, customer success managers, professional services, implementation partners...<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Grow your skills through structured enablement, coaching and close collaboration with experienced Strategic Account Executives and your Sales Manager</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong></p>
<p>●&nbsp; &nbsp; 3+ years of relevant experience in either one - or ideally both - of the following domains:<br>○&nbsp; &nbsp;SaaS Sales: Track record of applying a consultative sales approach to sell complex B2B software solutions to enterprise accounts, ideally with experience in both expanding existing customers and winning new logos.<br>○ &nbsp; &nbsp;AI / Management Consulting: Experience in a (boutique) consultancy, delivering AI or digital transformation projects with exposure to account management, client relationships, and business development.<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;A track record of meeting or exceeding targets, commitment, and successful career progression with your previous companies<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;A hunter mentality: proven ability to prospect, open doors and build pipeline in new accounts<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Strong business acumen and a solid understanding of core processes and KPIs across the enterprise value chain (e.g., Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain)<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different industries and business models<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Ability to build trusted relationships with Business and IT stakeholders and the confidence to engage up to the C-level<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Grit, a hands-on mindset, strong discovery skills and a structured approach to running sales processes<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Excellent communication and presentation skills in German (fluent) and English<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Eagerness to learn and develop, open to feedback and coaching<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Ability to adapt to a fast moving, ever changing, high growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking, and a growth mindset<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Willingness to be collaborative, inclusive, to embrace diversity and to have strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter<br>● &nbsp; &nbsp;Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins</p>
<p><span><strong>Zurich area location preferred</strong>; candidates based elsewhere in Switzerland must be available for <strong>weekly in-person presence</strong> and customer visits (primarily in <strong>German-speaking Switzerland</strong>).</span></p>
<p><br><span>#LI-SS6</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p>
<ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested">
<li><span>Pioneer Innovation:</span> Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li>
<li><span>Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li>
<li><span>Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li>
<li><span>Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li>
<li><span>Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li>
<li><span>Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li>
<li><span>Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li>
<li><span>Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li>
<li><span>Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>About Us:</strong></p>
<p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.</p>
<p>Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _ect4ttxp _2rkolb4i _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YR5oRJGhJYg&amp;list=PLuVor-ZUD4pnM6G33C5D0tjXUvlTPYBRe">video</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Celonis Inclusion Statement:</strong></p>
<p>At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.<strong><br></strong></p>
<p><strong>Your Privacy:</strong></p>
<p>Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/candidate-notices">Accessibility and Candidate Notices</a></p>
<p>By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/privacy-notice/">Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools</strong><br><br>We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.<br><br>The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.</p>
<p>Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more <a href="https://www.celonis.com/careers/fraud-alert/">here</a>.</p></div>

      <title>Cockroach Labs: Account Executive, DACH</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇩🇪 Germany</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Germany
</p>

<div class="job-post-container">
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-post-content">
<div><img src="https://res.cloudinary.com/o2bwt8ar/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto/CockroachLabs_Symbol_Black_2" alt="Cockroach Labs" width="92"></div>
<h1>Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.</h1>
<p>For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.</p>
<p>The customers you'll work with are some of the most innovative businesses in the world, and the problems they're trying to solve are real and urgent. You'll bring a genuinely differentiated product to a market moving fast, at a company positioned to lead it. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity. &nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>Our Account Executives target and close new business with some of today’s most innovative companies. In this role, you’ll both nurture inbound leads in your territory with marketing-led support as well as prospect into a target list of select accounts. You will do this by driving opportunities through the entire sales cycle from pipeline generation to closure, employing a value-oriented sales methodology with a focus on use cases spanning customer data and marketing activation. The ideal candidate will have the aptitude and passion for becoming an expert in CockroachDB’s product capabilities, business impact, and competitive advantages and loves to build long-lasting relationships with customer needs at the center. <strong>While this is a remote role, you must be based in Germany to be eligible.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Close new logos and expand existing business within an assigned territory, meeting and exceeding sales goals through prospecting, qualifying, managing, and closing sales opportunities&nbsp;</li>
<li>Leverage and coordinate cross-functional internal teams (Sales Development, Legal, Engineering, Security, Marketing, Product) to efficiently navigate complex sales cycles</li>
<li>Maintain, build and own specific relationship maps for your territory, including existing relationships and aspirational contacts</li>
<li>Lead compelling presentations of CockroachDB’s product and vision to a broad range of audiences, from c-level executives to individual contributors</li>
<li>Provide timely and accurate forecasts and clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively handling your pipeline of opportunities</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Expectations</strong></h2>
<p>In your first 30 days, you will learn about CockroachDB and will be able to pitch the product proficiently. We believe that it is necessary for you to build this foundation so you can successfully engage with existing accounts and grasp the sales strategy. Upon completion of your first month, you will have built cross-functional relationships and will have started building your strategy for account penetration.&nbsp;</p>
<p>After three months, you'll have a sound plan for account strategy and mapping. You have started building relationships with several leaders across your region and are beginning to understand their challenges and how CockroachDB can help solve them.&nbsp;</p>
<p>After six months, you will have 3x your quota in pipeline and will have at least 3 POCs in process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>6-8+ years of experience selling enterprise solutions and demonstrated success in software sales within the database ecosystem or adjacent technologies</li>
<li>Experience leading large and complex sales cycles within the C-Level at Fortune 500 companies&nbsp;</li>
<li>A consultative and value-based approach to selling software for cloud, on-premise and hybrid deployments</li>
<li>The ability to assess customer needs and build valuable, trusted relationships at all levels&nbsp;</li>
<li>A track record of overachievement and hitting sales targets</li>
<li>Expert time management and resource skills</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<p>Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at <a href="mailto:accessibility@cockroachlabs.com">accessibility@cockroachlabs.com</a>.</p>
<p>Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.</p>
<hr>
<h1>Benefits</h1>
<ul>
<li>Stock Options</li>
<li>Medical Insurance</li>
<li>Vision Insurance</li>
<li>Dental Insurance</li>
<li>Life and Disability Insurance</li>
<li>Professional Development Funds</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off</li>
<li>Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Paid Sick Days</li>
<li>Paid Parental Leave</li>
<li>Retirement Benefits</li>
<li>Mental Wellbeing Benefits</li>
<li>And more!</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cockroach-labs-account-executive-dach">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cockroach-labs-account-executive-dach</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Postscript: Senior Product Marketing Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Postscript is the AI-powered, all-in-one retention platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands, including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.</p>
<p>Our mission is to maximize the lifetime value of every shopper. We built the best-in-class SMS platform, expanded into email, and launched revenue-driving AI products you won’t find anywhere else. Now we’re building the most AI-forward team in ecommerce, and we’re just getting started.</p>
<p>Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator. Fully remote since 2018.</p></div><p>As <strong>Senior Product Marketing Manager</strong>, you will lead product marketing activities for a portfolio of product areas that will grow and shift as Postscript scales. This includes established product areas such as Billing and partner integrations, as well as new product lines. Your responsibilities will span positioning and messaging, GTM strategy and execution, product launches and campaigns, competitive intelligence, and partnering with Enablement to get the field ready. This role works cross-functionally at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and our customer-facing teams.</p>
<p><strong>This is a fully remote position.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Primary duties</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop clear, differentiated positioning in the marketplace for your product lines. Ensure that we tell a consistent and memorable story across our website, sales assets, content, and in customer communications.</li>
<li>Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market and translate them into revenue.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Serve as the Marketing lead for major launches in your portfolio. Run a repeatable launch process for smaller releases.</li>
<li>Contribute to our competitive intelligence program with battlecards and competitive updates for your product areas that keep the field sharp on how we win.</li>
<li>Become a subject matter expert in the domain of your product lines. Partner with Enablement on training materials, answer questions from the field team, and help maintain our internal knowledge base.</li>
<li>Be a strong advocate for customer needs by joining customer-facing calls, reviewing sales calls, reading product feedback, talking to the field team, and doing industry research.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We’ll Love About You</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in product marketing, preferably within a B2B SaaS context</li>
<li>Experience working across teams to launch significant features and products.</li>
<li>An expert project manager who has a track record of leading cross functional projects</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills: experience writing short form copy and/or long form content</li>
<li>You’re a believer in SMS and email marketing and can make the case for why owned channels win for DTC brands.</li>
<li>Time spent in ecommerce or startups is a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You’ll Love About Us</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Salary range of USD $125,000-$146,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo based salaries)</li>
<li>High growth startup - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and grow your career!</li>
<li>Work from home (or wherever)</li>
<li>Fun - We’re passionate and enjoy what we do</li>
<li>Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>Health, dental, vision insurance</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://postscript.io/job-applicant-privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a></em></p>
<p><em>You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-senior-product-marketing-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-senior-product-marketing-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>BeyondTrust: Field & Partner Marketing Manager, Public Sector</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote Unites States | Atlanta, Austin, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Phoenix
</p>

<p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p>
<p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.<br><br><strong>Priority Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Austin, Denver, Phoenix</strong></p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>We are seeking a high-impact and execution-focused Field &amp; Partner Marketing Manager, Public Sector to support pipeline growth and brand awareness across State, Local and Education (SLED) verticals. In this role, you will act as the strategic marketing partner to the US SLED leadership team and our cybersecurity channel partners (including elite VARs, Integrators, and Managed Service Providers). Along with the Sr Manager, Field and Partner Marketing Manager, Public Sector, you will design and execute data-driven, account-based marketing (ABM) programs, regional field events, and joint channel campaigns that penetrate net-new customer accounts, accelerate active cycles, and maximize partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.<br><br>This role is ideal for a hands-on marketer who enjoys running events, supporting partners, and working cross-functionally in a fast-paced cybersecurity environment. You will play a key role in bringing regional and partner marketing initiatives to life and ensuring programs are executed efficiently and effectively.</p>
<p>What You’ll Do</p>
<p><strong>Field &amp; Partner Marketing Execution</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Support the execution of SLED regional field and partner marketing programs, including field events, local roundtables, ABM campaigns, virtual events, and industry conferences.</li>
<li>Work closely with Sr Manager, Field and Partner Marketing, sales leadership, direct sellers and channel to support territory-based campaigns and event execution.</li>
<li>Assist in coordinating joint marketing activities with partners and distributors, including scheduling, promotion, and follow-up.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Partner &amp; Alliance Marketing Ecosystem Growth </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Joint GTM Planning: Co-author and execute comprehensive joint marketing plans with national and regional channel partners to drive awareness and source pipeline.</li>
<li>MDF &amp; Budget Management: Strategically allocate, track, and optimize regional marketing budgets and Market Development Funds (MDF) to maximize return on investment (ROI).</li>
<li>Enablement &amp; Local Execution: Equip partner sales and marketing teams with localized 'campaign-in-a-box' assets, sales tools, and localized threat-intelligence content to drive self-sufficient demand generation.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Campaign Measurement &amp; Reporting</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Track, analyze, and report on regional pipeline metrics, including marketing sourcing, partner influence, conversion velocity, and campaign ROI using Salesforce and marketing automation platforms.</li>
<li>Ensure accurate campaign setup, lead routing, partner attribution, and data hygiene in Salesforce and marketing automation tools.</li>
<li>Work closely with Sales Development Team on event and campaign follow-up to ensure appropriate lead follow-up and conversion.</li>
<li>Support post-campaign analysis and documentation of results and learnings.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Skills</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comfortable managing multiple events and deadlines simultaneously.</li>
<li>Experience supporting co-marketing initiatives with channel or technology partners.</li>
<li>Basic understanding of the cybersecurity market and security buyer personas.</li>
<li>Strong organizational and project coordination skills with attention to detail.</li>
<li>Collaborative, proactive, and adaptable in a fast-moving environment.</li>
</ul>
<p>What You’ll Bring</p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in field marketing, partner marketing, demand generation, or related B2B marketing roles.</li>
<li>Previous experience is public sector marketing, channel or sales strongly preferred</li>
<li>Exposure to marketing for B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or IT technology companies.</li>
<li>Experience supporting multi-channel marketing campaigns and events.</li>
<li>Familiarity with channel ecosystems (VARs, MSSPs, technology partners) is a plus.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of Salesforce and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Eloqua).</li>
<li>Strong written and verbal communication skills.</li>
<li>Able to travel 30% to support field and industry events.</li>
<li>Remote Anywhere in US- priority locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Austin, Denver, Phoenix</li>
</ul>
<p>Better Together</p>
<p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p>
<p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who&nbsp;come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.<br><br></p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p>
<p>Learn more at <a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-JB1</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - D.C., USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p>
<p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p></p>
<p>The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to lead a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for an Account Executive in DoW supporting DISA and Fourth Estate, to join our Sales and Go-to-Market team. Reporting to the Regional Director, you will be part of a global group of professionals passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. By demonstrating the power and agility of cloud transformation, you will help cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Build relationships with important internal and customer stakeholders, including c-suite decision-makers</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Create a long-term account strategy aligned with customer goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborate with internal teams to meet customer needs and contribute to comprehensive account planning</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Act as a trusted advisor by understanding client businesses and aligning technical solutions with their strategic goals</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>8+ years of full-cycle sales experience within the software or security industry</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Progressive selling experience engaging with enterprise accounts and selling at the C-Level</p>
</li>
<li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Established relationships with current and prospective customers and a deep understanding of how technology facilitates high-level business goals</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with a proven track record of closing net new logos</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience meeting or exceeding sales targets while leveraging channel partnerships</p>
</li>
<li>Effectively leverage LLMs and Generative AI tools to boost productivity and sales effectiveness across research, prospecting, customer prep, and opportunity management</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>#LI-LB1</strong></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.</p>
<p>The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/ bonus/ equity (if applicable) + benefits.</p></div><div class="title">Base Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$145,250</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$207,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p>
<p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p>
<div class="has-nudge">
<ul>
<li>Various health plans</li>
<li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li>
<li>Parental leave options</li>
<li>Retirement options</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>In-office perks, and more!</li>
</ul>

</div>

<p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p>
<p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. <p>Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.</p>

      <title>Twilio: Communications Specialist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/">&nbsp;hundreds of thousands of businesses&nbsp;</a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span>.</span></p>
<p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p>
<p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p>
<p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Communications Specialist.</p>
<p><strong>About the job</strong></p>
<p>This position is needed to lead the external communications for Twilio’s CIO and our Speaking and Awards program. The role will also support the North America PR team across product launches, external campaigns, thought leadership content, and reporting &amp; measurement.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The role sits within Twilio’s Corporate Communications team, which is responsible for shaping and delivering Twilio’s story to media, customers, industry analysts, and employees. You will collaborate closely with partners across Analyst Relations, Government Relations &amp; Public Policy, Internal Comms, Social Media, and R&amp;D and Enterprise Technology leadership to craft compelling external narratives that generate press coverage and awareness.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you’ll:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lead External CIO Communications: </strong>Design and execute a comprehensive external communications strategy for Twilio’s Chief Information Officer, inclusive of media opportunities, thought leadership, speaking engagements, and LinkedIn social presence.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Own Speaking &amp; Awards Program:</strong> Partner closely with Twilio’s R&amp;D and Enterprise Technology leadership, Events, Executive Communications, and external PR agency partners to develop a comprehensive speaking and awards program, driving thought leadership and awareness.</li>
<li><strong>Support North America PR Programs &amp; Product Launches: </strong>Collaborate cross-functionally with members of the Corporate Communications team, Product Marketing, and Product Management on thought leadership content and external company and product announcements.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Manage External Comms for AR, Government Relations, &amp; Public Policy Teams</strong>: Serve as the PR team lead for ad hoc external facing moments and announcements coming from Twilio’s Analyst Relations, Government Relations, and Public Policy teams.</li>
<li><strong>Lead Reporting &amp; Measurement: </strong>Partnering with Twilio’s PR agency and International PR Team, lead PR team reporting and measurement, including AEO visibility, daily coverage tracking, and quarterly QBR reporting.</li>
<li><strong>Own AI tools for the PR team:</strong> Own the PR team’s AI tool stack—ensuring all training data and prompt libraries remain current. Proactively identify new AI use cases to streamline workflows and drive team efficiency.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p>
<p><strong>*Required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>5+ years of experience</strong> in corporate communications, executive communications, or public relations, with some PR agency experience.</li>
<li><strong>Strong media relations</strong>, with a demonstrated ability to successfully pitch and place stories in business and technology outlets – even in the absence of hard news.</li>
<li><strong>Track record</strong> of directly supporting and advising C-suite leaders in high-stakes, fast-moving environments.</li>
<li><strong>Strong writing, editing, and storytelling skills</strong> with executive judgment and the ability to capture a specific leader's authentic voice.</li>
<li><strong>Systematic thinker</strong> who can establish high-level narratives and execute them with tactical precision.</li>
<li><strong>Exceptional organizational skills</strong> with a calm-under-pressure demeanor and the ability to manage competing priorities on tight timelines.</li>
<li><strong>Strong collaborative skills</strong>, with a proven ability to work with multiple cross-functional partners simultaneously.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Desired:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Active practitioner of AI:</strong> Strong interest in how artificial intelligence is transforming public relations and communications, with a willingness to lead change and build innovative workflows using AI tools.</li>
<li><strong>Familiarity with enterprise technology:</strong> A solid baseline understanding of cloud communications, API technologies, data platforms, and the customer engagement landscape.</li>
<li><strong>Experience managing executives’ social media presence</strong> (e.g., LinkedIn) with an eye for digital engagement trends.</li>
<li>Experience working inside a fast-paced <strong>agency environment.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location</strong></p>
<p>This role will be remote and based in the East Coast, USA</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Travel&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><em>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15-20% travel is anticipated for key external events, media moments, and in-person team meetings.</em></p>
<p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p>
<p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.</p>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p><em>*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.</em></p>
<p>The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:</p>
<ul>
<li>Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland (outside of the DC area), Massachusetts, Minnesota, or Vermont: $81,600 - $102,000&nbsp;</li>
<li>Based in New York (outside of the New York City area), New Jersey (outside of the New York City area), Washington State (outside of the Seattle area), Washington D.C., Washington D.C. area, Maryland, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $86,400 - $ 108,000&nbsp;</li>
<li>Based in California (within the San Francisco Bay area), New York (within the New York City area), New Jersey (within the New York City area), or Washington State (within the Seattle area): $96,000 - $120,000</li>
<li>This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Application deadline information&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until Dec 17th, but may change based on business needs.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio thinks big. Do you?</strong></p>
<p>We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. Additionally, we empower employees to build <a href="https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund">positive change in their communities</a> by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.</p>
<p>So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a><br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p>
<p>We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @<a href="http://twilio.com">twilio.com</a> email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.<br><span>.</span><strong> </strong></p>
<p><strong>Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.</strong> We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-communications-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twilio-communications-specialist</a></p>
</description>

<hr>
<p><strong>About Gusto</strong></p>
<p>At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.</p>
<p>All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/total-rewards"> Total Rewards philosophy</a>.</p>
<p>AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>Gusto is looking for a seasoned performance marketer to own execution across paid social and emerging acquisition channels, testing new platforms, formats, and tactics to find what works before scaling. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of performance marketing, channel experimentation, and AI-powered workflow design. You will own execution and day-to-day strategy for paid social and new channel tests, working within Gusto's demand generation framework, with clear accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.</p>
<p><strong>About the Team</strong></p>
<p>As a member of Gusto's Demand Generation team, you will be embedded specifically within Paid Acquisition, a focused group responsible for driving awareness and pipeline through paid media. This team operates with high autonomy, a bias for experimentation, and a culture of cross-functional partnership. We hold ourselves to a high standard, move fast, and genuinely believe that being AI-native is part of what it means to do this job well today.</p>
<p><strong>Here's what you'll do day-to-day:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own paid social strategy and execution across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, and TikTok, driving full-funnel campaigns from brand awareness through retargeting and conversion, with accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.</li>
<li>Manage significant, multi-million dollar budgets with rigor, including campaign pacing, forecasting, budget-vs-actuals analysis, and making the case for paid social investment in imperfect attribution environments.</li>
<li>Apply and help refine Gusto's paid acquisition measurement framework, including attribution philosophy and budget allocation principles, in partnership with the broader marketing team. Collaborate with Engineering to launch new pixels and tracking, troubleshoot platform-side issues, and QA implementations, keeping measurement reliable as tracking needs evolve.</li>
<li>Lead creative strategy and testing at scale: briefing creative studios and agencies, structuring meaningful experiments, interpreting complex data sets to drive actionable insights, and building a clear learning roadmap. Align with the Brand and Influencer team to run the organic-to-paid feedback loop: turning proven organic and influencer content into paid scale, and feeding results back to sharpen what earns that investment next.</li>
<li>Use AI tools as a consistent, habitual part of your workflow: generating campaign briefs, developing copy variants, accelerating audience research, and building reusable systems that raise the bar for the whole team. Serve as the team's go-to expert on paid social and AI-powered marketing workflows, documenting playbooks and best practices for the paid acquisition team.</li>
<li>Identify, test, and validate new digital media channels and formats beyond core paid social (such as Google Demand Generation campaigns and ChatGPT ads), running structured pilots, defining success criteria upfront, and making the call on scale vs. kill within existing budget guardrails.</li>
<li>Partner cross-functionally with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Communications, and Web to align paid social with integrated campaigns and earned media moments, and bring performance data back upstream to influence creative production and asset strategy. Partner with Web Marketing to align on landing page strategy, message match, and post-click conversion, because paid social performance doesn't end at the click.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Here's what we're looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of performance marketing experience at a B2B SaaS, performance marketing agency, or high-growth consumer organization, with deep expertise in paid social and a track record of testing and scaling new channels.</li>
<li>Full-funnel ownership across two or more major paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, TikTok), including deep, hands-on, in-platform execution (campaign builds, audience/targeting strategy, creative testing, bid/budget management), with significant budget responsibility and a track record of driving measurable pipeline impact.</li>
<li>Strong creative strategy and testing instincts: you know how to structure a test, distinguish a learning from a result, and translate performance data into creative direction.</li>
<li>AI-fluent in practice, not just in theory; you use AI tools consistently in your day-to-day workflow to accelerate briefs, copy, and analysis, and have a track record of implementing AI-driven efficiencies for your team.</li>
<li>Excellent cross-functional collaborator who can translate integrated briefs into paid social strategy, advocate for what the channel needs, and work effectively alongside brand, web, and comms partners.</li>
<li>You are analytical and data-driven, with a clear point of view on attribution in imperfect measurement environments and comfort communicating paid social's contribution to business outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p>Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $109,000 - $133,000/yr in Denver, and $132,000 - $161,000/yr for San Francisco and New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr>
<p>At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.</p>
<hr>
<p>Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.</p>
<p>Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.&nbsp;</p>
<p>When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.</p>
<p><strong>Reliable, consistent presence: </strong>We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.</p>
<hr>
<p><span>Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out <a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdEfl7Bp-Twz7LLlhGlha46CrxZ9Kacgakmarf3K2TbnaEgKQ/viewform">this form</a> and a member of our team will get in touch with you.</span></p>
<p>Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our <a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/fraudulent-activity-disclaimer">Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer</a>.</p>
<p>Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to&nbsp;<a href="https://gusto.com/about/careers/applicant-privacy-notice">Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Upstart</strong></p>
<p>At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.</p>
<p>As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.</p>
<p>We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.</p>
<p>If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.</p></div><p><strong>The Team:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Upstart’s Lending Partnerships team connects our technology and credit expertise with the capital and customer relationships of banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. We are growing our team and seeking a<strong> Business Development Manager, Bank &amp; Lending Partnerships</strong>&nbsp;to help build and expand these partnerships across our target market</p>
<p>You will lead efforts to identify, attract, and develop new bank and credit union partnerships to expand our depository capital base, with a focus on new products. You will structure and execute thoughtful deals that align with each financial institution's funding needs, risk appetite, and strategic objectives. Working cross-functionally with teams across Upstart, you will turn high-potential opportunities into durable partnerships and meaningful sources of capital.</p>
<p><strong>How you’ll make an impact</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Identify and qualify prospective partners based on their funding needs, risk appetite, strategic priorities, and interest in new products</li>
<li>Drive negotiations and close strategic partnerships that expand Upstart’s capital network and unlock new growth opportunities across products and channels</li>
<li>Build and cultivate relationships with executives and decision-makers at banks and credit unions.</li>
<li>Develop compelling partnership strategies and business cases that demonstrate the value of working with Upstart</li>
<li>Collaborate with Solutions Consulting, Product, Legal, Credit, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to design and structure lender-aligned deals</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum Qualifications&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years of experience in leading and managing complex lending deals, corporate strategy, or business development strategy roles preferably at financial services institutions</li>
<li>Established relationships with senior decision-makers across banks, credit unions, and related financial institutions</li>
<li>Strong understanding of how depository institutions evaluate lending partnerships, including funding needs, risk appetite, economics, and strategic priorities</li>
<li>Ability to independently build pipeline, develop a market strategy, and drive complex deals from initial outreach through close</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to develop compelling business cases and influence stakeholders across both partner organizations and internal cross-functional teams</li>
<li>Strong judgment, executive presence, and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex, high-visibility transactions</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Prior experience in HELOC, auto lending, or other secured consumer lending markets.</li>
<li>An established network of senior relationships across banks, credit unions, and related financial institutions.</li>
<li>Experience using AI tools to improve prospecting, account research, deal strategy, or sales execution</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Position location</strong> REMOTE</p>
<p><strong>Time zone requirements</strong> The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. &nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Travel requirements</strong> As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p>

<p><strong>SLSQ128R30</strong></p>
<p>While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations may be considered.</p>
<p>Candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role</p>
<ul>
<li>Remote - Washington (Seattle is ideal)&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive at Databricks, you are a sales professional experienced in leading go-to-market campaigns in Fortune 500 accounts, specifically in the CMEG Telco space. You know how to sell innovation and change through customer vision expansion and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating value to Customers and System Integrators.</p>
<p>Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Unified Data Analytics and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation that their businesses need to gain first mover advantage in today’s ultra-competitive landscape. As we continue our rapid expansion, we are looking for a creative, execution-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to join the Databricks team and maximize the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks.</p>
<p>Reporting to our Sr. Director of Enterprise Sales, you will map to an enterprise client under the CMEG umbrella. &nbsp;You will come with an informed point of view on Big Data, Advanced Analytics and AI which will help to guide your successful execution strategy and allow you to provide genuine value to the client</p>
<p><strong>The impact you will have:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build relationships with CIOs, IT executives, LOB executives, Program Managers, and other important partners.</li>
<li>Drive value-based growth within the account.</li>
<li>Expand the Databricks footprint into new business units and use cases.</li>
<li>Exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue targets.</li>
<li>Track all customer details including use case, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce.</li>
<li>Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for customers.</li>
<li>Promote Databricks' Data Intelligence Platform powered by Apache Spark™ and Delta Lake</li>
<li>Prioritize opportunities and leverage appropriate resources.</li>
<li>Build a plan for success internally at Databricks and externally with your account</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we look for:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have previously excelled in an early-stage company -- you know how to navigate and be successful with limited oversight</li>
<li>Previous field sales experience within big data, Cloud, SaaS, and a consumption selling motion</li>
<li>Prior customer relationships with CIOs, program managers, and essential decision makers at local accounts</li>
<li>The ability to simplify a technical capability into a value-based benefit</li>
<li>7+ years of Enterprise Sales experience exceeding quotas in larger accounts</li>
<li>Managing a small set of enterprise accounts rather than a broad territory</li>
<li>Bachelor's Degree</li>
</ul><div><div><div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Pay Range Transparency</strong></p>
<p><span>Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.&nbsp; Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page <a href="https://www.databricks.com/sites/default/files/2024-08/us-pay-zone-mapping.pdf">here</a>.<br></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><div>Local Pay Range</div><div><span>$272,000</span><span>—</span><span>$374,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p>
<p><span>Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. <p>

</p>

<div><p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p>
<p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p></div><p><span>Location: Remote – United States&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><strong>Why You'll Love This Role</strong></p>
<p>As a Solutions Engineer, you'll get to flex your technical chops and storytelling skills by helping customers uncover the full potential of Cribl in real-world environments. With the freedom of remote work and the excitement of solving unique data challenges, every day brings something new—and impactful.</p>
<p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Serve as the technical lead for strategic GSI and CSP relationships, working alongside Cribl Sales Engineers and account teams.</li>
<li>Apply the core Sales Engineer motion: discover customer requirements, demonstrate value, design solutions, lead proofs of concept, address technical objections, and support successful handoffs.</li>
<li>Build trusted technical relationships with GSI architects, practice leaders, delivery teams, cloud specialists, and alliance stakeholders.</li>
<li>Explain Cribl’s value in the context of enterprise observability, security, data infrastructure, and cloud modernization initiatives.</li>
<li>Map Cribl capabilities to GSI service offerings, reference architectures, migration programs, managed services, and industry solutions.</li>
<li>Collaborate with partners to design repeatable solutions, accelerators, deployment patterns, and implementation guidance.</li>
<li>Support joint customer engagements, including discovery workshops, architecture sessions, demonstrations, technical validations, and executive briefings.</li>
<li>Develop and deliver technical enablement for GSI and CSP field teams, solution architects, consultants, and delivery organizations.</li>
<li>Help partners identify opportunities where Cribl can complement cloud platforms, security tools, observability platforms, SIEMs, data lakes, and other enterprise technologies.</li>
<li>Work with partner teams to create solution briefs, reference architectures, technical playbooks, demo environments, and proof-of-concept plans.</li>
<li>Coordinate with Cribl Professional Services and partner delivery organizations to improve implementation readiness and customer outcomes.</li>
<li>Capture partner and field feedback for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Alliances teams.</li>
<li>Help establish technical success measures for strategic partner programs, including enablement completion, validated solutions, influenced pipeline, joint wins, and partner-led delivery readiness.</li>
<li>Represent Cribl at partner events, technical workshops, industry conferences, and customer meetings.</li>
<li>Up to 50% Travel</li>
<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Consulting Architect, Partner Engineer, or similar customer-facing technical role.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, observability, security operations, or data platforms.</li>
<li>Experience translating business and technical requirements into practical architectures and solution designs.</li>
<li>Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading technical discovery, product demonstrations, proofs of concept, architecture reviews, and customer workshops.</li>
<li>Experience working with or through GSIs, consulting firms, managed service providers, or other strategic technology partners.</li>
<li>Understanding of how GSIs develop practices, package services, build reference architectures, and deliver solutions at enterprise scale.</li>
<li>Ability to create clear technical content, including presentations, diagrams, solution briefs, enablement materials, and implementation guidance.</li>
<li>Strong collaboration skills and the ability to influence across Sales, Alliances, Product, Marketing, Services, and partner organizations.</li>
<li>Willingness and ability to travel as needed for customer and partner engagements, workshops, events, and team meetings.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Experience working directly with one or more major GSIs, such as Accenture, Deloitte, Capgemini, Cognizant, EY, Kyndryl, or PwC.</li>
<li>Familiarity with one or more major CSPs, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.</li>
<li>Understanding of how CSPs and GSIs work together on cloud adoption, modernization, migration, managed services, and marketplace-led solutions.</li>
<li>Experience with cloud marketplaces, partner programs, co-sell motions, private offers, or cloud consumption models.</li>
<li>Experience helping a partner turn a technology capability into a repeatable service offering or solution accelerator.</li>
<li>Knowledge of observability, SIEM, XDR, data lakes, cloud security, network telemetry, or data pipeline technologies.</li>
<li>Familiarity with Cribl, competing data pipeline technologies, or adjacent platforms is a plus.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>How you’ll be successful</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<ul>
<li>Partners view you as a trusted technical advisor who understands both their business model and their customers’ needs.</li>
<li>GSI teams can clearly articulate where Cribl fits and how to incorporate it into their services and solutions.</li>
<li>CSP and GSI stakeholders are aligned on practical joint architectures, delivery patterns, and routes to market.</li>
<li>Cribl account teams have a strong technical partner motion that accelerates discovery, validation, and customer value.</li>
<li>Partner enablement produces measurable field activity, qualified opportunities, repeatable solutions, and successful deployments.</li>
<li>Customers receive technically sound solutions that improve the way they manage observability and security data.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-JK1<br><span>#LI-Remote</span></p><div><div><div><p>The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.<br><br>In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.<br><br>In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.</p></div><div>Base Salary Range</div><div><span>$140,000</span><span>—</span><span>$182,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div><p><strong>Bring Your Whole Self<br></strong><span><br></span><span>Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.</span></p>
<p><span>Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at </span><a href="https://cribl.io/about-us/"><span>cribl.io/about-us</span></a><span>.&nbsp;</span></p></div>

      <title>Ping Identity: Strategic Account Executive - LATAM</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
