      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> USA - Remote
</p>

<div><p><strong>About Ping Identity:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.&nbsp;</p>
<p>While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pingidentity.com/en/company/championing-every-identity.html">We champion every identity.</a> One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>Position Summary</strong></h2>
<p>We are seeking a Strategic Account Executive to join Ping’s sales organization. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Accounts, this role owns and grows a focused portfolio of strategic&nbsp; accounts across providers, payers, and technology organizations. The Strategic Account Executive is responsible for driving new business while expanding the right existing relationships, helping customers solve complex identity challenges tied to security, digital experience, compliance, and operational efficiency. This role works across technical and executive buying groups and partners closely with cross-functional teams to turn identity priorities into measurable business outcomes. This draft follows Ping’s internal job description guide and reflects internal role signals showing a strategic team structure, strong new-logo expectations, and solution positioning across workforce, customer, and embedded identity use cases.</p>
<h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own a strategic portfolio of accounts and build account plans that create, advance, and close high-value opportunities.</li>
<li>Generate pipeline through targeted prospecting, account prioritization, executive outreach, partner collaboration, and disciplined territory planning, with a strong emphasis on landing new logos.</li>
<li>Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through close, aligning Ping’s solutions to customer priorities around risk reduction, cost reduction, and improved digital experiences.</li>
<li>Position Ping’s identity platform across workforce, customer, and embedded use cases, including opportunities where technology companies integrate identity into their own products and experiences.</li>
<li>Build trusted relationships with security, IT, digital, product, operations, and executive stakeholders to shape buying consensus and move opportunities forward.</li>
<li>Partner closely with Sales Engineering, leadership, customer-success teams, and channel partners to develop account strategy, validate solution fit, and deliver a strong customer experience.</li>
<li>Maintain accurate pipeline, forecast, and account hygiene while operating with strong inspection, prioritization, and execution discipline.</li>
<li>Represent Ping with credibility in the market by connecting industry challenges to clear business value and differentiated identity outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of successful enterprise software, SaaS, cybersecurity, or identity sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota in complex sales environments.</li>
<li>Experience selling into accounts, including providers, payers, technology companies, or adjacent regulated industries.</li>
<li>A demonstrated ability to generate pipeline and win net-new business through strategic prospecting and account planning.</li>
<li>Success navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that involve technical buyers, business leaders, and executive sponsors.</li>
<li>Strong business acumen and the ability to translate technical capabilities into value tied to revenue, efficiency, risk reduction, or customer experience.</li>
<li>Excellent communication, discovery, negotiation, and forecasting skills.</li>
<li>A disciplined, self-directed working style with strong prioritization and follow-through.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Bonus Points If You Have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience selling identity, access management, CIAM, IGA, MFA, fraud, or verification solutions.</li>
<li>Familiarity with industry dynamics, including digital patient or member experiences, regulatory considerations, and security requirements.</li>
<li>Experience with platform, embedded, OEM, or ISV sales motions.</li>
<li>Experience working with strategic partners, GSIs, or channel ecosystems in enterprise accounts.</li>
<li>Knowledge of modern identity trends such as passwordless authentication, decentralized identity, or behavioral and risk-based security models.</li>
</ul>
<p>Base Hiring Range: $135,000-$165,000</p>
<p>In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.</p><div><p><strong>Life at Ping:</strong></p>
<p>We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.</li>
<li>Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.</li>
<li>Regular company and team bonding events.</li>
<li>Competitive benefits and perks.</li>
<li>Global volunteering and community initiatives</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Our Benefits:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Generous PTO &amp; Holiday Schedule&nbsp;</li>
<li>Parental Leave</li>
<li>Progressive Healthcare Options</li>
<li>Retirement Programs</li>
<li>Opportunity for Education Reimbursement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Commuter Offset (Specific locations)&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.</p>
<p><em>We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.&nbsp; All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.</em></p></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://abnormal.ai">https://abnormal.ai</a>
</p>

<h1>Senior Technical Marketing Manager</h1>
<h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>Attackers are using AI to look more human than ever. Stopping them takes technology that recognizes normal behavior, and prevents when there is a deviation.</p>
<p>As a Senior Technical Marketing Manager, you will be the technical voice that carries Abnormal's R&amp;D breakthroughs to the market. You are excited to own and deliver the high-impact, customer-facing technical assets that prove the depth, sophistication, and value of our AI-driven security solutions: demos, the technical collateral, and materials that technical buyers trust. Working side by side with Product Management, Engineering, Pre and Post Sales, and Marketing, you will turn what our engineers build into content that engages practitioners, equips our field, and helps close deals.</p>
<p>Our platform keeps growing beyond email into identity and AI security, which means more to build, more to demonstrate, and more complexity to make clear. This is a role for someone who pairs deep technical expertise with exceptional communication, and who excels in turning complicated ideas into clarity.&nbsp;</p>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Build a library that sells.</strong> Develop and maintain a comprehensive library of technical assets, including demo videos, whitepapers, technical blog posts, and interactive demo experiences that articulates Abnormal's differentiated capabilities to both technical and executive audiences.</li>
<li><strong>Translate engineering into messaging.</strong> Dig into new features, understand how they work, and turn technical capabilities into market- and fieldready messaging and content.</li>
<li><strong>Create guided technical experiences.</strong> Independently build and maintain guided experiences that bring Abnormal's unique value proposition and differentiated capabilities to life.</li>
<li><strong>Be our technical authority with analysts.</strong> Serve as the senior technical subject matter expert in strategic engagements with industry analysts, clearly articulating the technical superiority of the platform.</li>
<li><strong>Prove it and lead the conversation.</strong> Produce technical validation and thought leadership content, including benchmark reports, integration guides, and architecture deep dives, that positions Abnormal as the technical leader in email security and AI-driven threat detection.</li>
<li><strong>Keep content current as we ship.</strong> Establish and maintain the processes that keep technical content accurate and relevant as our products evolve.</li>
<li><strong>Own the technical side of launches.</strong> Lead the development of technical launch deliverables, including demo scenarios, content, and internal enablement tools, in partnership with Product Management and Product Marketing.</li>
</ul>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>Must Haves</h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a related technical, customer-facing role.</li>
<li>A strong background in cybersecurity, email security, or adjacent security domains, with the ability to quickly grasp and explain complex technical concepts, architectures, and threat models.</li>
<li>Proven experience owning the end-to-end development of customer-facing technical content, including videos, demo assets, technical blogs, whitepapers, and solution briefs.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication, strong presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate technical value to both practitioner and executive audiences.</li>
<li>Experience working with R&amp;D teams and translating engineering developments into market-facing content.</li>
<li>A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).</li>
<li>Strong experience with AI-driven content creation tools, video production, and technical documentation platforms.</li>
<li>Must be based in the US&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>Nice to Have</h2>
<ul>
<li>Previous experience in email security, AI/ML applications in cybersecurity, or threat detection technologies.</li>
<li>Experience with interactive demo platforms and customer engagement tools.</li>
<li>A background in technical sales or solutions engineering roles.</li>
<li>A Master's degree in a relevant technical field.</li>
<li>Industry certifications in cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM, etc.).</li>
</ul><div><div><div><p>Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.<br>In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.</p></div><div>Base salary range:</div><div><span>$153,000</span><span>—</span><span>$200,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div><p><strong>A note on AI in our process:&nbsp;<br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p>
<p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf"><span><em>click here</em></span></a>. If you would like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please&nbsp;<em><span><a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt4eb3a265cc7b1ca9/6a1e3d3bfe33e73c16ff026b/EEOC_Know_Your_Rights_Oct_30_2025.pdf">click here</a></span></em>.</p></div>

      <title>ŌURA: Senior Director of Retail, North America</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div><p>Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.</p>
<p>Empowering the world starts with living <a href="https://ouraring.com/about-us">our values</a> and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.&nbsp;</p></div><p>Oura is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Director of Retail, North America to lead the growth and commercial performance of Oura’s retail business across the region.This individual will provide leadership, direction, and resource stewardship to the North America retail sales function while owning relationships with some of Oura’s largest and most strategic retail partners. The Senior Director will shape joint business plans, lead complex negotiations, and ensure the organization delivers against ambitious revenue, market-share, profitability, and customer experience goals.As a senior commercial leader, the Senior Director will align retail objectives with Oura’s broader business strategy; influence executive stakeholders internally and externally; identify opportunities to expand distribution, productivity, and market share; and build the operating discipline required to deliver consistent results. This role will also lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing retail organization while partnering closely with marketing, product, finance, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and e-commerce teams.The ideal candidate brings extensive experience leading retail businesses in consumer electronics, connected devices, health technology, or a related category; a demonstrated track record of growing strategic accounts; strong executive presence; exceptional negotiation skills; and the ability to inspire teams through clear direction, accountability, and collaboration.</p>
<h3><strong>What You Will Do:</strong></h3>
<p><strong>Retail Sales Strategy and Business Leadership:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Define and execute the North America retail strategy, translating Oura’s company priorities into clear channel, account, and team objectives.</li>
<li>Lead annual and multi-year planning across select retailer portfolio, including sales strategy, forecasting, budgeting, assortment, distribution, and investment priorities.</li>
<li>Identify and capitalize on market opportunities to drive revenue growth, market share, customer acquisition, and long-term brand strength.</li>
<li>Establish the operating cadence, performance standards, and decision-making processes required to deliver retail goals at scale.</li>
<li>Serve as a senior voice for retail in cross-functional and executive planning forums, ensuring retail considerations are incorporated early into product launches, innovation, and go-to-market decisions.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Strategic Account Leadership:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own executive relationships and joint business plans with Oura’s largest and most strategic North American retail partners.</li>
<li>Build trusted, multi-level relationships with retailer executives and decision-makers across merchandising, marketing, operations, finance, and e-commerce.</li>
<li>Lead high-stakes negotiations covering commercial terms, pricing, promotions, assortment, placement, merchandising, marketing support, and operational commitments.</li>
<li>Develop account strategies that balance near-term performance with long-term partnership value, sustainable economics, and customer experience.</li>
<li>Represent Oura with credibility and influence in executive customer meetings, business reviews, industry forums, and strategic negotiations.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Sales Performance Management:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Set and achieve revenue, margin, distribution, sell-through, inventory, and market-share targets across North America retail.</li>
<li>Monitor business performance, diagnose trends and risks, and adjust strategies quickly to deliver against commitments.</li>
<li>Evaluate and optimize retail investments, including MDF/CO-OP, conditional and unconditional rebates, merchandising, promotions, and administrative support.</li>
<li>Create clear performance narratives and recommendations for senior leadership, using financial, market, category, and customer insights to guide decisions.</li>
<li>Partner with finance and operations to improve forecasting accuracy, inventory health, profitability, and commercial discipline.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Organizational Leadership and Talent Development:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing retail sales organization with clear roles, priorities, goals, and accountability.</li>
<li>Build a strong leadership bench by coaching managers and senior individual contributors and creating meaningful opportunities for growth.</li>
<li>Set a high bar for executive communication, customer leadership, analytical rigor, and follow-through.</li>
<li>Foster a culture of collaboration, inclusion, ownership, and continuous improvement across the retail team and broader organization.</li>
<li>Support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and organizational design as the business scales.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration and Execution:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Work closely with marketing, product, finance, operations, supply chain, customer experience, and e-commerce teams to deliver shared business outcomes.</li>
<li>Influence product launch planning and execution to ensure retail readiness across assortment, pricing, training, inventory, merchandising, and marketing.</li>
<li>Align internal stakeholders around retailer-specific priorities and resolve complex issues with urgency and sound judgment.</li>
<li>Ensure account plans translate into strong field execution, compelling in-store and online experiences, and consistent delivery against retailer commitments.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Market Insights and Executive Communication:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Maintain a deep understanding of the North American retail landscape, consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, category trends, and retailer strategies.</li>
<li>Translate market and customer insights into actionable commercial strategies and clear recommendations.</li>
<li>Provide regular executive updates on retail performance, account health, market conditions, opportunities, risks, and required decisions.</li>
<li>Represent Oura’s brand, values, and commercial ambition with confidence and professionalism in every external interaction.</li>
</ul>
<p>This is a remote role based in the US.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>15+ years of progressive experience in retail sales, account management, or commercial leadership, including significant experience leading strategic retail accounts.</li>
<li>Proven track record of growing revenue, market share, distribution, and profitability across major North American retailers.</li>
<li>Experience leading complex negotiations and long-term business planning with senior retail executives.</li>
<li>Strong executive presence, communication skills, and ability to influence stakeholders across functions and levels of seniority.</li>
<li>Demonstrated success leading, developing, and scaling high-performing sales teams.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of the North American retail market and consumer electronics, connected devices, health technology, or another relevant consumer category.</li>
<li>Proven ability to create, review, and interpret financial, market, category, and customer performance information and translate insights into action plans.</li>
<li>Exceptional strategic thinking, judgment, prioritization, and problem-solving skills.</li>
<li>Proven ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.</li>
<li>Excellent negotiation, relationship-management, written, and verbal communication skills.</li>
<li>Passion for wellness, technology, Oura’s mission, and delivering results through others.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Benefits</strong></h3>
<p>At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.</p>
<p>What we offer:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary and equity packages</li>
<li>Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources</li>
<li>An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends &amp; family</li>
<li>20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off</li>
<li>Paid sick leave and parental leave</li>
</ul>
<p>Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. <p>

</p>

<div><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3>
<p>The <strong>Territory Account Executive</strong> (TAE) is a key growth role within Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) Germany's Go-To-Market organisation. This position focuses on driving growth across all accounts not currently managed by an Account Executive, including the full install base, dormant accounts, and new inbound opportunities. TAEs are responsible for expanding Pure’s footprint, reigniting customer relationships, and capturing new business through a combination of direct engagement and partner collaboration.<br><br>As a Territory Account Executive (TAE), you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life - helping customers unlock the power of their data, modernise their infrastructure, and accelerate transformation. You’ll <strong>join our Commercial team in Germany</strong>, with the autonomy to own a dynamic territory, driving growth across a broad set of customers, from re-engaging dormant relationships to winning new logos.</p>
<p>At Pure, you’ll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and to do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Drive Account Growth &amp; Pipeline:</strong> Execute sales activities to generate revenue, manage a high-volume pipeline, and contribute to closing deals on a quarterly basis.</li>
<li><strong>Execute Outreach &amp; Prospecting:</strong> Perform consistent, high-activity prospecting to penetrate new accounts, reach decision-makers, and learn how to win new business effectively.</li>
<li><strong>Support Partner Strategy:</strong> Collaborate closely with Channel Partners and Partner Managers to align on customer engagement and utilise partner resources to advance opportunities.</li>
<li><strong>Reactivate Customer Relationships:</strong> Focus on re-engaging dormant or inactive customers by discovering new business use cases and identifying potential refresh and expansion opportunities.</li>
<li><strong>Build Foundational Skills:</strong> Develop and deliver proposals and business cases that clearly demonstrate the value of Pure's solutions, supported by internal experts.</li>
<li><strong>Maintain Sales Discipline:</strong> Diligently manage sales technology (Salesforce), deliver accurate forecasts, and maintain strong time management to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Proven Sales Experience:</strong> Demonstrated success in direct, full-lifecycle B2B technology sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales metrics (KPIs).</li>
<li><strong>Sales Drive &amp; Motivation:</strong> A high degree of self-motivation, strong time management skills, demonstrates initiative and the drive to learn quickly and succeed across both transactional and early-stage strategic sales motions.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Mindset:</strong> Demonstrated success working with both internal teams and channel partners to ensure seamless customer engagement and shared goal achievement.</li>
<li><strong>Digital Proficiency:</strong> Proficiency with core sales technologies, including Salesforce and G Suite, and an ability to use data to prioritise daily activities.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Communication &amp; Presence:</strong> Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for engaging with business leaders and maintaining professional business relationships.</li>
<li><strong>Resilience &amp; Focus:</strong> A competitive, positive attitude combined with strong organisational and time management skills necessary to handle a dynamic, high-activity territory.</li>
<li><strong>Language Skills: </strong>Business Level, written and spoken, German and English language skills required.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Industry Knowledge:</strong> Prior knowledge of the storage industry and familiarity with how data solutions drive business outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>Channel Sales Expertise:</strong> Understanding of channel-led sales motions and experience collaborating effectively within the broader partner ecosystem.</li>
<li><strong>Sales Training:</strong> Completion of a structured B2B sales methodology training (e.g., Business Value Selling or similar).</li>
<li><strong>Digital Tools:</strong> Experience using digital prospecting and engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to accelerate the sales cycle.</li>
</ul>
<p>Join Everpure Germany team and be part of a team that's redefining data storage. Apply now and unleash your potential!</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p>

<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>

      <title>GitLab: Strategic Account Executive -  San Francisco</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<div><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>Location: San Francisco&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>An overview of this role</h2>
<p>As a Strategic Account Executive on our AMER Enterprise team, you'll help large, regulated organizations adopt, implement, and expand their use of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll focus on strategic enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex DevSecOps and software delivery transformations across areas like CI/CD automation, secure development, and infrastructure modernization. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab’s field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner before, during, and after the sale. In your first year, you’ll be expected to build and manage a healthy enterprise pipeline, create repeatable sales motions, and drive successful rollouts and adoption that translate into measurable results and long-term expansion.</p>
<h2>What you'll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Support GitLab’s strategic large prospects and customers as a trusted advisor throughout their DevSecOps journey.</li>
<li>Drive the full sales cycle in large, complex enterprises, including prospecting, qualifying, developing, and closing new opportunities across your assigned accounts.</li>
<li>Provide strong account leadership and direction in both the pre-sales and post-sales process to ensure customers realize value from GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform.</li>
<li>Coordinate closely with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Support, and strategic channel partners to design and execute account strategies that drive adoption, expansion, and retention.</li>
<li>Develop and execute structured account plans based on customer business needs, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement across technical and business teams.</li>
<li>Ensure successful rollout and ongoing adoption through proactive account management activities, regular business reviews, and clear alignment on customer outcomes.</li>
<li>Prepare and deliver accurate activity and forecast reports, and contribute to root cause analysis on wins and losses while sharing lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li>
<li>Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas, and use a consultative approach to create proposals, quotes, and presentations that clearly link GitLab’s solutions to customer business objectives.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you'll bring</h2>
<ul>
<li>A true desire to see customers achieve meaningful outcomes and long-term value from their investment in GitLab.</li>
<li>Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprises, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS solutions.</li>
<li>Proven success selling into large, strategic organizations, with the ability to build trusted relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders across business and technical teams.</li>
<li>Able to provide a high degree of account management and control, working under minimal supervision on complex opportunities while maintaining clear communication and alignment.</li>
<li>Ability to generate new business and expand existing accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that result in sustainable, long-term partnerships.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with strategic channel partners to develop opportunities, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption.</li>
<li>Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills, with effective written and verbal communication that influences internal and external stakeholders.</li>
<li>Preferred experience with Git, software development tools, application lifecycle management, or security/application security tools.</li>
<li>You share our values and work in accordance with them, use GitLab in your daily work, and are able to travel if needed while following GitLab’s travel policy.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About the team</h2>
<p>The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our largest and most strategic customers. As a Strategic Account Executive on the AMER Enterprise team, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, and customer success teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared account planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on enterprise customers across regulated and large-scale environments.</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><span>Remote-Global</span></span></div><div><div><div><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">benefits</a><span> and </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div>United States Salary Range</div><div><span>$98,600</span><span>—</span><span>$174,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li>
<li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li>
<li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p>
<p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-strategic-account-executive-san-francisco">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gitlab-strategic-account-executive-san-francisco</a></p>

</p>

<p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p>
<p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.</p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>The Paid Media Manager will own paid media strategy and execution for BeyondTrust's International markets (EMEA, UKI, and APJ), driving pipeline through demand creation and capture campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Targeted Display, and Video (CTV and YouTube). You will manage the international paid budget, serve as the primary partner to our global digital agency, and work closely with regional Field Marketing and ABM teams to build integrated, locally relevant campaigns. You will be accountable for pipeline contribution and cost efficiency across all International markets, and you will ensure our paid programs are compliant with GDPR and built on consent-driven measurement.</p>
<p>What You’ll Do</p>
<ul>
<li>Plan, launch, and optimize always-on paid media campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Targeted Display, and Video, including ad copy, creative briefs, campaign setup, and performance reporting</li>
<li>Manage and allocate the annual international paid media budget to maximize ROI and pipeline impact across regions</li>
<li>Lead local-language campaign execution, with German and French as primary languages, working with the agency and regional teams to ensure messaging is accurate and culturally relevant</li>
<li>Ensure paid campaigns comply with GDPR and related privacy regulations, and implement consent-driven targeting and measurement approaches that preserve reporting accuracy</li>
<li>Serve as the day-to-day lead for our global digital agency, which manages the global BeyondTrust account with a dedicated focus on the International markets, holding them accountable for performance, scope, and spend pacing</li>
<li>Partner with Field Marketing in EMEA, UKI, and APJ on regional campaign strategy, and recommend optimizations for each geography and strategic campaign</li>
<li>Work with the Integrated Campaigns and ABM teams to build and deploy targeted campaigns at scale, using intent data from 6sense and ZoomInfo</li>
<li>Align paid media with organic efforts in partnership with the SEO and Social Media teams</li>
<li>Run A/B and multivariate tests on ad copy, creative, and landing pages to meet performance targets</li>
<li>Report regularly to stakeholders on performance, communicating insights and recommendations</li>
<li>Track digital marketing trends and recommend new channels and tactics to reach our target buyers</li>
</ul>
<p>What You’ll Bring</p>
<ul>
<li>Ideally 4+ years of B2B digital marketing experience, including managing paid campaigns across multiple regions or markets</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn, and YouTube, plus display and video platforms</strong></li>
<li>In-depth knowledge of paid search management, including keyword research and optimization</li>
<li>Working knowledge of GDPR and consent-driven measurement for paid campaigns, and how privacy regulation shapes targeting and attribution</li>
<li><strong>Solid understanding of ABM advertising strategies</strong> and intent-data tools (we use 6sense and ZoomInfo)</li>
<li>Experience managing external agency relationships</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, diagnose performance problems, and make data-driven decisions</li>
<li>Experience running A/B and multivariate tests</li>
<li>Experience with ad reporting and CRM tools such as Salesforce and Power BI</li>
<li>Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns across regions while keeping setup and execution accurate</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li>
<li>Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience</li>
</ul>
<p>Better Together</p>
<p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p>
<p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who&nbsp;come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.</p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p>
<p>Learn more at <a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>#LI-KP1</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p>

</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, Canada; Remote, United States
</p>

<div><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p>
<p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p>
<p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2>
<p>As an Executive Assistant at GitLab, you’ll help two senior leaders protect time for their priorities. You’ll primarily support a Vice President in Product and also support a Vice President in Marketing. You’ll manage both executives’ calendars, travel, and expenses.</p>
<p>This all-remote role is open to candidates in the United States and Canada, with no preference for a specific time zone within those countries.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Manage both executives’ calendars across time zones, resolving scheduling conflicts before they disrupt priority meetings.</li>
<li>Prepare a complete itinerary for each domestic or international trip, including flights, hotels, and any required visas.</li>
<li>Submit and reconcile expense reports for both executives by each reporting deadline, following GitLab’s travel and expense policies.</li>
<li>Coordinate recurring leadership activities with the Senior Executive Business Partner and keep shared office resources, distribution lists, Slack channels, and calendars up to date.</li>
<li>Plan team events, offsites, and large meetings with partners across GitLab so schedules and logistics are in place before each event.</li>
<li>Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools like Claude to capture meeting notes and reduce manual note-taking while protecting confidential information.</li>
<li>Cover for other Executive Business Administrators by handling time-sensitive calendar, travel, and expense requests before they’re due.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience providing executive-level administrative support to multiple senior leaders at once and adapting to each leader’s needs.</li>
<li>Proficiency with productivity, video meeting, team messaging, and travel and expense tools, and the ability to learn new tools quickly. We use Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, and Navan. Experience with comparable tools, such as Microsoft Teams for messaging, is welcome.</li>
<li>Sound judgment under pressure: you can work independently, stay composed when plans change, and know when to reprioritize or escalate competing executive requests.</li>
<li>Experience planning offsites or comparable events, with the organization, clear communication, and attention to detail to coordinate with multiple teams.</li>
<li>Experience using AI to improve day-to-day operations while keeping sensitive information confidential.</li>
<li>Ability to build relationships and gather context remotely, with flexibility in your working hours to coordinate across regions. Experience supporting teams across offices or regions can transfer to this role.</li>
<li>Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally to support executives, offsites, and key events. Expect roughly one trip per quarter on average, though frequency will vary.</li>
<li>Experience supporting Product or Design leaders, or working at a software company or startup, is helpful but not required.</li>
</ul>
<p>We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and value transferable experience.</p>
<h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2>
<p>The Executive Business Administration team helps GitLab’s leaders work effectively in an asynchronous environment. We work with teams across GitLab to coordinate leadership meetings, maintain shared resources, and bring people together for events. You’ll partner with our Senior Executive Business Partner and other Executive Business Administrators.</p>
<h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4>
<ul>

</ul>

Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world.       <title>Everpure: Sr District Manager, Enterprise (Majors)</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, California
</p>

<div><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h2><strong>Should you accept this challenge?</strong></h2>
<p>Everpure is looking for a strategic, operationally strong Senior District Manager to lead and grow a group of our largest Enterprise West field-sales business. This leader will translate regional and company priorities into a clear district strategy, set operating direction for a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives, and align the extended sales organization and channel ecosystem to deliver durable results.</p>
<p>The Senior District Manager is accountable for district sales performance, including bookings, new-logo production, pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and team development. Success requires sound judgment across complex sales situations, strong executive relationships, and the ability to direct coordinated action across Account Executives, PreSales Engineering, Channel, and Inside Sales. The ideal candidate lives and sells in the Bay Area; significant field travel is expected.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Set district strategy and deliver results:</strong> Translate regional and company objectives into district priorities, territory plans, and execution plans. Own district performance against annual bookings and new-logo goals, and adjust plans as market conditions and business needs evolve.</li>
<li><strong>Lead and develop the sales organization:</strong> Lead, coach, and performance-manage Enterprise Account Executives. Recruit and develop talent, set clear expectations, build succession and team capability, and ensure Everpure’s culture and values are embedded in how the team operates.</li>
<li><strong>Direct cross-functional execution:</strong> Align PreSales Engineers, Channel Managers, Inside Sales, and other partners around district priorities, account strategies, and resource needs. Coordinate complex, multi-resource sales motions through to close.</li>
<li><strong>Establish operating rigor:</strong> Set and maintain standards for pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, proof-of-concept management, partner alignment, and CRM discipline. Maintain a 4X pipeline to goal, review activity and pipeline weekly, and take timely action when coverage or performance is off plan.</li>
<li><strong>Build strategic channel partnerships:</strong> Develop and sustain productive relationships with channel partner principals, account executives, and leadership teams. Establish alignment between partner plans and district objectives, and mobilize partners to improve customer outcomes and business results.</li>
<li><strong>Elevate customer and executive engagement:</strong> Build trusted relationships with customer executives and IT leaders. Participate in key sales presentations and provide strategic direction for complex accounts, coordinating resources and addressing obstacles to successful outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>Lead through insight and accountability:</strong> Use sales data, customer and partner input, and sound judgment to identify root causes, evaluate options, and make timely decisions. Drive accountability for quota attainment, sales-call activity, pipeline sufficiency, and individual development.</li>
<li><strong>Represent the district in broader planning:</strong> Partner with senior sales and cross-functional leaders on district and regional planning, resource alignment, and initiatives that improve sales effectiveness.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What you’ll need to bring to this role</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of successful field-sales management experience in storage or core IT infrastructure in a highly competitive environment.</li>
<li>A record of leading, recruiting, developing, and performance-managing successful sales teams.</li>
<li>Experience selling to IT departments and IT management, with credibility in executive-level customer discussions.</li>
<li>The ability to set direction across a district, translate business priorities into territory and account plans, and deliver results through coordinated execution.</li>
<li>A track record of accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and using KPIs and CRM tools to make sound business decisions.</li>
<li>Strong channel-partner leadership skills, including the ability to build productive relationships with partner principals, account executives, and leadership teams.</li>
<li>The ability to coordinate cross-functional resources and guide complex sales strategies from planning through close.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly and persuasively articulate Everpure’s value.</li>
<li>Strong organization, judgment, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and identify root causes.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel extensively in the field; Bay Area residence and market experience are strongly preferred.</li>
</ul><div><div><div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em>This range is our good faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to pay for this position upon hire, as of the date of this posting. Actual base pay within this range will depend on job-related factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and work location. </em><em>For positions open to candidates in multiple geographical locations, the base salary range is reflective of the labor market across the applicable locations.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>This role may be eligible for incentive pay and/or equity.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>There is no application deadline and we accept applications on an ongoing basis until the job is filled.</em></p></div><div>The annual base salary hiring range is:</div><div><span>$221,400</span><span>—</span><span>$270,600 USD</span></div></div></div><div><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p>
<p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p>
<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>
<p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p>
<p>Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.</p>
<p><strong>Join us and bring your best.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Bring your bold.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Pure and simple.</strong></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/everpure-sr-district-manager-enterprise-majors">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/everpure-sr-district-manager-enterprise-majors</a></p>
</description>

      <title>LaunchDarkly: Mid-Market Account Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<h4><strong>About the Job:</strong></h4>
<p>The Mid-Market Account Executive will drive LaunchDarkly's growth across a blended book of net-new and existing accounts. Acting as the "quarterback" for a defined book of business, you will develop and execute account strategies, run technical discovery and proof-of-concept cycles, and help customers successfully test, purchase, and adopt LaunchDarkly's platform.</p>
<h4>Responsibilities:</h4>
<ul>
<li>Pipeline Generation: Qualify and convert inbound leads at a rapid pace while prospecting into ICP target accounts.</li>
<li>Value Articulation: Articulate and sell the value of LaunchDarkly's platform subscriptions and usage-based pricing model.</li>
<li>Technical Discovery: Prepare for and run discovery sessions with prospects to surface core use cases and align pricing to third-party architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li>
<li>Solution Demonstration: Customize and deliver demos with the Solutions Engineering team, and run proofs of concept for prospects.</li>
<li>Account Expansion: Own, build, and develop relationships with existing customers, uncovering and developing new opportunities within the install base.</li>
<li>Customer Success: Educate, evangelize, and guide customers through successful adoption, delivering their feedback back to Product and Engineering.</li>
<li>Revenue Growth: Consistently hit revenue targets across both net-new and expansion motions.</li>
<li>Collaboration: Work with your manager, Sales Engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure seamless execution and customer success.</li>
<li>Strategic Thinking &amp; Execution:
<ul>
<li>Design and execute account strategies that balance net-new acquisition with expansion of existing customers.</li>
<li>Identify and capitalize on usage-based pricing signals and third-party architecture fit to prioritize opportunities.</li>
<li>Adapt strategies as customer needs and market dynamics evolve, ensuring continuous growth and a competitive edge.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Full-Cycle Sales Expertise:
<ul>
<li>Proven track record managing a full sales cycle, from inbound qualification and prospecting through close and expansion.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of usage-based pricing models and the ability to manage discovery, demo, and proof-of-concept stages.</li>
<li>Skilled in selling to Engineering Leaders, Platform Teams, CTOs, CIOs, and other technical decision-makers.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Customer-Centric Problem Solving:
<ul>
<li>Assess customer pain points and design tailored solutions, including proofs of concept, that create measurable value.</li>
<li>Build long-term relationships with existing customers, acting as a trusted advisor who drives product adoption.</li>
<li>Overcome obstacles and find innovative ways to expand LaunchDarkly's footprint within an account.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Independent Decision Making:
<ul>
<li>Work autonomously with minimal day-to-day supervision, making sound decisions based on account signals and data.</li>
<li>Take ownership of your book of business, managing both acquisition and expansion motions with confidence.</li>
<li>Prioritize tasks and make decisions quickly, ensuring alignment with broader revenue goals.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Analytical Skills &amp; Data-Driven Insights:
<ul>
<li>Gain and apply an understanding of third-party cloud architectures to accurately position and price the usage-based model.</li>
<li>Evaluate account signals and customer data to prioritize the accounts most likely to convert or expand.</li>
<li>Keep all data current in SFDC, Aviso, and Outreach, and use these tools to track and analyze performance.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Negotiation &amp; Deal Structuring:
<ul>
<li>Negotiate platform subscription agreements that balance customer needs with company goals.</li>
<li>Create mutually beneficial agreements that support long-term adoption and expansion.</li>
<li>Handle objections, overcome resistance, and close deals in a competitive market.</li>
</ul>
</li>

<p>

<h2><strong>Account Executive</strong></h2>
<p>As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you will be working on reinforcing our leadership in the mid-market space. You should demonstrate skills associated with working in a high-performance sales culture, especially demonstrating pipeline management, lead generation, contact network development and delivering results against a quota. This is a full sales cycle role with the focus on hunting and closing net new business.</p>
<p>The Mid-Market Account Executive team's charter is to provide the best sales experience possible to Sumo Logic’s mid-market segment customers. This team has a consultative sales approach, a track record of growing sales, demolishing quotas, and keeping customers happy and wanting to dive more into our product.</p>
<h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Target, manage and sell to a defined geographic territory with up to 1,500 employees</li>
<li>Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to close, in order to fill Sumo Logic's pipeline</li>
<li>Create and deliver accurate sales forecasts</li>
<li>Perform product demos using web tools to prospects and customers</li>
<li>Partner with internal resources to provide a stellar experience for prospective customers and ensure their needs are being met</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Required Qualifications and Skills</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of quota-carrying experience selling B2B applications; on-demand/SaaS, IT Infrastructure Management or Cloud Security offerings</li>
<li>History of quota over-achievement selling to a technical audience like IT operations, Security, and DevOps teams</li>
<li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills, collaborative mindset a must</li>
<li>Contact network within the Big Data ecosystem, highly preferred</li>
<li>Salesforce power user</li>
</ul>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">About Us</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit</span><a class="XqQF9c" href="http://www.sumologic.com/"><span class="C9DxTc "> www.sumologic.com.</span></a></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><a class="XqQF9c" href="https://www.sumologic.com/privacy-statement/"><span class="C9DxTc aw5Odc ">Sumo Logic Privacy Policy</span></a><span class="C9DxTc ">. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">The expected annual base salary range for this position is $88,000 - $103,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application.</span><span class="C9DxTc ">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="zfr3Q CDt4Ke "><span class="C9DxTc ">Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position.</span></p>

      <title>BeyondTrust: Front-End Engineer, UX/UI</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote Canada
</p>

<p>BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.</p>
<p>Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.</p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>The Web Development Team, part of Brand, owns beyondtrust.com end to end: a React and Next.js front end backed by an enterprise headless CMS, serving a global cybersecurity audience and the pipeline that runs through it. beyondtrust.com is BeyondTrust's largest go-to-market surface, and this role builds it — the campaign and launch experiences, the shared component system underneath them, and the front-end quality of the whole site.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, mid-level individual contributor role for an engineer who is strong in React, TypeScript and Next.js, has the visual judgment to make what they build look right without every state being specified, and uses AI tooling as an everyday part of how they work. Direction comes from the team; execution and craft are yours. The role reports to the Sr. Manager, UX/UI &amp; Digital Experience.</p>
<p>What You’ll Do</p>
<ul>
<li>Build the web experiences behind BeyondTrust's launches, campaigns and new product narratives, working from direction set with Brand, Demand Generation and Product Marketing, and turning it into something live quickly.</li>
<li>Work hands-on in the shared component library every week: build new components, extend existing ones, and improve what is there through cleaner APIs, better typing and clearer documentation, and help shape where it goes next.</li>
<li>Build for front-end performance across the site, including Core Web Vitals.</li>
<li>Build and improve the conversion and demo-request journey and the form experience.</li>
<li>Build WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility into components and pages from the start, including automated accessibility checks.</li>
<li>Write component and end-to-end tests for your own work.</li>
<li>When you see a better way to do something — a pattern, an interaction, a page that should work differently — prototype it far enough that the team can react to a working example.</li>
<li>Use AI tooling, including Claude and Claude Code, as a core part of how you design, build, test and review, and help shape how the team uses it.</li>
<li>Build AI-powered features into the site as the team takes them on, such as assistive and conversational search, and content recommendation and personalization.</li>
<li>Follow secure development practices: handle secrets properly, keep dependencies current, validate input at boundaries, and take part in standing security review.</li>
</ul>
<p>What You’ll Bring</p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years shipping production <strong>React</strong> and <strong>TypeScript</strong>, working in TypeScript strict mode.</li>
<li>Solid working knowledge of Next.js App Router, including server versus client components, rendering and caching, and the interest to go deeper.</li>
<li>Experience building against a headless CMS or API-driven content, including querying over GraphQL, and building components that hold up when content does something unexpected.</li>
<li>Strong CSS, including a utility-first framework, and an eye for layouts that hold together at every breakpoint.</li>
<li>Experience working in a shared component library, and opinions about what makes one good to build with.</li>
<li>Experience measuring and improving front-end performance.</li>
<li>Experience testing your own work with component and end-to-end tests, including accessibility checks.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of accessibility implementation: semantics, focus management and keyboard interaction.</li>
<li>Good visual judgment and comfort in Figma: able to take design direction and fill in the gaps — spacing, states, responsive behavior — without needing every case specified.</li>
<li>Everyday, specific use of AI tooling in your own workflow, with examples you can walk through.</li>
<li>Comfort taking a piece of work from brief to shipped in a small team.</li>
</ul>
<p>Nice To Have</p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with a modern hosting and edge platform, including caching and revalidation, incremental regeneration, and debugging production builds.</li>
<li>Experience building marketing and go-to-market web experiences, such as campaigns, launches and landing pages.</li>
<li>Experience contributing to the design or evolution of a component library, not just building in one.</li>
<li>Experience with Claude, Claude Code or comparable AI-assisted development tooling in a team setting.</li>
<li>Experience building LLM-backed features, such as retrieval, prompt design and evaluation.</li>
<li>Serverless or edge function work behind a front end, such as form handling, API routes and third-party integrations.</li>
<li>Motion and animation implemented in code.</li>
<li>Comfort working alongside marketers and other non-engineers: explaining tradeoffs without jargon and working from a brief that is not yet fully specified.</li>
<li>B2B SaaS, enterprise or security-industry background.</li>
</ul>
<p>Better Together</p>
<p>Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.</p>
<p>We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who&nbsp;come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.</p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.</p>
<p>BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.</p>
<p>Learn more at <a href="http://www.beyondtrust.com/">www.beyondtrust.com</a>.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><span><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p>
<p><span>Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.&nbsp;</p>
