      <title>Postscript: Head of Growth</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.&nbsp;</p>
<p>With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.</p></div><p>Marketing is being rewritten. The playbooks that built B2B pipeline for the last decade are losing their edge, and the teams that win next will look more like product and engineering teams than traditional marketing departments. We're looking for the person who is already living in that future.</p>
<p>As <strong>Head of Growth Marketing</strong>, you'll own every way merchants discover, evaluate and come back to Postscript: paid channels and budget, postscript.io, every traffic source, our email and SMS distribution, community, creative and experiential. You'll run growth as an experimentation engine: fast, quantitatively rigorous and AI-native from the ground up.</p>
<p>You won't just run campaigns. You'll build and ship things: free tools, interactive experiences and AI-powered products ecommerce brands actually want to use, tested against real traffic and measured against pipeline. Part mad scientist, part operator, part builder.</p>
<p>This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere in the United States.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you'll own</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>The growth number.</strong> Own the pipeline target with sales and marketing leadership, and build the machine that hits it.</li>
<li><strong>All paid.</strong> Strategy, budget, channel mix and creative testing across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and whatever comes next.</li>
<li><strong>Postscript.io as a product.</strong> Conversion, testing and new experiences.</li>
<li><strong>Distribution.</strong> Email, SMS, community, partners and experiential.</li>
<li><strong>Software as marketing.</strong> Conceive, build and ship AI-powered experiences (think "Get an AI audit of your SMS program"), test them against traffic and scale what works.</li>
<li><strong>Experiment velocity.</strong> A testing cadence measured in experiments per week, not per quarter, with clean measurement behind it.</li>
<li><strong>The team.</strong> Lead and grow a team across growth, lifecycle, creative and experiential, and redesign how it works with AI.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years leading teams in marketing, growth or engineering, or as a founder</li>
<li>Deep performance marketing and paid media experience at scale</li>
<li>Quantitative fluency: you do your own analysis and know attribution and incrementality cold</li>
<li>AI-native: you use AI tools daily and have built and shipped things with them</li>
<li>A track record of high-velocity experimentation that moved pipeline or revenue</li>
<li>A builder's bias for action: you'd rather ship a prototype Friday than debate a strategy doc for a month</li>
<li>Creative instincts: you know great growth starts with ideas, not just optimization</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>An engineering, technical or founder background</li>
<li>Ecommerce, DTC or martech experience, brand side or vendor side</li>
<li>GTM engineering experience (Clay, n8n, Zapier or your own tooling)</li>
<li>Experience with HubSpot and Salesforce</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you'll love about us</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Salary range of USD $207,000–287,000 base plus significant equity (we do not have geo-based salaries)</li>
<li>A high-growth company with plenty of room to directly shape the business and your career</li>
<li>Work from home (or wherever)</li>
<li>A team that is passionate and enjoys what we do</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>Health, dental and vision insurance</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For information about how we use your personal data, please see our U.S. Job Applicant&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://postscript.io/job-applicant-privacy-notice">Privacy Notice</a></em></p>
<p><em>You are welcome here. Postscript is an ever-evolving place of equal employment for talented individuals.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-head-of-growth">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/postscript-head-of-growth</a></p>

      <title>PagerDuty: Future Openings -  Enterprise Account Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA - New York City, NY)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><em><strong>Join our talent community: We’re building a pipeline of enterprise Account Executives for upcoming openings. We don’t have an immediate vacancy for this role today, but we’re actively collecting applications and will reach out when a role aligns with your background.</strong></em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>PagerDuty seeks Account Executives (AE) to join our high-performing, customer-focused team! As an Account Executive, you will drive growth and expansion within an established customer portfolio, combining strategic account management with consultative enterprise selling. You’ll partner with C-level executives and key stakeholders to deliver measurable outcomes through Operations Cloud conversions and multi-product adoption. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the customer’s journey, close high-value deals, and accelerate PagerDuty’s growth in the enterprise market.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate is a relationship-driven sales professional who thrives in complex deal cycles, excels at executive engagement, and is passionate about delivering customer impact through innovative SaaS solutions.</p>
<h3><strong>KEY RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own and grow a defined set of enterprise accounts by driving upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities.</li>
<li>Build and maintain trusted executive relationships through regular in-person engagement and consultative selling.</li>
<li>Develop and execute strategic account plans to identify growth areas, expansion pathways, and competitive positioning.</li>
<li>Drive adoption of PagerDuty’s Operations Cloud by articulating clear business value and ROI.</li>
<li>Execute complex, multi-product sales motions and partner with Solution Consultants for technical validation and proof-of-concept activities.</li>
<li>Maintain accurate forecasts and a disciplined pipeline in Salesforce using the MEDDICC framework.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Customer Success, Product Management, and Renewals teams to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term retention.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in B2B sales, account management, or expansion roles within SaaS or cloud software.</li>
<li>Proven success managing a quota in complex, long-cycle enterprise sales.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience selling to and influencing C-level executives.</li>
<li>Proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC) for pipeline management and forecasting.</li>
<li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Prior enterprise sales expertise leveraging MEDDPICC &amp; Value Selling</li>
<li>Experience managing high-value accounts&nbsp;</li>
<li>Track record of success with multi-product sales and solution-based selling models.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of enterprise software ecosystems, Operations Cloud, or DevOps environments.</li>
<li>Strategic thinker with exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.</li>
</ul>
<h3>&nbsp;</h3>
<p>The <span>base</span> salary range for this position is $<span class="collapsed-field-text">130,000.00 - $170,500.00</span>&nbsp; USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission (50/50 split), and/or benefits.</p>
<p>Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.</p>
<p>Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Hesitant to apply?</strong></p>
<p>We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/jobalerts">job alerts</a>!</p>
<p><strong>Where we work</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/locations">offices</a> in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we <strong>cannot</strong> employ candidates residing in:</p>
<p><strong>Location restrictions: </strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Australia:</strong> Northern Territory, Queensland, South Australia, Tasmania, Western Australia<br><strong>Canada:</strong> Alberta, Manitoba, Newfoundland, Northwest Territories, Nunavut, PEI, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Yukon<br><strong>United States:</strong> Alaska, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, Wyoming<br><em>Candidates must reside in an eligible location, which vary by role.</em></p>
<p><strong>How we work</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/#values">Our values</a> guide how we support customers, collaborate with colleagues, develop products, and foster a culture of belonging. They define not just our actions, but what it means to be Dutonian.</p>
<p>People Leaders at PagerDuty are responsible for creating high performance environments that drive accountability. PagerDuty has four key dimensions that define our Leadership Impact: Lead Self, Lead the Team, Lead the Business, and Lead the Future. Each dimension has three associated competencies to give leaders a shared language for guiding their development, career, promotion, and succession planning discussions. Our Manager Expectations serve as a practical guide for managers to understand their responsibilities, prioritize their efforts, and drive engagement and performance.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer</strong></p>
<p>As a global organization, our total rewards approach is competitive with industry standards and aligned with local laws and regulations. Learn more, including country-specific offerings, on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/global-benefits">benefits site</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Your package may include:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive salary</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefits package&nbsp;</li>
<li>Flexible work arrangements</li>
<li>Company equity*</li>
<li>ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Program)*</li>
<li>Retirement or pension plan*</li>
<li>Generous paid vacation time</li>
<li>Paid holidays and sick leave</li>
<li>Dutonian Wellness Days &amp; HibernationDuty - companywide paid days off in addition to PTO</li>
<li>Paid parental leave: 22 weeks for pregnant parent, 12 weeks for non-pregnant parent (some countries have longer leave standards and we comply with local laws)*</li>
<li>Paid volunteer time off: 20 hours per year</li>
<li>Company-wide hack weeks</li>
<li>Mental wellness programs</li>
</ul>
<p>*Eligibility may vary by role, region, and tenure</p>
<p><strong>About PagerDuty</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. The PagerDuty Operations Cloud is an AI-powered platform that empowers business resilience and drives operational efficiency for enterprises. With a generative AI assistant at its core, PagerDuty empowers teams to detect and resolve issues in real time, orchestrate complex workflows, and drive continuous improvement across their digital operations. Trusted by nearly half of both the Fortune 500 and the Forbes AI 50, as well as approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100, PagerDuty is essential for delivering always-on digital experiences to modern businesses</p>
<p>PagerDuty is Great Place to Work-certified™, a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, a Fortune Best Medium Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace in Technology, and a top rated product on TrustRadius and G2.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Go behind-the-scenes on our <a href="https://careers.pagerduty.com/home">careers site</a> and @pagerduty on Instagram.</p>
<p><strong>Additional Information</strong></p>
<p>PagerDuty is an equal opportunity employer. PagerDuty does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or disability status. Your privacy is important to us. By submitting an application, you confirm that you have read and understand PagerDuty's <a href="https://www.pagerduty.com/privacy-policy/">Privacy Policy</a>.</p>
<p>PagerDuty is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. Should you require accommodation, please email accommodation@pagerduty.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.</p>
<p>PagerDuty uses the E-Verify employment verification program.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-future-openings-enterprise-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pagerduty-future-openings-enterprise-account-executive</a></p>

<p>

</p>

<p><strong>SLSQ128R78</strong></p>
<p>While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.</p>
<ul>
<li>Remote - Chicago</li>
</ul>
<p>As a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive at Databricks, you are a sales professional experienced in leading go-to-market campaigns in Fortune 500 accounts. You know how to sell innovation and change through customer vision expansion and can guide deals forward to compress decision cycles. You love understanding a product in depth and are passionate about communicating value to Customers and System Integrators.</p>
<p>Databricks operates at the leading edge of the Unified Data Analytics and AI space. Our customers turn to us to lead the accelerated innovation that their businesses need to gain first mover advantage in today’s ultra-competitive landscape. As we continue our rapid expansion, we are looking for a creative, execution-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to join the Retail team and maximize the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks.</p>
<p>Reporting to our Director of Enterprise Sales, you will manage a strategic enterprise client as part of the Retail team. &nbsp;You will come with an informed point of view on Big Data, Advanced Analytics and AI which will help to guide your successful execution strategy and allow you to provide genuine value to the client.</p>
<p><strong>The impact you will have:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build relationships with CIOs, IT executives, LOB executives, Program Managers, and other important partners.</li>
<li>Drive value-based growth within the account.</li>
<li>Expand the Databricks footprint into new business units and use cases.</li>
<li>Exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue targets.</li>
<li>Track all customer details including use case, purchase time frames, next steps, and forecasting in Salesforce.</li>
<li>Use a solution-based approach to selling and creating value for customers.</li>
<li>Promote Databricks' Data Intelligence Platform powered by Apache Spark™ and Delta Lake</li>
<li>Prioritize opportunities and leverage appropriate resources.</li>
<li>Build a plan for success internally at Databricks and externally with your account</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have previously excelled in an early-stage company and you know how to navigate and be successful with limited oversight</li>
<li>Previous field sales experience within big data, Cloud, SaaS, and a consumption selling motion</li>
<li>Prior customer relationships with CIOs, program managers, and essential decision makers at local accounts</li>
<li>The ability to simplify a technical capability into a value-based benefit</li>
<li>7+ years of Enterprise Sales experience exceeding quotas in larger accounts</li>
<li>Managing a small set of enterprise accounts rather than a broad territory</li>
<li>Bachelor's Degree</li>
</ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>&nbsp;</p>

The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.&nbsp; Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog.       <title>SoFi: Direct Mail Marketing Manager, Credit Card (Contract)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> CA - San Francisco HQ; CA-Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://www.sofi.com/sofi-employee-applicant-privacy-notice/"><strong>Employee Applicant Privacy Notice</strong></a></p>
<p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p>
<div>
<p>Shape a brighter financial future with us.</p>
<p>Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.</p>
<p>We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. <strong>Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.</strong></p>
</div></div><p><strong>The role:</strong></p>
<p>SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative.</p>
<p>At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you.</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>This role owns four core areas of responsibility:</p>
<p><strong>1. Creative Strategy &amp; Planning</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>2. Campaign &amp; Production Management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>3. Compliance, Quality &amp; Operations</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>4. Performance, Insights &amp; Competitive Intelligence</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications.</p>
</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><strong>Compensation and Benefits</strong></div>
<div class="gmail_default">The base pay range for this role is listed below. Final base pay offer will be determined based on individual factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, and location.&nbsp;</div>
<div class="gmail_default">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="gmail_default">To view all of our comprehensive&nbsp;and competitive&nbsp;benefits, visit our&nbsp;<strong><a href="https://sofietyinfo.sofi.com/sofi-benefits">Benefits at SoFi</a>&nbsp;</strong>page!</div>
<h5><span>SoFi provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, and conditions related to breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, age (40 or over), physical or medical disability, medical condition, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military and/or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable state or federal law.</span></h5>
<h5><span>The Company hires the best qualified candidate for the job, without regard to protected characteristics.</span></h5>
<h5><span>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.</span></h5>
<h5><a href="https://dol.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2022/02/ls740_1.pdf"><span>New York applicants: Notice of Employee Rights</span></a></h5>
<h5><span>SoFi is committed to an inclusive culture. As part of this commitment, </span><span>SoFi </span><span>offers reasonable accommodations to candidates with physical or mental disabilities. If you need accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, please let your recruiter know or email </span><a href="mailto:accommodations@sofi.com">accommodations@sofi.com.</a></h5>
<h5><span>We are unable to accommodate remote work from Hawaii, Alaska or Puerto Rico at this time.</span></h5>
<div class="gmail_default"><strong>Internal Employees</strong></div>
<div class="gmail_default">If you are a current employee, do not apply here - please navigate to our Internal Job Board in Greenhouse to apply to our open roles.</div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sofi-direct-mail-marketing-manager-credit-card-contract">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sofi-direct-mail-marketing-manager-credit-card-contract</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Tailscale: ABM Campaign Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (United States)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.&nbsp;<em>Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. </em><em>We encourage you to help us break that statistic!</em></p>
<p><strong>About Tailscale&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.</p></div><h3><span>About the Role</span></h3>
<p>We're looking for an Integrated ABM Campaign Manager to develop and scale creative, targeted campaigns that engage priority accounts and drive pipeline across our Enterprise and Mid-Market segments.</p>
<p>You'll own the strategy and execution of 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns, bringing together paid advertising, personalized content, direct mail, gifting, and coordinated Sales outreach to reach the right people at the right accounts.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on role where you'll have the freedom to test new ideas, build integrated programs, and use data to understand what's working. You'll also partner closely with our wider ABM, Sales, and Partner Marketing team to connect campaigns with account priorities, strategic experiences, and partner-led opportunities.</p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the strategy, planning, execution, and optimization of integrated ABM campaigns across Enterprise and Mid-Market audiences.</li>
<li>Develop campaign audiences, messaging, channel plans, budgets, and success metrics based on Sales priorities and account insights.</li>
<li>Manage targeted paid advertising, particularly LinkedIn, alongside personalized landing pages and other digital ABM experiences.</li>
<li>Own direct mail, gifting, and scalable prospect engagement programs, including gifting program workflows.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales and GTM Operations to identify target accounts, build contact lists, and activate campaigns.</li>
<li>Develop coordinated Sales outreach plays and sequences with the Sales Enablement Lead to support campaign engagement and follow-up.</li>
<li>Work with Product Marketing and Content to develop relevant messaging and creative for priority audiences.</li>
<li>Collaborate with our wider Enterprise ABM, Events, and Partner Marketing teams on account-specific activations, event invitations, and joint campaigns.</li>
<li>Proactively identify new campaign opportunities based on engagement signals, account intelligence, and business priorities.</li>
<li>Track performance, test new approaches, and optimize for account engagement, meetings, pipeline creation, and progression.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a background in building ABM campaigns for both net-new acquisition and customer expansion.</li>
<li>Experience independently developing and executing multi-channel campaigns from strategy through measurement.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with LinkedIn advertising, audience segmentation, and marketing automation.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with personalized landing page platforms like Userled or Mutiny.</li>
<li>Experience with direct mail, gifting, personalization, or other creative account engagement tactics and platforms like Reachdesk or Sendoso.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of how marketing campaigns support Sales engagement and pipeline generation.</li>
<li>Comfortable working with data, testing new ideas, and using performance insights to improve results.</li>
<li>Organized, creative, and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once.</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Nice to Have</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience marketing to technical or Enterprise B2B audiences.</li>
<li>Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Clay, or Common Room.</li>
<li>Experience with partner or co-marketing campaigns.</li>

      <title>Algolia: Enterprise Account Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Netherlands
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div><span>Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><div class="p-rich_text_section">
<p>At Algolia, we are on a mission to help businesses connect their end-users with what matters most, in milliseconds. As the leader in AI-powered Search and Discovery, we’re driving the next frontier of digital experiences - where generative AI, adaptive relevance, and agentic workflows help enterprises move beyond traditional search into truly intelligent, self-optimising discovery at scale.</p>
<p>As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing these innovations to life for Global 2000 organisations. You won’t just sell a product - you’ll guide customers through a transformation where algorithms act as strategic copilots, delivering contextual recommendations, predictive experiences, and AI-assisted user journeys that improve engagement and business outcomes.</p>
<p>You will own complex, high-impact relationships, lead multi-stakeholder buying cycles, and work cross-functionally to articulate the value of AI-first search, agentic automation, and composable architecture. This role demands strategic instincts, a consultative mindset, and the ability to translate AI innovation into measurable business value.</p>
<p>You are a builder, a challenger, and a trusted advisor. You thrive in dynamic environments and know how to position Algolia as a key enabler of AI-driven digital transformation - not just another line item in a stack.</p>
<p><strong>YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Owning, managing, and accelerating an enterprise pipeline&nbsp;</li>
<li>Driving inbound and outbound opportunities through complex, multi-threaded sales cycles to closed-won</li>
<li>Positioning Algolia’s generative AI and agentic capabilities to executives and technical champions - showing how real-time relevance, predictive personalisation, and autonomous search assistants deliver business value</li>
<li>Developing territory and account strategies across your portfolio</li>
<li>Expanding existing accounts by identifying opportunities for strategic and commercial growth</li>
<li>Generating new enterprise projects by self-sourcing high-value meetings, networking within communities, and leveraging partner ecosystems</li>
<li>Partnering with Solutions Engineering to build bespoke demos, proofs-of-value, and ROI analyses that highlight impact beyond traditional search metrics</li>
<li>Forecasting accurately with disciplined methodologies (MEDDPICC) and a deep understanding of decision drivers and buyer risk profiles</li>
<li>Collaborating cross-functionally (SDRs, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Legal, Marketing, Partners) to align execution with business outcomes and long-term enterprise value</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Fluency in Dutch and English</li>
<li>5+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals - especially in digital transformation, AI/ML, or search/commerce domains</li>
<li>A deep interest in generative AI, machine learning-enabled customer experiences, and how agentic systems unlock competitive advantage</li>
<li>Proven success selling into large, multi-department organisations with complex evaluation criteria and dispersed stakeholder influence</li>
<li>Familiarity with selling adjacent solutions or ability to quickly learn technical differentiation and articulate it to technical and executive stakeholders</li>
<li>Strong outbound sales capability, modern prospecting skills, and comfort leading with insight</li>
<li>Experience working with strategic partners (consultancies, SIs, ISVs) to co-build opportunities</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>NICE TO HAVE:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience selling platforms with usage-based pricing, AI-first capabilities, or composable architectures</li>
<li>Understanding of how generative models and agentic tools are used in commerce, discovery, and digital engagement</li>
<li>Comfort discussing technical architecture and AI relevance with technical decision makers</li>
<li>A curious, growth-oriented approach with the ability to balance strategic vision and execution rigor</li>
<li>A passion for building new ground - especially where cutting-edge AI meets real business outcomes</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="p-rich_text_section">#LI-Hybrid</div><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Algolia does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, military status, veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.</p>
<p>The annual total cash compensation range (base salary and commission) for this role reflects market pay data within this location. The exact compensation offered for this role may vary depending on specific location and job-related knowledge, technical skills, and experience; and is only one part of our Total Rewards philosophy to compensate and recognize employees for their work.</p></div><div class="title">On-Target Earnings Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€172.000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>€200.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr>
<p><strong>FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:</strong></p>
<p>Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees.<strong> Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.</strong></p>
<p><strong>WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO CAN LIVE OUR VALUES:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>GRIT</strong> - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.</li>
<li><strong>TRUST </strong>- Willingness to trust our co-workers and to take ownership.</li>
<li><strong>CANDOR</strong> - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.</li>
<li><strong>CARE</strong> - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.</li>
<li><strong>HUMILITY</strong> - Aptitude for learning from others, putting ego aside.</li>
</ul>
<p>We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is respected and supported—regardless of race, age, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, color, veteran status, disability, or socioeconomic background.</p>
<p><strong>IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR CANDIDATES - Recruitment Fraud Notice</strong></p>
<p>We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams targeting job seekers. To help protect yourself, please keep the following in mind:</p>
<ul>
<li>Our open positions may appear on third-party job boards, but the <strong>best way to apply safely</strong> is directly through our <strong>careers page</strong>.</li>
<li>All genuine communication from Algolia will come from an <strong>@algolia.com</strong> email address. If you receive an email from someone claiming to work at Algolia who does not have an @algolia.com email address, please do not respond or share any personal information.</li>
<li>We’ll <strong>never ask for payments, purchases, or financial details</strong> during the hiring process.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>READY TO APPLY?</strong></p>
<p>If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search &amp; discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/algolia-enterprise-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/algolia-enterprise-account-executive</a></p>
</description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States (Remote)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.</p>
<p>Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.</p>
<p>As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.&nbsp;</p>
<p>At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.</p></div><p><strong>*This is a remote position that must be based in either the New York City or Boston metro areas as this person will be required to attend in person meetings &amp; events in those areas regularly.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>We're looking for an exceptional second-line sales leader to build and scale our East region. As the Area Vice President of Sales East, you'll report to the Sr. AVP of Sales, Americas and lead four Regional Vice Presidents of Sales, collectively overseeing a team of 20+ quota-carrying Account Executives. You will be instrumental in driving Tines' next phase of growth by setting regional strategy, developing elite sales talent, and executing with consistency and accountability across the East.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Provide second-line leadership to four RVPs of Sales, coaching and developing them into elite first-line leaders</li>
<li>Own the East regional go-to-market strategy: territory design, quota allocation, hiring plan, and partner ecosystem development</li>
<li>Drive consistent pipeline generation standards and forecast discipline across all sub-regions</li>
<li>Serve as executive sponsor in key enterprise deals, partnering with RVPs and AEs to accelerate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li>
<li>Partner with Sr. AVP of Sales, Americas and cross-functional leaders (Field Marketing, XDR, SE, Partnerships, CommercialOps) to align on regional priorities and resource allocation</li>
<li>Recruit, hire, and develop top sales talent at the manager and AE level across the East</li>
<li>Drive accountability through rigorous performance management, pipeline reviews, and regular coaching cadences with both RVPs</li>
<li>Expand the partner ecosystem across the East, including VAR and technology alliance relationships</li>
<li>Own regional revenue forecasting through methodical deal analysis and disciplined processes</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You Bring With You</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of B2B SaaS/technology sales experience</li>
<li>3+ years of experience managing quota-carrying AEs including second-line leadership experience</li>
<li>Proven track record of exceeding regional quotas and driving results in enterprise software sales, particularly in security or automation</li>
<li>Experience leading and developing first-line sales managers (RVPs or Directors) strongly preferred</li>
<li>Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing sales teams that consistently generate new pipeline and acquire net new logos</li>
<li>A passion for winning and personal accountability for achieving ambitious goals</li>
<li>Demonstrated success in navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in emerging technology markets</li>
<li>History of closing or influencing large enterprise deals</li>
<li>Strong executive presence and ability to build lasting relationships at all levels</li>
<li>Exceptional ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling business value</li>
<li>Deep understanding of modern enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, etc.)</li>
<li>Outstanding communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment</li>
<li>Ability to travel up to 35% of the time</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Target Annual Compensation:&nbsp;</strong>$215-220k salary + $215-220k commission = $430-440k OTE + Equity</p>
<p><em>Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.</em></p>
<p>#LI-SW1 #LI-LC1 #LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a&nbsp;career pivot&nbsp;– but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.tines.com/blog/inside-tines">the company we are</a>. We’d love to hear from you.</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!&nbsp;</p>
<p>Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.</p>
<p><em>Learn more at </em><a href="https://www.veracode.com/"><em>www.veracode.com</em></a><em>, on the </em><a href="https://www.veracode.com/blog"><em>Veracode blog</em></a><em>, and on </em><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fveracode%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cjbelmonte%40Veracode.com%7C989fdcd544fe425a07b808dc69096df9%7C3b627b68f21c4ed79fe3698efdedbe21%7C0%7C0%7C638500736454429530%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=WIg8EmVTgkrfgliLodV3%2Fgl%2F1IdGyT05d7Y%2FEfXS070%3D&amp;reserved=0"><em>LinkedIn</em></a><em> and </em><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FVeracode%3Fref_src%3Dtwsrc%255Egoogle%257Ctwcamp%255Eserp%257Ctwgr%255Eauthor&amp;data=05%7C02%7Cjbelmonte%40Veracode.com%7C989fdcd544fe425a07b808dc69096df9%7C3b627b68f21c4ed79fe3698efdedbe21%7C0%7C0%7C638500736454434178%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=YUcOAPoWdcug7OmcC1N7CEoeEKUFDAaTvgE4r1rAAe0%3D&amp;reserved=0"><em>Twitter</em></a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<div>Veracode is looking for someone who KNOWS Webflow inside out and knows how to make a large B2B website work harder for the business.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Must be equally comfortable building a reusable component, debugging custom JavaScript, improving a page’s visual hierarchy, and using conversion data to decide what to build next. You have the technical depth to solve problems yourself and the experience to own a website’s strategy, operations, and ongoing growth.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>At Veracode, you’ll help bring a modern enterprise Webflow website to life and lead its continued evolution as a marketing and sales engine. Working closely with our Creative Director and partners across marketing, you’ll create experiences that express our brand, help buyers understand our value, and turn interest into qualified demand.<br><strong>This is a hands-on website ownership role. Deep, recent Webflow design and development experience is required. General CMS experience or experience managing website projects alone will not meet the needs of this position.</strong> Building, troubleshooting, and improving the site yourself will be a regular part of your work.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>What you’ll own</strong></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>Hands-on Webflow development.</strong> Build and refine responsive pages, CMS collections, reusable components, templates, and interactions. Maintain clear structure and styling conventions so the site can scale without becoming difficult to manage.</li>
<li><strong>Design execution and brand quality.</strong> Translate Figma designs into polished Webflow experiences. Bring a strong eye for typography, spacing, layout, imagery, motion, and responsive behavior, working with the Creative Director to extend the brand thoughtfully.</li>
<li><strong>Website strategy and priorities.</strong> Own the roadmap and daily website function. Turn marketing and sales goals into a practical plan, balance campaign needs with longer-term improvements, and follow work through implementation and measurement.</li>
<li><strong>Migration and launch quality.</strong> Take ownership of the in-progress WordPress-to-Webflow migration alongside internal teams and agency partners. Validate CMS structure, content migration, redirects, search visibility, tracking, forms, integrations, and launch readiness, then resolve issues after launch.</li>
<li><strong>Conversion and buyer journeys.</strong> Improve how visitors discover content, understand our products, and take the next step. Develop and test improvements to navigation, landing pages, calls to action, forms, and conversion paths.</li>
<li><strong>Analytics and actionable insights.</strong> Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, search data, heatmaps, and testing tools to identify opportunities. Explain what the data means, recommend changes, implement them, and measure their effect on qualified conversions and pipeline with marketing operations.</li>
<li><strong>SEO and evolving discovery.</strong> Partner with SEO and content teams on technical SEO, site architecture, crawlability, metadata, structured data, and content discoverability across traditional and AI-powered search.</li>
<li><strong>Integrations and technical performance.</strong> Build and troubleshoot custom HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and third-party integrations. Partner with marketing operations on Marketo forms, Salesforce lead flow, and reliable tracking. Improve accessibility, page speed, and Core Web Vitals.</li>
<li><strong>AI and emerging tools.</strong> Stay active in the Webflow ecosystem and evaluate new capabilities, AI-assisted development workflows, automation, personalization, and experimentation tools. Turn promising ideas into tested improvements that serve our visitors and business.</li>
<li><strong>Enterprise website operations.</strong> Maintain publishing standards, permissions, documentation, QA, and content governance. Set clear requirements for agency partners and evaluate their work directly in Webflow and custom code.</li>
</ul>
<div><strong>What you bring</strong></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>Advanced, recent Webflow expertise.</strong> You have personally built and maintained sophisticated production websites and can explain your decisions around CMS architecture, components, responsive layouts, interactions, custom code, and maintainability.</li>
<li><strong>Experience owning large B2B websites.</strong> You have managed websites with hundreds of pages, multiple stakeholders, ongoing campaigns, and complex content and integration needs. You understand the responsibility that continues after launch.</li>
<li><strong>Strong design and development skills.</strong> Your portfolio demonstrates modern visual craft and careful execution. You can extend a design system, build new layouts, and write and debug HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.</li>
<li><strong>Migration experience.</strong> You have played a substantial hands-on role in a large website migration, including redirects, content validation, SEO preservation, integrations, and launch QA.</li>
<li><strong>Marketing and commercial judgment.</strong> You understand B2B buyer journeys, lead generation, conversion optimization, and how website decisions support marketing and sales outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>Analytical problem-solving.</strong> You can investigate a performance issue, identify a useful hypothesis, implement a change, and assess the result.</li>
<li><strong>Resourcefulness and ownership.</strong> You enjoy getting into the details, finding solutions, and shipping improvements. You also know when a problem needs a specialist or cross-functional partner.</li>
<li><strong>Clear, collaborative communication.</strong> You can explain technical decisions, recommend priorities, and work effectively with creative, content, SEO, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, and sales.</li>
</ul>
<div>Experience with Webflow Enterprise, B2B SaaS or cybersecurity websites, Marketo and Salesforce integrations, and AI-enabled website tools is especially valuable.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Show us what you’ve built and run</strong><br>Please include a portfolio with live Webflow websites and a brief explanation of your personal contribution.</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed</h3>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.</p>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Here’s our recruitment promise to you:</p>
<ul>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.</li>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware.</li>
<li class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-2">Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address.</li>
</ul>
<p class="sa-static-feature-box-section__text mb-5">If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@veracode.com">careers@veracode.com</a>&nbsp;before taking any further action.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-webflow-guru-website-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-webflow-guru-website-manager</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (USA)
</p>

<p><strong>WHO WE ARE</strong></p>
<p>Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World.</p>
<p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>Glossier is seeking a senior brand consultant to help accelerate the brand's cultural &amp; PR relevance, creator ecosystem, and breakthrough marketing initiatives during a pivotal period of growth and evolution.</p>
<p>This is not a traditional influencer marketing or PR role. We are looking for a strategic, creatively minded marketer with exceptional cultural instincts, deep relationships across creators, talent, and emerging cultural communities, and a track record of turning ambitious brand ideas into meaningful cultural moments.</p>
<p>Working closely with the CMO and cross-functional marketing leadership, this person will bring an outside-in perspective, fresh thinking, and an entrepreneurial approach to building brand heat, relevance, and advocacy.</p>
<p>The immediate focus will be an upcoming launch, alongside longer-term brand-first opportunities.</p>
<h3><strong>Key Areas of Focus</strong></h3>
<ol>
<li><strong> New Launch:&nbsp;</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>Develop and help activate an earned-first cultural amplification strategy that extends the launch beyond traditional product marketing.</li>
<li>Identify unexpected creators, talent, cultural partners, and communities that can bring the campaign to life in distinctive ways.</li>
<li>Originate high-impact brand moments, partnerships, and activations designed to drive conversation, organic advocacy, and cultural relevance.</li>
<li>Lead press strategy in partnership with external agency partners</li>
<li>Collaborate with Brand Marketing, Influencer, PR, Social, and Creative teams to integrate opportunities into the broader launch plan.</li>
</ul>
<ol>
<li><strong> Creator &amp; Cultural Ecosystem</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>Help build Glossier's approach to creators and influencers beyond transactional partnerships toward meaningful, sustained brand relationships.</li>
<li>Identify emerging cultural voices and tastemakers across beauty, fashion, art, music, lifestyle, and adjacent communities.</li>
<li>Develop opportunities for creator-led storytelling, organic advocacy, and innovative collaborations that reinforce Glossier's unique place in culture.</li>
<li>Partner with the existing influencer team to elevate strategic thinking and unlock new opportunities.</li>
</ul>
<ol>
<li><strong> Brand-First Marketing &amp; Narrative&nbsp;</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>Partner with CMO on reinforcing Brand Narrative&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborate with the CMO and Brand Marketing leadership to identify opportunities for Glossier to show up in culture beyond traditional product launches.</li>
<li>Develop compelling ideas for cultural collaborations, community initiatives, and brand platforms that deepen emotional connection with consumers.</li>
<li>Explore how Glossier's flagship stores can become meaningful cultural and community destinations through relevant partnerships and programming.</li>
<li>Bring fresh inspiration, emerging trends, and outside perspectives to challenge conventional beauty marketing approaches.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Compensation for the role will be determined based on permissible, nondiscriminatory factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and experience.</em></p>

This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignment, benefits, layoff, and termination.</em></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<div><p><strong>Our Mission:</strong></p>
<p>6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.&nbsp; We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.</p>
<p><strong>Our People:</strong></p>
<p>People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. &nbsp;Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.&nbsp; 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.&nbsp; We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>At 6sense, we're building one of the fastest-growing advertising businesses in B2B technology and looking for talented enterprise sellers to help fuel the next phase of growth.</p>
<p>This is a unique opportunity to join a rapidly expanding team within one of the industry's leading go-to-market platforms and play a direct role in shaping the future of B2B advertising. As an Enterprise Advertising Account Executive, you'll partner with enterprise organizations to help them leverage programmatic advertising, predictive intelligence, AI-driven insights, intent data, and audience activation to identify in-market buyers, accelerate pipeline, and drive measurable revenue growth.</p>
<p>This is an overlay seller role that partners closely with SaaS Account Executives to grow revenue across enterprise accounts, help customers unlock greater value from 6sense, and drive measurable pipeline and business outcomes.</p>
<p>We're looking for ambitious, driven sellers who want more than just another sales role. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-growth business, work alongside industry-leading GTM experts, and become a core contributor to one of the company’s growing revenue streams.</p>
<p>The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments and is energized by helping enterprise customers achieve measurable outcomes, growing customer relationships, driving revenue, and contributing to the continued expansion of 6sense’s advertising business.</p>
<p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of quota-carrying advertising, media, or SaaS sales experience, with experience selling into enterprise organizations.</li>
<li>Experience selling B2B programmatic advertising, digital media, audience solutions, intent data, or related advertising technology.</li>
<li>Experience working with large or complex enterprise customers.</li>
<li>Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals and successfully navigating complex sales cycles.</li>
<li>Ability to identify opportunities to grow media revenue within existing accounts by developing relationships, uncovering new use cases, and working across multiple stakeholders.</li>
<li>Strong consultative selling skills, communication skills, and business acumen.</li>
<li>Ability to articulate how advertising, audience activation, predictive intelligence, and intent data can contribute to pipeline and revenue outcomes.</li>
<li>Comfortable partnering with internal account teams and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute account strategies.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Preferred Experience</strong></p>
<p>Preferred experience includes selling advertising, media, or marketing technology solutions into enterprise organizations and engaging marketing stakeholders such as CMOs, VPs of Marketing, Advertising and Media leaders, Demand Generation teams, and ABM leaders.</p>
<p><strong>Ideal Candidate</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The ideal candidate has experience selling B2B advertising, programmatic media, AdTech, or related marketing technology solutions and understands how advertising fits within a broader B2B go-to-market strategy.</li>
<li>This individual is comfortable engaging senior marketing buyers and can connect advertising investments to pipeline creation, account engagement, revenue growth, and measurable business outcomes.</li>
<li>They have demonstrated an ability to grow customer relationships by identifying new opportunities, building strong stakeholder relationships, and expanding adoption across accounts.<br>They are curious, collaborative, motivated to learn, and excited about building their career within a rapidly growing area of 6sense.</li>
</ul>
<p>Base Salary Range: $98,760.00 - $144,848.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). <span>#Li-remote</span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span>Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: </span><a href="https://6sense.com/california-recruitment-privacy-notice/">California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy</a></span></span></span></p><div><p><strong><span>Our Benefits:</span></strong><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.</span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to </span><span><a href="mailto:jobs@6sense.com">jobs@6sense.com</a><a href="mailto:jobs@6sense.com">.</a></span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><em><span><span lang="EN-US"><span>We are aware of recruiting impersonation&nbsp;</span><span>attempts</span><span> that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. </span><span>A</span><span>ll email communications from </span><span>6sense</span><span> will originate from </span><span>the @6sense.com domain</span><span>. </span><span>We will </span><span>not initially contact you via text message and will </span><span>never request payments</span><span>. </span><span>If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to </span></span><a href="mailto:jobs@indeed.com"><span><span lang="EN-US"><span>jobs@</span><span>6sense.com</span></span></span></a><span>&nbsp;</span></span></em></p></div>

      <region>USA Only</region>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6866/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States, Remote
</p>

<p><strong>Job Title: </strong>Regional Vice President, Enterprise Sales</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> United States, Remote</p>
<p><em>This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.</em></p>
<p><strong><em>ABOUT THE COMPANY:</em></strong></p>
<p><em>Revenue is complex, and clarity is rare. Our mission at Salesloft is to transform revenue complexity into clear, decisive action for every team driving growth.</em></p>
<p><em>We’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, where humans and AI work together to make confident decisions based on real signals. Thousands of customers run on our platforms every day, which gives us Revenue Context: a view into what happens in a deal, when, and with what outcome.</em></p>
<p><em>Our vision is a future where revenue growth is predictable and the teams driving it are unstoppable. If you want to help build it, alongside people who Move as One and let Evidence over Ego guide the work, we’d love to meet you.</em></p>
<p><strong>THE OPPORTUNITY</strong><strong><br></strong>Own the results of our Enterprise Account Executive team, from quota and booking attainment to net new enterprise customers.</p>
<p>As our Regional Vice President, Enterprise Sales, you’ll lead a team of high-performing Account Executives winning net new business with enterprise customers. You’ll help those buyers see the value of Salesloft’s Predictive Revenue System and the Revenue Context behind it, and you’ll be accountable for delivering against budgeted revenue and KPI goals. In your first six months you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Lead, develop and manage your team of Enterprise Account Executives to quota and booking targets.</li>
<li>Work with Marketing, Sales Operations and Product to deliver against budgeted revenue and KPI goals.</li>
<li>Raise team productivity and efficiency through innovation, new technologies, skill set training and process improvement.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>HOW YOU’LL WORK HERE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Move as One:</strong> You’ll partner with Marketing, Sales Operations and Product to hit revenue and KPI goals, and rally direct and indirect teams around shared results.</li>
<li><strong>Evidence over Ego:</strong> You’ll run pipeline reviews and forecast from real signals, and say so when the data changes your mind.</li>
<li><strong>Lead from the Front:</strong> You’ll become a product expert who can demo and help close deals, and coach each Account Executive toward quota and their own career path.</li>
<li><strong>Customer-Inspired:</strong> You’ll help your team educate the market on the power of Salesloft and turn what enterprise buyers tell you into sharper deals and coaching.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR</strong><strong><br></strong>You’re a results-oriented, strategic leader who builds and coaches enterprise Account Executive teams to win net new business, and who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you want to learn more, do more, and become more, this is your next move.</p>
<p><strong>YOU’LL BRING</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Led new logo enterprise sales teams in a SaaS environment for 5+ years.</li>
<li>Built and motivated enterprise sales teams that grew pipeline and hit revenue targets.</li>
<li>Achieved and exceeded revenue targets, and guided teams through complex, evangelical sales cycles.</li>
<li>Brought urgency and an execution focus, with a belief in Salesloft’s mission and an approach that goes beyond relationship management.</li>
<li>Worked self-directed and resourcefully, with a strong work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile.</li>
<li>Rallied direct and indirect staff behind shared results as a team-building leader.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience hiring, developing and coaching Account Executives to consistent month-to-month results.</li>
<li>In-depth knowledge of competitors and unified communications and collaboration industry trends.</li>
<li>Experience mentoring or coaching peer leaders on a growing team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>THE TEAM</strong><strong><br></strong>Salesloft’s Sales Leadership team is tight-knit and collaborative, and works closely together to achieve success. We are experienced salespeople who are passionate about the teams we lead, our product and, above all, our customers. We stay in the weeds with our teams, making sure each member gets the training, coaching, tools and mentorship they need to grow and be successful.</p>
<p><strong><em>BENEFITS:</em></strong></p>
<p><em>Your well-being matters to us. We offer a competitive, holistic benefits program designed to support your physical, mental, and financial health at every stage of your life and career. For full details on coverage options, wellness incentives, and perks, explore our benefits overview at&nbsp; </em><a href="https://salesloftbenefits.com/"><em>https://salesloftbenefits.com/</em></a></p>
<p><em>At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.</em></p>
<p><em>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.</em></p>
