      <title>Oportun: Director, Regulatory Counsel (R14354)</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - US
</p>

<div><h2><span>Who We Are</span></h2>
<p><span>Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.</span></p></div><h2><span>The Opportunity&nbsp;</span></h2>
<p><span>This role provides dedicated legal leadership for Oportun’s multi-state licensing and regulatory examination program, regulatory tracking and reporting and serves as regulatory counsel for the Set &amp; Save product. Success in year one means establishing strong ownership of licensing, reporting, exams and regulator relationships, while providing practical legal guidance that helps the business operate and grow Set &amp; Save within an evolving regulatory landscape.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.</strong></span></p>
<h2><span>What You'll Do</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Your day-to-day</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You'll own Oportun’s multi-state licensing program, researching and determining licensing requirements across Oportun’s direct-lending and fintech bank partnership models, and leading applications, renewals, maintenance and related regulatory reporting.</span></li>
<li><span>You'll lead the licensing and regulatory examination process, including coordinating responses, gathering information from business partners, tracking obligations and issues to resolution, and working directly with state regulators as appropriate.</span></li>
<li><span>You'll monitor legal and regulatory developments affecting both areas of responsibility—including state licensing requirements and true-lender laws—and advise senior leaders, Legal and Compliance partners, and business stakeholders on risk, implications and needed action.</span></li>
<li><span>You'll review and advise on policies, procedures, marketing and operational practices; support regulatory change implementation; and identify opportunities to strengthen processes and reduce regulatory risk.</span></li>
<li><span>You'll provide leadership reporting on licensing, examinations and regulatory reporting, manage priorities across a complex portfolio, and directly manage and develop one paralegal supporting these activities.</span></li>
<li><span>You'll advise Set &amp; Save product and business owners on the application of federal and state laws and regulations, including requirements related to subscription services, privacy, UDAAP, TCPA and product marketing.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Who You Are</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>The right fit looks like this</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>You're a pragmatic regulatory lawyer who can move comfortably between detailed licensing requirements, complex regulatory questions and strategic business conversations.</span></li>
<li><span>You bring sound judgment, communicate clearly with senior leaders and regulators, and know how to turn changing legal requirements into practical action for the business.</span></li>
<li><span>You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward.</span></li>
<li><span>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>What You Bring</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>Skills &amp; experience</strong></span></p>
<p><span><strong>Required</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>12+ years of legal experience in financial services, with substantial experience advising on consumer financial services regulatory matters.</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated experience independently managing multi-state licensing processes, including NMLS filings, license applications, renewals, maintenance, regulatory reporting and related requirements.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with NMLS and state licensing requirements, strong knowledge of privacy and fintech regulatory issues, and the ability to interpret and apply federal and state consumer financial services laws.</span></li>
<li><span>Skilled in using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to improve your own productivity</span></li>
<li><span>Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree and admitted and in good standing to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span><strong>Nice to Have</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Experience working with bank partnership models, including fintech programs operated through bank partnerships.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience supporting or leading state regulatory examinations and interacting with state regulators.</span></li>
<li><span>Spanish fluency, written and verbal.&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span>Our AI Mindset</span></h2>
<h3><span>We build with AI. We lead with judgment.</span></h3>
<p><span><strong>AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.</strong></span></p>
<p><span>We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be <span><strong>open to experimenting</strong></span>, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.</span></p>
<p><span>In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when <span><strong>human judgment and AI capability work together.</strong></span></span></p>
<h2><span>Why Oportun</span></h2>
<p><span><strong>What's in it for you&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.</span></p>
<p><span>Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:</span></p>
<p><span><strong>US Benefits:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Medical, Dental &amp; Vision Insurance</span></li>
<li><span>401(k) including company match</span></li>
<li><span>Flexible PTO and Parental Leave</span></li>
<li><span>Company-paid Life &amp; Disability Insurance</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit&nbsp;<span><strong>oportun.com/careers</strong></span></span></p>
<p><span>The US salary range for this full-time position is $ 158,200 - $ 253,100</span></p>
<p><span>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects a national minimum and maximum range for new hire salaries for this position.</span></p>
<p><span>Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range that meets your criteria during the hiring process.</span></p>
<p><span>Please note that the compensation range listed in this posting reflects only the base salary for this position and does not include other compensation elements or benefits. <span>R1 #LI-REMOTE #LI-RR1</span></span></p><div><p><em><span>We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:&nbsp; <a href="https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/">https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/</a>.</span></em></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><em><span>We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).</span></em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-director-regulatory-counsel-r14354-1">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-director-regulatory-counsel-r14354-1</a></p>

      <title>Everpure: Cloud Native Architect, Portworx, (UAE)</title>
      <region>EMEA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, UAE
</p>

<div><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h2><strong>OVERVIEW</strong></h2>
<p>The Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a senior technical leader within the organization. The role owns the technical sales strategy, evaluation approach, and architectural direction for a focused set of the company's largest and most complex customers. Operating at the intersection of cloud native platforms, business outcomes, and executive decision making, the CNA guides customers through discovery, validation, and financial justification. Each engagement is expected to result in a clear technical win and a credible path to company wide adoption, positioning Everpure's product portfolio as a standard platform for cloud native data management. This is a senior individual contributor role within pre-sales, centered on influence, quality of execution, and long-term outcomes rather than transactional activity.</p>
<h3><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO...</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>The role leads the full cloud native technical sales lifecycle for opportunities, spanning discovery, architectural alignment, workshops, demonstrations, POC or POV execution, and technical wrap-up. Ownership includes defining success criteria, guiding validation, and securing the technical decision.</li>
<li>Architectural responsibility centers on Kubernetes-centric data platforms that span multiple environments, business units, and regions. Solutions are designed in collaboration with customers and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment between technical design, operational reality, and business objectives.</li>
<li>As the primary technical advisor, the CNA engages senior engineering leaders and executives through briefings, architecture workshops, and steering discussions. Close partnership with account teams and co-sellers ensures technical strategy and commercial goals remain aligned.</li>
<li>The role also contributes beyond individual opportunities by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and participating in thought leadership through customer forums, community events, and industry engagements.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE...</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Success is reflected in consistent technical wins within complex enterprise opportunities that convert into booked revenue and sustained customer momentum.</li>
<li>Technical sales cycles progress with clarity and pace, supported by strong discovery, well-defined success criteria, and disciplined validation. Customers view the CNA as a trusted technical partner rather than a transactional pre-sales resource.</li>
<li>Over time, the role contributes to deeper penetration and broader adoption within accounts, expanding footprint and strengthening long-term relationships.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU...</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>The ideal candidate brings senior-level experience in customer-facing technical roles within software or platform organizations, with strong exposure to cloud native and Kubernetes based architectures.</li>
<li>Comfort operating at high/enterprise level is essential, along with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business and financial value. Experience navigating long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise opportunities is expected.</li>
<li>Strong architectural judgment, clear communication, and the ability to collaborate effectively across sales, product, engineering, and customer-facing teams are critical to success.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>WHY THIS ROLE...</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>This is a high trust, high impact role with visibility across the company's key customers and initiatives. The scope is intentionally focused, enabling deep engagement where technical leadership materially influences outcomes.</li>
<li>For architects who want to operate at enterprise scale, shape platform adoption, and play a meaningful role in how modern data platforms are delivered, this position offers both challenge and impact.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div><p><strong>WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Innovation</strong>: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.</li>
<li><strong>Growth</strong>: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!</li>
<li><strong>Team</strong>: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.</li>
</ul>
<p>And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out <a href="http://benefits.everpuredata.com/">http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ </a>for more information.</p>
<p><strong>ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:</strong></p>
<p>Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at <a href="mailto:TA-Ops@purestorage.com">TA-Ops@purestorage.com</a> if you’re invited to an interview.</p>
<p><strong>OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:</strong></p>
<p>We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.</p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, France; Remote, Germany; Remote, Netherlands; Remote, United Kingdom
</p>

<div><p>Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.</p>
<p>This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Position Overview</strong></h3>
<p>As a member of the World Wide Strategic Accounts field team, the Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a senior technologist who owns the <strong>technical sales strategy, evaluation program, and architectural vision</strong> creating repeatable business with software opportunities with the company’s largest multinational customers. You will guide C‑level and engineering stakeholders through solution discovery, validation, and financial justification, ensuring every engagement results in a <em>technical win</em> and a clear path to enterprise‑wide adoption that delivers the customers business outcomes aligned to the project. Driving Everpure as the standard solution for delivering data-management in the WWSA Segment. Creating market penetration strategy and thought leadership across the entire theater/segment.</p>
<p>The role of a Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a multifaceted position that serves as a technical bridge between the sales, product, and engineering teams. This role is important for driving revenue growth and enhancing customer relationships by providing technical solutions for a specific set of accounts. Primarily focused on the pre-sales process, the individual in this role will engage with potential and existing customers to understand their business issues and technical hurdles related to Kubernetes. They will deliver tailored product demonstrations, respond to technical inquiries, and work with the Everpure technical field to architect solutions that integrate Everpure offerings with clients' software driven platforms. The responsibilities of the Cloud Native Architect will fall into (5) categories:</p>
<ul>
<li>Participation in Lead Generation</li>
<li>Technical Qualification</li>
<li>Solution Validation</li>
<li>Prospect to Customer Transition</li>
<li>Established Customer Satisfaction</li>
</ul>
<p>These categories will serve not only as the foundation for the role, but align with the Technical Sales Process to provide the best possible customer experience.</p>
<h3><strong>Role Scope</strong></h3>
<p><strong>Theater:</strong> Strategics (EMEA)</p>
<p><strong>Builds and leads:</strong> CNA team pooled to deliver outcomes in aligned theater Strategic accounts</p>
<p><strong>Role type:</strong> Technical Pre-sales Architect</p>
<h3><strong>Revenue alignment:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>This role is <strong>directly assigned to the Theater Strategics Portworx and Pure Storage Cloud quota</strong> and is expected to <strong>meet and exceed TCV Sales goals</strong>.</li>
<li>CNAs have <strong>primary vertical/account assignments</strong> while also being <strong>goaled on overall Theater quota performance</strong>, ensuring the team operates as a focused unit without losing shared accountability.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Focus Areas &amp; Key Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ol>
<li><strong>Technical Sales Leadership</strong></li>
<ul>
<li>Lead the full Cloud Native  technical sales process life‑cycle, Discovery, Strategy Alignment, Demo, Workshop, POC/POV, and Wrap‑Up to secure the technical decision in deals for WWSA.</li>
<li>Architect Kubernetes‑centric data platforms spanning multiple regions, clouds, and business units.</li>
<li>Own the technical sections of proposals, RFx responses, and SOWs.</li>
<li><strong>Written and verbal fluency in French as well as English is mandatory.</strong></li>
</ul>
</ol>
<p><strong>Financial &amp; Business Value Selling</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Translate technical capabilities into quantified business outcomes that resonate with executive sponsors.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Customer Engagement</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Act as the primary technical face of the company’s Cloud Native portfolio to WWSA teams; orchestrate executive briefings, architecture workshops, and steering‑committee updates. Locating and coordinating with other BU and technical sales stakeholders to deliver outcomes for customers goals.</li>
<li>Establish a cadence (weekly checkpoints, executive QBRs) aligned to the customer’s program milestones. For NNL and Expansion opportunities.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Thought Leadership</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Evangelize best practices in Cloud Native data management, platform engineering, and cost optimization through conference talks, blogs, and executive roundtables.</li>
<li>Mentor fellow Cloud Native Architect (CNA) on enterprise engagement methodology and financial value selling.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Co-Seller Collaboration and Leadership</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Interact with the WWSA Sales Global Account Manager, Lead Client Director for each strategic account to bring full Pure Storage portfolio solutions to customers</li>
<li>Enablement of Cloud Native Processes, standards and excellence.</li>
</ul>
<ol>
<li><strong>Lead Generation:</strong></li>
<ul>
<li>Attend industry events to deliver a talk or support booth staff</li>
<li>Produce technical content in the form of blogs, webinars and podcasts</li>
<li>Proactively engage contacts in professional network through LinkedIn etc</li>
<li>Support monthly Hands-on Labs</li>
<li>Attend Pure user groups</li>
<li>Organize community user groups</li>
<li>Attend co-seller Sales Engineering Manager/Directors team meetings monthly to reinforce alignment, share relevant insights, and ensure consistent technical messaging across teams.</li>
<ul>
<li>Bi-Weekly Interactions should focus on meaningful changes in opportunity status, emerging risks, customer sentiment, deal velocity, and where technical leadership can improve outcomes or remove friction.</li>
<li>Quarterly Interactions should support shared planning and reflection, including QBR/QSR collaboration, headwinds and tailwinds, participation effectiveness, and alignment on priorities for the coming quarters.</li>
</ul>
<li>Collaborate with the Co-seller Technical Sales Directors to co-sponsor targeted PX sales efforts for a small number of priority customers, engaging directly where technical leadership can materially influence outcomes.</li>
<li>Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership</li>
</ul>
<li><strong>Technical Qualification:&nbsp;</strong></li>
<ul>
<li>Review information gathered as part of Sales Stage 1</li>
<li>Discuss the opportunity with the AE to identify missing data related to BANT and/or other qualifiers.</li>
<li>Capture the project success criteria from the customer</li>
<li>Create a mapping to the desired Business Impact &amp; Outcomes</li>
<li>Review &amp; document the customers current state</li>
<li>Document technical pain points &amp; focus areas</li>
<li>Review the Assessment Scorecard to ensure alignment with the customer</li>
<li>Document the technical details and other data points in SFDC</li>
<li>Present the proposed Evaluation Program, based on information gathered from the discovery phase:</li>
<ul>
<li>An overview of their current architecture</li>
<li>Review of Pure Storage Capabilities critical to the customer and their project</li>
<li>A proposed solution including an updated architecture with Pure Storage data management and key components</li>
<li>Success criteria for the proposed solution and method to demonstrate (demo, workshop, POC/POV)</li>
</ul>
<li>Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership</li>
</ul>
<li><strong>Solution Validation:</strong></li>
<ul>
<li>Provide a capabilities demonstration to the prospect</li>
<li>Conduct an Technical Workshop with the prospect to gather deeper solution configuration parameters, discuss additional benefits, and highlight specific solution capabilities</li>
<li>Plan and coordinate a Proof Of Concept/Value that will address the customers outstanding solution parameters</li>
<li>Provide a POC/POV outcomes report that highlights the testing completed as part of the POC/POV, the relevant outcomes, and the overall business value to the customer.</li>
<li>Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership</li>
</ul>
<li><strong>Prospect to Customer Transition:</strong></li>
<ul>
<li>Introduce &amp; explain fixed scope installation services</li>
<li>Coordinate scoping of Professional Services (if needed)</li>
<li>Discuss the value of BCS (Business Critical Services) and propose</li>
<li>Discuss the value of SA (Solution Architect) Hours and propose</li>
<li>Discuss the value of a CSM (Customer Success Manager) and propose</li>
<li>Discuss customer training/certification credits and propose</li>
<li>Prepare Transition Documentation:</li>
<ul>
<li>High-level Project Plan</li>
<li>Key Milestones</li>
<li>Customer Key Technical Contacts</li>
<li>External Integration Overview</li>
<ol>
<li>Observability&nbsp;</li>
<li>Identity Management</li>
<li>Security Requirement</li>
<li>Any additional Integrations</li>
<li>5. Other dependencies to begin the project (Hardware, Platform, etc.)</li>
</ol>
</ul>
<li>Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership</li>
</ul>
<li><strong>Established Customer Satisfaction:</strong></li>
<ul>
<li>Establish a regular cadence beginning 90 days post deal close and continuing quarterly</li>
<li>Review product expansion and feature adoption as part of quarterly cadence</li>
<li>Document RFEs and usability concerns</li>
<li>Provide release updates and updated roadmaps</li>
<li>Other duties as assigned by Technical Sales Leadership</li>
</ul>
</ol>
<h3><strong>Expected Impact &amp; Success Metrics</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deliver Technical Wins that Convert to Booked Revenue</li>
<ul>
<li>80% Technical Win rate in Opportunities above Stage 2(Exception for Misaligned Deals)</li>
<li>Achieve booked sales attainment goal</li>
</ul>
<li>Accuracy and Accelerated Technical Sales Process</li>
<ul>
<li>Qualified Opportunities with TSP Cycle less than 90 days in Stage 2</li>
</ul>
<li>Technical and Financial Solution Delivery</li>
<ul>
<li>100% of Opportunities have TCO/ROI proposals with written customer approval</li>
</ul>
<li>Strengthen CX Handoff and Post Close Won Customer Relationship</li>
<ul>
<li>Measure <strong>first‑year adoption</strong> of features validated during the Technical Sales Process. Document customer progress with CSM.</li>
<li>Quarterly meets with every current customer&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<li>WWSA Penetration</li>
<ul>
<li>Pool Goal of raising Under penetrated WWSA accounts to over $1M TCV</li>
<li>Pool Goal of Pipeline in 50% of WWSA&nbsp;</li>
<li>Pool Goal of initial landing footprint in 50% of WWSA</li>
</ul>
</ul>

<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>As a Channel Development Manager (CDM) you will build &amp; manage relationships between Rubrik and key regional and national channel partners across the <strong>Desert Region (AZ, NV, NM)</strong>. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams from Rubrik’s Field Sales, Systems Engineering, Channel Marketing, Field Marketing, Alliances and Sales Operations functions, as they will be key resources for you to leverage to attain and exceed sales performance goals.<strong> </strong><br><br><strong>Day-to-Day</strong></div>

<div>CDM’s will grow the channel business in their regions through strategic partner planning, enablement, and driving sales acceleration and pipeline generation activities.<br><br><strong>Where you can make an impact:</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Driving Rubrik focus around technologies/products and increases revenues and number of Partner Initiated Deals.</li>
<li>Managing existing and the growth of Distribution and regional Channel partners that will allow better market and vertical sales/support coverage.</li>
<li>Arrange account mappings and meetings with other Rubrik staff with partners to qualify target accounts and opportunities that will lead to Partner Initiated Deals and POCs.</li>

<li>Build up strong relationships with relevant decision makers and key persons within those partners to get the right and needed attention to be set as strategic partner with them.</li>
</ul>
<div><strong>Who you are:</strong></div>
<ul>
<li>Hard working, self-driven and highly motivated individual with great team spirit</li>
<li>Strong knowledge about the Data Management / Data Protection / Storage market</li>
<li>Great relation and reputation with key partners in assigned region</li>
<li>Able to present in front of bigger audience and hosting events with and for partners and end-customers</li>
<li>Able to identify and initiate deals with partners, work on deals and close them with a partner in close sync with Rubrik Account Teams</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>Experience working with local regional channel partners or distributors</li>
<li>Effective at quarterly and yearly planning of sales activities</li>
<li>Ability to implement marketing plans and coordination of marketing activities</li>
<li>Able to identify, develop and acquire new partners</li>
<li>Display repeated success in encouraging existing partners in their sales activities</li>
<li>Strong ability to execute channel programs</li>
<li>Led sales and product trainings</li>
<li>Strong presenter on reseller and end-customer events</li>
<li>Successfully run sales activities with partners</li>
<li>Worked supporting partners in identifying opportunities and closing projects</li>
<li>Worked in teams and is used to work as a team player</li>
<li>Knows how to report numbers and activities, and do forecasting</li>
<li>Sold competitive solutions and has an extensive experience in Backup and Recovery</li>

<div><p><span><strong><span>About Blueprint</span></strong></span></p>
<p><span>Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.</span></p>
<p><span>Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.</span></p>
<p><span>At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.</span></p>
<p><strong><span>Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.</span></strong></p></div><p><span></span></p>
<h2><span><strong>In this role</strong></span></h2>
<p><span>We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Marketing Operations professional to support a global marketing organization. In this role, you will coordinate day-to-day marketing operations, manage team priorities and planning calendars, and support communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams. You will help maintain operational resources, prepare leadership presentations, coordinate recurring meetings, and ensure key business activities and deliverables remain on track. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities independently while improving processes and supporting effective team collaboration in a fast-paced environment.</span></p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Chicago, Illinois, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.siemens.com">http://www.siemens.com</a>
</p>


                                        
                    <div>
                        <div>
                                                                                                                                    
                                    <div>
                                        
                                        <div>
                                                                                            <p><strong>Position Location: </strong>This role is remote.</p><br> <p>Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?</p>&nbsp; <p>Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives.</p> <p><strong>Transform the everyday with us!</strong></p><br> <p>The<strong> Head of Sales Excellence</strong> reports directly to the Head of Sales and serves as a key member of the Sales leadership team, responsible for strengthening the effectiveness, capability and future readiness of the Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings sales organization.</p> <p>The Head of Sales Excellence brings together performance insights, execution and productivity, sales capability and incentive management to identify and lead systemic improvements that make strong sales performance more repeatable, scalable and sustainable. They are uniquely positioned to provide an integrated view of the health of Sales, anticipate emerging needs, and translate business strategy into a focused Sales Excellence agenda.</p> <br><p><strong>As the Head of Sales Excellence, you will:</strong></p> <p>Strategic Leadership</p> <ul> <li>Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of Sales, bringing insights, recommendations and an independent point of view on sales effectiveness.</li> <li>Translate Sales strategy into a focused Sales Excellence roadmap, prioritizing resources and initiatives based on business impact.</li> <li>Constructively challenge practices and investments that limit sales effectiveness or create unnecessary complexity.</li> <li>Orchestrate work across Areas, businesses and partner functions to address systemic opportunities and barriers.</li> </ul> <p>Sales Performance, Insights &amp; Future Readiness</p> <ul> <li>Establish the measures and leading indicators needed to understand sales performance, including funnel health, forecast effectiveness, conversion and productivity.</li> <li>Translate data into actionable insights, identifying trends, risks and opportunities that require leadership attention.</li> <li>Connect insights across Areas and businesses to identify systemic performance opportunities and anticipate emerging Sales needs.</li> <li>Translate One Tech Company, customer and market trends, technology and business priorities into implications for future Sales capabilities and ways of working.</li> </ul> <p>Sales Execution &amp; Productivity</p> <ul> <li>Define and continuously improve end-to-end Sales processes, standards and ways of working.</li> <li>Establish common expectations for CRM, funnel and opportunity management, and sales hygiene while allowing appropriate Area flexibility.</li> <li>Shape Sales requirements for CRM, CPQ, analytics and other sales technologies in partnership with technology owners.</li> <li>Simplify and automate Sales processes to improve seller and sales-manager productivity and reduce administrative complexity.</li> <li>Measure adoption and effectiveness of Sales processes and tools and continuously improve the seller experience.</li> <li>Introduce and leverage AI, where appropriate, to improve sales productivity</li> </ul> <p>Sales Capability</p> <ul> <li>Define the capabilities sellers and sales leaders need to execute the business strategy and support future growth.</li> <li>Translate Foundational Sales into practical capabilities, behaviors and leadership expectations.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize systemic capability gaps based on business impact.</li> <li>Partner across Sales, P&amp;O, learning functions and business stakeholders to address priority capability needs.</li> <li>Strengthen sales-leader coaching and measure sustained proficiency, behavior change and business impact.</li> </ul> <p>Sales Incentive Management</p> <ul> <li>Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the Sales Incentive Management Office.</li> <li>Lead Sales incentive governance and represent Sales priorities in cross-functional incentive decisions.</li> <li>Evaluate plan effectiveness, complexity and unintended consequences and recommend improvements.</li> <li>Partner with Sales leadership, Finance, P&amp;O and global stakeholders on plan design, implementation, administration and governance.</li> <li>Ensure appropriate controls, standards and effective communication of Sales incentive programs.</li> </ul> <p>Leadership of the Sales Excellence Function</p> <ul> <li>Set the strategy and priorities for the Sales Excellence organization and align resources to the highest-value Sales needs.</li> <li>Build, lead and develop a high-performing team with clear accountabilities and decision rights.</li> <li>Build the talent, capabilities and succession needed for the future Sales Excellence organization.</li> <li>Champion accountability, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement across the function.</li> </ul> <p>Decision Rights &amp; Accountability</p> <ul> <li>The Head of Sales Excellence owns the Sales Excellence roadmap, frameworks, standards and systemic improvement agenda, including prioritization of Sales Excellence resources and initiatives.</li> <li>The role is expected to recommend, challenge and orchestrate improvements across organizational boundaries while respecting the decision rights of Sales leaders and partner functions.</li> <li>Area Sales leaders remain accountable for leadership, execution, coaching, adoption and business results.</li> </ul> <br><p><strong>You will make an impact with these qualifications:</strong></p> <p><em>Basic Qualifications:</em></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of progressive experience in B2B Sales, Sales Excellence, Sales Operations, sales transformation or related disciplines, ideally within a complex, matrixed organization.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide sales effectiveness, transformation or capability initiatives.</li> <li>Strong understanding of end-to-end sales processes, pipeline and opportunity management, forecasting, CRM and sales performance analytics.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into practical Sales capabilities, priorities and ways of working.</li> <li>Experience using data and business insight to diagnose performance challenges and develop actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and deliver outcomes across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.</li> <li>Strong change leadership capability with demonstrated experience driving sustained adoption.</li> <li>Experience leading, developing and building high-performing teams.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.</li> <li>Ability to operate successfully in a fast-paced, highly matrixed environment.</li> <li>Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations.</li> <li>Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.</li> </ul> <p><em>Preferred Qualifications:</em></p> <ul> <li>15+ years of B2B Sales, Sales leadership, Sales Excellence, Sales Operations or related experience.</li> <li>Direct Sales or Sales leadership experience.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce CRM and modern sales technologies.</li> <li>Experience with sales incentive design, governance or management.</li> <li>Experience leading large-scale Sales capability or enterprise transformation initiatives.</li> <li>Experience operating across multiple businesses, markets or organizational boundaries.</li> <li>MBA or advanced business degree.</li> </ul> <br><p> #HQ-EREF #VeteranCareers</p> <br><p><strong>Ready to create your own journey?</strong> Join us today!</p> <br><p><strong>About Siemens</strong></p> <p>We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.&nbsp;</p> <br><p><strong>Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.&nbsp;</p> <br><p><strong>You’ll Benefit From</strong></p> <p>Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here:&nbsp;<a href="https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html">https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html</a></p> <p>The pay range for this position is $149,511 - $256,304 annually with a target incentive of 25% of the base salary. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.</p><br>

<p><strong>Title: </strong>Social Media Content Creator (Pizza industry)<br><strong>Location: </strong>Remote (candidates must be located in the United States)<br><strong>Company:&nbsp;</strong>Fortune 100 Food &amp; Beverage Manufacturing&nbsp;<em>(FuseGlobal has worked with this company for 20 years)<br></em><strong>Initial term:&nbsp;</strong>12 months (position expected to run longer)<br><strong>Schedule: </strong>Monday-Friday,<strong> </strong>35 hours per week; Up to 25% travel (once per quarter)</p>
<h1>Love Pizza? Love Creating Bold And Edgy UGC Food Content?</h1>
<h1>Let’s Cook.</h1>
<p><strong>About This Role:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are searching for a motivated self-starter with a passion for producing engaging video and static content for social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram for two of our pizza brands. The ideal candidate is confident both on and behind the camera, savvy in graphic design for the digital space, and hyper-creative. They have a sharp eye for online trends, a genuine passion for the food industry, and are fired up about pioneering new creative tactics to drive engagement with Gen Z and millennial consumers. And, most importantly, they must love pizza!</p>
<p>We're looking for candidates who have experience with making food the star of the content through prep, food style, etc (bonus points for frozen food/pizza experience!). Ideally candidates are comfortable being both on camera talent when needed, but also experience making the food the central piece to the content in an edgy and bold style.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Social Listening: Perform listening across channels to identify relevant trends and opportunities for content that allows the brands to drive engagement and relevancy.</li>
<li>Develop and Pitch Creative Ideas: Generate and present innovative concepts for both static design and lo-fi lifestyle video content to be published on TikTok and Instagram that ladder back to brands’ strategy.</li>
<li>End-to-End Content Creation: Design, produce, edit, and write post copy for all social content across TikTok and Instagram. Some content will be adapted for use in paid media campaigns, so an understanding of creative best practices for paid social is a plus.</li>
<li>Perform On-Camera: Serve as on-camera talent as needed, bringing energy and engagement to each piece of content.</li>
<li>Analyze and Optimize Performance: Track content performance metrics and share continuous optimization strategies to drive growth in engagements, reach, followers, etc.</li>
<li>Trend-Savvy: Keep up to date with the latest trends and formats in short-form content to maintain relevance and audience appeal.</li>
<li>Collaboration: Bring social-led ideas and continuously collaborate closely with the social media strategist and community manager on execution</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor’s Degree preferred, not required.</li>
<li>Minimum of 2-3 years’ experience in content creation and/or social media management representing a brand or organization.</li>
<li>Strong content creation skills that are distinctive and reflect the brand’s strategy and voice.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to think creatively and have a strong understanding of culture.</li>
<li>Proficiency with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva Pro, InShot, CapCut, social media platforms – Instagram, TikTok and video editing knowledge required.</li>
<li>Exceptional understanding of the social media landscape, including Instagram and TikTok.</li>
<li>Ability to synthesize data to identify insights to inform creative content and opportunities.</li>
<li>Exceptional communication (written and oral) skills.</li>
<li>Experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously, self-direction, and collaborating successfully with multiple stakeholders and teams.</li>
<li>A passion for food, and comfortable preparing frozen foods into content-ready meals.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience using social listening and publishing tools.</li>
<li>Previous experience working with large brands and partner agencies.</li>
<li>Familiarity with paid social media content formats and performance metrics.</li>
<li>Experience with food styling a plus.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> El Salvador

<h1>Performance Manager (Demand Gen)</h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Job Details</strong></h3>
<div><strong>Role:</strong> Performance Manager (Demand Gen)&nbsp;<br><strong>Department: </strong>Performance<br><strong>Job Location:</strong> Remote (El Salvador)</div>
<div><strong>Role Type:</strong> Full-Time, Permanent</div>
<div><strong>Hours:</strong> Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)<br><strong>Compensation:&nbsp;</strong>$47,000 - $61,000 USD + Benefits</div>
<div><strong>Role Availability: </strong>This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>About Thrive</strong></h3>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.</p>
<p>Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.</p>
<p>Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h3>
<p>This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3>
<p>Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.</p>
<p><strong>Your focus will of responsibilities will be:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Domain: </strong>Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.</li>
<ul>
<li><em>Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.</em></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>Client</strong>: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
<ul>
<li>Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>People:</strong> Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
<ul>
<li><em>Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders &amp; address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><strong>Company: </strong>Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
<ul>
<li><em>Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>In your first 30 days you’ll</strong> familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.</li>
<li><strong>In your first 60 days you’ll</strong> be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.</li>
<li><strong>In your first 90 days you’ll</strong> be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward.<br>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).</li>
<li>You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.</li>
<li>You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.</li>
<li>You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.</li>
<li>You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.</li>
<li>You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>---</p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p>
<p>Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.</p>
<p>This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.</p>
<p><strong>Competitive Total Compensation Package</strong></p>
<p>At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!</p>
<p><strong>The Use of Artificial Intelligence</strong></p>
<p>Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.</p>
<p><strong>Hiring Eligibility by Location</strong></p>
<p>While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.</p>
<p><strong>Beware of Hiring Scams</strong></p>
<p>Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).</p>
<p><em>Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.</em></p>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> El Salvador
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://thrivedigital.com">http://thrivedigital.com</a>
</p>

<h1>Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)</h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Job Details</strong></h3>
<div><strong>Role:</strong> Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)<br><strong>Department: </strong>Performance<br><strong>Job Location:</strong> Remote (El Salvador)</div>
<div><strong>Role Type:</strong> Full-Time, Permanent</div>
<div><strong>Hours:</strong> Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)<br><strong>Compensation: </strong>$41,000 - $50,000 USD + Benefits</div>
<div><strong>Role Availability: </strong>This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>About Thrive</strong></h3>
<p>Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.</p>
<p>Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.</p>
<p>Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.<br><br></p>
<h3><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h3>
<p>This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3>
<p>Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You’ll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.</p>




<p><strong><em>Working Within Our Values:</em></strong></p>
<p><em>At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.</em></p>




<p><strong>Your focus of responsibilities will be:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Domain: </strong>Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
<ul>
<li><em>Example: </em><em>You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You’re responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Client</strong>: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
<ul>
<li><em>Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. </em><em>You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>People:</strong> Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
<ul>
<li><em>Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Company:</strong> Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
<ul>
<li><em>Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>In your first 30 days you’ll</strong> familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.</li>
<li><strong>In your first 60 days you’ll</strong> be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.</li>
<li><strong>In your first 90 days you’ll</strong> be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).</li>
<li>You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.</li>
<li>You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.</li>
<li>You’ve managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.</li>
<li>You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You’ve resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.</li>
<li>You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.</li>
</ul>
<p>---</p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p>
<p>Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.</p>
<p>This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.</p>
<p><strong>Competitive Total Compensation Package</strong></p>
<p>At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!</p>
<p><strong>The Use of Artificial Intelligence</strong></p>
<p>Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.</p>
<p><strong>Hiring Eligibility by Location</strong></p>
<p>While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.</p>
<p><strong>Beware of Hiring Scams</strong></p>
<p>Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).</p>
<p><em>Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.</em></p>

Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies &amp; marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising. </p><p>Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like: </p><p></p><p>Edutainment &amp; Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV) </p><p>Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony) </p><p>Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)</p><p> Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs) </p><p>Social &amp; Community – Place to find &amp; post social updates (Lokal app) </p><p>Emotional Well-being &amp; Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt &amp; Eaze) </p><p>Astrology &amp; Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal) </p><p>Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more </p><p></p><p>Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital </p><p>About the role : </p><p>We are looking for a highly creative and skilled Video Editor to join the marketing/product team of Lokal. The candidate will leverage storytelling, editing trends, and cultural nuances to produce videos that drive engagement and impact. </p><p>Key Responsibilities:</p><p> ● Edit short-form and mid-length       <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6835/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Vancouver, Canada
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.indus.travel">https://www.indus.travel</a>
</p>

<p>Indus Travels, an established Canadian tour operator specializing in international travel, is seeking an ambitious, results-oriented <strong>Business Development Manager</strong> to drive business growth through new partnerships and sales channels.</p>
<p>This role is ideal for a proactive professional who enjoys developing new business, building meaningful relationships, and turning opportunities into successful long-term partnerships.</p>
<p>Working closely with the Managing Director and Director of Sales, the Business Development Manager will focus on expanding Indus Travels' group travel business, particularly through <strong>affinity groups, Chambers of Commerce, professional associations, clubs, community leaders, travel agencies, and other distribution partners.</strong></p>
<p>A significant part of this role involves identifying and recruiting individuals and organizations with established networks or communities who can become successful group travel partners, even if they have no previous experience organizing tours.</p>
<p>The successful candidate will take ownership of the complete business development cycle, from identifying opportunities and initiating conversations to securing partnerships and developing sustainable business relationships.</p>
<p>This is a <strong>business development and revenue-generating role</strong>, offering considerable independence, direct access to senior management, and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the company's continued growth.</p>
