      <title>Ellipsis®: Strategy Lead (market-leading GEO / SEO agency)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Warwickshire</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0077/5768/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Oxford, UK
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://getellipsis.com">https://getellipsis.com</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Ellipsis is fast becoming the market leader in "GEO" for B2B technology companies. This is a senior, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.</strong></p>
<p>The move to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative and strategic in our approach. We started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, so this has been a time for us to thrive.</p>
<p>We think we understand AI search better than almost anyone. We have our own tracking product, ~25 million AI answers to analyze (with more tracked every week), and execution end-to-end: strategy, writing, in-house design, optimization, and performance reporting.</p>
<p>Marketing teams everywhere are working out what AI search means for them, and we're one of the few firms with credible answers backed by work we've already done. That's taking us beyond B2B tech scale-ups into conversations with global retailers, banks, and consumer brands, and into work well beyond search: positioning, websites, and how buyers choose between suppliers.</p>
<p>As Strategy Lead, you'll decide what work we do for every client, and why, and shape how our latest research on AI Search feeds into this decision. You'll run the Strategy team, set the strategy for our biggest accounts yourself, and build a strategy service that holds its quality as we take on much larger projects.</p>
<h2>What you'll own</h2>
<p>You'll own strategy across Ellipsis: what we recommend for each client, in what order, and why. You’ll ensure that all work we do for clients is adapted based on our constantly growing understanding of AI Search. You'll report directly to the MD/Founder and sit on the leadership team alongside the Accounts Lead, Head of Operations, and Chief of Staff.</p>
<p>Ellipsis is at the forefront of demand as SEO turns into GEO. We are growing very quickly as buyers are deciding now whom to trust with AI search, and some are bringing us in at board level as part of their AI strategy. The firms that earn those relationships over the next year will be hard to replace.</p>
<p><strong>Our view is that AI makes yesterday's expertise cheap, so the job is to keep producing today's expertise and applying it well.</strong> Every client project should teach us more about what works, and that learning should make the next project faster and better. You’ll work closely with our Research and Development analyst to shape overall strategy, work with the team to ensure this is effectively used in practice, and ensure we have an effective feedback loop of findings &lt;&gt; implementation &lt;&gt; upskilling the team to ask better questions &lt;&gt; identifying gaps and new research.</p>
<p>Your job is to provide strategic judgement and ensure work gets done across the whole team. We have more data, tooling and ideas than any single client needs! And so your role will be identifying the leverage points across our customers; what can be done that makes performance better across the board? How can we deliver more of what our clients need? How can we build or improve automations that help us deliver more value? How do we apply findings, data, and research that actually lands?</p>
<p>You will own a couple of (high level or at risk – depending where you are most needed) clients and will need to be comfortable presenting, answering hard questions from clients, and building trust with our customers. You’ll need to be doing client work in order to understand how we do Strategy, what works, etc.; but client work is a max of 50% of the role.</p>
<p>You will work closely with other senior members of the team: our Accounts Lead owns client relationships, and you will need to collaborate closely; our Head of Operations owns capacity and process; our Founder&amp;MD leads the business and is hands-on in the weeds with clients; and we’re currently hiring a Research and Development analyst to own the research (currently this is split across the team). You’ll also need to work closely with our Writing team and Content team to ensure questions are answered, strategy is understood, and everyone is doing the right work!</p>
<p>You will lead and line manage our Strategy team (currently 3); their personal development and progression is very important and you will have the chance to shape their up-skilling and growth! Search is changing quickly, and you’ll help our ambitious team progress rapidly.</p>
<h2>How we'll measure it</h2>
<p>We want to see progress in the key metrics we and our clients care about across the board – clients recommended, and picked, more often on the buying questions that matter to them, and that showing up in their pipeline. Alongside it, we want to see progress in the whole Strategy team's output: more clients and larger programmes carried by the same people, without quality slipping, and progress / progression for the team members too. Our understanding of AI Search continues to develop, and you’ll be instrumental in ensuring the work we do for clients adapts quickly to our latest research.</p>
<p>You'll see it working day to day! Every client has a plan they can explain in a sentence! Work lands when we said it would! Strategists spend most of their week doing strategy instead of preparing for meetings about it. And client calls never need the founder to step in to answer a question or rescue a number.</p>
<h2>What you will do</h2>
<p><strong>Decide the work for every client.</strong> You own the plan for each account: what we do month on month, what we don't, and why. We have far more data and tooling than any one client needs, so most of your value is in choosing / discerning the two or three things that will move the result and saying no to the rest. You’ll need to be confident in understanding industry shifts and our latest research, and feeding that into the work we do for clients.</p>
<p><strong>Make strategy simple.</strong> Turn complicated analysis into a recommendation a client, a Content Manager or a writer can act on first time, without coming back to you. Lead with the answer, and caveat only when it changes the decision. A one-page plan the client agrees with beats a 40-slide deck they have to decode.</p>
<p><strong>Front strategy on the biggest accounts.</strong> You set the strategy for a handful of our largest, most complex accounts yourself and present it on calls with the Accounts Lead. You know the numbers, you answer the hard questions in the room, and can confidently and clearly present to senior stakeholders.</p>
<p>You'll need to be effective on these calls from your first few weeks. As the team grows, you'll do less of this day-to-day, but you'll still step in confidently whenever a client needs you.</p>
<p><strong>Build strategy that scales to enterprise.</strong> Our newer projects span several markets and, in some cases, several brands. You design strategy that holds up across all of them: one approach per portfolio, adapted locally, with quality checks that don't depend on one senior person reading everything.</p>
<p><strong>Take strategy closer to the sale.</strong> Clients increasingly bring us into positioning, website decisions and commercial performance reviews. Point our strategy at the decisions that move pipeline, using what buyers ask AI and what clients' sales teams hear to shape what clients say about themselves.</p>
<p><strong>Run the Strategy team.</strong> You lead and develop a small, growing team of strategists, and upskill them so they can handle accounts at your level. You review their plans before clients see them, coach their judgment, and protect their time. You make it easy for them to ask for help early, and you notice when they haven't. Their progression is extremely important.</p>
<p><strong>Plan to capacity. </strong>Our tooling generates more good ideas than any team can deliver. You make sure the plan fits the hours, working with Operations so what we promise each client is what Content, Writing and Design can ship on time. When something has to slip, you decide what and say so early.</p>
<p><strong>Own our playbook and how we measure it.</strong> AI search changes weekly. You decide which new findings change how we work, update the playbook, and get the team using it. You also work with our Account Lead to define success for clients -- which questions count, what counts as a recommendation, how we weight them -- so every number in a client report means something commercially.</p>
<p><strong>Shape what our tooling and agents do.</strong> Ellipsis builds its own AI search technology, and more of our delivery is moving to agents. You decide which strategy work they take on, check their output is right, and feed that back to our tech team, who build it. They own the tooling; you shape what it does for strategy.</p>
<p><strong>Back up sales. </strong>Give our sales team a sharp strategic view on prospects quickly: what they need and what we'd do first. A clear view early in the process is often what wins the work.</p>
<h2>Who we're looking for</h2>
<p>You've led strategy for a portfolio of client accounts and managed strategists doing the same. In UK agencies this is typically a Head of SEO, SEO Director or Strategy Director, with 6-10 years in organic search and at least two of those managing people. Experience with enterprise or multi-market clients is a strong advantage. We're open to other routes if you can show the judgment.</p>
<p>You'll need a strong grasp of organic search fundamentals and a working understanding of AI search. We'll teach you how we think about AI search; we can't teach judgment. That means making a clear call from imperfect data, defending it calmly, and changing it when the evidence says so.</p>
<p>This is very much a client facing role. You will be expected to interact with the clients in tandem with the Accounts Lead regularly in meetings. Having experience handling strategic conversations, managing high level discussions and presentations with clients, from junior to C-suite is essential to your success.</p>
<p>We'll be looking hard for six things:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>You simplify.</strong> You can explain a client's strategy in one sentence and defend it for ten minutes. Your decks got shorter as you got more senior.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Your priorities hold. </strong>You decide what matters this week, it stays decided, and when something will slip you say so before anyone has to ask.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You take feedback without ego.</strong> When you're wrong, you change course. At Ellipsis, continuous improvement matters more than being right! Especially as so much is changing now.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You use AI for speed, not slop or sprawl. </strong>You use Claude or ChatGPT daily, and you know the difference between work AI made faster and work AI just made bigger.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You want to drive things forward.</strong> You'd rather design a strategy service that works for 50 clients than be the hero on five.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>You're a doer. </strong>You'd rather get the right work live for a client than spend a week building a tool to do it, and you're at your best in the room, with clients and with your team.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>First 3 months</h2>
<p>Shadow the Founder and the Accounts Lead on the main accounts, review strategy, data, etc and see how we work; and meet each strategist one-to-one. Get up to speed over the first month, and be effective on client calls for those accounts from early on.</p>
<p>By day 60, you're presenting strategy on those accounts, and every client plan is sized against the team's real capacity. By day 90, you own client strategy across the business, plans land on time, you've started building a way of working that lets the team carry more clients, strategists need you less on their accounts, and the founder joins strategy calls by exception only.</p>
<p>By six months, you're hitting your stride: adapting the work we do for clients as our understanding of AI Search changes, with less of your week spent on day-to-day client strategy.</p>
<h2>How we'll test for this</h2>
<p>The paid test project gives you a real, anonymized client dataset and asks for a one-page plan for the next quarter. We're testing what you choose and what you leave out, so a longer answer won't score better. In the follow-up interview we'll give you direct feedback on it, and how you respond is part of the assessment.</p>
<h2>Compensation</h2>
<p>£60k-£65k; which we expect to review after 6-12 months.</p>
<h2>Benefits and application process</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). You'll be a full team member, involved in our team projects, work and meetups.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>We have a lot of clients in the US, so you'll need to be available for client and new business calls in the 5-7pm UK slot a couple of days a week.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Pension benchmarked to UK rates.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>28 days of paid holiday, plus 1 extra day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://ellipsis.wiki/knowledge-base/core-collaboration-hours/">Flexible working</a>, within the meeting schedule above.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Regular team retreats (~1 per year); the last was Istanbul, and before that Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid and Budapest.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Time and budget for learning and development.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><a href="https://ellipsis.wiki/knowledge-base/maternity-paternity-leave-summary/">Enhanced maternity/paternity leave</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://ellipsis.wiki/knowledge-base/sick-leave-summary/">sick pay</a>.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this. You'll have at least three video interviews, including with the Founder and members of the leadership team, and carry out the paid test project described above before we make an offer. After the test project, we'll ask for references from your previous two managers, and ask you to introduce us to them for a 10-minute call.</p>
<p>Much of <a href="https://ellipsis.wiki/">our company Wiki</a> is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through it before applying. We have a very useful&nbsp;<a href="https://ellipsis.wiki/knowledge-base/interview-and-hiring-process/">guide to our interview process</a>. It tells you what we're looking for, and reading it will make a real difference to your chances!</p>
<p>Please apply through Workable:&nbsp;<a href="https://apply.workable.com/getellipsis">apply.workable.com/getellipsis</a>. We'll decide who progresses based on the form you submit, your cover letter and your CV, so please give us a good reason to select you. Taking the time to research the role, what we do and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this.</p>
<p>Whilst we love AI and sit at the leading edge of its adoption, we want to hear from you rather than from ChatGPT. For this role especially, your application is where we want to see how you think, in your own words.</p>
<p><strong>We are hoping to fill this role by Christmas, so will review applications and start interviews on a rolling basis from the start of December. Applications will then close at the end of the day on Friday 11 December.</strong></p>
<p>We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply!</p>
<p>Ellipsis is an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ellipsis-strategy-lead-market-leading-geo-seo-agency">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ellipsis-strategy-lead-market-leading-geo-seo-agency</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Sweden (Remote)
</p>

<h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3>
<p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p>
<h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3>
<p>The Nordic team is a high-velocity, solution-oriented sales team dedicated to capturing market share and landing the region's next generation of high-growth tech companies and enterprise category leaders. From Maersk to Lovable, we win new business by showing companies how Stripe’s financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and powers international expansion.</p>
<h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2>
<p>As an Enterprise Account Executive covering new business, you’ll identify new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can execute on long-term sales strategies, engage with internal and external stakeholders, align on technical and business requirements with product teams, build value in competitive situations, lead commercial negotiations, and close deals.</p>
<h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Proactively identify, target, and acquire high-growth mid-market and enterprise prospects across the Nordic region to aggressively expand Stripe’s market footprint.</li>
<li>Build and execute creative, hyper-targeted outbound strategies to open doors with executive decision-makers</li>
<li>Lead complex sales processes from initial prospect contact and discovery through technical qualification, business case delivery, commercial negotiation, and contract execution.</li>
<li>Perform strategic account mapping across target organizations to build deep, multi-threaded relationships with business and technical leaders.</li>
<li>Collaborate with sales engineering, product, and leadership to refine outbound playbooks and elevate Stripe’s net-new acquisition strategy in the Nordics.</li>
<li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process and help shape the Stripe sales culture.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p>
<h3><strong>Minimum requirements</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>6+ years of enterprise/mid-market SaaS or fintech sales experience with a proven track record of consistently exceeding net-new ARR and new logo quotas</li>
<li>Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products</li>
<li>Proactive experience sourcing pipeline independently through cold outreach, executive networking, and strategic prospecting.</li>
<li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements.</li>
<li>A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally</li>
<li>Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders</li>
<li>Superior verbal and written communication skills in English&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<h3>Preferred requirements</h3>
<ul>
<li>Proven domain knowledge in payments (e.g, acquiring, payment orchestration, or embedded finance).</li>
<li>A track record of closing complex, seven figure+ Enterprise deals</li>
<li>Professional working proficiency in one of the Nordic languages</li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-account-executive-nordics-hunter">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-account-executive-nordics-hunter</a></p>

      <title>Typeform: Senior Paid Marketing Strategist</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; Spain (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote) 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3>
<p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1"><span>Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span></span></p>
<h3>About the role</h3>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.</p>
<p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.</p>
<h3>What you’ll do</h3>
<ul>
<li>Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.</li>
<li>Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.</li>
<li>Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.</li>
<li>Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.</li>
<li>Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.</li>
<li>Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.</li>
<li>Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.</li>
<li>Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.</li>
<li>Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.</li>
<li>Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.</li>
<li>Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.</li>
<li>Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.</li>
</ul>
<h3>What we’re looking for</h3>
<ul>
<li>Around six or more years of hands on and strategic experience in performance marketing and media buying.</li>
<li>Strong experience managing paid social and video channels, ideally including TikTok, YouTube and Meta.</li>
<li>Experience owning campaigns from initial idea and creative brief through implementation, optimisation and measurement.</li>
<li>A track record of managing six figure budgets and delivering efficient performance.</li>
<li>Experience working with MMM, incrementality testing or other measurement methods beyond traditional attribution.</li>
<li>Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign performance, conversion funnels, CAC and LTV.</li>
<li>A strong understanding of digital measurement, from tagging and attribution through to incrementality.</li>
<li>Experience developing creative and UGC assets for paid social channels.</li>
<li>The ability to balance creative thinking with strong commercial judgement.</li>
<li>Curiosity and a willingness to figure things out. When you do not know the answer, you know how to find it, whether that means speaking to the right person, digging into documentation or using AI tools.</li>
<li>Confidence working across teams and influencing partners in Creative, Product Marketing, Data and Finance.</li>
<li>Comfort operating with uncertainty. You are happy testing ideas, learning from the results and changing direction when the data tells you to.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Nice to have</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience working in SaaS or B2B lead generation.</li>
<li>Experience across sales technology or marketing technology.</li>
<li>Experience managing external agencies or digital production partners.</li>
<li>Experience with ad servers and campaign trafficking.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We <strong>move as one team</strong>, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters <strong>strong bonds</strong> grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We <strong>champion our diverse customer base</strong> by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we<strong> hold high expectations </strong>for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-paid-marketing-strategist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-senior-paid-marketing-strategist</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Collibra: Commercial Account Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Raleigh, North Carolina, USA; Remote, East Coast USA
</p>

<h3><strong>Joining Collibra’s Sales team</strong></h3>
<p>Our customers are under pressure to deliver more value from their data while building a strong foundation for AI. As an Account Manager, you’ll help them connect those priorities to their investment in Collibra.</p>
<p>You’ll own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of existing customers, with responsibility for renewals and expansion. You’ll build relationships across each account, understand what customers need to achieve, and develop a clear plan to retain and grow their business.</p>
<p>Working closely with Customer Success, Customer Engineering and other teams across Collibra, you’ll connect customer outcomes with commercial opportunities. That includes strengthening adoption of our data governance products and identifying where our AI products can address additional business needs.</p>
<h2><strong>Account Managers at Collibra are responsible for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Owning renewal and expansion sales across a portfolio of existing customers, with accountability for retention, growth and quota attainment</li>
<li>Building account plans that connect customer priorities, business outcomes, stakeholder relationships and commercial opportunities</li>
<li>Developing relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technical stakeholders and procurement teams</li>
<li>Leading discovery to understand changing customer needs and identify opportunities for additional products and broader use across the organization</li>
<li>Partnering with Customer Success to understand adoption, demonstrate value and address risks ahead of renewal</li>
<li>Managing the full commercial process, from identifying and qualifying opportunities through proposals, negotiation and close</li>
<li>Coordinating the right expertise across Collibra to address customer needs and move opportunities forward</li>
<li>Maintaining an accurate pipeline and forecast, with clear next steps, decision criteria and timelines for each opportunity</li>
<li>Bringing customer feedback to internal teams to inform how we improve our products and customer experience</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>You have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of quota-carrying account management or sales experience in enterprise software or SaaS</li>
<li>A track record of achieving renewal and expansion targets across existing customer accounts</li>
<li>Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, procurement and contract negotiations</li>
<li>Experience building account plans and developing relationships with executive decision-makers</li>
<li>The ability to lead discovery and translate technical capabilities into a clear business case</li>
<li>Experience identifying account risk and coordinating action across sales, customer success and technical teams</li>
<li>Familiarity with data management, data governance or AI, or experience learning and selling complex enterprise technology</li>
<li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant working experience</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>You are</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Curious about your customers’ businesses and persistent in understanding what matters to them</li>
<li>Commercially focused, with sound judgment about how to build lasting customer relationships</li>
<li>Proactive in identifying opportunities and addressing concerns before they become barriers to renewal or growth</li>
<li>Clear and confident in conversations with both executive and technical audiences</li>
<li>Collaborative and accountable, bringing the right people together and following through on commitments</li>
<li>Organized and disciplined in managing your accounts, pipeline and forecast</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Measures of success</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Within your first month,</strong> you will learn Collibra’s portfolio and sales process, build relationships with your account teams, and understand the priorities, renewal timelines and risks across your assigned customers.</li>
<li><strong>Within your third month,</strong> you will have actionable account plans for your priority customers, established relationships with key stakeholders, and a qualified renewal and expansion pipeline.</li>
<li><strong>Within your sixth month,</strong> you will independently manage your portfolio, demonstrate progress against your retention and expansion targets, and provide a reliable forecast supported by clear customer commitments and next steps.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits at Collibra</h3>
<p>Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about <a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits">Collibra’s benefits</a>.</p>
<p>We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei">diversity, equity, and inclusion</a> at Collibra.</p>
<p>At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.</p>
<p>With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations">Accommodations for Applicants form</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-commercial-account-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-commercial-account-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Gong.io: Enterprise+ Account Executive</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote (US)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.</p>
<p>At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.</p></div><p>We are looking for an enterprise seller who is ready to take their game to the next level. This is a <strong>hunt-to-own role</strong>: you win the logo, and you keep it. There is no handoff after the close. You own the relationship and grow the account over time. You have proven you can close enterprise deals and navigate complex buying processes. You build relationships at the executive level, create pipeline through your own initiative, and show up to every conversation with a clear point of view. You are competitive, curious, and disciplined, and you are looking for a platform where your best work will be recognized and rewarded.</p>
<h5>Responsibilities</h5>
<ul>
<li>Own a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts (4,000+ employees), driving net new logo acquisition from prospecting through close</li>
<li>Build and manage a self-sourced pipeline — the majority of your opportunities will come from your own outbound activity, creativity, and relationships</li>
<li>Navigate complex, multi-threaded sales cycles (9+ months) involving C-suite and VP-level stakeholders across Revenue, Operations, and Technology</li>
<li>Develop tailored account plans that identify key buying stakeholders, decision processes, current investments, and expansion opportunities across the account</li>
<li>Position Gong as a strategic platform — not just a product — by consulting on revenue strategy and helping customers understand the value of Revenue Intelligence at an organizational level</li>
<li>Land new accounts and expand them, building a book of business that grows in value over time through a disciplined land and expand motion</li>
<li>Partner with SDR, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success teams to build account-based strategies and deliver a seamless customer experience</li>
<li>Engage senior executives on the evolving Revenue Intelligence industry, establishing Gong as the market leader in this space</li>
<li>This role is fully remote in the US but will require travel to customers (up to 20%)</li>
</ul>
<h5>Qualifications</h5>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of closing experience, with 5+ years selling into large enterprise organizations (4,000+ employees) in a greenfield territory</li>
<li>Proven track record of exceeding $1M+ net new ARR with consistently closed six-figure deals ($250K+) in multi-stakeholder, multi-threaded sales cycles (9+ months)</li>
<li>A track record of building pipeline from the ground up — generating the majority of your opportunities through deliberate outbound effort and self-sourced activity</li>
<li>Experience winning in competitive markets — you have gone head-to-head with established alternatives and have a track record of coming out ahead</li>
<li>Experience with land and expand selling motions — you understand that the initial close is the beginning, not the finish line</li>
<li>Proven experience with MEDDPICC or a similarly effective value-based selling methodology</li>
<li>Strong business acumen with the ability to think strategically at a high level while going deep within accounts to consult on and align with global strategies</li>
<li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and present them in an engaging and approachable way</li>
<li>Consistent role tenure — you build deep expertise within a selling motion before moving on</li>
<li>Experience with Gong.io is preferred but not required</li>
</ul>
<h5>Perks &amp; Benefits</h5>
<ul>
<li>We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family's needs.</li>
<li>Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.</li>
<li>Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.</li>
<li>401(k) program to help you invest in your future.</li>
<li>Education &amp; learning stipend for personal growth and development.</li>
<li>Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.</li>
<li>Paid parental leave to support you and your family.</li>
<li>Company-wide recharge days each quarter.</li>
<li>Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual OTE for this position is $270,000 – $330,000 USD.</p>
<p>Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.</p>
<p>We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect.</p>
<p><strong>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored.</strong></p>
<hr>
<p><em>Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.</em></p>
<p><em>To review Gong's privacy policy, visit <a href="https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/">https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/</a> for more details.</em></p>

      <title>Legion: Revenue Enablement Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, United States
</p>

<p><strong>JOB OVERVIEW</strong></p>
<p>Legion builds AI-powered workforce management software for enterprises that run hourly workforces in retail, hospitality, facilities management, and manufacturing.</p>
<p>We're hiring a Revenue Enablement Manager to own how our go-to-market team learns, sells, and improves. You'll build onboarding that shortens ramp, run the enablement cadence, launch new products to the field, and reinforce a consistent sales methodology. You'll measure all of it against productivity, win rate, and pipeline outcomes.</p>
<p>This is a builder role. You'll work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and RevOps, and you'll be the field's single point of contact for what to know and how to sell it.</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES</strong></p>
<p>Onboarding and ramp</p>
<ul>
<li>Own new-hire onboarding for AEs, AMs, SDRs, and SCs, with clear milestones and visibility into ramp progress</li>
<li>Build role-based certifications that confirm readiness before reps run deals on their own</li>
</ul>
<p>Curriculum and training</p>
<ul>
<li>Design and deliver curriculum across five domains: company, function, industry, product, and selling skills</li>
<li>Map content to how reps work: manage, prospect, present, collaborate, sell, and deliver</li>
<li>Run the bi-weekly enablement session and feed the enablement segment of weekly team meetings</li>
</ul>
<p>Sales methodology and process</p>
<ul>
<li>Reinforce a consistent methodology and drive adherence to the sales process</li>
<li>Equip Account Executives for deal and forecast reviews</li>
<li>Build skills in prospecting</li>
</ul>
<p>Content, playbooks, and knowledge</p>
<ul>
<li>Build and maintain playbooks, competitive intelligence, and messaging by industry and persona</li>
<li>Own knowledge management so the field finds the right content fast</li>
</ul>
<p>Partners and the wider GTM team</p>
<ul>
<li>Enable partners on co-sell and “Better Together” storytelling</li>
<li>Extend enablement to CSMs, delivery, and support where it drives customer outcomes</li>
</ul>
<p>Tools and measurement</p>
<ul>
<li>Drive adoption and ROI of the sales tool stack, partnering with RevOps</li>
<li>Report enablement impact against ramp time, quota attainment, win rate, sales cycle, and pipeline progression</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in B2B SaaS, with 3+ in sales or revenue enablement</li>
<li>Experience enabling enterprise sales teams on complex, multi-stakeholder deals</li>
<li>Working knowledge of a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC</li>
<li>Strong curriculum design and facilitation skills, live and virtual</li>
<li>Comfort with Salesforce and enablement or conversation-intelligence platforms</li>
<li>Ability to tie programs to revenue metrics and report on them</li>
<li>Clear writing and the credibility to coach AEs and work with executives</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Background in workforce management, HCM, or software sold into retail, hospitality, facilities management, or manufacturing</li>
<li>Prior quota-carrying or solution consulting experience</li>
<li>Experience enabling channel or alliance partners</li>
<li>Experience running product launches with Product Marketing</li>
<li>Familiarity with AI products and helping sellers position them</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>COMPENSATION &amp; BENEFITS</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Salary Range:&nbsp;</em>$130,000 - $150,000<em> + Bonus (if applicable) + </em><em>Stock Equity</em></strong></p>
<p>At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Benefits include, but are not limited to:</p>
<ul>
<li>$0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment</li>
<li>401k plan</li>
<li>Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays</li>
<li>Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
<li>Equity&nbsp;</li>
<li>Monthly Wellness Reimbursement</li>
<li>Monthly Lunch on Legion</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>ABOUT LEGION</strong></h3>
<p>Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.</p>
<p>Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.&nbsp;</p>
<p>If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.</p>
<h3><strong>BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p>There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees.&nbsp; Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.</p>
<p>For more information, visit<a href="https://legion.co"> https://legion.co</a>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY</strong></h3>
<p>Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.</p>
<h3><strong>DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION</strong></h3>
<p>For individuals with disabilities who need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email recruiting@legion.co&nbsp;</p>
<p>We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @<a href="http://legion.co">legion.co</a> domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span><em>Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.</em></span></p>
<h2>How We Determine What We Pay</h2>
<p><em>As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.</em></p>
<h1>Job Applicant Privacy Policy</h1>
<p>This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“<strong>Policy</strong>”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“<strong>Legion</strong>”, “<strong>we</strong>”, “<strong>us</strong>” and “<strong>our</strong>”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.</p>
<p>This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the&nbsp;<a href="https://legion.co/privacy-policy/">Legion Privacy Policy</a>&nbsp;applies.</p>
<div class="section-anchor position-relative"></div>
<ol class="ol-bold">
<li>
<p><strong>Types of Personal Information We Handle</strong></p>
<p>We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Identification and contact information, and related identifiers</strong>&nbsp;such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts.</li>
<li><strong>Professional or employment-related information,</strong>&nbsp;including:
<ul>
<li><strong>Recruitment, employment, or engagement information</strong>&nbsp;such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver’s licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references.</li>
<li><strong>Career information</strong>&nbsp;such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Education Information</strong>&nbsp;such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information.</li>
<li><strong>Legally protected classification information</strong>&nbsp;such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history.</li>
<li><strong>Other information</strong>&nbsp;such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="mt-3">
<p><strong>How We Use Personal Information</strong></p>
<p>We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers’ business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions.</p>
</li>
<li class="mt-3">
<p><strong>With Whom We Share Personal Information</strong></p>
<p>We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable):</p>
<ul>

<li><strong>Business Transaction Purposes</strong>: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="mt-3"><strong>How to Contact Us About this Policy</strong>&nbsp;– If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact <a href="mailto:privacy@legion.co">privacy@legion.co</a>.</li>
</ol></div>

      <title>Upgrade: Demand Generation Manager, Auto</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Atlanta; San Francisco; United States (Remote)
</p>

<p></p>
<p><span><em>Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.</em></span></p>
<p><span><em>We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.&nbsp;</em></span></p>
<p><span><em>We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.</em></span></p>
<p></p>
<hr>
<p><span>Upgrade is a fintech company focused on providing affordable and responsible credit to everyday consumers. Our Auto business is growing, and demand generation is how we reach the customers, and partners who power that growth. </span><span>As a <strong>Demand Generation Manager</strong>, you will own the day-to-day strategy and execution that drive new business across Auto, spanning paid media, email, content, events, and sales-led campaigns. You will build the campaigns, nurture journeys, and reporting needed to drive measurable pipeline growth and revenue impact. This is a highly visible role for someone who is analytical, comfortable owning cross-functional work end to end, and energized by building and scaling a marketing foundation.</span></p>
<p><span>You will work in close partnership with Sales, Partnerships, Sales Enablement, and Customer Success, and alongside Lifecycle, Product Marketing, Design, Legal &amp; Compliance, and Data partners, so that acquisition efforts line up with onboarding, engagement, and retention. You will sit at the intersection of growth and marketing execution, working directly with the teams closest to revenue, with real ownership and the ability to shape how Upgrade shows up in the Automotive market.</span></p>
<h2><span><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li><span>Own demand generation strategy for Auto across PPC, email, content, events, and web</span></li>
<li><span>Refine the GTM, messaging, and value proposition for each business, aligned to ICP and buyer personas</span></li>
<li><span>Optimize lead acquisition, conversion, and pipeline velocity, and manage and improve MQL quality and performance</span></li>
<li><span>Partner with Account Executives, Partnerships, and Sales leadership to brainstorm, align on, and launch campaigns, including sales incentives, competitions, and referral programs</span></li>
<li><span>Refine nurture journeys and build segmentation strategies in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach</span></li>
<li><span>Lead campaigns end to end (strategy, execution, measurement), defining success metrics and setting a clear reporting cadence</span></li>
<li><span>Work cross-functionally to move campaigns forward: Design tickets within the sprint cycle, Lifecycle requests, and early Legal, Compliance, and bank review</span></li>
<li><span>Oversee website strategy and optimization, ensuring alignment with campaign messaging, ICP targeting, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization</span></li>
<li><span>Build performance dashboards and attribution reporting tied to revenue outcomes, working with Data and Sales Ops partners across Heap, Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Tableau</span></li>
<li><span>Manage the demand generation budget and track program spend against results</span></li>
<li><span>Continuously test and optimize campaigns for efficiency and effectiveness</span></li>
<li><span>Use AI-enabled tools when helpful to streamline content development, summarize insights, and improve workflow efficiency, so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span><strong>What We Look For:</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li><span>5-7+ years of B2B or demand generation marketing experience, ideally within fintech, consumer lending, auto finance focused products.</span></li>
<li><span>Proven experience leading demand generation and pipeline growth, including paid digital channels such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.</span></li>
<li><span>Proficiency in Salesforce and HubSpot.</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated skills or projects with claude, chatgpt, co-pilot or any other AI tool.</span></li>
<li><span>Data-driven mindset with strong analytical skills, including experience with attribution, funnel reporting, and dashboards in Tableau (or a comparable BI tool).</span></li>
<li><span>Track record of designing and analyzing test-and-learn experiments (e.g., A/B tests) to optimize campaign performance.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong understanding of integrated marketing strategy, with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans and messaging.</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting results and recommendations to senior stakeholders.</span></li>
<li><span>Self-starter who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cross-functional workstreams in a fast-paced environment.</span></li>
<li><span>BA/BS degree in business or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.</span></li>
<li><span>Curiosity and adaptability with AI-enabled tools, which are already part of how work gets done across our organization and will continue to expand over time.</span></li>
</ul>
<h2><span><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li><span>Experience with Outreach, Heap, or Google Analytics.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience partnering with Legal and Compliance on marketing review in a regulated environment.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience with partner, referral, or sales-incentive programs.</span></li>
<li><span>Familiarity with website strategy, SEO best practices, and conversion rate optimization.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span></span></p>
<h2><span><strong>What We Offer You:&nbsp;</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li><span>Competitive salary and stock option plan</span></li>
<li><span>100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Flexible PTO</span></li>
<li><span>Opportunities for professional growth and development&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Paid parental leave</span></li>
<li><span>Health &amp; wellness initiatives&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>#BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid</strong></span></p>
<p><span><strong><em>For California residents:</em></strong><a href="https://www.upgrade.com/PRIVACY_POLICY_CALIFORNIA_EMPLOYEE/"><strong><em> </em></strong><strong><em>Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy</em></strong></a><strong><em> describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants.</em></strong></span></p>
<hr>
<p><span><strong>Environmental &amp; Working Conditions</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. </span><span>Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.&nbsp;</span><span>The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need. J</span><span>ob duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.&nbsp;</span><span>Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. </span><span>Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.</span></p>
<p><span><em>Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws. </em></span><span><em>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</em></span></p>
<p><span><em>Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.</em></span></p>
<p><span></span></p>
<p><span></span></p>

      <title>Braze: Account Manager, Scale</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - Australia
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.</p>
<p>We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.</p>
<p>To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.</p>
<p>Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.</p>
<p>If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.</p></div><h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></h3>
<p><strong>Team Overview:</strong><strong><br></strong>The Braze ANZ Account Management team drives commercial growth and retention across our existing customer base. In this role you will own a portfolio of established mid market customers, operating as a commercial partner who helps them mature their use of Braze and convert that maturity into growth. Success comes from breadth and rhythm, knowing your book well enough to spot where value is stalling and where the next opportunity sits.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own a portfolio of mid market customers across ANZ, with full accountability for renewal, upsell and cross sell</li>
<li>Prioritise ruthlessly across the book, directing time and executive attention to the accounts where growth or risk is most material</li>
<li>Generate your own expansion pipeline through usage analysis, whitespace mapping and maturity assessment</li>
<li>Build durable relationships with marketing, CRM and digital leadership, and multi thread beyond a single champion</li>
<li>Partner with Customer Success to run account plans and business reviews that connect Braze performance to customer outcomes</li>
<li>Develop tailored commercial proposals and lead renewal and expansion negotiations to close</li>
<li>Identify retention risk early using adoption signals, account health and stakeholder change</li>
<li>Achieve and exceed quarterly expansion and retention targets</li>
<li>Maintain accurate forecasts with a clear view of deal progression, risk and timing</li>
<li>Build repeatable plays that hold across a larger book rather than one off approaches</li>
<li>Lead customer meetings virtually and in person, with regular domestic and occasional international travel</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></h3>
<p>You are a commercially minded Account Manager who enjoys running a busy book and knows where the growth is hiding in it. You have a proven record of expanding SaaS accounts, you are comfortable owning a number in a fast moving environment, and you work well across functions..</p>
<p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of progressive experience in SaaS sales, account management or similar, with demonstrated success driving revenue growth and retention</li>
<li>Minimum 3 years owning SaaS customer relationships end to end, including accountability for renewals, upsell and expansion</li>
<li>Experience managing portfolios with annual contract values from 150K to 500K</li>
<li>Proven track record of consistently exceeding commercial targets in fast paced, high growth environments</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to build relationships and sell value to senior marketing, CRM and digital stakeholders</li>
<li>Experience in the Martech, Adtech or broader CX space is highly regarded, including CRM, marketing automation, customer analytics, email or content marketing</li>
<li>Excellent collaborator with a proven ability to work across Customer Success, Services, Marketing, Partnerships and Sales</li>
<li>Exceptional communicator, a confident presenter, persuasive writer and trusted relationship builder with strong verbal, written and numerical fluency</li>
<li>Strong organisational and time management skills, comfortable managing competing priorities across a broad portfolio</li>
<li>Self starter with a high level of accountability, drive and commercial acumen</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p>
<p><em>Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at <a href="https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section">here</a>. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.</em></p>
<p>From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation that may include equity</li>
<li>Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability</li>
<li>Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend</li>
<li>A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation</li>
<li>Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching</li>
<li>Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze</li>
<li>Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>ABOUT BRAZE</strong></p>
<p>Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.</p>
<p>The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.</p>
<p>Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.</p>
<p>The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.</p>
<p><strong>BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER</strong></p>
<p>At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.</p>
<p>Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.</p>
<p>We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you</p>
<p><strong>OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS</strong></p>
<p>At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.</p>
<p>This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.</p>
<p>Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:</p>
<ul>
<li>To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.</li>
<li>To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a <strong>retroactive</strong> manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at <a href="talentdata.privacy@braze.com">talentdata.privacy@braze.com</a>.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please contact us at <a href="talentdata.privacy@braze.com">talentdata.privacy@braze.com</a> with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out <a href="https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire">this page</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)</strong></p>
<p>Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.&nbsp;</p>
<p>To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at <a href="talentdata.privacy@braze.com">talentdata.privacy@braze.com</a> promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available <a href="https://www.braze.com/company/legal/bias-audit-candidates">here</a>.</p>
<p><em>Please see our</em><a href="https://www.braze.com/company/legal/privacy-policy-job-candidates"> Candidate </a><em><a href="https://www.braze.com/company/legal/privacy-policy-job-candidates">Privacy Policy</a> for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.<br></em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/braze-account-manager-scale">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/braze-account-manager-scale</a></p>
</description>

<div class="content-intro"><p>At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.</p>
