If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.</p></div><p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p>
<p>The Enterprise BDR in the LATAM team is the engine behind Braze’s large company growth. You’ll partner with Account Executives to identify, engage, and qualify prospects at companies with 5,000+ employees, helping leading B2C brands discover how Braze can transform their customer engagement.</p>
<p>This is a high-impact role based in Mexico City. While initially remote, this position may transition to a hybrid work model in the future. You’ll blend volume-driven outreach with personalized, consultative prospecting, researching strategic accounts, crafting relevant messaging, and creating opportunities that directly fuel Braze’s regional pipeline across LATAM.</p>
<p><strong>Main responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Enterprise Outbound Prospecting:</strong> Prospect into Enterprise (5,000+ employees) target accounts across key industries such as retail, media, fintech, and travel.</li>
<li><strong>Pipeline &amp; Meeting Generation:</strong> Generate qualified meetings for the Enterprise AE team through multi-channel outbound outreach (email, phone, LinkedIn, video).</li>
<li><strong>Account Research:</strong> Research accounts to identify pain points around customer engagement, cross-channel messaging, and data activation.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with Account Executives and marketing to develop territory strategies and prioritize high-potential accounts across the region.</li>
<li><strong>CRM &amp; Data Hygiene:</strong> Maintain accurate activity, prospecting notes, and pipeline data in Salesforce.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Consistently hitting or exceeding monthly qualified meeting and pipeline targets.</li>
<li>Building a repeatable outreach motion that balances efficiency, volume, and thoughtful personalization.</li>
<li>Developing strong product and industry knowledge to speak credibly about Braze’s value proposition to executive prospects.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Prospecting &amp; Sales Background:</strong> Proven track record in outbound prospecting within sales, business development, or high-activity customer-facing roles. Experience in Enterprise SaaS or complex sales environments is a plus.</li>
<li><strong>Location &amp; Work Flexibility:</strong> Based in or near Mexico City, comfortable working remotely initially with openness to transitioning to a hybrid setup.</li>
<li><strong>Language Proficiency:</strong> Fluency in both Spanish and English (written and verbal) is required to engage prospects and collaborate with global stakeholders. Fluency in Portuguese is a plus.</li>
<li><strong>Self-Discipline &amp; Autonomy:</strong> Highly organized and self-motivated, with the ability to manage high-volume outreach, prioritize tasks, and maintain strong performance across remote/hybrid environments.</li>
<li><strong>Communication Skills:</strong> Strong written and verbal communication; ability to craft compelling, concise outreach and articulate value clearly.</li>
<li><strong>Coachability &amp; Growth Mindset:</strong> Eager to learn, open to feedback, and driven to iterate quickly to improve sales techniques.</li>
<li><strong>Resilience:</strong> Comfortable with rejection, persistent, and motivated by ambitious targets and healthy competition.</li>
<li><strong>Domain &amp; Tool Familiarity:</strong> Genuine curiosity in MarTech, SaaS, and customer engagement. Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar sales tech is preferred.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>WHY JOIN</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Clear Career Path:</strong> Structured progression toward Senior BDR and Account Executive (AE) roles with dedicated leadership coaching and enablement.</li>
<li><strong>High Impact &amp; Visibility:</strong> Partner directly with regional AEs and GTM leadership; your contribution directly impacts Braze’s growth in LATAM.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborative Culture:</strong> Inclusive, supportive team environment focused on shared wins, continuous learning, and peer development.</li>
<li><strong>Competitive Compensation:</strong> Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied directly to qualified meetings and pipeline generation.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Mexico City (Remote with potential future transition to Hybrid)</p>
<p>#LI-Remote #LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p>
<p><em>Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at <a href="https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section">here</a>. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.</em></p>
<p>From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:</p>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation that may include equity</li>
<li>Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability</li>
<li>Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave</li>
<li>Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend</li>
<li>A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation</li>
<li>Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching</li>
<li>Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze</li>
<li>Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>ABOUT BRAZE</strong></p>
<p>Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.</p>
<p>The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.</p>
<p>Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.</p>
<p>The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.</p>
<p><strong>BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER</strong></p>
<p>At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.</p>
<p>Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.</p>
<p>We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you</p>
<p><strong>OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS</strong></p>
<p>At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.</p>
<p>This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.</p>
<p>Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:</p>

Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.</li>
<li>To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a <strong>retroactive</strong> manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at <a href="talentdata.privacy@braze.com">talentdata.privacy@braze.com</a>.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>Please contact us at <a href="talentdata.privacy@braze.com">talentdata.privacy@braze.com</a> with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out <a href="https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire">this page</a>.</p>

<p>To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available <a href="https://www.braze.com/company/legal/bias-audit-candidates">here</a>.</p>
<p><em>Please see our</em><a href="https://www.braze.com/company/legal/privacy-policy-job-candidates"> Candidate </a><em><a href="https://www.braze.com/company/legal/privacy-policy-job-candidates">Privacy Policy</a> for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.<br></em></p></div>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Chicago | Salt Lake City | Remote (US)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.</p>
<p>At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.</p></div><p>Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.</p>
<p>At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.</p>
<p><br><strong>About Revenue Foundations</strong></p>
<p>Revenue Foundations is a new team at Gong with one mission: accelerate new-logo acquisition by helping more companies turn customer conversations into business growth. Gong’s call intelligence captures, understands, and delivers insight from every interaction—helping revenue teams see what’s happening in their deals, coach their people, and act on what customers are telling them. Our job is to meet buyers where they are and find the fastest path for them to realize that value.</p>
<p>This is a 0-to-1 build, a startup inside Gong. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Foundations and the leadership team, helping shape the playbook rather than simply run it. As AI changes how companies sell, buy, and operate, you’ll advise customers on how Gong’s call intelligence, and the agents and AI tools that now draw on it, can become part of their broader AI workflows. Some of the motion isn’t written yet, and that’s the point. You’ll experiment, iterate, and turn what works into the playbook the rest of Gong runs next.</p>
<p><strong>The Role</strong></p>
<p>As a Commercial Account Executive on the Revenue Foundations team, you’ll be a pure hunter. You’ll own the full sales cycle, with 100% focus on outbound prospecting and closing net-new Gong customers. You’ll sell across personas and verticals, so strong business acumen, sales fundamentals, and the ability to deliver a compelling, pain-based demo are critical. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you do need to understand call intelligence, AI, and MCP well enough to have credible conversations about how Gong helps revenue teams turn customer interactions into insight, action, and results—and how it can fit into a prospect’s broader AI initiatives.</p>
<p><strong>This role is for you if</strong> you’re a hungry, self-driven prospector who builds your own pipeline and is excited to create demand for a new way of working with customer conversations. You’re energized by change, naturally curious, and motivated to win. You want real coaching because you’re building toward something, and you’re excited to help discover and refine the motion that will scale.</p>
<p><strong>This role is not for you if</strong> you need a finished playbook, are averse to change, rely on others to advance your deals, or aren’t self-motivated.</p>
<h5><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h5>
<ul>
<li>Source and manage a pipeline of net-new prospects through proactive outbound prospecting, from lead to close focused on Gong Foundations.</li>
<li>Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects.</li>
<li>Build relationships with net-new logos to drive them through the sales cycle to close</li>
<li>Maintain weekly sales forecast and achieve new business quota quarterly.</li>
<li>Run and implement 7 to 10 day pilot program.</li>
</ul>
<h5><strong>QUALIFICATIONS&nbsp;</strong></h5>
<ul>
<li>Located in the Lehi area within a commutable distance to our office, with the ability to work our hybrid schedule of 3 days/week in-office.</li>
<li>6 months+ of relevant new business/net-new logo closing experience for Commercial.</li>
<li>Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience preferred.</li>
<li>Strong previous outbound prospecting experience — you're comfortable building your own pipeline, not just working inbound leads.</li>
<li>Demonstrated success in achieving new business sales goals (President's Club, Rep of the Year, etc.)</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li>
<li>Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.</li>
<li>Comfortable selling to VP and C-Suite executives, navigating multiple decision makers within an organization — experience selling to sales leaders specifically is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<h5><strong>PERKS &amp; BENEFITS&nbsp;</strong></h5>
<ul>
<li>We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.</li>
<li>Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.</li>
<li>Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.</li>
<li>401(k) program to help you invest in your future.</li>
<li>Education &amp; learning stipend for personal growth and development.</li>
<li>Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend.</li>
<li>Paid parental leave to support you and your family.</li>
<li>Company-wide recharge days each quarter.</li>
<li>Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>The annual OTE for this position is $130,000.</strong></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gong-io-commercial-account-executive-foundations">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gong-io-commercial-account-executive-foundations</a></p>
</description>

<div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2>
<p><span>Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.</span></p>
<p><span>Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.</span></p></div><div>
<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>As an Account Executive, Commercial, you’ll win net-new logos by selling Vercel’s frontend cloud to developers and engineering leaders at digital-native companies at the leading edge of modern web and AI, tying it to outcomes such as speed, conversion, productivity, and reliability. You’ll run full-cycle deals alongside Solutions Architects, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success, helping teams adopt Vercel and expand as they scale, and help shape how Vercel goes to market as the Commercial segment grows. Success means consistent new logo acquisition and hitting your revenue and pipeline targets. We prefer to grow talent internally, with a path to larger scopes and leadership over time.</p>
<p>For candidates in Berlin, this is a hybrid role with 3 in-office days per week in our Berlin hub.&nbsp;</p>
<h2>What you'll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Own a net-new revenue number by building and progressing pipeline from first meeting through close</li>
<li>Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, multi-threading, and account research, and partner with your BDR on top-of-funnel</li>
<li>Run full-cycle deals with Solutions Architects and Customer Success: discovery, qualification, deal strategy, technical evaluation, stakeholder alignment, negotiation, and close</li>
<li>Build and execute territory and account plans that drive consistent new logo acquisition</li>
<li>Lead a weekly forecast, keep Salesforce stages, next steps, and close plans accurate, and track leading indicators such as meetings and pipeline creation</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you need</h2>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience</li>
<li>Track record of generating your own pipeline through outbound prospecting</li>
<li>Closed net-new customers, from discovery through negotiation</li>
<li>Sold to technical buyers such as developers and engineering leaders</li>
</ul>
<h2>Bonus if you</h2>
<ul>
<li>Have sold into teams at Mid-Enterprise level</li>
<li>Have sales experience at a product-led growth (PLG) company</li>
<li>Have hands-on frontend development experience</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Benefits:</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation package, including equity.</li>
<li>Inclusive Healthcare Package.</li>
<li>Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off.</li>
<li>We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.</li>

      <title>Jumio: Sales Solutions Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> USA (remote)
</p>

<p><strong>Role Purpose:</strong></p>
<p>Solution Engineers help customers understand how to get the best out of Jumio’s products. They also provide technical and functional expertise across our suite of online ID and Identity verification, KYC, AML, user authentication and Risk Management solutions to colleagues in sales, product, engineering, account management and marketing.</p>
<p>You’ll be an integral part of our growing global sales team, interacting with a broad and interesting range of internal and external stakeholders.</p>
<p><strong>Role Value:</strong></p>
<p>Increasing pipeline conversion rates, helping to grow revenue and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction are just some of the high value outputs from Solution Engineers.</p>
<p>You will play a major role in improving and expanding existing processes such as, pre-sales technical presentations, product testing, integration and customer onboarding. You are the integration expert for how Jumio solutions can add value to the customer’s user journey, specifically through web and different API channels. Your performance has a direct impact on the overall sales team effectiveness. Ultimately it’s about helping to drive Jumio’s continued growth and success while growing your own career.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Example Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Consult prospective clients by asking investigative questions to understand the intended use-case and propose recommendation(s) on how best to implement Jumio’s solution to meet their requirements</li>
<li>Create and lead customer facing technical presentations</li>
<li>Aid in the completion of solution presentations, RFPs and RFIs</li>
<li>Take lead in proof-of-concept during pre-sale, cross-selling activity</li>
<li>Manage the onboarding of customers to Jumio from kick-off meeting with business and project teams to Go Live</li>
<li>Provide technical and functional subject matter expertise to our external customers as well as Jumio Account Executive and Account Management team</li>
<li>Work closely with marketing, product management, and engineering business units to maintain and improve the technical and functional knowledge of existing and new product features</li>
<li>Create and deliver customised demos on different platforms (web, iOS, Android) to showcase Jumio products</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Experience and Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Proven professional experience of SaaS Enterprise level experience in Technical Pre-sales, Technical Implementation Management or Technical Consulting role, including exposure to complex environments</li>
<li>Strong customer facing experience, used to interacting with all levels and departments across enterprise customers&nbsp;</li>
<li>Strong presentation and customer facing skills combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills</li>
<li>In depth technical knowledge, including web and mobile programming or scripting languages (including, but not limited to JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift), computer operating systems (Unix, Linux, Windows, Mac), mobile operating systems (iOS, Android, React-Native, Cordova)</li>
<li>Comfortable in a rapid growth environment with high degrees of autonomy and ambiguity - used to navigating the challenges and opportunities in a start-up or scale-up business</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><span><strong>: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>
<p><strong>About Jumio:</strong></p>
<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>
<p><strong>Applicant Data Privacy </strong></p>
<p>We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s <a href="https://www.jumio.com/legal-information/privacy-notices/candidate-notice/">Applicant Privacy Notice.</a> If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to <a href="mailto:privacy@jumio.com">privacy@jumio.com</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-sales-solutions-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-sales-solutions-engineer</a></p>
</description>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.</p>
<p>We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.</p></div><p><strong>Why You’ll Love This Role</strong></p>
<p>We are looking for a Commercial Sales Representative who is ambitious, adaptable, and enthusiastic. A successful Commercial Sales Rep at Cribl will clearly articulate our value proposition and execute on proven sales processes. Most importantly, we put our customers first, always. We are looking for a rep who will do just that.</p>
<p><strong>Please note, this is a remote position based out Texas. We are looking for candidates that live local to the territory.</strong></p>
<p><strong><br>As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...</strong></p>

<li>Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity</li>

<li>Articulate our value proposition up and down the organization, from engineer up to CxO</li>

<li>We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><br>If You’ve Got It - We Want It</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2+ year of experience in a full cycle SaaS sales role and a track record of achieving targets in a lead-generation role</li>
<li>Experience developing pipeline and opening new accounts, including lead generation</li>
<li>A successful track record of overachievement annually</li>
<li>Experience navigating complex sales cycles&nbsp;</li>
<li>Experience selling a SaaS product to Security and IT personas</li>
<li>Experience selling through security channel partners&nbsp;</li>
<li>Success building a territory from scratch&nbsp;</li>
<li>Background using MEDDIC&nbsp;</li>
<li>Accountability &amp; ownership: holding yourself and others accountable to meet commitments</li>
<li>Resourcefulness: securing resources and managing scarcity effectively and creatively</li>

</ul>

For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.<br><br>In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$75,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$90,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Bring Your Whole Self<br></strong><span><br></span><span>Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better.       <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.huntress.com/demo">https://www.huntress.com/demo</a>
</p>

<div><p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What We Do:</strong></p>
<p>Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.</p>
<p>Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.</p>
<p>Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director, Reseller Sales</p>
<p><strong>Location:&nbsp; </strong>Must live in the Southwest US.&nbsp; IE: SoCal, Nevada or Arizona</p>
<p><strong>Compensation:&nbsp; $</strong>175,000 – $185,000 on target earnings with a 60/40 split plus equity</p>
<p><strong>What You’ll Do:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Huntress is looking for a Reseller Sales Development Specialist to join our new reseller sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and managing new reseller partnerships in North America to support Huntress' continued growth and expansion. This is a front-line, hunter role built for someone who lives to recruit, activate, and scale channel partners at pace. You’ll own the recruitment, onboarding, and early growth of new broad channel partners across the US who transact through distribution. Your mission is simple: find them, sign them, enable them, and drive revenue through their preferred distributor.</p>
<p>You’ll work closely with distribution partners, marketing, and the wider channel team to turn raw partner interest into productive, revenue-generating relationships.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Proactively identify, recruit, and onboard new reseller partners (VARs, IT providers, etc) across North America who buy through distribution</li>
<li>Qualify prospective partners quickly and move fast from first contact to onboarding with a heavy focus on time-to-first-deal</li>
<li>Build a strong bench of net-new, first-time Huntress partners</li>
<li>Drive partner recruitment and growth through Huntress distribution relationships, working hand-in-hand with distribution partners to co-sell, co-market, and accelerate pipeline</li>
<li>Own the first 90–180 days of the partner journey</li>
<li>Ensure partners understand how to buy, quote, and transact efficiently via distribution</li>
<li>Deliver foundational enablement on Huntress value, positioning, and use cases</li>
<li>Identify expansion opportunities and hand off mature partners at the right time</li>
<li>Build strong relationships with key decision-makers at reseller and distributor companies, ensuring they are actively promoting our products and addressing any concerns they may have</li>
<li>Provide resellers with the tools, resources, and ongoing training necessary to effectively present and sell our products to their customers</li>
<li>Oversee the process of registering sales opportunities with resellers/distributors to ensure proper attribution and margin allocation</li>
<li>Track reseller sales performance, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching to maximize their sales potential</li>
<li>Represent Huntress at industry events, partner days, and other related conferences</li>
<li>Bring real-time market and reseller/distributor feedback back to the business</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What You Bring To The Team:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2-5+ years of experience in a combination of channel sales, partner development, and/or distribution-led roles</li>
<li>Proven track record of partner recruitment or high-velocity sales</li>
<li>Experience working with US distribution (tech, security, SaaS, and/or Microsoft strongly preferred)</li>
<li>Demonstrated knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including different product categories, technical capabilities, and industry trends, particularly in the SMB and Commercial customer segments</li>
<li>Proven track record of identifying, recruiting, and quickly activating resellers, including an understanding of partner dynamics and incentive structures. Existing key reseller relationships are highly preferred.</li>
<li>SMB and Commercial mindset with a bias for action and execution</li>
<li>Experience and knowledge of MSFT licensing and Security solutions are highly preferred</li>
<li>Confident, credible communicator who can open doors and build trust quickly with key decision makers at reseller companies and foster long-term partnerships</li>
<li>Comfortable working remotely and managing a wide geographic territory</li>
<li>Willingness to travel as needed<strong> </strong>&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What We Offer:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015</li>
<li>Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays</li>
<li>12 weeks of paid parental leave</li>
<li>Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans&nbsp;</li>
<li>401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution</li>
<li>Life and Disability insurance plans</li>
<li>Stock options for <strong>all</strong> full-time employees&nbsp;</li>
<li>One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office</li>
<li>Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance&nbsp;</li>
<li>$75 USD/month digital reimbursement</li>
<li>Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><div><p></p>
<p><em>Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are.</em><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status. </em><em>&nbsp;</em></p>

Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response.&nbsp;</em></p>

These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. Please review our <a href="https://trust.huntress.com/?itemUid=47f0a941-b86f-4864-a0d0-a224a34cfd57&amp;source=click">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more details on our practices and your data privacy rights.</em></span></em></p>

      <title>ChiroCat: Humbly Confident Marketing Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇨🇦 Canada, 🇲🇽 Mexico, 🇵🇷 Puerto Rico, and 🇺🇸 United States of America</country>
      <state>Utah</state>
      <skills>Community Growth, Digital Marketing, Paid Social Media Advertising, Content Writing, and Branding</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0170/3944/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Utah
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.chirocat.com/">https://www.chirocat.com/</a>
</p>

<h3>About Us and Why We're Hiring</h3>
<p>We're ChiroCat, and we build cloud-based chiropractic software that practices across the United States love and trust. From the first patient interactions with digital intake forms to the final insurance processing and post-visit communication, our system supports doctors and their staff every step of the way. We’re modernizing the chiropractic software space in big ways, but much more importantly, we’re bettering the lives of our doctors, their team members, and especially their patients.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The bottom line: we LOVE to help people who help people. And that’s where you come in!&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re building something special at ChiroCat; both with our product and the people behind it. We’re not like “the other guys,” and our customers know it. They tell us, and more and more, they’re telling their peers about ChiroCat, too. But truth be told, we haven’t done a great job of showcasing what sets us apart to the rest of the world. And now we want everyone to feel that from the first time they come across us.</p>
<p>That’s where you come in! We’re hiring our first dedicated marketer. If you’re the right fit, you know that a brand is much more than a logo, voice is more than just words, and a website isn’t just a funnel. You’re a skilled writer and will help us find our voice and strengthen it. You’ve been around the block and know how to build a strategy toward a better future, but you’re not satisfied to sit behind reports and dashboards. You’re excited to roll up your sleeves and start doing the work yourself. Website, ads, social, email, internal guidelines, in-app messaging: you’ll touch all of it. And as we grow, your opportunity grows with us.</p>
<h3>What We're Looking For</h3>
<h4>REQUIREMENTS</h4>
<p>For this role, you must:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have at least 4 years of hands-on marketing experience, including real ownership of brand, messaging, and content (not just executing someone else’s plan)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Be an exceptional writer who can adapt to a brand’s voice, and have samples to show us</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have hands-on experience running paid social campaigns: building them, testing creative, and improving results based on what the numbers tell you</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have experience managing a company’s social media presence, including engaging with the community, and not just publishing posts</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Be comfortable writing and updating website and landing page content in a CMS (Currently Webflow)&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Be self-directed: you can take an ambiguous list of needs, decide what matters most, and make a case for it; continuously iterating your way toward excellence&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Be a thoughtful communicator in written and spoken forms. It’s an art you enjoy improving!</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Love to learn. In short order, you’ll need to get fluent in the world of chiropractic, medical practices, and the people who run them.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</h4>
<p>These aren't required, but will help you stand out:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Marketing experience in healthcare, medical practice, or B2B SaaS</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience shaping or refreshing a brand’s voice, messaging, or identity</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience leading a small team, or managing freelancers and agencies</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Design skills (Figma, Canva, or similar). If you use AI design tools, you use them with enough taste that nobody can tell.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience with email marketing platforms and in-app messaging tools (we use Intercom)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience managing online reviews and reputation (G2, Capterra, Google)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort making short-form video</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with chiropractic care. (Being a happy chiropractic patient counts a little.)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>Note: If you believe you’re a fit, but don’t meet our preferred qualifications, still apply! We’re more interested in finding the right person, than the perfect resume.&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Life at ChiroCat</h3>
<p>ChiroCat started with a simple mission: Empowering caregivers to transform lives through tools they trust. In an industry dominated by big conglomerates or funding-dependent startups, we're privately owned and stable. That means we can run our business as we choose. Our culture is built on genuine care for our customers, each other, and the meaningful work we do.</p>
<h4>HOW YOU'LL WORK AT CHIROCAT</h4>
<p><strong>Work from (Almost) Anywhere: </strong>We’re based in southern Utah, but most of our team works remotely. This role is open to candidates located in U.S. time zones (Pacific, Mountain, Central, Eastern) or internationally within UTC-8 to UTC-4. You’ll need to live in one of these time zones, since this role requires strong overlap with our team and customers. Working these hours from elsewhere won’t qualify.</p>
<p><strong>Balanced Work, Balanced Life:</strong> We work a standard 40-hour week and are fans of legitimately unplugging after hours. We're in this for the long haul and want you rested and focused. Exceptions exist, but we mostly work standard business hours in our local time zone.</p>
<p><strong>Take Vacation (Seriously): </strong>Most team members take three to four weeks per year — real vacations where you're not tied to your laptop or phone. We'll look forward to seeing pictures in our team #water-cooler channel!&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Great Benefits:</strong> We offer fantastic health, dental, and vision insurance, with 100% of the premium covered for you and affordable rates for dependents. This is a salaried role with a starting salary of $95k–$130k a year. Most new hires start in the lower to middle part of that range, and the top end is reserved for the rare candidates with truly exceptional, deep, and directly relevant experience.</p>
<p><strong>You’ll Make a Real Impact: </strong>This role will have an incredible impact on the lives of our doctors and staff, not to mention the patients they serve. You’ll be instrumental in helping chiropractors find and trust ChiroCat as their EHR of choice. ChiroCat is the core of their business and their ability to serve patients, so their success with ChiroCat has far-reaching implications. Additionally, we're growing, and the road ahead is exciting. You'd be joining at a stage where you can meaningfully shape our brand and voice, perception in the market, and our trajectory. That kind of impact doesn't come along often.</p>
<p><strong>And do it with Great People:</strong> We're firm believers that the foundation of success is building a great team. You’ll be joining a team full of truly exceptional people. The kind you’ll be excited to work with and learn to care about. People who get stuff done. Who are genuine to their core. Who hold humility and confidence equally well at the same time. Who support each other and care deeply about our customers. It’s a strong culture that’s apparent the moment you walk through the [digital] door. And we can’t wait to see how you’ll make us even better.&nbsp;</p>
<p>If this sounds like your ideal environment, read on because now we’ll dig into the role itself.&nbsp;</p>
<h3>What You'll Do at ChiroCat</h3>
<p>At ChiroCat, marketing isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room. It’s about being the most trustworthy one. Chiropractors get plenty of noise from software vendors: big promises, long contracts, and slick ads for products that feel twenty years old. We want people to meet the real ChiroCat, the same one our customers already know. Everything we put into the world should sound like us, look like us, and be true.</p>
<p>Your early focus will be brand: making sure that whatever someone sees of ChiroCat, whether it’s our website, our ads, our social posts, our reviews, or the messages inside our app, gives them an accurate (and awesome) picture of who we are. Next up is widening the funnel and building our inbound lead flow. Down the road, perhaps you’ll build a marketing team, one amazing hire at a time, but let’s not get ahead of ourselves.</p>
<p>This role reports to the CEO and works closely with our Head of Customer Success, our CTO, and our Sales team.</p>
<h4>A TYPICAL WEEK MIGHT INCLUDE:</h4>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Rewriting a page of our website so it sounds like us, and not like every other EHR vendor</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Taking over our Facebook ads from our CEO (Psst… he’s relieved, and honestly, so are the ads and the people viewing them!)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Jumping into a Facebook group thread where chiropractors are comparing software, and being genuinely curious and helpful instead of defensive or salesy.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Planning next week’s social posts, and making sure at least one of them shows off the people behind ChiroCat (our team is way more fun than our current feed suggests); next week you’ll execute that plan.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Working with our Customer Success team to rewrite in-app messages so new customers feel like they’re hearing from ChiroCat, not a robot</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Responding to a G2 review thoughtfully and honestly</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sitting in on a sales call or reading through support chats to hear how chiropractors actually describe their problems</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Briefing a designer on next week’s ad creative, or making it yourself</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Drafting an email campaign that people actually want to open</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Bringing a proposal to the CEO: “Here’s what I think we should work on first, and why.”</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Learning the difference between a 98940 and a 98941 (you’ll get there, we promise)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>You’re the right fit if:&nbsp;</h3>
<p><strong>You think in brand, not just funnel.</strong> Leads matter, and you know how to get them (we’ll need lots of them). But you also know that the way people feel about us impacts our success from beginning to end.</p>
<p><strong>Words matter to you. </strong>You obsess over the right word and notice when a sentence is trying too hard. You can write in a voice that isn’t your own, yet somehow make it sound effortless.</p>
<p><strong>You don’t wait for the next task. </strong>You look around, spot what’s missing, and come up with a plan. You’re the driver, not a passenger.</p>
<p><strong>You have taste.</strong> You can tell when something looks off, sounds generic, or feels like it came out of a template (or AI), and you won’t ship it.</p>
<p><strong>You’re humbly confident. </strong>You’ll make a strong case for your ideas, and you’ll change your mind when someone shows you something better.</p>
<p><strong>You love being a jack of all trades.</strong> Writing copy in the morning, digging into ad performance after lunch, and tweaking a landing page before you log off sounds like a great day to you.</p>
<p><strong>You measure what matters.</strong> You care about results more than activity, and you’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t. You’re obsessive about getting a good ROI on our ad spend and efforts.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>You love learning complex things.</strong> Chiropractic workflows? Insurance billing? How a front desk really runs? You’ll dive in. Because you can’t market what you don’t understand.</p>
<p><strong>You’d rather build than maintain.</strong> A website that needs a rethink and a brand that’s still taking shape sounds like an opportunity to you, not a mess.</p>
<p><strong>You see feedback as a gift.</strong> Even when it’s offered imperfectly but kindly, you stay curious instead of defensive, and look for the nugget that helps you grow.&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Ready to Apply?</h3>
<p>Apply (here: <a href="https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr">https://apply.workable.com/chirocat/j/5198B94A48?utm_source=wwr</a>) by 11:59 PM on Monday, November 30th, 2026.</p>
<p>TWO IMPORTANT NOTES:&nbsp;</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>We don’t want to see AI answers (yes, we can tell). We use AI at ChiroCat all the time, but we’re hiring you, not an AI agent. We want YOUR answers.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>We review applications as they come in, so we might find our perfect fit early! We don’t recommend waiting until the last minute.&nbsp;</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>WHAT TO INCLUDE (IN PDF FORMAT, PLEASE):&nbsp;</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Your resume</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A cover letter (Yep, we read them!)</p>
</li>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Page 1: Skip the formal stuff and help us get to know you. Pretend we just met at a picnic. Introduce yourself, explain why you’re interested, and why you think you’d be great in this role. Include the word "rambunctious" somewhere (we want to make sure you're real and read this whole thing).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Page 2: Answer this in 1-2 paragraphs: “Pretend you’re hiring for this role. What is the most important trait or skill you’re looking for in an applicant? Why?”</p>
</li>
</ol>
</ol>
<p>PS: Not interested, but know someone who might be? Please pass it along!</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/chirocat-humbly-confident-marketing-lead</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.growthloop.com">http://www.growthloop.com</a>
</p>

<p><span><strong>Partner Marketing Manager</strong></span></p>
<p><span><em>Remote, North America</em></span></p>
<p><span>As our Partner Marketing Manager, you’ll own marketing to, with, and through our partners, building on an established partner strategy. You’ll work closely with our partnerships and marketing teams to bring joint solutions to market, build relationships across our ecosystem, and help partner sellers understand where GrowthLoop fits and when to bring us into a customer conversation. This is a hands-on role: you’ll shape the plan and drive the details that deliver results.</span></p>
<h3><span>What You'll Do</span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Own partner event marketing from planning through follow-up. Turn conferences and joint events into opportunities to reach the right buyers, deepen partner relationships, and create sales conversations.</span></li>
<li><span>Lead co-branded product launches and customer announcements, coordinating the joint story, partner quotes and approvals, content, and promotion.</span></li>
<li><span>Build marketing relationships with priority technology, cloud, and advisory partners. Develop joint campaigns that support shared sales priorities and give partners a reason to introduce GrowthLoop to their customers.</span></li>
<li><span>Help sellers at our strategic partners understand, trust, and recommend GrowthLoop through relevant content, enablement, and opportunities to engage with our team.</span></li>
<li><span>Bring key partner marketing opportunities into GrowthLoop’s broader quarterly marketing plan. Coordinate with partnerships, sales, marketing, and partner teams to deliver joint initiatives with clear owners, timelines, and goals.</span></li>
<li><span>Proactively involve strategic partners in our major marketing announcements by securing endorsements and/or social media amplification and coordinating with content and product marketing.</span></li>
<li><span>Work with content and product marketing to create partner-targeted content and sales materials, including solution one-pagers, decks, and joint customer stories.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with content marketing on co-branded content, such as drafting guest blog posts and lead generation assets (eBooks, whitepapers).&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Keep external partner listings and the partnerships sections of our website up to date.</span></li>
<li><span>Run partner campaigns in HubSpot, including audience lists, campaign setup, lead capture, routing, and reporting, so engagement turns into timely sales follow-up.</span></li>
<li><span>Work with sales to track partner engagement, event follow-up, and sales opportunities generated or supported by partner programs. Use the results to improve programs and decide where to focus next.</span></li>
<li><span>Regularly analyze and report on partner engagement and results of partner marketing initiatives.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span>What You Bring</span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>4–6 years of relevant partner marketing experience in enterprise B2B.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience running partner campaigns, joint launches, and event marketing, including lead capture and sales follow-up. You can explain what you owned and how you measured the results.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong relationship-building skills. You can earn a partner’s trust, find a shared opportunity, and get commitments, content, and approvals across the finish line.</span></li>
<li><span>Clear writing and messaging skills, with the ability to turn a joint solution into a story buyers and partner sellers understand. You’re comfortable creating content, collateral, and presentations.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong project management and follow-through. You can coordinate multiple teams, manage competing deadlines, and keep work moving when priorities change.</span></li>
<li><span>You’ve run partner marketing programs that led to customer introductions or sales conversations, and can explain what worked and how you measured it.</span></li>
<li><span>Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform. You’re comfortable setting up campaigns, managing lists and workflows, and tracking results yourself.&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span>About GrowthLoop</span></h3>
<p><span>GrowthLoop built the first composable CDP, helping marketers leverage live, first-party data from their cloud warehouse to launch highly targeted campaigns. That composable foundation gave way to the Compound Marketing Engine, an evolution of the composable CDP that drives compound growth by using agentic AI to accelerate the marketing cycle.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Now, we’re building what comes next: an agentic system that uses causality data to find the actions that actually improve customer outcomes and gets smarter with every campaign cycle.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Founder-led, we’re partnering with the world’s most innovative brands to close the loop between people, data, and AI. Enterprise marketing teams at Google, Costco, Ford, and Whirlpool (to name a few) choose GrowthLoop to launch smarter, more personalized marketing programs that compound growth with every campaign.</span></p>
<h3><span>About You</span></h3>
<p><span>You’re a builder who enjoys turning a shared idea into something real, whether it’s a partner event, a joint launch, or a campaign that opens doors. You take ownership from planning through follow-up, bring clarity when priorities shift, and care about the details that make the work successful. You build trust by listening, communicating directly and kindly, and doing what you say you’ll do. You’re curious about our partners, our customers, and how to do the work better, including using new tools thoughtfully. You pitch in where needed, make the people around you better, and measure success by what the team and our partners achieve together.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>What We Offer</strong></span></p>
<p><span>The on-target earnings range for this role is USD $125,000–$135,000. Total compensation includes equity.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Final base salary decisions will be based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors unique to each candidate, such as the individual’s skill set, location, depth of experience, and qualifications.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Remote, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://capslock.global">http://capslock.global</a>
</p>

<p class="editor-paragraph"><span>CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.</span></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><span>At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.</span></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><br></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><b><strong class="editor-text-bold">Role overview</strong></b></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><span>We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.&nbsp;</span></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><span>You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.</span></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><span>Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.</span></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><span>You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.</span></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><br></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><b><strong class="editor-text-bold">What you will work on</strong></b></p><ul class="editor-list-ul"><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Run regular R&amp;D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.</span></li></ul><p class="editor-paragraph"><br></p> <p class="editor-paragraph"><b><strong class="editor-text-bold">Your must-haves</strong></b></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><i><em class="editor-text-italic">You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.</em></i></p><ul class="editor-list-ul"><li class="editor-listitem"><span>5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Mature Leader &amp; Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Fluency in English - both spoken and written.</span></li></ul><p class="editor-paragraph"><b><strong class="editor-text-bold">Nice to have</strong></b></p><ul class="editor-list-ul"><li class="editor-listitem"><span>A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.</span></li></ul><p class="editor-paragraph"><br></p><p class="editor-paragraph"><b><strong class="editor-text-bold">What we offer</strong></b></p><ul class="editor-list-ul"><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.</span></li><li class="editor-listitem"><span>Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.</span></li></ul>

<h3><span>Location:Florida, United States - Remote</span></h3>
<h3><span>Who Are We?&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></h3>
<h3><span>About Airlock Digital:&nbsp;</span></h3>
<p><span>Airlock Digital is a global leader in application control and allowlisting. We seek to empower every organization to run only what they trust and operate free from malware and ransomware. &nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>With rapid growth across Australia, North America, and EMEA. We are committed to our core values, respect, determination, and integrity. We support a diverse and expanding global customer base. At Airlock, we pride ourselves on being a team of humble, collaborative, and driven professionals who support one another and share a passion for cybersecurity.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>What We Are Looking For:&nbsp;</span></h3>
<p><span>Airlock Digital is seeking a&nbsp;high-impact Channel Account Manager&nbsp;to help scale our North American partner ecosystem and drive meaningful partner-led revenue.</span></p>
<p><span>This is an individual contributor role&nbsp;with both strategic and hands-on responsibilities. You will own partner relationships across a defined territory or portfolio, develop joint business plans, drive pipeline creation, and ensure strong execution across enablement, co-selling, and go-to-market initiatives.</span></p>
<p><span>The ideal candidate brings deep channel experience, strong commercial instincts, and thrives in fast-growing environments where building structure, accountability, and momentum go hand-in-hand.</span></p>
<h3><span>Key Responsibilities:</span></h3>
<p><span>Channel Strategy &amp; Partner Growth</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Own and execute the regional channel strategy for North America, aligned to Airlock Digital’s global partner vision</span></li>
<li><span>Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic channel partners across resellers, distributors, MSSPs, and technology alliances</span></li>
<li><span>Identify, recruit, onboard, and activate new partners where there is clear opportunity for incremental growth</span></li>
<li><span>Develop and manage&nbsp;joint business plans, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and mutual success metrics&nbsp;with priority partners</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>Revenue Ownership &amp; Pipeline Execution</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Own a&nbsp;measurable partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue target</span></li>
<li><span>Drive high-quality deal registration, accurate forecasting, and consistent operating cadence with partners</span></li>
<li><span>Partner closely with direct sales teams to support co-selling motions, unblock deals, and accelerate enterprise opportunities</span></li>
<li><span>Meet or exceed quarterly and annual channel revenue objectives</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>Enablement &amp; Go-to-Market</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Lead partner onboarding, sales enablement, and ongoing training to ensure strong product knowledge and sales readiness</span></li>
<li><span>Collaborate with Marketing on joint campaigns, events, MDF execution, and demand-generation initiatives with clear ROI</span></li>
<li><span>Drive field execution including partner-led workshops, events, executive briefings, and regional activities</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>Cross-Functional Leadership</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Act as the internal advocate for partner needs across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success</span></li>
<li><span>Provide feedback on market trends, competitive insights, and partner sentiment to influence program evolution</span></li>
<li><span>Maintain strong CRM and PRM hygiene to ensure visibility, scale, and data-driven decision-making</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>Representation &amp; Market Presence</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>Represent Airlock Digital at regional partner events, industry trade shows, and security conferences</span></li>
<li><span>Strengthen Airlock’s brand and presence within the North American channel ecosystem</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications:&nbsp;</span></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>7+ years&nbsp;of experience in channel sales, partner management, or alliances within&nbsp;cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise software</span></li>
<li><span>Proven success driving revenue through indirect sales models and partner ecosystems</span></li>
<li><span>Demonstrated ability to own a region and deliver&nbsp;repeatable, partner-led pipeline and bookings</span></li>
<li><span>Strong experience with partner enablement, joint planning, and co-selling execution</span></li>
<li><span>Data-driven mindset with strong forecasting, reporting, and performance management skills</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent executive presence, communication, and relationship-building abilities</span></li>
<li><span>Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-growth environments with evolving structure</span></li>
<li><span>Experience using CRM and PRM tools (Salesforce preferred)</span></li>
<li><span>Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, or a related field (or equivalent experience)</span></li>
<li><span>Spanish language skills are a plus.</span></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span>What We Offer:&nbsp;</span></h3>
<p><span>We don’t think money is everything, but we know it is an important part of your decision to apply for a role. &nbsp;The base salary for this role ranges from $138,000 - $153,000, with on-target earnings (OTE) ranging from $230,000 – $255,000, inclusive of performance-based variable compensation. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include responsibilities of the job, education, location, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal equity, alignment with market data, or applicable laws. &nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>At Airlock Digital we offer a wide range of benefits to our eligible team members. Our benefit programs vary by location and can include Medical, dental, and vision insurance – 401K Plan with 4% Company Match – Life and Disability Programs – Paid Parental Leave - Paid time off and Paid Holidays – Volunteer and Birthday Time off – Home Office Allowance&nbsp;</span></p>
<h3><span>Our Commitment:&nbsp;</span></h3>
<p><span>We believe in supporting our team members both personally and professionally. Named one of the USA’s Greatest Places to Work in 2024 and 2025, we value flexibility, trust, and a work environment that empowers our team to do their best work.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><em><span>We will be assessing applications as they come in, so we encourage you to send your resume through to us as soon as possible. All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official BambooHR document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience. No contact from recruitment agencies, thank you. #LI-REMOTE #LI-GP1</span></em></p>

      <title>SweetSpot Heating and Cooling: Creative Strategist (AI-Native, Direct Response)</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>

      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, New York, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://sweetspothvac.com/">https://sweetspothvac.com/</a>
</p>

<h2>About SweetSpot Heating &amp; Cooling</h2><p>SweetSpot is a growing home-services company in the New York metro, and we are building our creative team from zero. This is the number one creative seat in the company, not a slot in a large agency hierarchy. The strategist hired here owns the function, works directly with the owner, and has a real path to leading the team as we scale.</p><h2>About the role</h2><p>We are hiring a creative strategist who will own paid ad creative end to end: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefing creators and editors, and the learnings that turn winners into the next batch.</p><p>This is not a "make pretty ads" role and it is not strategy-only. You will direct really strong video editors and UGC creators, and you will use AI (including Claude Code) as your production engine for research, hooks, scripts and variants. We are honest about the level this role is hired at: we are looking for strong raw talent with real direct-response instincts who wants ownership and serious training, and who wants to grow into a top-tier strategist with us. You will get mentorship, a proven creative system, and weekly learnings reviews. In return we expect pace, curiosity, and work you can defend.</p><h2>What you will do</h2><ul><li><p>Build the research base first: homeowner avatars, desires, objections, competitors, and our own ad account history. No angles before research.</p></li><li><p>Plan concepts in a structured roadmap, each with angle, avatar, desire, mechanism, authority, awareness level, emotion, positioning and urgency.</p></li><li><p>Write hooks and scripts built for the first 3 seconds: one desire, one avatar, one message per ad.</p></li><li><p>Brief UGC creators and editors so clearly they can execute with no follow-up call, and review their work to a finished, launch-ready ad.</p></li><li><p>Run the testing system: from one winning angle, build structured iterations where each variation tests something named.</p></li><li><p>Run the learnings: label every ad (Breakthrough, Spend Winner, KPI Winner, Loser), state why it performed, and turn that into the next round.</p></li><li><p>Hit 20 to 30 finished, launch-ready ads per month at full pace, working with our editors and AI workflows.</p></li></ul><h2>What we are looking for</h2><ul><li><p>Direct-response ad experience: you have written ads that ran as paid social (Meta or TikTok) and you can show them.</p></li><li><p>A testing system, not just good taste. You can explain how you turn one winner into 20 variations.</p></li><li><p>Research discipline. Your hooks trace to evidence, not guesses.</p></li><li><p>AI fluency: you already use AI tools in your creative workflow and can show how.</p></li><li><p>Execution: you have briefed creators or managed editors and shipped finished ads.</p></li><li><p>Ownership mindset: you talk about business outcomes, not just outputs delivered, and you close feedback loops: you learn, you apply, you show what changed.</p></li><li><p>Local services or lead generation experience is a plus, not a requirement. Seasonal urgency, emergency calls, proof and trust are the game here.</p></li></ul><h2>Pay and structure</h2><ul><li><p>Contract (1099), remote, month-to-month: $4,000 to $8,000 per month, 40 hours per week, based on experience.</p></li><li><p>Performance bonus structure discussed after the trial month, tied to winning ads.</p></li><li><p>Growth path: this seat grows into leading the creative team. One of the paths we model is editor or strategist to team lead as spend scales.</p></li></ul><h2>Our hiring process (exactly how it works)</h2><ol><li><p>Short application: portfolio of ads you wrote that actually ran, plus 3 short answers (your testing system on a real winner; one ad you iterated and what it tested; your AI workflow).</p></li><li><p>Interview 1 (30 minutes): screening and craft in one call, run as a working session on your past ads: what did you learn, how did you apply it, what feedback loops did you complete.</p></li><li><p>Paid test: $100 flat, 48 hours, capped at 4 hours of work, paid regardless of outcome. A short research snapshot, hooks, scripts, an iteration plan and an execution plan for a real scenario.</p></li><li><p>Interview 2 (final, with the owner): we walk your test together and you defend your choices. References are checked after this call (we will ask to speak with one past employer). Two interviews total, no more.</p></li><li><p>Paid 30-day trial at your full agreed monthly rate, with daily contact, mentorship and a weekly check-in. Written decision at day 30.</p></li></ol><p>We hire off the test and the trial, not the interview. If you are the kind of strategist who would rather prove it than pitch it, apply.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sweetspot-heating-and-cooling-creative-strategist-ai-native-direct-response</a></p>
</description>
