<h2><strong>🐶 Our mission</strong></h2><div><br></div><div>Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At&nbsp;<a href="https://www.snoutplans.com/">Snout</a>, we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer pet wellness plans,&nbsp;<em>that actually work.</em></div><div><br></div><h2><strong>🚀 The opportunity</strong></h2><div><br></div><div><span>Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the U.S. We're a small but mighty startup team and we're on the lookout for an experienced and remote </span><strong>Growth Marketing Manager</strong><span> based in the United States to help turn the interest pet parents show in the clinic into completed plan enrollments.</span></div><div><br></div><h2><strong>💻 The role</strong></h2><div><br></div><div><span>As a Growth Marketing Manager, you'll be the owner of the pet parent's path to enrollment, from the first flyer they see in an exam room to the moment they complete sign-up. You'll map the prospect journey, build the nurture flows around each appointment, create the in-clinic assets and consumer tools that capture interest, and track what converts. You'll work closely with Clinic Success and Marketing. We don't have an in-house creative team yet, so you'll write your own copy and wireframe your own emails and assets, with support available.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>Your impact, measured in plan sales, will be felt by clinics and pet parents alike. Clinic teams get clear, client-facing materials that explain Snout in the exam room and at home. Pet parents get the right information at the right time, so they enroll understanding exactly what their plan covers and start as confident, engaged members. And Snout learns which messages and channels drive enrollment, so we can scale what works and get more pets the care they need.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>If you're a builder who likes taking an idea from a blank page to launch, a writer who can turn plan benefits into a clear reason to act, and a marketer who wants to see the numbers behind every send, we'd love to hear from you. </span></div><div><br></div><div><em>Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of qualifications including the first bullet. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.</em></div><div><br></div><h2><strong>🛠 What you’ll do</strong></h2><div><br></div><ul><li><span>Own the prospect journey from first lead capture through completed enrollment, mapping lead stages, triggers, timing and handoffs so every pet parent gets a relevant next step</span></li><li><span>Build and improve direct-to-client nurture journeys for pre-appointment, post-visit, incomplete enrollment and lapsed prospects, segmented by appointment <strong>Description</strong><br><h2><strong>SEO &amp; Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads &amp; Lead Generation | Remote</strong></h2><p><strong>Position Type:</strong> Full-Time, Remote<br> <strong>Working Hours:</strong> U.S. Business Hours<br> <strong>Experience Level:</strong> Mid-Level to Senior<br> <strong>Department:</strong> Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing</p><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2><p>At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced <strong>SEO &amp; Digital Marketing Specialist</strong> to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.</p><p>The ideal candidate has strong expertise in <strong>technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation</strong>. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.</p><p>You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in <strong>AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO)</strong>.</p><h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2><h3><strong>SEO Strategy &amp; Optimization</strong></h3><ul><li>Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.</li><li>Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.</li><li>Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.</li><li>Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.</li><li>Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.</li><li>Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).</li></ul><h3><strong>Paid Advertising &amp; Lead Generation</strong></h3><ul><li>Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across <strong>Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads</strong>.</li><li>Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).</li><li>Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.</li><li>Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.</li><li>Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.</li></ul><h3><strong>Content Marketing &amp; Website Management</strong></h3><ul><li>Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.</li><li>Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.</li><li>Manage website updates through <strong>WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms</strong>.</li><li>Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.</li></ul><h3><strong>Analytics, Reporting &amp; Optimization</strong></h3><ul><li>Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using <strong>Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager</strong>.</li><li>Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.</li><li>Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.</li><li>Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.</li></ul><h3><strong>Marketing Automation &amp; CRM</strong></h3><ul><li>Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.</li><li>Work with platforms such as <strong>HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign</strong>.</li><li>Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.</li><li>Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.</li></ul><h2><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></h2><ul><li><strong>3+ years of professional experience</strong> in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.</li><li>Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.</li><li>Strong knowledge of <strong>technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization</strong>.</li><li>Hands-on experience with <strong>GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools</strong>.</li><li>Experience managing <strong>Google Ads and paid social media campaigns</strong>.</li><li>Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.</li><li>Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.</li><li>Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.</li><li>Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.</li><li>Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.</li><li>Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.</li><li>Availability during <strong>U.S. Business Hours</strong>.</li></ul><h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2><ul><li>Experience with <strong>Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)</strong> and <strong>Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)</strong>.</li><li>Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.</li><li>Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.</li><li>Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.</li><li>Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.</li><li>Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.</li></ul><h2><strong>What Makes You a Strong Fit</strong></h2><ul><li>You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.</li><li>You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.</li><li>You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.</li><li>You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.</li><li>You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.</li><li>You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.</li></ul><h2><strong>What a Typical Day Looks Like</strong></h2><p>Your day may begin by reviewing <strong>GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards</strong> to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.</p><p>You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.</p><p><strong>In short:</strong> You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.</p><h2><strong>Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)</strong></h2><p>Success in this role will be measured through:</p><ul><li><strong>Organic Traffic Growth:</strong> Increase qualified organic website traffic.</li><li><strong>Keyword Rankings:</strong> Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.</li><li><strong>Lead Generation:</strong> Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.</li><li><strong>Conversion Rate:</strong> Improve website and landing page conversions.</li><li><strong>Cost per Lead (CPL):</strong> Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.</li><li><strong>Return on Ad Spend (ROAS):</strong> Improve paid campaign profitability.</li><li><strong>Technical SEO Health:</strong> Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.</li><li><strong>Marketing Attribution:</strong> Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.</li></ul><h2><strong>Interview Process</strong></h2><ol><li>Initial Application</li><li><strong>Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview</strong></li><li>Recruiter Screening</li><li>Client Interview</li><li>Final Selection &amp; Onboarding</li></ol><h2><strong>Spark Hire Video Interview – Required</strong></h2><p>As part of the application process, <strong>all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire</strong>.</p><p>After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a <strong>Spark Hire invitation by email</strong> with instructions to record and submit your video responses.</p><p>Completion of the Spark Hire video is <strong>required to be considered for the next stage</strong>. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.</p><h2><strong>Apply Now</strong></h2><p>If you’re an experienced <strong>SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional</strong> with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.</p><p>Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.</p><p><strong>#SEOSpecialist #DigitalMarketing #TechnicalSEO #GoogleAds #PerformanceMarketing #LeadGeneration #AEO #GEO #MarketingAutomation #RemoteMarketingJobs #RemoteJobs</strong></p><p><strong>#LI-AG1</strong></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pavago-seo-digital-marketing-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pavago-seo-digital-marketing-specialist</a></p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Charlottetown, PE
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.silverorange.com/">https://www.silverorange.com/</a>
</p>

<h3><strong><span>The company</span></strong></h3>
<div><span>silverorange is a design and development agency based in Canada. We design and develop simple yet powerful web and mobile applications. When pursuing work, we focus on interesting and meaningful projects. Over our 26 years as a company, we've worked with well-known technology organizations like Duolingo and Mozilla, not-for-profit organizations working in areas including </span><a href="https://blog.silverorange.com/usability-for-promotion-codes-and-access-codes"><span>affordable internet access for low-income families</span></a><span>, and with </span><a href="https://www.emrap.org/"><span>world-renowned doctors training other doctors</span></a><span> through online education.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re proud of the fantastic products we’ve built in partnership with our clients and we’re actively invested in the processes behind these products. We are committed to fostering a team-focused approach in our work of building great user-focused systems, while also placing a serious emphasis on quality of life, openness, empathy, and a supportive work environment.</span></div>
<h3><strong><span>The position</span></strong></h3>
<div><span>We're looking for a full-time Director of Business Development to lead our efforts to expand our client base. For a long time silverorange successfully relied on word of mouth and existing partnerships to sustain our growth - we have now reached a point where we feel we need a dedicated business development specialist in order to meet our business goals. We’re looking for a strategic and proactive person who will leverage their expertise to shape our business development strategy and implement the processes to support sustained growth.&nbsp;</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>This position is available immediately and we will work with you to get you started as soon as possible.</span></div>
<h3><strong><span>Responsibilities</span></strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Develop, maintain, and implement a strategic business development plan.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Build out our sales pipeline; implement and maintain a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system or alternative for leads.</span></li>
<li><span>Seek out, establish, and cultivate new client relationships.</span></li>
<li><span>Act as the face of the company for events, client visits, business mixers etc.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Seek and respond to appropriate requests for proposals; create proposals for potential new clients.</span></li>
<li><span>Recommend a business-to-business marketing strategy while keeping an eye on industry trends, advise leadership of potential new markets and research to support our services.</span></li>
<li><span>Maintain and/or coordinate open communication with existing and former clients to foster future work.</span></li>
<li><span>Regularly report to the operations team on business development activities.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong><span>Requirements</span></strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Be eligible &amp; available to work from Canada.&nbsp;</span></li>
<li><span>Be willing and able to travel nationally and internationally to meet with prospective clients.</span></li>
<li><span>5+ years of experience leading business-to-business sales for an organization in the digital services industry.</span></li>
<li><span>Experience developing, maintaining, and implementing a business development plan and actively managing a sales pipeline.</span></li>
<li><span>Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills. Experience working in a remote or asynchronous environment is an asset.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong sense of ownership over and self-direction in the work.</span></li>
<li><span>Strong client management skills.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong><span>Growth &amp; ownership</span></strong></h3>
<div><span>Our team is co-operative and will help you learn and expand your skills via mentoring, team-wide support, and learning opportunities. All members of the team are encouraged and given space to grow as individual contributors, and have ongoing opportunities in project and team leadership.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We’re excited to hear your fresh ideas and approach. We have decades of collective experience, and we all continue to become better at what we do by both teaching and learning from each other. Add your voice to our mix!</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Opportunity for employee ownership is a fundamental part of silverorange (non-founders currently own more than a third of the company) and we’re currently working on new ways to transfer even more ownership to employees.</span></div>
<h3><strong><span>Inclusion &amp; diversity</span></strong></h3>
<div><span>People with different backgrounds and experiences make us stronger, and we’re always looking for ways to improve. Our team is getting more diverse across many dimensions of diversity, but we’re still missing perspectives that could make our work better. We highly encourage people from traditionally underrepresented groups in our industry to apply—we’d love to hear from you.</span></div>
<h3><strong><span>Remote working is just as good as local</span></strong></h3>
<div><span>Our team has been remote-friendly for over 20 years, and remote-first for the last 10. We continue to improve our approach to having a dispersed team. This is a full-time remote position regardless of location, though you are welcome to work from our lovely offices in Charlottetown, Prince Edward Island, Canada if you wish.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>The majority of our team is full-time remote and 95% of our clients are remote. You’ll need to be comfortable working with a remote team regardless of your location.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Typically all employees spend at least one week each year working from our Charlottetown office, so plan on visiting PEI semi-regularly.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Though you may be working remotely, you’ll be an active member of a great and small but growing team, both here at silverorange and with our clients. Regular voice or video communication will help keep you in touch with the smart people with whom you’ll be working.</span></div>
<h3><strong><span>Benefits &amp; compensation</span></strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><span>Flexible work days, approached collaboratively with you to allow for the realities of appointments, family minding, and your everyday life.</span></li>
<li><span>3 weeks of paid vacation, on top of 10 paid days of civic holidays, and 3 weeks of paid company-wide shut down.</span></li>
<li><span>Generous health and dental coverage, with 100% of premium covered by silverorange.</span></li>
<li><span>New computer hardware every 4 years, and other tools as needed.</span></li>
<li><span>Yearly company-wide bonuses based on overall company success, plus ownership opportunities and dividends for long-term employees.</span></li>
<li><span>Salaries based on skills and experience ranging from </span><span>CAD $80,500 - $98,500, with both annual company wide salary band adjustments as well as opportunities and expectation of ongoing career and compensation growth.</span></li>
<li><span>Additional remote worker salary add-on of CAD $3,000 per year and a wellness salary add-on of $500 per year.</span></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong><span>How to apply</span></strong></h3>
<div><span>We will be accepting applications until noon Atlantic time on Friday, November 27th. We will begin reviewing applications and following up with candidates after this date.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>Click 'Apply Now' and include a copy of your resume, and an explanation of why you’d be great for the job.&nbsp;</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>We want people to feel they can be their genuine selves at work, so we’d love to hear about who you are. If there is anything else you would like to share with us — i.e. a Medium account, online writing or select blog posts, etc. — please feel free to include those as well.</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span>If you require accommodations at any phase of the application or interview process, please let us know. We would be happy to support you and discuss accommodations as required.</span></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/silverorange-director-of-business-development-1">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/silverorange-director-of-business-development-1</a></p>

<div><h2><strong>About Pacaso</strong></h2>
<p>Pacaso exists to enrich lives by making second home ownership possible and enjoyable for more people. We've reimagined the second home category — pairing a thoughtfully designed co-ownership model with simplified financials, equitable scheduling, and dedicated local property management, so owners get the joy of a true second home without the hassle.</p>
<p>Since launch, Pacaso has facilitated more than <strong>$1.2 billion in gross real estate transactions and service fees</strong> across <strong>40+ destinations</strong> in the U.S., Mexico, and Europe — including Aspen, Lake Tahoe, Napa, Malibu, Palm Springs, Cabo, Paris, London, and most recently Florence, Milan, and Rome. We've raised over <strong>$300 million in cumulative equity funding</strong>, closed the largest real estate Regulation A+ offering of 2025, and reserved the Nasdaq ticker <strong>PCSO</strong> as we build toward a public listing.</p>
<p>Our work has been featured in <em>The New York Times</em>, <em>The Wall Street Journal</em>, <em>Fortune</em>, <em>Forbes</em>, <em>CNBC</em>, <em>Bloomberg</em>, and others.</p>
<h2><strong>Recognition</strong></h2>
<p>We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for both our culture and our category-defining work:</p>
<ul>
<li>No. 5, Forbes America's Best Startup Employers (2026) — our second consecutive Top 10 ranking</li>
<li>Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2025)</li>
<li>Winner, 2025 Inman Best of Proptech Awards — Consumer Experience &amp; Marketplace Innovation</li>
<li>Fortune &amp; Great Place To Work Best Workplaces in Real Estate (2024)</li>
<li>Best Workplace in the Bay Area™ (2023)</li>
<li>LinkedIn Top Startup (2022) · Glassdoor Best Places to Work, #6 (2022)</li>
</ul></div><h2>The role</h2>
<p>Pacaso buyers are high-net-worth individuals making a considered purchase over months, sometimes years. They move between our site, email, messaging, and our Sales team, and today each of those runs on its own tools with its own picture of the customer. We believe one personalized system that follows each customer from first interest to purchase, and keeps serving them as an owner, will shorten the path to purchase and make our growth product-led.</p>
<p>We're hiring a principal-level technical product IC to architect that system and own its outcome. You'll define the reference architecture: how we recognize a customer across channels, what we know about them, how the system decides what to do next, and which of those decisions AI agents can make without a person. You'll prove the design with working prototypes you build yourself with AI tooling, then lead Engineering and Data in taking it to production.</p>
<p>This isn't a roadmap-and-backlog PM role, and it isn't a full-time production engineering role. It sits between them. You'll make product calls with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, make architecture calls with senior engineers, and be accountable for both.</p>
<p>Some of this is already moving. AI agents talk to our customers today, and parts of the data and decisioning exist. None of it runs end to end on its own yet. You'll take what's there, decide what to keep, and design the system that can.</p>
<h2>What you'll own</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>The architecture of the customer system.</strong> One design for new leads, dormant leads, and stalled buyers first, then owners who add a share, so the same person is served by one system instead of separate tools for each stage. You write the architecture and the decisions behind it, and other teams build against it.</li>
<li><strong>The customer intelligence layer.</strong> Identity across channels, the event and signal model, shared memory and context, scoring, eligibility and frequency caps, and the next-best-action logic that decides what happens next.</li>
<li><strong>Agent and workflow design.</strong> Which agents exist, what each one is allowed to decide, how they hand off to each other and to Sales, and the prompts, tools, and orchestration behind them.</li>
<li><strong>Trust and reliability.</strong> Evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, cost and latency budgets, and kill switches, in place before anything reaches a customer.</li>
<li><strong>The path to autonomy.</strong> What the system decides on its own, what still needs a person, and the evidence we need before we take that person out of the loop.</li>
<li><strong>Technical direction across teams.</strong> Build-versus-buy calls, data contracts with Engineering and Data, and integration standards for the CRM, messaging, email, and the site.</li>
<li><strong>The outcome.</strong> Funnel velocity (time from first interest to high intent, and to purchase) and the measured lift in qualified actions and closed sales.</li>
</ul>
<p>Two examples of the work:</p>
<ul>
<li>An AI agent engages a new lead in the channel they prefer, qualifies them, and hands them to Sales at the right moment with the context Sales needs to close.</li>
<li>A customer reads an email, chats with us, and comes back to the site a week later. They get one continuous experience, because the system remembers what we've already said and done.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who you are</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Customer-obsessed.</strong> You start from the customer's experience, not the org chart or the backlog. When you have to choose between channels, surfaces, or features, the tiebreaker is what improves that experience. Our customers value clarity and discretion, and you design for both.</li>
<li><strong>An architect who still builds.</strong> You've designed systems other teams build on, and you still prototype yourself. You're expert at getting AI to do real work through prompting, tool use, and orchestration.</li>
<li><strong>Technically deep.</strong> You can read a data model, challenge an integration design, reason about latency, cost, and failure modes, and hold your own with senior engineers on how something should be built.</li>
<li><strong>Rigorous about autonomy.</strong> You design systems to run on their own, and you know how to prove they're ready. Evals and guardrails go in before launch, not after an incident.</li>
<li><strong>Accountable for outcomes.</strong> You measure yourself on results, not tasks shipped. You've stopped your own work when the impact wasn't there, and you can tell us about it.</li>
<li><strong>Fluent in business and technical.</strong> You can frame and defend a tradeoff with Sales, Marketing, and leadership, then go deep with engineers on the build. You own the decision in both conversations.</li>
<li><strong>A multiplier.</strong> You raise the bar for how Product, Engineering, and Data build with AI, through your designs, your reviews, and the patterns you leave behind.</li>
<li><strong>A partner.</strong> Marketing and Sales are core stakeholders, and you'll co-own the buyer journey with our product owner for new-lead acquisition. When the path to impact runs through another team's area, you work with the owner to move it.</li>
<li><strong>Fast at context.</strong> You go deep on systems you didn't build and turn a lot of information into a plan quickly.</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you'll bring</h2>
<p>We'll ask for specific evidence of each of these. If you can't point to all five, this probably isn't the right fit yet.</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Customer obsession. </strong>You take customer insights and translate them into real product features that deliver results.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>A production agentic system.</strong> You've designed and shipped an autonomous or agentic system that runs end to end with minimal human intervention. You can show us what it decides on its own and how you knew it was making the right calls before you trusted it with real customers.</li>
<li><strong>A measurable growth outcome.</strong> You've owned a growth, conversion, lifecycle, or re-engagement result. You can give us the baseline, what you changed, the lift, the time frame, and how you knew your work caused it.</li>
<li><strong>Decisioning and intelligence layers.</strong> You've designed signals, identity, scoring, context, eligibility and caps, or next-best-action logic.</li>
<li><strong>Prototype to production.</strong> You've built working prototypes yourself with AI tooling, beyond specs and slides, and taken at least one to production with engineers. You can tell us what you owned and what they owned.</li>
<li><strong>Architecture others built on.</strong> You've been the architect of a system that multiple teams built on or integrated with, and you made the core technical calls: data model, integration pattern, build versus buy.</li>
</ol>
<p>Nice to have:</p>
<ul>
<li>Experience with long-consideration, high-value purchases such as real estate, luxury, or financial services.</li>
<li>Experience putting AI into a human sales team's workflow, including CRM integration.</li>
<li>An earlier career as a software engineer, data architect, or solutions architect.</li>
</ul>
<h2>This role isn't for you if</h2>
<ul>
<li>You want to manage a roadmap and backlog, or execute against a defined spec.</li>
<li>You want to manage a team right now. This is a principal IC role.</li>
<li>You'd rather be a production software engineer full time.</li>
<li>You see this as an email or campaign program, or measure success in opens, clicks, or campaigns shipped.</li>
<li>Your AI experience is mostly using it to write docs and emails faster.</li>
<li>You need a full team and a clean data stack before you start. Some pieces exist today and don't talk to each other yet.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How we work</h2>
<p><strong>We start with AI.</strong> It's one of our core values. We design processes with automation and intelligence in mind from the start, and our product team already has AI agents talking to customers.</p>
<p><strong>Small team, real ownership.</strong> Product at Pacaso works closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Sales, and Marketing. If you see a problem worth solving, you're trusted to solve it. We ship weekly and demo working software, not slides.</p>
<p><strong>We move fast and play the long game.</strong> We make decisions and change course quickly. "Embrace an infinite mindset" is one of our values: a quarterly number is information, not a verdict, and we'd rather send nothing than send the wrong thing.</p>
<p><strong>We pick up the phone and empty the dishwasher.</strong> When async isn't enough, we get on a call. No task is beneath anyone, and we keep bureaucracy to a minimum. We're a distributed Crew.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>Compensation</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>&nbsp;Around $220,000 with equity</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div><h2><strong>Why You'll Love Working Here</strong></h2>
<p>We invest in our Crew the way we invest in our homes — thoughtfully, generously, and with care.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Competitive base salary and meaningful equity</strong> — every Crew member shares in what we're building</li>
<li><strong>Discretionary time off</strong> — take the rest you need, when you need it</li>
<li><strong>Premium medical, dental, and vision coverage</strong> for you and your family</li>
<li><strong>Sponsored memberships</strong> to One Medical, Peloton, and WellHub for whole-person, modern healthcare</li>
<li><strong>401(k)</strong> to help you build long-term security</li>
<li><strong>Paid parental leave</strong> for primary and secondary caregivers</li>
<li><strong>Home office stipend</strong> and a monthly internet and cell phone reimbursement to set you up for great remote work</li>
<li><strong>Quarterly team gatherings</strong> and ongoing learning and development investment</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Our Commitment</strong></h2>
<p>Pacaso is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ability, and background — including veterans and individuals with disabilities. We believe a Crew as diverse as the owners we serve makes Pacaso stronger, and we're committed to building a workplace where every voice belongs.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>

      <title>Hadley Designs LLC: Amazon Brand Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Texas</state>
      <skills>Paid Social Media Advertising, Product Marketing, Product Lifecycle Management, Power BI/Tableau, Product Listing, and  Amazon Seller Central</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6760/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Flower Mound, TX, USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.hadleydesigns.com">http://www.hadleydesigns.com</a>
</p>


<div>
<p><strong>Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.</strong></p>
<p>Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.</p>
<p>You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>How You'll Win at Hadley Designs</strong></p>
<p>You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.</p>
<ul>
<li>Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.</li>
<li>Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.</li>
<li>Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.</li>
</ul>
<p>We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Own</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory</li>
<li>Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop</li>
<li>Finding inspiration outside Amazon, on Etsy, TikTok, Pinterest, and in wider trends, and turning it into product and format ideas</li>
<li>Product and format relaunches that lift your catalog</li>
<li>How your products look and compete on the page, from main images to packaging and format</li>
<li>Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price</li>
<li>Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit</li>
<li>AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog</li>
<li>Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p>
<p><strong>Within your first 90 days, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape</li>
<li>Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results</li>
<li>Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion</li>
<li>Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver</li>
</ul>
</div>


<h2>Requirements</h2>
<div>
<p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business</li>
<li>A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data</li>
<li>You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer</li>
<li>You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format</li>
<li>You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price</li>
<li>Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising</li>
<li>AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward</li>
<li>Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done</li>
<li>Clear, confident spoken and written English</li>
<li>Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>


<h2>Benefits</h2>
<div>
<p><strong>Why You'll Thrive Here</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale</li>
<li>Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins</li>
<li>Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule</li>
<li>Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO</li>
<li>Personal development and autonomy over your time</li>
<li>An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div><div><div><div><div><div><div><div><div><div><div><div><h1><br></h1><h1><img src="https://static.workforcenow.adp.com/cccustom/Client/Recruitment/itechralogo_tagline_25a3e222-7ee0-4c68-b026-64bc19c6131b.png"></h1><h1><br></h1><h1>Outbound Sales Representative (Inside Sales) – Remote, U.S.</h1><p><strong>Location:</strong> 100% Remote – United States<br><strong>Schedule:</strong> Full-Time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Central Time<br><strong>Employment Type:</strong> Hourly, Non-Exempt<br><strong>Base Pay:</strong>&nbsp;$24.00–$28.85 per hour (approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually), plus uncapped FTA bonuses and commission opportunities<br><strong>On-Target Earnings (OTE):</strong> Approximately $75,000+ annually, based on performance<br><strong>Reports To:</strong> VP of Sales</p><h2>100 Dials a Day. Real Coaching. Get Paid When Your Appointments Convert.</h2><p>We're looking for an experienced outbound sales professional who enjoys prospecting, tracks their numbers, and wants to be rewarded for results.</p><p>At Itechra, you'll make the calls, build relationships, and book qualified meetings. We'll train you on IT, support you through a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, and provide ongoing coaching to help you succeed.</p><p>You'll earn a bonus for every qualified First Time Appointment (FTA) that converts to a Second Time Appointment (STA), plus commission on qualifying deals that close and generate client payment.</p><p><strong>You don't need an IT background.</strong> You do need outbound sales experience, resilience, confidence on the phone, and the motivation to consistently achieve your goals.</p><p>This is a fully remote, phone-based sales position focused on generating business opportunities for our sales team.</p><h2>What You'll Do</h2><p>As an Outbound Sales Representative, internally classified as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR), you'll open doors for our sales team by connecting with business owners and IT decision-makers at companies with 25 or more computers.</p><p>Your responsibilities will include:</p><ul><li><p><strong>Prospect every day.</strong> Make high-volume outbound calls, send emails, and use LinkedIn to reach business owners and decision-makers.</p></li><li><p><strong>Do your homework.</strong> Research target companies, identify decision-makers, and gather relevant business information before reaching out.</p></li><li><p><strong>Qualify opportunities.</strong> Ask thoughtful questions to understand each prospect's IT needs, company size, and purchasing authority.</p></li><li><p><strong>Book qualified appointments.</strong> Schedule First Time Appointments (FTAs) that create opportunities for Second Time Appointments (STAs) with our sales team.</p></li><li><p><strong>Manage your pipeline.</strong> Consistently follow up with prospects, nurture relationships, and keep opportunities moving forward.</p></li><li><p><strong>Maintain accurate CRM records.</strong> Document calls, prospect details, activities, and follow-up information in HubSpot.</p></li><li><p><strong>Track and report results.</strong> Provide weekly updates on activity, pipeline development, and conversion metrics.</p></li><li><p><strong>Continuously improve.</strong> Participate in role-playing, call reviews, sales training, and one-on-one coaching.</p></li></ul><h2>How We Measure Success</h2><p>We're a metrics-driven sales organization. You'll have clear expectations, ongoing feedback, and visibility into your performance.</p><p>Our established performance goals include:</p><ul><li><p><strong>Outbound Calls:</strong> 500+ per week (approximately 100 per day)</p></li><li><p><strong>Decision-Maker Conversation Rate:</strong> 5% of outbound dials</p></li><li><p><strong>Qualified First Time Appointments (FTAs):</strong> 12+ per month</p></li><li><p><strong>CRM Accuracy:</strong> Complete and accurate documentation of calls, activities, notes, and next steps in HubSpot</p></li></ul><p>If you enjoy measurable goals, friendly competition, and the opportunity to see your hard work translate into results, you'll fit right in.</p><h2>Your First 90 Days: Training, Coaching &amp; Performance</h2><p>We believe strong salespeople deserve clear expectations, quality training, and consistent coaching.</p><p>Our structured 30/60/90-day onboarding program is designed to help you learn our business, build confidence, develop your skills, and understand exactly what success looks like.</p><p><strong>Days 1–30 | Learn</strong></p><ul><li><p>Complete onboarding and training on Itechra's services, ideal clients, sales processes, and technology solutions.</p></li><li><p>Learn our prospecting tools, talk tracks, objection-handling strategies, and HubSpot CRM.</p></li><li><p>Participate in daily role-playing and coaching before and during your first live calls.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Days 31–45 | Ramp</strong></p><ul><li><p>Build toward and achieve 500+ outbound dials per week.</p></li><li><p>Participate in weekly call reviews and coaching sessions.</p></li><li><p>Demonstrate consistent prospecting, follow-up, and CRM documentation.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Days 46–90 | Perform</strong></p><ul><li><p>Maintain established outbound activity expectations.</p></li><li><p>Demonstrate consistent prospecting, qualification, and pipeline management.</p></li><li><p>Work toward the monthly goal of 12 qualified FTAs.</p></li><li><p>Meet individual ramp-up milestones outlined in your onboarding plan.</p></li></ul><p>You'll always know where you stand. If you're coachable, accountable, and committed to improving, we'll invest in helping you succeed.</p><h2>What You'll Earn</h2><p>Your effort and results should create opportunity.</p><p>Itechra offers competitive hourly base compensation along with performance-based bonuses and commission opportunities.</p><ul><li><p><strong>Base Pay:</strong>&nbsp;$24.00–$28.85 per hour, equivalent to approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually based on a 40-hour workweek, depending on experience and qualifications.</p></li><li><p><strong>FTA-to-STA Bonus:</strong>&nbsp;$250 for every qualified FTA that converts to an STA, with no stated cap. The bonus is earned when the qualifying STA is scheduled with a confirmed date and time, subject to the sales compensation plan.</p></li><li><p><strong>Closed-Won Commission:</strong> 10% of the first month's recurring revenue for qualifying deals originating from your FTA. Commission eligibility is based on the applicable client invoicing and payment requirements outlined in Itechra's sales compensation plan.</p></li><li><p><strong>On-Target Earnings:</strong> Approximately $75,000+ annually, including base pay and performance incentives. Actual earnings vary based on individual performance.</p></li></ul><p><strong>What Qualifies as an FTA?</strong></p><p>A qualified First Time Appointment is a meeting you schedule with an IT purchasing decision-maker at a company with 25 or more computers.</p><p><strong>Here's an Example of Your Earning Potential</strong></p><p>If eight of your FTAs convert to STAs in one month, you would earn $2,000 in FTA-to-STA bonuses. Maintaining that performance for 12 months would generate $24,000 in annual bonuses.</p><p>If one qualifying appointment also results in a new client generating $4,000 in monthly recurring revenue, the associated 10% first-month commission would be an additional $400.</p><p>Bonuses and commissions are paid according to Itechra's applicable sales compensation plan.</p><p><em>Examples are for illustration only and do not represent guaranteed earnings. Actual compensation depends on individual performance, qualifying transactions, and plan requirements.</em></p><h2>Where This Role Can Take You</h2><p>We believe in recognizing performance, developing talent, and promoting from within.</p><p>Successful ISRs may have opportunities to pursue two career paths:</p><p><strong>Inside Sales Team Lead</strong></p><p>Lead, coach, and develop a team of Inside Sales Representatives. This potential advancement opportunity may be available to qualified remote employees throughout the United States.</p><p><strong>Outside Sales Representative</strong></p><p>Advance into a client-facing sales position focused on conducting Second Time Appointments, managing opportunities, and closing new business.</p><p>This career path requires residing in or relocating to one of Itechra's local markets, currently in Minnesota or Wisconsin.</p><p>Advancement opportunities depend on business needs, performance, qualifications, and position availability.</p><h2>What Makes You a Great Fit?</h2><p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li><p>At least 3 years of professional experience in outbound B2B sales, inside sales, business development, lead generation, or a closely related role.</p></li><li><p>Demonstrated experience with cold calling, prospecting, appointment setting, and CRM management.</p></li><li><p>Confidence engaging business owners, executives, and decision-makers and asking for the appointment.</p></li><li><p>Resilience and persistence when handling rejection and objections.</p></li><li><p>A competitive, self-motivated mindset with a focus on achieving measurable sales goals.</p></li><li><p>Willingness to receive coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve.</p></li><li><p>Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate CRM documentation.</p></li><li><p>Ability to work independently, remain accountable, and maintain productivity in a remote environment.</p></li><li><p>A quiet, professional home workspace with reliable internet access.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li><p>An associate degree or higher in sales, business, marketing, or a related       <title>Thrive Market: Performance Creative Coordinator (Contractor)</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Quality Assurance</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Contract</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.thrivemarket.com">http://www.thrivemarket.com</a>
</p>

<p><strong>ABOUT THRIVE MARKET&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.</p>
<p>Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.</p>
<p><strong>THE ROLE</strong></p>
<p>A contractor (30-40 hrs per week) who helps keep the paid social performance creative engine running: first-round ad review, QA and delivery, performance data, builds and decks, and ad hoc support for our creative strategist.</p>
<p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p>
<p><strong>1. First-round creative review</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Review ads against the brief: does the concept, message, and offer answer what was asked?</li>
<li>Assess engagement potential (hook, first 3 seconds, clarity of CTA, platform-native feel)</li>
<li>Give team concise first-round feedback and flag what needs a closer look before it goes further</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>2. Creative QA &amp; delivery</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Check aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, etc.) and file specs (format, size, video length, safe zones, captions)</li>
<li>Check ad naming against convention</li>
<li>Confirm all assets are in (nothing missing) and the correct, approved version is used</li>
<li>Deliver to channel managers with a standard handoff note (batch contents, launch date, links)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>3. Coordination &amp; Workload Balance</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp;Keep track of what is due, what is ready, and what is at risk in Wrike and build out a 8-12 week rolling calendar</li>
<li>&nbsp;Balance competing projects and flag blockers or slipping deadlines early</li>
<li>&nbsp;Proactively contact the right people when a new project starts (designers, editors, copywriters, channel managers, brand/legal)</li>
<li>&nbsp;Move work along on Sabrina's behalf (follow-ups, nudges), with signoff as described below</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>4. Ad hoc support</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp;Slot in last-minute asks and triage them by urgency, telling Sabrina what gets bumped</li>
<li>&nbsp;Own small edit and resize requests end to end without Sabrina stepping in: no editing skills required, but coordinate with the project manager to find bandwidth on the editing team, brief the editor, and track the request through delivery</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>5. Performance data &amp; reporting</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp;Pull performance data (Motion, Meta Ads Manager) and build recurring reports (top and bottom performers, spend by concept)</li>
<li>&nbsp;Tag and categorize creatives (hook, format, angle, offer)</li>
<li>&nbsp;Keep a testing learnings log</li>
<li>&nbsp;Surface early takeaways to inform briefs and next rounds</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>6. Decks &amp; strategy support</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp;Help build decks: test readouts, performance recaps, creative reviews</li>
<li>&nbsp;Research competitor and inspiration ads</li>
<li>&nbsp;Draft first-pass briefs or test summaries for Sabrina to review</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p>
<p><strong>Core competencies</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Proactive mindset; balances strategic objectives with day-to-day tactical execution &nbsp;</li>
<li>Maintains timelines and prioritizes tasks for smooth workflows and timely delivery of creative assets &nbsp;</li>
<li>Comfortable wearing multiple hats and shifting between review, data, and coordination work</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Must-have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Background in performance creative (paid social preferred), with a trained eye for what makes ads engaging and on-brief</li>
<li>Strong attention to detail (specs, naming, completeness)</li>
<li>Clear written communication, able to give concise, constructive feedback</li>
<li>Organized and self-directed; comfortable with fast-changing priorities</li>
<li>Basic data pulling and deck-building skills</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>BELONG TO A BETTER COMPANY</strong></h3>
<p>We're a community of more than 1 Million + members who are united by a singular belief: It should be easy to find better products, support better brands, make better choices, and build a better world in the process.</p>
<p>At Thrive Market, we believe in building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic culture. If you are excited about this role along with our mission and values, we encourage you to apply.</p>
<p><em>Thrive Market is an EEO/Veterans/Disabled/LGBTQ employer</em></p>
<p><em>At Thrive Market, our goal is to be a diverse and inclusive workplace that is representative, at all job levels, of the members we serve and the communities we operate in. We’re proud to be an inclusive company and an Equal Opportunity Employer and we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. If you’re thinking about joining our team, we expect that you would agree!</em></p>
<p><em>Employment with Thrive Market requires that employees be based in the United States. This is a condition of employment and must be maintained throughout the duration of employment.</em></p>
<p><em>If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please email us at eeo@thrivemarket.com and we’ll be happy to assist you.</em></p>
<p>Ensure your Thrive Market job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Thrive Market never seeks payment from job applicants. Thrive Market recruiters will only reach out to applicants from an @thrivemarket.com email address. For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at <a href="http://www.thrivemarket.com/">www.thrivemarket.com</a>.</p>
<p>© Thrive Market 2026 All rights reserved.</p>
<p><strong>JOB INFORMATION</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Compensation Description - The hourly rate for this role is up to $45 per hour.&nbsp;</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thrive-market-performance-creative-coordinator-contractor">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thrive-market-performance-creative-coordinator-contractor</a></p>
</description>

<h1><strong>Marketing &amp; Content Intern (Part-Time)</strong></h1>

<h3><strong>About Kinelo</strong></h3>
<p><a href="http://kinelo.com">Kinelo</a> is an early-stage AI startup building technology that helps companies work faster by keeping company knowledge current and making it available to both people and AI. Our proactive AI Coworkers use that knowledge to take on work, coordinate across teams, and keep people informed.</p>
<p>We're looking for a marketing intern to help us build and grow Kinelo's presence in the market. The role covers a wide range of marketing activities, from content, social media, and creative production to market research, partnerships, and campaigns.</p>
<p>You'll work directly with our founding GTM lead and have plenty of opportunities to come up with ideas and execute them.</p>
<h3><strong>On a given day or week, you might</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Come up with content ideas for X, LinkedIn, and other channels, then help turn those ideas into posts, articles, videos, or visual content.</li>
<li>Develop creative video concepts, plan and edit short-form videos, and experiment with different styles and formats.</li>
<li>Design graphics, social assets, and other visuals for our website, content, and marketing campaigns.</li>
<li>Research AI trends, competitors, and relevant industry conversations to identify interesting topics, market opportunities, and new ideas worth exploring.</li>
<li>Find relevant creators, influencers, newsletters, and communities, research their audiences, and help coordinate potential collaborations.</li>
<li>Support marketing campaigns, from researching target audiences and developing content to coordinating distribution and tracking results.</li>
<li>Help create website content, customer stories, presentations, and other marketing materials.</li>
<li>Research journalists, podcasts, events, and other opportunities to get Kinelo in front of relevant audiences.</li>
<li>Experiment with different marketing ideas, see what works, and bring recommendations for what we should try next.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>We're looking for someone who</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Is currently studying marketing, communications, journalism, media, or a related field.</li>
<li>Has previous marketing/content internship experience OR has built and managed their own social media accounts.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Writes well and has a good instinct for what makes content interesting, useful, or worth sharing.</li>
<li>Has experience creating and editing videos, especially short-form content, and is comfortable developing creative concepts from scratch.</li>
<li>Has a good eye for visual design and experience with tools like Canva, Figma, CapCut, Adobe, or similar.</li>
<li>Understands social media platforms, follows relevant creators and trends, and has opinions about what makes good content.</li>
<li>Is a strong researcher who can dig into unfamiliar topics, find useful information, and turn it into ideas or recommendations.</li>
<li>Is actively using AI tools in their own work, studies, or creative projects, and enjoys experimenting with new tools and finding ways to get better results. You don't need a technical background, but you should be excited about what AI makes possible.</li>
<li>Is resourceful, organized, and comfortable figuring things out independently.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Logistics</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Part-time, approximately 10-20 hours per week</li>
<li>$25/hr</li>
<li>Remote (US)</li>
</ul>

Landing Pages</p><ul><li>Write email copy for automated email workflows sequences</li><li>Build and publish landing pages in HubSpot's CMS/page tools to support campaigns and lifecycle flows</li><li>Publish blog posts and pages in WordPress</li><li>Ensure workflows, content, and landing pages work as one connected system </li></ul><p></p><p>Ongoing Optimization</p><ul><li>Run and maintain our lead nurture flows: keep emails, offers, and links current, and test changes that improve engagement and conversions</li><li>Monitor email performance and revise logic accordingly; share the results and make regular optimization recommendations to the team</li><li>Maintain clean data hygiene practices within workflows (list membership, enrollment/re-enrollment logic, suppression rules)</li></ul>
<p>Required Qualifications</p><p></p><ul><li>Demonstrated HubSpot workflow architecture experience — must be able to design multi-branch automation from a blank canvas, not just configure templates</li><li>Hands-on experience building lead scoring models</li><li>Experience building segmentation strategies (behavioral, firmographic, or lifecycle-based)</li><li>Experience designing lifecycle-stage email flows (nurture through renewal)</li><li>Experience building landing pages in HubSpot's CMS or page builder tools</li><li>Hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: building emails, landing pages, and campaigns</li><li>3+ years in marketing automation, ideally with at least 1–2 years focused specifically on HubSpot</li><li>Strong B2B email copywriting skills, with samples you can share</li><li>Experience publishing content in WordPress</li><li>A sharp eye for QA: you catch broken links, wrong personalization tokens, and rendering issues before anything goes out</li><li>Comfortable reading email performance data (opens, clicks, conversions) and turning it into clear recommendations</li><li>Organized and proactive, with the communication skills to keep multiple teams aligned on a shared calendar</li><li>Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous, US-hours-adjacent environment</li></ul><p></p><p>Preferred Qualifications</p><ul><li>Prior experience in property management, real estate, or a related vertical (rental software, PropTech, or landlord/tenant-facing products)</li><li>HubSpot certification(s) — Marketing Software, Email Marketing, or Reporting</li><li>Experience working across multiple product lines or brands within one HubSpot portal</li><li>Experience with A/B testing email sequences and using results to refine workflow logic</li><li>Experience running or maintaining lead nurture and lifecycle email flows</li><li>Experience with UTM tracking and campaign attribution</li></ul><p></p><p>Schedule and Availability</p><p>This role is a full-time equivalent of about 160 hours a month. Your working day should overlap consistently with US Eastern morning hours, when our standups, Sales syncs, and most async requests happen.</p>

<p>Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.</p>
<p>Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. <p>

</p>

<div><p></p><h2>Company Description</h2></div><div><p>WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000&nbsp;logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders&nbsp;worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.</p></div><div><p></p><h2>Job Description</h2></div><div><p><strong>A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now</strong></p><p>In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.</p><p>WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.</p><p>Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.</p><p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p><p>We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.</p><p>This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.</p><p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p><ul><li>Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.</li><li>Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.</li><li>Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.</li><li>Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.</li><li>Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.</li><li>Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.</li><li>Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.</li></ul><p><strong>Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission</strong></p></div><div><p></p><h2>Qualifications</h2></div><div><p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p><ul><li>8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&amp;OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).</li><li>Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.</li><li>Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.</li><li>Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.</li><li>Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.</li><li>Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.</li><li>Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.</li><li>Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.</li></ul></div><div><p></p><h2>Additional Information</h2></div><div><p>When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.</p><p>Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team&nbsp;is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics.</p><div></div><p><strong>Before You Apply&nbsp;</strong></p><p><em>From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations.</em></p></div><li> Compensation: USD <span>100000</span> - USD <span>150000</span> - yearly</li>

delivery.</p><p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p><ul><li>Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.</li><li>Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.</li><li>Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand metrics.</li><li>Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.</li></ul><p><strong>Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission</strong></p></div><div><p></p><h2>Qualifications</h2></div><div><p><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></p><ul><li>8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&amp;OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).</li><li>Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.</li><li>Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.</li><li>Confident presenting to challenges.</li><li>Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.</li><li>Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.</li><li>Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.</li></ul></div><div><p></p><h2>Additional Information</h2></div><div><p>When you join       <title>Intellipet: Sales Consultant – (Uncapped Bonuses)</title>
      <region>USA Only</region>
      <country></country>
      <state></state>
      <skills>Sales, Objection Handling, Relationship Building, and Customer Service</skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://usserviceanimals.org">https://usserviceanimals.org</a>
</p>

<p><strong>Sales Consultant – (Uncapped Bonuses)</strong></p>
<p><em>Remote · Full-time · $19.00/hr base + uncapped bi-weekly bonuses, </em><strong><em>40 hours weekly within 8 AM–9 PM CST</em></strong></p>
<p><strong>Tired of a paycheck that’s the same no matter how hard you work? Good. So are we.</strong></p>
<p>Intellipet helps dog owners get the training their dogs need: in-home sessions with professional trainers, virtual coaching, and programs for everyday manners up to service-dog work. People call us because something isn’t working at home, and they need someone to help them fix it.</p>
<p><strong>That’s you.</strong></p>
<p><strong>This job is for you if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; You’re motivated by money and you’re not shy about it. Bonus weeks get you out of bed.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; You like people and want them to leave the call better off than they started.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; You can hear “I need to think about it” and know how to keep a conversation going.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; You want a job where effort shows up in your paycheck.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>This job is NOT for you if </strong>you’re looking to clock in, take calls and clock out. Base Pay is how you pay the bills, BONUS is how you LIVE!</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Talk with dog owners who reached out for help (warm inbound and follow-up leads, no cold calling).</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Learn their dog, their home and their goals, then match them to the right training program.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Close the sale, handle objections, and set firm follow-ups.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Hit weekly targets and watch your bonuses stack.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you get:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>$19.00/hr base pay</strong>, so you’re never at zero.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>Uncapped weekly bonuses.</strong> Top performers earn About $1,500/month on average, $6,000+/month for top earners on our <strong>bi-weekly</strong> bonus plan.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>Paid training</strong> on our products, scripts and sales process, with coaching from top performers.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>A product people actually want.</strong> You’re helping families keep their dogs, not selling something nobody needs.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>Growth.</strong> Strong closers can move into mentor and team lead roles if they are interested in that path.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>Benefits:</strong> Remote work, Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance, 401k/Roth IRA, FSA and more!</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; <strong>40 hours weekly within 7 AM–11 PM CST</strong> [Schedule: e.g. full-time, some evenings and weekends required.]</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Sales experience phone sales, retail, call center, or anything where you had a number to hit.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Confidence asking for the sale.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Clear, friendly communication, and reliable attendance.</li>
<li>&nbsp; &nbsp; A love of dogs helps. A love of winning is required.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Ready to get paid what you’re worth? </strong>Apply today and tell us, in one sentence, about the best sale you ever made.<br><br><br></p>
<p><strong>Hiring Process</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong> Applicants complete a short online assessment through TestGorilla before interview consideration. Candidates who advance should be prepared to discuss specific examples of quota performance, persistence, objection handling, and successful closes.</p>
<p><em>Intellipet is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.</em></p>
<h1><br><br></h1>

</p>

<p>About DataVisor:</p><p>DataVisor is the world’s leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's solution scales infinitely and enables organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide guaranteed performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases multiple financial services use cases with flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many scalable financial service companies across the globe.</p><p>Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in AI, machine learning, security, big data, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!</p><p>Summary:</p><p>As a Senior Account Executive – Payments, you will be responsible for hunting and securing new accounts within a defined Payments sector target list. This is a visible quota-based position and is critical role aligning to the forecasted growth of the company. This candidate will drive the sales cycle from end-to-end as the “quarterback” of the deal, driving the supporting sales engineers, data scientists, delivery etc. &nbsp; The candidate will need to partner with marketing, represent the organization at conferences, and take all measures to build a healthy new opportunity pipeline, and drive opportunities to closure.&nbsp; The ideal candidate will have experience succeeding in a line positions within the payment industry, have exposure to SaaS solutions, fraud, and success leading enterprise sales.&nbsp; They will have good technical knowledge of the payment transaction eco-system and be able to interact and influence the c-suite, product leaders, risk leaders and technology leaders.&nbsp;<br></p><p>Responsibilities:</p><ul><li>Identify and drive new business. Build and maintain a strong pipeline within the payments segment.</li><li>Understand the payments ecosystem, including a strong technical acumen of the segment.</li><li>Be able to communicate the challenges facing providers in the payment segment.&nbsp;</li><li>Have a working knowledge of fraud risk.</li><li>Understand SaaS solutions.</li><li>Be a thought leader and build relationships at all levels within product, technology, and risk organizations.</li><li>Understand and be able to communicate the company value story, and the ROI story aligning to the dynamics in the payment segment in parallel to influencing technical feasibility.&nbsp;</li><li>Drive the sales cycle from end-to-end.&nbsp;</li><li>Collaborate with internal teams including marketing, sales engineering, system architects, delivery, finance, and legal.</li><li>Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Salesforce.com.</li><li>Lead contract negotiations to closure with time-sensitive urgency.</li></ul>
<ul><li>15+ years total experience across a combination of payments, fraud, SaaS, and Sales.</li><li>History excelling in a quota driven environment.</li><li>Strong executive presence, and the ability to engage with C-level and VP-level executives.</li><li>Demonstrated ability to drive the sales process from end-to-end. Formal methodology training is a plus.</li><li>Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.</li><li>Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute territory and close plans.</li><li>Experience with contract negotiations.</li><li>Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams both internally and within our client’s organizations.</li><li>Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.</li><li>Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.</li></ul>
<p>Compensation range:  $160K-$175K base salary per year, OTE $320 -$350K, uncapped and negotiable</p><p>Health Insurance, Stock options, 401k, PTO</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/datavisor-senior-account-executive-payment">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/datavisor-senior-account-executive-payment</a></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
