      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<h3><strong>Joining Collibra’s Public Sector team</strong></h3>
<p>Make an impact at Collibra Public Sector by driving growth in US federal DOW agencies.&nbsp; This role will be responsible for selling Collibra's value and vision to prospects and existing customers, offering a complete solution that includes software, support and services.&nbsp; As part of our federal sales team, you will manage some of Collibra’s largest accounts.&nbsp; You will use your knowledge and skills in enterprise sales to establish trusted and credible relationships, build Collibra’s brand and awareness around our solutions, and serve as a data intelligence advisor throughout the customer journey.&nbsp; You will be actively involved in the entire sales cycle creating initial demand, progressing the opportunity through the technical and financial decision process, and ensuring adoption and expansion after the sale.&nbsp;</p>
<h3><strong>Collibra Public Sector Account Executive II, Federal at Collibra are responsible for</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>5+ years in a technical customer facing role, ideally supporting Enterprise Class customers in an SaaS environment.</li>
<li>Experience in Technical Account Management, Support or similar type of Premium or Signature Service organization dealing with Enterprise Software Application Support.</li>
<li>Experience troubleshooting web-based applications.</li>
<li>Experience with Java, REST API and SSO and a working knowledge of kubernetes, with VM, SQL, SSL, SSO, and LDAP a plus.</li>
<li>Experience and a strong interest in developing deep customer relationships while facilitating discussions about enterprise IT architecture.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Consistently exceeded assigned sales quotas.</li>
<li>Experience in the data storage or data management software industry.</li>
<li>7 + years experience calling on federal defense accounts in a field sales capacity.</li>
<li>Prior relationships with Departments of Defense/War, Army, Fourth Estate.</li>
<li>Originated and closed complex sales with multiple technical and business stakeholders.</li>
<li>Managed consultative sales processes, with value-based impacts or outcomes.</li>
<li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience.</li>
<li>US citizenship (required) and active security clearance (preferred).</li>
<li>Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.</li>
<li>Because this role supports the US government, it is required that this candidate be a US citizen who resides on US soil.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>You are</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Known for your integrity, and commitment to the customer.</li>
<li>Detail and results oriented – you work backwards from a goal using documented plans.</li>
<li>Composed, resourceful, and comfortable in high-growth high-expectation environments.</li>
<li>Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented.</li>
<li>A concise communicator, persuasive negotiator, collaborative seller.</li>
<li>Proud of your work and aim for excellence.</li>
<li>Flexible to travel as required.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Measures of success</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Within your first month, you will have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers.</li>
<li>Within your third month, you will be building a pipeline of business in your assigned territory.</li>
<li>Within your sixth month, you will have solid foundation of prospective clients who you will be close to closing.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Compensation for this role</strong></h3>
<p>The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>Benefits at Collibra</h3>
<p>Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about <a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/benefits">Collibra’s benefits</a>.</p>
<p>We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/dei">diversity, equity, and inclusion</a> at Collibra.</p>
<p>At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.</p>
<p>With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.collibra.com/us/en/company/careers/accommodations">Accommodations for Applicants form</a>.</p></div>

      <title>Tailscale: Head of Communications</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country>🇨🇦 Canada</country>
      <state>California</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6643/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://tailscale.com/">https://tailscale.com/</a>
</p>

<div>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function. This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.</p>
<p>Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure. We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure. We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.</p>
<p>Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO. You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.</p>
<p>This is a builder role for someone who combines strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You will initially be hands-on while hiring and developing a small, high-performing team. You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.</li>
<li>Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage. This should include sustained product storytelling between launches, including through independent reviews, technical publications, comparisons, creators, and third party validation. It could also include research-led PR.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Build strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, cybersecurity, and AI journalists, driving proactive media opportunities and increasing Tailscale's share of voice.</li>
<li>Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.</li>
<li>Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.</li>
<li>Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.</li>
<li>Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence. Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.</li>
<li>Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.</li>
<li>Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation. You should be able to improve processes over time as we scale.&nbsp;</li>

      <title>Apollo GraphQL: Senior Solution Engineer (Pre-sales)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Georgia</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Sales and Marketing</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6630/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, California, United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://apollographql.com">https://apollographql.com</a>
</p>

<p>At Apollo GraphQL, we’re on a mission to make it radically easier for engineering teams to ship fast, reliable products and services on top of the world’s data, powering everything from web to mobile to agentic experiences..</p>
<p>We’re looking for a Senior Solution Engineer who loves stepping into business‑critical challenges and turning them into clear, elegant architectures that customers can’t wait to build. As a Senior SE, you’ll be the technical quarterback on some of our most important opportunities: partnering with prospects and customers to design and scale their supergraph on GraphOS, and helping them prove out real impact in production.</p>
<p>You’ll join a tight‑knit global SE team that collaborates closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering—so the work you do doesn’t just close deals, it directly shapes Apollo’s roadmap and how we show up in the market.</p>
<p>At its core, this role connects customer problems, Apollo’s capabilities, and value: uncovering the real problem, translating technical options into business outcomes, building technical confidence, and reducing buying risk.</p>
<h2>What you’ll do</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Own complex technical evaluations</strong> for strategic new and existing accounts: lead discovery, workshops, and solution design to deeply understand customer APIs, architectures, and constraints, and turn them into clear required capabilities and technical win plans.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Design and present multi‑system solution architectures</strong> that show how Apollo’s supergraph, GraphOS, and tooling fit into modern cloud‑native environments —meeting customers where they are while charting a safe, future‑proof path forward.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Lead compelling, value‑focused demos and PoCs</strong>, translating complex technical capabilities into simple, business‑aligned stories for audiences ranging from lead developers and architects to VP/C‑suite decision makers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>De‑risk and win complex deals</strong> by anticipating and resolving technical blockers (security, compliance, integration, performance), building customer confidence that Apollo will work in their environment, and partnering with AEs on value‑based selling, and close strategy.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Partner tightly with Sales, CS, Product, and Engineering</strong>: act as a trusted advisor throughout the account lifecycle, feed structured field insight back into roadmap and positioning, and contribute reusable reference architectures, playbooks, and patterns that the broader team can use at scale.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Elevate the team through enablement and AI‑augmented workflows</strong>: mentor junior SEs, share best practices, and actively use AI tooling (including agentic/MCP‑based workflows) to improve discovery, architecture design, and demo/PoC execution.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Who you are</h2>
<p>You’re an experienced, hands‑on Solutions Engineer (or architect in a similar customer‑facing role) who loves sitting at the intersection of code, architecture, and commercial impact. You’re just as comfortable whiteboarding a distributed system with staff engineers as you are explaining the “so what?” to a VP of Engineering or CIO, and you thrive when you can roll up your sleeves on a PoC, earn technical trust, and guide a customer from “evaluation” to “we can’t imagine building without this.”</p>
<p>You see Solutions Engineering as part of the go‑to‑market engine: your purpose is not just to “be technical” but to help progress qualified opportunities toward successful outcomes—new ARR, healthy renewals, and meaningful expansions.</p>
<h2>Minimum requirements</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>4+ years</strong> in a pre‑sales Solutions Engineering or equivalent technical customer‑facing role (sales engineer, field engineer, customer engineer, or architect) working on complex B2B SaaS or infrastructure products.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Deep domain expertise around APIs and integration</strong>, with prior experience working both with teams who build APIs and with teams who consume them, integrating into existing architectures and tool stacks (CI/CD, observability, cloud, API gateways, etc.).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Strong architecture and integration skills across modern web/cloud stacks</strong>—comfortable discussing REST/GraphQL, microservices, identity/security, and data flows, and designing multi‑system architectures that can be implemented in real‑world environments.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Proven track record owning complex technical evaluations end‑to‑end</strong>, including discovery, solution design, PoC implementation guidance, objection handling, and technical win for enterprise or upper‑mid‑market accounts.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Executive‑level communication and storytelling skills</strong>: able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and clear business value for developers, architects, product leaders, and executives, and to act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Sales process and value‑based selling fluency</strong>: comfortable with MEDDPICC, team selling with AEs/CS, and framing Apollo’s capabilities in terms of commercial impact.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Collaborative, low‑ego teammate</strong> who works well across Sales, Product, Engineering, and CS, mentors less‑tenured SEs, and prefers creating reusable assets over one‑off work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>Nice to have</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Hands‑on GraphQL experience</strong>, ideally including schema design, federation, or operating production GraphQL services—whether from a previous SE role, as an engineer, or through meaningful side projects.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Background as a <strong>software engineer or architect</strong>, with the ability to read code, reason about performance and scalability trade‑offs, and pair productively with customer engineering teams.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Experience selling or implementing <strong>developer‑focused platforms</strong> (APIs, integration platforms, data/analytics, observability, or adjacent infra) into large or regulated enterprises.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with common <strong>security, compliance, and networking</strong> topics that come up in enterprise evaluations (SSO, RBAC, data residency, SOC 2, VPC/networking patterns).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort in <strong>fast‑moving, high‑growth environments</strong>, where you help shape the playbook (including via AI/agentic tooling) rather than just follow it, and enjoy contributing to content, enablement, and broader GTM strategy.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>About Apollo</h3>
<p>Apollo helps teams build, operate, and scale the graphs that power modern applications. If you’ve streamed a show, booked a trip, or read the news online, there’s a good chance Apollo was working quietly behind the scenes. We support some of the largest and most sophisticated GraphQL platforms in the world.</p>
<p>But we’re not here just to maintain the status quo. Apollo is redefining how software teams build and ship - bringing clarity, speed, and leverage to increasingly complex systems. Our platform gives teams a single, coherent way to connect clients, services, and now AI-powered experiences, without drowning in endpoints or bespoke integrations.</p>
<p>Just as importantly, we’re building a company where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. That means meaningful ownership, smart teammates, and tackling hard problems that actually matter. If you like moving fast, thinking deeply, and helping shape what comes next, you’ll feel right at home here.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/apollo-graphql-senior-solution-engineer-pre-sales">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/apollo-graphql-senior-solution-engineer-pre-sales</a></p>
</description>

<p>As the Principal Product Manager for ClickHouse Cloud, you will be responsible for leading the development and delivery of the product working closely with engineering, customers, and stakeholders.</p>
<p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p>

<p><strong>About You:</strong></p>

<li>
<p>Hands-on experience with SQL and strong understanding of query execution, indexing strategies, partitioning, and performance tuning.</p>

<li>

<li>
<p>Understanding of modern data infrastructure: data lakes, ETL pipelines, CDC and data orchestration frameworks.</p>

<li>
<p>Demonstrated ability to work with engineering on low-level technical topics, such as schema management, query planning, storage engines, schema design.</p>

<li>
<p>Experience designing and delivering features such as database replication, consistency models, and backup/restore workflows.</p>

<li>
<p>Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying deep technical topics for non-technical audiences.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p>
